local a = (function()
    local a = game:GetService("TweenService")

    local k = {}
    k.Flags = {}
    k.Windows = {}
    local function l(m, n)
        local o = {}
        if type(m) == "string" then
            o.Name = m
        elseif type(m) == "table" then
            for p, q in pairs(m) do
                o[p] = q
            end
        end
        for p, q in pairs(n or {}) do
            if o[q] == nil and o[p] ~= nil then
                o[q] = o[p]
            end
        end
        if o.Range then
            o.Min = o.Min or o.Range[1]
            o.Max = o.Max or o.Range[2]
        end
        return o
    end
    local function m(n, o, p, q, r)
        p._type = r
        p._frame = q
        p._listeners = p._listeners or {}
        local s = n and n.Window
        local t = o.Name or o.Text or o.Title
        p._searchName = type(t) == "string" and t or ""
        p._searchKey = string.lower(p._searchName)
        if n and n._items then
            table.insert(n._items, p)
        end
        if o.Flag then
            k.Flags[o.Flag] = p
            if s then
                s:_flagCreated(o.Flag, p)
            end
        end
        p._userVisible = o.Visible ~= false
        function p:IsVisible()
            return p._userVisible
        end
        function p:_isShown()
            return p._userVisible and not (n and n._userVisible == false)
        end
        function p:SetVisible(u)
            u = u and true or false
            if u == p._userVisible or p._destroyed then
                return
            end
            p._userVisible = u
            if not u then
                if p._onHide then
                    p._onHide()
                end
                if p.Open and type(p.SetOpen) == "function" then
                    p:SetOpen(false)
                end
            end
            if q then
                q.Visible = u
            end
            if s then
                s._controlsDirty = true
            end
        end
        if q and not p._userVisible then
            q.Visible = false
        end
        function p:SetTooltip(u)
            p._tooltip = u
            if q and s and not p._tooltipBound then
                p._tooltipBound = true
                s:_attachTooltip(p, q)
            end
        end
        function p:GetTooltip()
            return p._tooltip
        end
        if o.Tooltip ~= nil and o.Tooltip ~= false then
            p:SetTooltip(o.Tooltip)
        end
        function p:Destroy()
            if p._destroyed then
                return
            end
            p._destroyed = true
            if s and s._tipOwner == p then
                s:_hideTooltip()
            end
            for u, v in ipairs(p._listeners) do
                v()
            end
            p._listeners = {}
            if n and n._items then
                local u = table.find(n._items, p)
                if u then
                    table.remove(n._items, u)
                end
            end
            if o.Flag and k.Flags[o.Flag] == p then
                k.Flags[o.Flag] = nil
            end
            if s then
                s._controlsDirty = true
            end
            if q then
                q:Destroy()
            end
        end
        return p
    end
    k.Theme = {

        return {

            AccentDark = o(table.unpack(x)),
            Text = o(table.unpack(y)),
            Muted = o(table.unpack(z)),
        }
    end

    -- ======================================================================================
    -- THEME ENGINE v2
    -- * every theme token is kept on its own unique colour, so the colour -> token lookup that
    --   drives live re-theming can never confuse two tokens (or a token with pure white/black)
    -- * k._themeClean always holds the colours exactly as the user / preset specified them
    -- * palette generator, light themes, share codes, status colours per theme
    -- ======================================================================================
    k.ThemeTransition = 0.3
    k._themeClean = table.clone(k.Theme)
    k._themeBuiltin = {}
    k._themeCustom = {}
    k._themeOrder = {
        "Noir", "Midnight", "Nebula", "Synthwave", "Sakura", "Velvet", "Rose", "Crimson", "Sunset", "Amber",
        "Gold", "Cyber", "Toxic", "Matcha", "Emerald", "Aurora", "Ocean", "Frost", "Abyss", "Mono",
        "Halloween", "Haunted", "Christmas", "Valentine", "Lunar", "Tropical", "Dracula", "Coffee",
        "Slate", "GitHub", "Nord", "Gruvbox", "Tokyo", "Mocha", "OneDark", "Monokai", "RosePine", "Solar",
        "Light", "Snow", "Paper", "Latte", "Dawn", "Mint", "SolarLight",
    }
    k._ThemeKit = (function()
        local Http = game:GetService("HttpService")
        local Kit = {}
        local TOKENS = {
            "Accent", "AccentDark", "Background", "Surface", "Surface2", "Surface3", "Stroke", "StrokeHover",
            "Text", "Muted", "Warning", "Success", "Error",
        }
        local PRESET_SLOTS = {
            "Background", "Surface", "Surface2", "Surface3", "Stroke", "StrokeHover", "Accent", "AccentDark", "Text",
            "Muted", "Warning", "Success", "Error",
        }
        -- when two tokens land on the same colour the one listed first keeps it
        local PRIORITY = {
            "Background", "Surface", "Surface2", "Surface3", "Stroke", "StrokeHover", "Text", "Muted", "Accent",
            "AccentDark", "Warning", "Success", "Error",
        }
        local WHITE, BLACK = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
        -- colours the UI paints literally (pure white / black and the "inert" colours) must never be claimed by a token
        local RESERVED = {
            Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255), Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 254), Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0),
            Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 1), Color3.fromRGB(1, 2, 3),
        }

        local function bytes(c)
            return math.clamp(math.floor(c.R * 255 + 0.5), 0, 255),
                math.clamp(math.floor(c.G * 255 + 0.5), 0, 255),
                math.clamp(math.floor(c.B * 255 + 0.5), 0, 255)
        end
        local function keyOf(c)
            local r, g, b = bytes(c)
            return r * 65536 + g * 256 + b
        end
        Kit.Tokens = TOKENS
        Kit.key = keyOf

        function Kit.hex(c)
            local r, g, b = bytes(c)
            return string.format("#%02X%02X%02X", r, g, b)
        end

        -- Color3 | "#RGB" | "#RRGGBB" | "RRGGBB" | "r, g, b" | { r, g, b } | { R =, G =, B = } | { Hex = } -> Color3 or nil
        function Kit.parse(v)
            if typeof(v) == "Color3" then
                return v
            elseif type(v) == "string" then
                local s = v:gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
                local h = s:match("^#?(%x+)$")
                if h then
                    if #h == 3 then
                        if s:sub(1, 1) ~= "#" then
                            return nil -- plain words such as "add" or "bed" are not colours
                        end
                        local r, g, b = h:match("^(%x)(%x)(%x)$")
                        return Color3.fromRGB(tonumber(r .. r, 16), tonumber(g .. g, 16), tonumber(b .. b, 16))
                    elseif #h == 6 or #h == 8 then
                        return Color3.fromRGB(
                            tonumber(h:sub(1, 2), 16),
                            tonumber(h:sub(3, 4), 16),
                            tonumber(h:sub(5, 6), 16)
                        )
                    end
                    return nil
                end
                local r, g, b = s:match("^rgb%(%s*(%d+)%s*,%s*(%d+)%s*,%s*(%d+)%s*%)$")
                if not r then
                    r, g, b = s:match("^(%d+)%s*,%s*(%d+)%s*,%s*(%d+)$")
                end
                if r then
                    return Color3.fromRGB(math.min(255, tonumber(r)), math.min(255, tonumber(g)), math.min(255, tonumber(b)))
                end
            elseif type(v) == "table" then
                local r, g, b = v[1] or v.R or v.r, v[2] or v.G or v.g, v[3] or v.B or v.b
                if tonumber(r) and tonumber(g) and tonumber(b) then
                    return Color3.fromRGB(
                        math.clamp(tonumber(r), 0, 255),
                        math.clamp(tonumber(g), 0, 255),
                        math.clamp(tonumber(b), 0, 255)
                    )
                end
                if type(v.Hex) == "string" then
                    return Kit.parse(v.Hex)
                end
            end
            return nil
        end

        local function lin(c)
            if c <= 0.04045 then
                return c / 12.92
            end
            return ((c + 0.055) / 1.055) ^ 2.4
        end
        function Kit.luminance(c)
            return 0.2126 * lin(c.R) + 0.7152 * lin(c.G) + 0.0722 * lin(c.B)
        end
        function Kit.contrast(a, b)
            local la, lb = Kit.luminance(a), Kit.luminance(b)
            if la < lb then
                la, lb = lb, la
            end
            return (la + 0.05) / (lb + 0.05)
        end
        function Kit.isLight(c)
            return Kit.luminance(c) > 0.179
        end
        local function mix(a, b, t)
            return Color3.new(
                math.clamp(a.R + (b.R - a.R) * t, 0, 1),
                math.clamp(a.G + (b.G - a.G) * t, 0, 1),
                math.clamp(a.B + (b.B - a.B) * t, 0, 1)
            )
        end
        Kit.mix = mix

        -- readable text / icon colour for anything painted in colour c (keeps c's hue)
        function Kit.onColor(c)
            local dark = mix(c, BLACK, 0.9)
            local pale = mix(c, WHITE, 0.93)
            if Kit.contrast(dark, c) >= Kit.contrast(pale, c) then
                return dark
            end
            return pale
        end

        local STATUS_DARK = {
            Warning = Color3.fromRGB(240, 176, 108),
            Success = Color3.fromRGB(150, 220, 170),
            Error = Color3.fromRGB(240, 120, 120),
        }
        local STATUS_LIGHT = {
            Warning = Color3.fromRGB(181, 100, 0),
            Success = Color3.fromRGB(22, 128, 64),
            Error = Color3.fromRGB(200, 40, 40),
        }
        function Kit.status(light)
            return light and STATUS_LIGHT or STATUS_DARK
        end

        -- Builds a complete, coherent palette from a Background and an Accent (everything else is derived).
        -- Any token passed in opts is kept as given. opts.Light forces light/dark, opts.Tint (0..1) is how much
        -- of the accent hue bleeds into surfaces, borders and text.
        function Kit.generate(opts)
            opts = type(opts) == "table" and opts or {}
            local base = k._themeClean
            local bg = Kit.parse(opts.Background) or base.Background
            local accent = Kit.parse(opts.Accent) or base.Accent
            local light = opts.Light
            if light == nil then
                light = Kit.isLight(bg)
            end
            local tint = math.clamp(tonumber(opts.Tint) or 0.5, 0, 1)
            local out = { Background = bg, Accent = accent }
            local text
            if light then
                local ink = mix(BLACK, accent, tint * 0.3)
                out.Surface = mix(bg, WHITE, 0.5)
                out.Surface2 = mix(bg, WHITE, 0.8)
                out.Surface3 = mix(bg, ink, 0.07)
                out.Stroke = mix(bg, ink, 0.12)
                out.StrokeHover = mix(mix(bg, ink, 0.4), accent, 0.15)
                text = mix(BLACK, accent, tint * 0.12)
            else
                local lift = mix(WHITE, accent, tint * 0.45)
                out.Surface = mix(bg, lift, 0.025)
                out.Surface2 = mix(bg, lift, 0.055)
                out.Surface3 = mix(bg, lift, 0.12)
                out.Stroke = mix(bg, lift, 0.105)
                out.StrokeHover = mix(bg, lift, 0.36)
                text = mix(WHITE, accent, tint * 0.1)
            end
            out.Text = text
            local muted = mix(bg, text, light and 0.62 or 0.52)
            for _ = 1, 8 do
                if Kit.contrast(muted, bg) >= 4 then
                    break
                end
                muted = mix(muted, text, 0.12)
            end
            out.Muted = muted
            out.AccentDark = Kit.onColor(accent)
            local st = Kit.status(light)
            out.Warning, out.Success, out.Error = st.Warning, st.Success, st.Error
            for _, token in ipairs(TOKENS) do
                local override = Kit.parse(opts[token])
                if override then
                    out[token] = override
                end
            end
            return out
        end

        -- what else should move when the user edits one colour with "Smart Colors" on
        function Kit.smart(token, color, current)
            local set = { [token] = color }
            if token == "Accent" then
                set.AccentDark = Kit.onColor(color)
            elseif token == "Background" then
                local gen = Kit.generate({ Background = color, Accent = current.Accent })
                for _, t in ipairs({ "Surface", "Surface2", "Surface3", "Stroke", "StrokeHover" }) do
                    set[t] = gen[t]
                end
                if Kit.isLight(current.Background) ~= Kit.isLight(color) then
                    for _, t in ipairs({ "Text", "Muted", "Warning", "Success", "Error" }) do
                        set[t] = gen[t]
                    end
                end
            end
            return set
        end

        -- Gives every token its own colour: the ones in PRIORITY keep their exact colour, later duplicates (and anything
        -- equal to a reserved literal colour) are moved by a single unnoticeable step.
        function Kit.resolve(clean)
            local taken = {}
            for _, c in ipairs(RESERVED) do
                taken[keyOf(c)] = true
            end
            local out = {}
            for _, token in ipairs(PRIORITY) do
                local c = clean[token]
                if typeof(c) == "Color3" then
                    local r, g, b = bytes(c)
                    local kk = r * 65536 + g * 256 + b
                    if taken[kk] then
                        local dir = (r + g + b) < 382 and 1 or -1
                        local found = false
                        for step = 1, 16 do
                            for _, ch in ipairs({ 3, 2, 1 }) do
                                local nr, ng, nb = r, g, b
                                if ch == 3 then
                                    nb = math.clamp(b + dir * step, 0, 255)
                                elseif ch == 2 then
                                    ng = math.clamp(g + dir * step, 0, 255)
                                else
                                    nr = math.clamp(r + dir * step, 0, 255)
                                end
                                local nk = nr * 65536 + ng * 256 + nb
                                if not taken[nk] then
                                    r, g, b, kk, found = nr, ng, nb, nk, true
                                    break
                                end
                            end
                            if found then
                                break
                            end
                        end
                        if found then
                            c = Color3.fromRGB(r, g, b)
                        end
                    end
                    taken[kk] = true
                    out[token] = c
                end
            end
            return out
        end

        -- preset helpers -----------------------------------------------------------------
        function Kit.make(list)
            local t = {}
            for i, name in ipairs(PRESET_SLOTS) do
                local v = list[i]
                if v then
                    t[name] = Color3.fromRGB(v[1], v[2], v[3])
                end
            end
            return t
        end
        -- fills the tokens a preset does not define (status colours follow the preset's brightness)
        function Kit.complete(preset)
            local out = table.clone(preset)
            local st = Kit.status(Kit.isLight(out.Background or k._themeClean.Background))
            for _, t in ipairs({ "Warning", "Success", "Error" }) do
                if out[t] == nil then
                    out[t] = st[t]
                end
            end
            return out
        end

        -- share codes: "airtheme:" .. base64(json) -------------------------------------------
        local B64 = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/"
        local B64Index = {}
        for i = 1, #B64 do
            B64Index[B64:byte(i)] = i - 1
        end
        local function b64encode(data)
            local out = {}
            for i = 1, #data, 3 do
                local b1, b2, b3 = data:byte(i, i + 2)
                local n = b1 * 65536 + (b2 or 0) * 256 + (b3 or 0)
                local c1 = bit32.extract(n, 18, 6) + 1
                local c2 = bit32.extract(n, 12, 6) + 1
                local c3 = bit32.extract(n, 6, 6) + 1
                local c4 = bit32.extract(n, 0, 6) + 1
                out[#out + 1] = B64:sub(c1, c1)
                    .. B64:sub(c2, c2)
                    .. (b2 and B64:sub(c3, c3) or "=")
                    .. (b3 and B64:sub(c4, c4) or "=")
            end
            return table.concat(out)
        end
        local function b64decode(data)
            data = data:gsub("[^%w%+/=]", "")
            local out = {}
            for i = 1, #data, 4 do
                local c1, c2, c3, c4 = data:byte(i, i + 3)
                local n1, n2 = B64Index[c1], B64Index[c2]
                if n1 == nil or n2 == nil then
                    return nil
                end
                local n3 = (c3 and c3 ~= 61) and B64Index[c3] or nil
                local n4 = (c4 and c4 ~= 61) and B64Index[c4] or nil
                local n = n1 * 262144 + n2 * 4096 + (n3 or 0) * 64 + (n4 or 0)
                out[#out + 1] = string.char(bit32.extract(n, 16, 8))
                if n3 then
                    out[#out + 1] = string.char(bit32.extract(n, 8, 8))
                end
                if n4 then
                    out[#out + 1] = string.char(bit32.extract(n, 0, 8))
                end
            end
            return table.concat(out)
        end

        function Kit.encode(tokens, name)
            local colors = {}
            for _, t in ipairs(TOKENS) do
                local c = tokens[t]
                if typeof(c) == "Color3" then
                    colors[t] = Kit.hex(c)
                end
            end
            local ok, json = pcall(function()
                return Http:JSONEncode({ v = 1, name = type(name) == "string" and name or nil, colors = colors })
            end)
            if not ok or type(json) ~= "string" then
                return nil
            end
            return "airtheme:" .. b64encode(json)
        end
        function Kit.decode(code)
            if type(code) ~= "string" then
                return nil, "not a theme code"
            end
            code = code:gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
            local json
            local body = code:match("^[Aa][Ii][Rr][Tt][Hh][Ee][Mm][Ee]:(.+)$")
            if body then
                json = b64decode(body)
            elseif code:sub(1, 1) == "{" then
                json = code
            end
            if not json or json == "" then
                return nil, "not a theme code"
            end
            local ok, data = pcall(function()
                return Http:JSONDecode(json)
            end)
            if not ok or type(data) ~= "table" then
                return nil, "theme code is corrupted"
            end
            local src = type(data.colors) == "table" and data.colors or data
            local tokens, count = {}, 0
            for _, t in ipairs(TOKENS) do
                local c = Kit.parse(src[t])
                if c then
                    tokens[t] = c
                    count += 1
                end
            end
            if count == 0 then
                return nil, "theme code has no colours"
            end
            local name = type(data.name) == "string" and data.name:sub(1, 40) or nil
            return tokens, name
        end
        return Kit
    end)()

    function k:LoadFont(v)
        v = l(v, {})
        if type(writefile) ~= "function" or type(isfile) ~= "function" or typeof(getcustomasset) ~= "function" then
            warn([[[AirFlow] custom fonts need writefile, isfile and getcustomasset]])
            return false
        end
        local w = v.Name or "CustomFont"
        local x = v.Weights or t[w]
        if type(x) ~= "table" then
            warn("[AirFlow] no font weights for " .. w)
            return false
        end
        local y = v.Folder or "AirFlowFonts"
        pcall(function()
            if type(isfolder) == "function" and type(makefolder) == "function" and not isfolder(y) then
                makefolder(y)
            end
        end)
        local z = {}
        for A, B in pairs(x) do
            local C = u[A]
            if C then
                local D = y .. "/" .. w .. "-" .. A .. ".ttf"
                local E = true
                if not isfile(D) then
                    E = pcall(function()
                        writefile(D, game:HttpGet(B))
                    end)
                end
                if E then
                    table.insert(z, { name = A, weight = C[1], style = "normal", assetId = getcustomasset(D) })
                else
                    warn("[AirFlow] could not download " .. A .. " weight of " .. w)
                end
            end
        end
        if #z == 0 then
            return false
        end
        local A = y .. "/" .. w .. ".json"
        local B = pcall(function()
            writefile(A, e:JSONEncode({ name = w, faces = z }))
        end)
        if not B then
            return false
        end
        local C = getcustomasset(A)
        local function D(E, F)
            local G = u[E]
            if G and x[E] then
                return Font.new(C, G[2])
            end
            return F
        end
        k.Fonts.Regular = D("Regular", k.Fonts.Regular)
        k.Fonts.Medium = D("Medium", D("Regular", k.Fonts.Medium))
        k.Fonts.Bold = D("SemiBold", D("Bold", k.Fonts.Bold))
        return true
    end
    function k:PreloadIcons()
        return s() ~= false
    end
    local function v(w)
        if type(w) == "number" then
            return "rbxassetid://" .. string.format("%.0f", w)
        end
        if type(w) == "string" then
            if w:match("^%d+$") then
                return "rbxassetid://" .. w
            end
            if w:find("^rbxassetid://") or w:find("^rbxasset://") or w:find("^rbxthumb://") or w:find("^http") then
                return w
            end
        end
        return nil
    end
    local function w(x)
        if x == k.Assets.Logo and k._logoUrl ~= nil then
            x = k._logoUrl or "wind"
        end
        if typeof(x) == "table" then
            return v(x.Image) or x.Image, x.RectOffset, x.RectSize, true, x.Tint == true
        end
        local y = v(x)
        if y then
            return y, nil, nil, true, false
        end
        if type(x) ~= "string" then
            return nil
        end
        local z = x:gsub("^lucide:", "")
        local A = s()
        if not A then
            return nil
        end
        local B = (A.Icons and A.Icons[z]) or A[z]
        if type(B) == "table" then
            local C = B.Image
            if type(C) == "number" then
                C = "rbxassetid://" .. tostring(C)
            end
            local D = (A.Spritesheets and A.Spritesheets[tostring(C)]) or C
            return D, B.ImageRectPosition, B.ImageRectSize
        elseif type(B) == "string" then
            return B
        end
        warn("[AirFlow] unknown lucide icon: " .. z)
        return nil
    end

    local Q = {}

    local function X(Y, Z)
        for _ in pairs(Y) do
            if _.Parent == nil then
                if U[_] then
                    Y[_] = nil
                    U[_] = nil
                    if Z then
                        V -= 1
                    end
                else
                    U[_] = true
                end
            else
                U[_] = nil
            end
        end
    end
    local function Y()
        X(R, true)
        X(S, false)
        W = math.max(4000, V * 2)
    end
    local function Z(_)
        return math.floor(_.R * 255 + 0.5) .. "," .. math.floor(_.G * 255 + 0.5) .. "," .. math.floor(_.B * 255 + 0.5)
    end
    local function _()
        table.clear(T)
        -- every token gets its own colour (see THEME ENGINE v2) before the lookup is rebuilt
        local resolved = k._ThemeKit.resolve(k._themeClean)
        for ab, ac in pairs(resolved) do
            k.Theme[ab] = ac
        end
        for aa = #n, 1, -1 do
            local ab = n[aa]
            T[Z(k.Theme[ab])] = ab
        end
    end
    _()
    local function aa(ab, ac)
        for ad, ae in pairs(ac) do
            if typeof(ae) == "Color3" then
                local af = T[Z(ae)]
                local ag = R[ab]
                if af then
                    if not ag then
                        ag = {}
                        R[ab] = ag
                        V += 1
                        if V >= W then
                            Y()
                        end
                    end
                    ag[ad] = af
                elseif ag then
                    ag[ad] = nil
                end
            end
        end
    end
    local ab = table.clone(k.Theme)
    local ac = nil
    local function ad(ae, af, ag)
        for ah, ai in pairs(af) do
            local aj = ag[ai]
            if aj then
                ae[ah] = aj
            end
        end
    end
    local function ae(af)
        for ag, ah in pairs(R) do
            pcall(ad, ag, ah, af)
        end
    end
    local function af(ag)
        if ac then
            ac:Disconnect()
            ac = nil
        end
        local ah, ai = {}, {}
        for aj, ak in ipairs(n) do
            local al = k.Theme[ak]
            local am = ab[ak] or al
            if am ~= al then
                ah[ak] = am
                ai[ak] = am
            end
        end
        local function aj()
            for ak, al in ipairs(n) do
                ai[al] = k.Theme[al]
                ab[al] = k.Theme[al]
            end
            ae(ai)
        end
        if ag <= 0 or next(ah) == nil then
            aj()
            return
        end
        local ak = 0
        ac = d.Heartbeat:Connect(function(al)
            ak += al
            if ak >= ag then
                ac:Disconnect()
                ac = nil
                aj()
                return
            end
            local am = 1 - (1 - ak / ag) ^ 5
            for an, ao in pairs(ah) do
                local ap = ao:Lerp(k.Theme[an], am)
                ai[an] = ap
                ab[an] = ap
            end
            ae(ai)
        end)
    end
    local function ag(ah, ai)
        S[ah] = ai
        ai()
    end
    local function ah(ai, aj, ak, al, am, an)
        ak = ak or 0.2
        if not an then
            aa(ai, aj)
        end
        if ak <= 0 then
            for ao, ap in pairs(aj) do
                ai[ao] = ap
            end
            return nil
        end
        al = al or Enum.EasingStyle.Quart
        am = am or Enum.EasingDirection.Out
        local ao = ak .. al.Name .. am.Name
        local ap = Q[ao]
        if not ap then
            ap = TweenInfo.new(ak, al, am)
            Q[ao] = ap
        end
        local aq = a:Create(ai, ap, aj)
        aq:Play()
        return aq
    end
    local function ai(aj, ak, al)
        local am = Instance.new(aj)
        for an, ao in pairs(ak) do
            if an ~= "Parent" then
                am[an] = ao
            end
        end
        aa(am, ak)
        if al then
            for an, ao in ipairs(al) do
                ao.Parent = am
            end
        end
        if ak.Parent then
            am.Parent = ak.Parent
        end
        return am
    end

        end)
        return at
    end
    local function ao(ap)
        return ai(
            "Frame",
            {
                Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0),
                Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 1),
                BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
                BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                BorderSizePixel = 0,
                ZIndex = 0,
                Parent = ap,
            }
        )
    end
    local ap = 1.35
    local function aq(ar, as, at)
        local au, av, aw, ax, ay = w(as)
        if not au then
            return
        end
        ar.Image = au
        ar.ImageRectOffset = av or Vector2.zero
        ar.ImageRectSize = aw or Vector2.zero
        if as == A.Logo then
            ay = true
            k._logoLabels[ar] = true
            ah(ar, { ImageColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 254) }, 0)
        end
        local az = ax and not ay
        ar:SetAttribute("CustomIcon", az or nil)
        if az then
            ah(ar, { ImageColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1) }, 0)
        end
        local aA = ax and not at and as ~= A.Logo and (typeof(as) == "table" and tonumber(as.Scale) or ap) or 1
        local aB = ar:FindFirstChild("CustomIconScale")
        if aA ~= 1 then
            aB = aB or ai("UIScale", { Name = "CustomIconScale", Parent = ar })
            aB.Scale = aA
        elseif aB then
            aB:Destroy()
        end
    end
    local function logoApply()
        local img, off, size = w(k.Assets.Logo)
        if not img then
            return
        end
        for lbl in pairs(k._logoLabels) do
            if lbl.Parent then
                lbl.Image = img
                lbl.ImageRectOffset = off or Vector2.zero
                lbl.ImageRectSize = size or Vector2.zero
            end
        end
    end
    function k._resolveLogo(host)
        if k._logoState then
            return k._logoState
        end
        local state = { Done = false }
        k._logoState = state
        task.spawn(function()
            local t0 = os.clock()
            while host and not host.Parent and os.clock() - t0 < 3 do
                task.wait(0.05)
            end
            local okCP, cp = pcall(function()
                return game:GetService("ContentProvider")
            end)
            local probe = ai("ImageLabel", {
                Name = "LogoProbe",
                Position = UDim2.fromOffset(-8, -8),
                Size = UDim2.fromOffset(2, 2),
                BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                ImageTransparency = 0.98,
                Parent = host,
            })
            local weak
            for _, src in ipairs(k.LogoSources) do
                probe.Image = src
                local status
                if okCP then
                    pcall(function()
                        cp:PreloadAsync({ probe }, function(_, st)
                            status = st
                        end)
                    end)
                end
                if status ~= Enum.AssetFetchStatus.Failure and status ~= Enum.AssetFetchStatus.TimedOut then
                    local t1 = os.clock()
                    while not probe.IsLoaded and os.clock() - t1 < 1.5 do
                        task.wait(0.05)
                    end
                    if probe.IsLoaded then
                        k._logoUrl = src
                        break
                    end
                    if status == Enum.AssetFetchStatus.Success then
                        weak = weak or src
                    end
                end
            end
            if k._logoUrl == nil then
                k._logoUrl = weak or false
                if not weak then
                    warn("[AirFlow] logo could not be loaded, using fallback icon")
                end
            end
            probe:Destroy()
            state.Done = true
            logoApply()
        end)
        return state
    end
    local function ar(as, at, au, av)
        if as:GetAttribute("CustomIcon") then
            ah(as, { ImageTransparency = au and 0 or 0.4 }, av)
        else
            ah(as, { ImageColor3 = at }, av)
        end
    end
    -- ===== UI host system (executor aware) =====
    -- Decides where the ScreenGui lives (gethui / CoreGui / PlayerGui), protects it, keeps it alive,
    -- replaces stale windows after a re-execute and exposes the detected executor capabilities.
    do
        local host = {}
        k._host = host
        host.Mode = "Auto"
        host.Modes = { "Auto", "Hidden", "CoreGui", "PlayerGui" }
        host._session = tostring(os.clock()) .. "-" .. tostring(math.random(100000, 999999))

        -- looks a function up in getgenv / getfenv / _G / syn so every executor flavour is covered
        function host.Lookup(name)
            local found
            pcall(function()
                if typeof(getgenv) == "function" then
                    found = getgenv()[name]
                end
            end)
            if typeof(found) ~= "function" then
                pcall(function()
                    if typeof(getfenv) == "function" then
                        found = getfenv(0)[name]
                    end
                end)
            end
            if typeof(found) ~= "function" then
                pcall(function()
                    if type(_G) == "table" then
                        found = _G[name]
                    end
                end)
            end
            if typeof(found) ~= "function" then
                pcall(function()
                    if typeof(syn) == "table" then
                        found = syn[name]
                    end
                end)
            end
            if typeof(found) == "function" then
                return found
            end
            return nil
        end
        function host.First(...)
            for i = 1, select("#", ...) do
                local fn = host.Lookup((select(i, ...)))
                if fn then
                    return fn
                end
            end
            return nil
        end
        function host.Clone(inst)
            local cr = host.Lookup("cloneref")
            if cr and typeof(inst) == "Instance" then
                local ok, res = pcall(cr, inst)
                if ok and typeof(res) == "Instance" then
                    return res
                end
            end
            return inst
        end

        -- executor name / version / capability map (cached: an executor never changes mid-session)
        function host.Executor()
            if host._exec then
                return host._exec
            end
            local name, version
            pcall(function()
                local fn = host.First("identifyexecutor", "getexecutorname")
                if fn then
                    name, version = fn()
                end
            end)
            if type(name) ~= "string" or name == "" then
                name = d:IsStudio() and "Studio" or "Unknown"
            end
            local function has(...)
                return host.First(...) ~= nil
            end
            host._exec = {
                Name = name,
                Version = type(version) == "string" and version or nil,
                Features = {
                    Hidden = has("gethui"),
                    CloneRef = has("cloneref"),
                    Protect = has("protect_gui", "protectgui", "ProtectGui"),
                    Files = has("writefile") and has("readfile") and has("isfile"),
                    Folders = has("isfolder") and has("makefolder") and has("listfiles"),
                    Clipboard = has("setclipboard", "toclipboard"),
                    Http = has("request", "http_request"),
                    CustomAsset = has("getcustomasset", "getsynasset"),
                    Identity = has("setthreadidentity", "setidentity", "set_thread_identity"),
                    QueueOnTeleport = has("queue_on_teleport", "queueonteleport"),
                },
            }
            return host._exec
        end

        function host.NormalizeMode(mode)
            if type(mode) == "string" then
                local low = string.lower(mode)
                if low == "hidden" or low == "gethui" or low == "hui" then
                    return "Hidden"
                elseif low == "coregui" or low == "core" then
                    return "CoreGui"
                elseif low == "playergui" or low == "player" then
                    return "PlayerGui"
                end
            end
            return "Auto"
        end
        -- Auto = gethui -> CoreGui -> PlayerGui; an explicit mode goes first and the rest stay as fallback
        function host.Order(mode)
            mode = host.NormalizeMode(mode)
            local order = { "Hidden", "CoreGui", "PlayerGui" }
            if mode == "Auto" then
                return order
            end
            local list = { mode }
            for _, name in ipairs(order) do
                if name ~= mode then
                    list[#list + 1] = name
                end
            end
            return list
        end

        local getters = {
            Hidden = function()
                local fn = host.Lookup("gethui")
                if not fn then
                    return nil
                end
                local ok, res = pcall(fn)
                if ok and typeof(res) == "Instance" then
                    return res
                end
                return nil
            end,
            CoreGui = function()
                local ok, res = pcall(function()
                    return host.Clone(game:GetService("CoreGui"))
                end)
                if ok then
                    return res
                end
                return nil
            end,
            PlayerGui = function()
                return j:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui") or j:WaitForChild("PlayerGui", 5)
            end,
        }
        -- runs `fn` once; if it fails it is retried at a higher thread identity (low identity executors cannot touch CoreGui)
        local function elevated(fn)
            if fn() then
                return true
            end
            local setId = host.First("setthreadidentity", "setidentity", "set_thread_identity")
            if not setId then
                return false
            end
            local getId = host.First("getthreadidentity", "getidentity", "get_thread_identity")
            local prev
            if getId then
                local ok, val = pcall(getId)
                if ok and type(val) == "number" then
                    prev = val
                end
            end
            pcall(setId, 8)
            local done = fn()
            if prev then
                pcall(setId, prev)
            end
            return done
        end
        -- a container is usable only if a child can really be created inside it
        local function usable(inst)
            if typeof(inst) ~= "Instance" then
                return false
            end
            return elevated(function()
                return (pcall(function()
                    local probe = Instance.new("Folder")
                    probe.Parent = inst
                    probe:Destroy()
                end))
            end)
        end
        -- first usable container for a mode (kept for callers that only need the Instance)
        function host.Get(mode)
            for _, name in ipairs(host.Order(mode or host.Mode)) do
                local ok, inst = pcall(getters[name])
                if ok and usable(inst) then
                    return inst, name
                end
            end
            return j:WaitForChild("PlayerGui"), "PlayerGui"
        end

        function host.Protect(gui)
            local fn = host.First("protect_gui", "protectgui", "ProtectGui")
            if fn then
                return (pcall(fn, gui))
            end
            return false
        end

        function host._parent(gui, inst)
            return elevated(function()
                if not pcall(function()
                    gui.Parent = inst
                end) then
                    return false
                end
                local ok, now = pcall(function()
                    return gui.Parent
                end)
                return ok and now == inst
            end)
        end

        function host.Place(gui, opts, mode)
            opts = opts or {}
            if mode == nil and typeof(opts.Parent) == "Instance" then
                if host._parent(gui, opts.Parent) then
                    return { Mode = "Custom", Instance = opts.Parent }
                end
                warn("[AirFlow] the custom Parent was rejected, falling back to the executor host")
            end
            for _, name in ipairs(host.Order(mode or opts.Host or host.Mode)) do
                local ok, inst = pcall(getters[name])
                if ok and usable(inst) and host._parent(gui, inst) then
                    return { Mode = name, Instance = inst }
                end
            end
            return nil
        end

        function host._finish(gui, info)
            if info.Mode == "CoreGui" or info.Mode == "Hidden" then
                -- keep the UI above the blur Roblox draws behind its own menu
                pcall(function()
                    gui.OnTopOfCoreBlur = true
                end)
            end
        end

        -- moves an existing window to another host (or re-attaches it after something removed it)
        function host.Remount(gui, win, mode)
            win._hostMoving = true
            local ok, info = pcall(host.Place, gui, win._hostOpts, mode)
            win._hostMoving = false
            if ok and info then
                info.Protected = win.HostInfo and win.HostInfo.Protected or false
                host._finish(gui, info)
                win.HostInfo = info
                return info
            end
            return nil
        end

        -- if the container gets wiped the gui is re-attached; if the gui itself was destroyed the window is cleaned up
        function host.Watch(gui, win)
            local moves, since = 0, os.clock()
            local conn = gui.AncestryChanged:Connect(function(_, parent)
                if parent ~= nil or win._destroyed or win._hostMoving then
                    return
                end
                task.defer(function()
                    if win._destroyed or win._hostMoving then
                        return
                    end
                    local okNow, now = pcall(function()
                        return gui.Parent
                    end)
                    if okNow and now ~= nil then
                        return
                    end
                    if os.clock() - since > 10 then
                        moves, since = 0, os.clock()
                    end
                    moves = moves + 1
                    if moves <= 4 and host.Remount(gui, win) then
                        return
                    end
                    pcall(function()
                        win:Destroy()
                    end)
                end)
            end)
            table.insert(win._connections, conn)
            return conn
        end

        function host.Mount(gui, opts, win)
            opts = opts or {}
            local protected = host.Protect(gui)
            pcall(function()
                gui.AutoLocalize = false
            end)
            local info = host.Place(gui, opts)
            if not info then
                local pg = j:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
                pcall(function()
                    gui.Parent = pg
                end)
                info = { Mode = "PlayerGui", Instance = pg }
                warn("[AirFlow] no executor host could be used, the UI was placed in PlayerGui")
            end
            info.Protected = protected
            host._finish(gui, info)
            if win then
                win.HostInfo = info
                win._hostOpts = opts
                host.Watch(gui, win)
            end
            return info
        end
        -- never lets a host problem stop the window from appearing
        function host.SafeMount(gui, opts, win)
            local ok, res = pcall(host.Mount, gui, opts, win)
            if ok then
                return res
            end
            warn("[AirFlow] host mount failed: " .. tostring(res))
            pcall(function()
                gui.Parent = j:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
            end)
            return nil
        end

        -- re-execute cleanup: a window with the same name from a previous execution is closed before the new one opens
        function host.Registry()
            local reg
            pcall(function()
                local e = (typeof(getgenv) == "function" and getgenv()) or _G
                reg = e.__AirflowUIWindows
                if type(reg) ~= "table" then
                    reg = {}
                    e.__AirflowUIWindows = reg
                end
            end)
            if type(reg) ~= "table" then
                host._fallbackRegistry = host._fallbackRegistry or {}
                reg = host._fallbackRegistry
            end
            return reg
        end
        function host.Replace(name, enabled)
            if enabled == false then
                return 0
            end
            local reg = host.Registry()
            local list = reg[name]
            if type(list) ~= "table" then
                return 0
            end
            local keep, stale = {}, {}
            for _, entry in ipairs(list) do
                if type(entry) == "table" and entry.Session == host._session then
                    keep[#keep + 1] = entry
                else
                    stale[#stale + 1] = entry
                end
            end
            reg[name] = keep
            for _, entry in ipairs(stale) do
                if type(entry) == "table" and type(entry.Destroy) == "function" then
                    pcall(entry.Destroy)
                end
            end
            return #stale
        end
        function host.Register(name, win)
            local reg = host.Registry()
            local list = reg[name]
            if type(list) ~= "table" then
                list = {}
                reg[name] = list
            end
            list[#list + 1] = {
                Session = host._session,
                Window = win,
                Destroy = function()
                    win:Destroy()
                end,
            }
        end
        function host.Forget(win)
            local name = win._hostName
            if not name then
                return
            end
            local list = host.Registry()[name]
            if type(list) ~= "table" then
                return
            end
            for i = #list, 1, -1 do
                local entry = list[i]
                if type(entry) == "table" and entry.Window == win then
                    table.remove(list, i)
                end
            end
        end

        function k:GetExecutor()
            local info = host.Executor()
            return { Name = info.Name, Version = info.Version, Features = table.clone(info.Features) }
        end
        function k:HasFeature(name)
            return host.Executor().Features[name] == true
        end
        function k:GetHostMode()
            return host.Mode
        end
        function k:GetHost()
            local win = k.Windows[#k.Windows]
            if win and win.HostInfo then
                return win.HostInfo
            end
            local inst, name = host.Get()
            return { Mode = name, Instance = inst }
        end
        -- UI:SetHost("Auto" | "Hidden" | "CoreGui" | "PlayerGui") moves every open window and remembers the choice
        function k:SetHost(mode)
            mode = host.NormalizeMode(mode)
            host.Mode = mode
            local last
            for _, win in ipairs(k.Windows) do
                last = win:SetHost(mode) or last
            end
            return last
        end
    end
    local function as()
        return k._host.Get()
    end
    local at, au = nil, Vector2.zero
    local function av()
        local aw = time()
        if at ~= aw then
            at = aw
            au = c:GetGuiInset()
        end
        return b:GetMouseLocation() - au
    end
    local function aw(ax)
        return ax.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or ax.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
    end
    local function ax()
        return b:GetLastInputType() == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
    end
    local function ay(az, aA)
        local aB
        az.InputBegan:Connect(function(aC)
            if aw(aC) then
                local aD = aA()
                aB = aD and aD.CanvasPosition
            end
        end)
        return function()
            local aC = aA()
            return not (aB and aC and (aC.CanvasPosition - aB).Magnitude > 4)
        end
    end
    local function az(aA, aB)
        local aC, aD = aB.AbsolutePosition, aB.AbsoluteSize
        return aA.X >= aC.X and aA.X <= aC.X + aD.X and aA.Y >= aC.Y and aA.Y <= aC.Y + aD.Y
    end
    local function aA(aB)
        return aB.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or aB.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
    end
    local function aB(aC, aD, aE, aF)
        local aG = ai(
            "Frame",
            {
                AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5),
                Position = aF,
                Size = UDim2.fromOffset(16, 16),
                BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                Parent = aC,
            }
        )
        local aH = ai(
            "ImageLabel",
            { Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 1, ImageColor3 = aE, ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit, Parent = aG }
        )
        aq(aH, aD)
        return aG, aH
    end
    local function aC(aD, aE, aF)
        local aG = ai(
            "Frame",
            {
                AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(aE, 0.5),
                Position = UDim2.new(aE, aF, 0.5, 0),
                Size = UDim2.fromOffset(18, 18),
                BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                Parent = aD,
            }
        )
        local aH = {}
        local aI = ai(
            "ImageLabel",
            {
                AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
                Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5),
                Size = UDim2.fromOffset(16, 16),
                BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                ImageColor3 = z.Muted,
                ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit,
                Parent = aG,
            }
        )
        aq(aI, "chevron-down")
        if aI.Image ~= "" then
            function aH:Set(aJ)
                ah(
                    aI,
                    { Rotation = aJ and 180 or 0, ImageColor3 = aJ and z.Accent or z.Muted },
                    0.3,
                    Enum.EasingStyle.Quint
                )
            end
            return aH
        end
        aI:Destroy()
        local function aJ(aK, aL)
            return am({
                AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
                Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5),
                Size = UDim2.fromOffset(18, 18),
                Text = "\u{203a}",
                TextSize = 22,
                TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center,
                TextColor3 = z.Muted,
                TextTransparency = aL,
                Rotation = aK,
                Parent = aG,
            })
        end
        local aK = aJ(90, 0)
        local aL = aJ(270, 1)
        function aH:Set(aM)
            ah(aK, { TextTransparency = aM and 1 or 0 }, 0.2)
            ah(aL, { TextTransparency = aM and 0 or 1, TextColor3 = aM and z.Accent or z.Muted }, 0.2)
        end
        return aH
    end
    local aD = {}
    local function aE(aF, rippleTint)
        local aG = av()
        local aH = math.max(aF.AbsoluteSize.X, aF.AbsoluteSize.Y) * 2.2
        local aI = table.remove(aD)
        if aI and not pcall(function()
            aI.Parent = nil
        end) then
            aI = nil
        end
        if not aI then
            aI = ai("Frame", { AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), BackgroundColor3 = z.Accent, BorderSizePixel = 0 })
            aj(aI, UDim.new(1, 0))
        end
        aI.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(aG.X - aF.AbsolutePosition.X, aG.Y - aF.AbsolutePosition.Y)
        aI.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0)
        aI.BackgroundColor3 = rippleTint or z.Accent
        aI.BackgroundTransparency = 0.82
        aI.ZIndex = aF.ZIndex + 1
        aI.Parent = aF
        ah(aI, { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(aH, aH), BackgroundTransparency = 1 }, 0.55)
        task.delay(0.55, function()
            if aI.Parent ~= aF or not aF.Parent then
                pcall(aI.Destroy, aI)
                return
            end
            aI.Parent = nil
            if #aD < 4 then
                table.insert(aD, aI)
            else
                aI:Destroy()
            end
        end)
    end
    local function aF(aG)
        if not aG or aG:GetAttribute("Hidden") then
            return
        end
        ah(aG, { Color = z.Accent, Transparency = 0.2 }, 0.08)
        task.delay(0.12, function()
            ah(aG, { Color = z.Stroke, Transparency = 0 }, 0.35)
        end)
    end
    local function aG(aH, aI)
        aH.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
            ah(aI, { Color = z.StrokeHover }, 0.12)
        end)
        aH.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
            ah(aI, { Color = z.Stroke }, 0.25)
        end)
    end
    local aH = {
        [Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl] = "LCtrl",
        [Enum.KeyCode.RightControl] = "RCtrl",
        [Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift] = "LShift",
        [Enum.KeyCode.RightShift] = "RShift",
        [Enum.KeyCode.LeftAlt] = "LAlt",
        [Enum.KeyCode.RightAlt] = "RAlt",
        [Enum.KeyCode.Return] = "Enter",
        [Enum.KeyCode.Escape] = "Esc",
        [Enum.KeyCode.Backspace] = "Backspace",
    }
    local function aI(aJ)
        if aJ == nil then
            return "None"
        end
        return aH[aJ] or aJ.Name
    end
    local function aJ(aK, ...)
        if type(aK) ~= "function" then
            return
        end
        local aL, aM = pcall(aK, ...)
        if not aL then
            warn("[AirFlow] callback error: " .. tostring(aM))
        end
    end
    local function aK(aL)
        local aM = nil
        task.spawn(function()
            aM = table.pack(pcall(aL))
        end)
        while aM == nil do
            task.wait()
        end
        return table.unpack(aM, 1, aM.n)
    end
    local function aL(aM, aN, aO)
        local function decimalsOf(n)
            local s = string.format("%.8f", math.abs(n)):gsub("0+$", "")
            local dot = s:find(".", 1, true)
            return dot and (#s - dot) or 0
        end
        local aP = math.min(math.max(decimalsOf(aO), decimalsOf(aM), decimalsOf(aN)), 8)
        local aS = "%." .. aP .. "f"
        local mult = 10 ^ aP
        return {
            snap = function(aT)
                aT = math.clamp(aT, aM, aN)
                local snapped = aM + math.floor((aT - aM) / aO + 0.5) * aO
                -- the end of the range stays reachable even when it is not on the step grid
                if snapped > aN or math.abs(aN - aT) < math.abs(snapped - aT) then
                    snapped = aN
                end
                snapped = math.floor(snapped * mult + 0.5) / mult
                return math.clamp(snapped == 0 and 0 or snapped, aM, aN)
            end,
            format = function(aT)
                return string.format(aS, aT)
            end,
        }
    end
    local function aM(aN)
        return aN._metrics or P.Card
    end
    local function aN(aO, aP)
        local aQ = aO.AbsoluteSize.X / aP.Scale.Scale
        return math.clamp(math.floor(aQ * 0.48), 90, 220)
    end
    local function aO(aP, aQ, aR, aS)
        local aT = aM(aP).Compact
        local aU = {
            Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, aR),
            BackgroundColor3 = z.Surface2,
            BackgroundTransparency = aT and 1 or 0,
            BorderSizePixel = 0,
            LayoutOrder = aP:_nextOrder(),
            Parent = aP.List,
        }
        if aQ == "TextButton" then
            aU.AutoButtonColor = false
            aU.Text = ""
        end
        local aV = ai(aQ, aU)
        aV:SetAttribute("NoDrag", true)
        aj(aV)
        local aW = ak(aV, z.Stroke, aT and 1 or 0)
        if aT then
            aW:SetAttribute("Hidden", true)
        end
        return aV, aW
    end
    local function aP(aQ, aR, aS, aT, aU)
        aU = aU or P.Card
        local aV, aW
        if aS then
            local aX = math.floor((aU.DescHeight - (aU.DescGap + aU.DescLine)) / 2)
            aV = am({
                Position = UDim2.fromOffset(14, aX),
                Size = UDim2.new(1, -(14 + aT), 0, aU.TitleHeight),
                Text = aR,
                TextSize = aU.TextSize,
                Parent = aQ,
            })
            aW = am({
                Position = UDim2.fromOffset(14, aX + aU.DescGap),
                Size = UDim2.new(1, -(14 + aT), 0, aU.DescLine),
                Text = aS,
                TextSize = aU.DescSize,
                FontFace = D.Regular,
                TextColor3 = z.Muted,
                Parent = aQ,
            })
        else
            aV = am({
                Position = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 0),
                Size = UDim2.new(1, -(14 + aT), 1, 0),
                Text = aR,
                TextSize = aU.TextSize,
                Parent = aQ,
            })
        end
        return aV, aW
    end
    local function aQ(aR, aS, aT, aU, aV, aW)
        aS = l(aS, aT)
        local aX = aM(aR)
        local aY = aS.Desc and aX.DescHeight or aX.Height
        local aZ, a_ = aO(aR, aU or "Frame", aY, aS)
        aG(aZ, a_)
        local a0, a1
        if aV then
            a0, a1 = aP(aZ, aS.Name or aW, aS.Desc, aV, aX)
        end
        return aS, aZ, a_, aY, a0, a1
    end
    local function aR(aS, aT, aU)
        if aS then
            aS.Size = UDim2.new(1, -(14 + aU), aS.Size.Y.Scale, aS.Size.Y.Offset)
        end
        if aT then
            aT.Size = UDim2.new(1, -(14 + aU), 0, aT.Size.Y.Offset)
        end
    end
    local aS = {}
    aS.__index = aS
    function aS:_nextOrder()
        self._order = self._order + 1
        return self._order
    end
    -- =========================================================================
    -- Section
    --
    -- :Section("Name") | :Section({ Name/Title, Icon, Desc, Color, Line, Visible, Tooltip })
    --   Icon  = lucide name / asset id          Desc  = small muted text on the right side
    --   Color = tone name ("Success", "Warning"...) or Color3 / hex       Line = false hides the rule
    -- Methods: Set / SetText, Get, SetIcon, SetDesc, SetColor, SetLine
    -- =========================================================================
    function aS:Section(sectionArg)
        local owner = self
        local opts = l(sectionArg, { Title = "Name", Text = "Name", Description = "Desc", Subtitle = "Desc" })
        local compact = aM(owner).Compact
        local edge = compact and 14 or 2
        local rightPad = compact and 14 or 0
        local ROW_Y = 16
        local state = {
            Text = opts.Name ~= nil and tostring(opts.Name) or "",
            Desc = opts.Desc ~= nil and tostring(opts.Desc) or "",
            Icon = opts.Icon,
            ColorSpec = opts.Color,
            Line = opts.Line ~= false,
        }
        local FADE_SOLID_END = NumberSequence.new({
            NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0),
            NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.6, 0.2),
            NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0.55),
        })
        local FADE_OUT = NumberSequence.new({
            NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0),
            NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.55, 0.3),
            NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1),
        })

        local holder = ai("Frame", {
            Name = "Section",
            Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 28),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            BorderSizePixel = 0,
            LayoutOrder = owner:_nextOrder(),
            Parent = owner.List,
        })

        -- heading = accent mark + optional icon + title
        local content = ai("Frame", {
            Name = "Heading",
            AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5),
            Position = UDim2.new(0, edge, 0, ROW_Y),
            Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 16),
            AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X,
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            BorderSizePixel = 0,
            Parent = holder,
        })
        ai("UIListLayout", {
            FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal,
            VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center,
            SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
            Padding = UDim.new(0, 6),
            Parent = content,
        })
        local mark = ai("Frame", {
            Name = "Mark",
            Size = UDim2.fromOffset(3, 11),
            BackgroundColor3 = z.Accent,
            BackgroundTransparency = 0.35,
            BorderSizePixel = 0,
            LayoutOrder = 1,
            Parent = content,
        })
        aj(mark, UDim.new(1, 0))
        local icon = ai("ImageLabel", {
            Name = "Icon",
            Size = UDim2.fromOffset(13, 13),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            ImageColor3 = z.Accent,
            ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit,
            Visible = false,
            LayoutOrder = 2,
            Parent = content,
        })
        local label = am({
            Name = "Title",
            Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0),
            AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X,
            Text = string.upper(state.Text),
            TextSize = 11,
            FontFace = D.Bold,
            TextColor3 = z.Muted,
            TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.None,
            LayoutOrder = 3,
            Parent = content,
        })

        local desc = am({
            Name = "Desc",
            AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5),
            Position = UDim2.new(1, -rightPad, 0, ROW_Y),
            Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 16),
            AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X,
            Text = state.Desc,
            TextSize = 11,
            FontFace = D.Regular,
            TextColor3 = z.Muted,
            TextTransparency = 0.2,
            TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.None,
            TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right,
            Visible = state.Desc ~= "",
            Parent = holder,
        })

        local rule = ai("Frame", {
            Name = "Rule",
            AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5),
            Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, ROW_Y),
            Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 1),
            BackgroundColor3 = z.Stroke,
            BorderSizePixel = 0,
            Visible = false,
            Parent = holder,
        })
        local ruleFade = ai("UIGradient", { Parent = rule })

        local function uiScale()
            local win = owner.Window
            local scale = win and win.Scale and win.Scale.Scale
            return math.max(type(scale) == "number" and scale or 1, 0.01)
        end

        -- the rule fills whatever room is left between the heading and the description
        local function relayout()
            if not holder.Parent then
                return
            end
            local scale = uiScale()
            local hasHead = content.Visible
            local headW = hasHead and content.AbsoluteSize.X / scale or 0
            if hasHead and headW <= 0 then
                rule.Visible = false
                return
            end
            local hasDesc = desc.Visible
            local descW = hasDesc and desc.AbsoluteSize.X / scale or 0
            if hasDesc and descW <= 0 then
                rule.Visible = false
                return
            end
            local left = edge + (hasHead and headW + 10 or 0)
            local right = rightPad + (hasDesc and descW + 10 or 0)
            local room = holder.AbsoluteSize.X / scale - left - right
            ruleFade.Transparency = hasDesc and FADE_SOLID_END or FADE_OUT
            rule.Position = UDim2.new(0, left, 0, ROW_Y)
            rule.Size = UDim2.new(1, -(left + right), 0, 1)
            rule.Visible = state.Line and room > 6
        end

        local function refreshHead()
            local hasText = state.Text ~= ""
            label.Visible = hasText
            content.Visible = hasText or icon.Visible
            relayout()
        end

        local function paint(time)
            local tone = state.ColorSpec ~= nil and k._color(state.ColorSpec) or nil
            local accent = tone or z.Accent
            ah(mark, { BackgroundColor3 = accent }, time)
            ah(label, { TextColor3 = tone or z.Muted }, time)
            ar(icon, accent, true, time)
        end

        local function setIcon(spec)
            state.Icon = spec
            icon.Image = ""
            local found = false
            if spec ~= nil and spec ~= false and spec ~= "" then
                aq(icon, spec)
                found = icon.Image ~= ""
            end
            icon.Visible = found
            paint(0)
            refreshHead()
        end

        content:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(relayout)
        desc:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(relayout)
        holder:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(relayout)
        setIcon(state.Icon)
        paint(0)
        task.defer(relayout)

        local api = {}
        function api:Set(text)
            state.Text = text == nil and "" or tostring(text)
            label.Text = string.upper(state.Text)
            refreshHead()
        end
        api.SetText = api.Set
        function api:Get()
            return state.Text
        end
        function api:SetIcon(spec)
            setIcon(spec)
        end
        function api:SetDesc(text)
            state.Desc = text == nil and "" or tostring(text)
            desc.Text = state.Desc
            desc.Visible = state.Desc ~= ""
            relayout()
        end
        function api:SetColor(color)
            state.ColorSpec = color
            paint(0.25)
        end
        function api:SetLine(on)
            state.Line = on ~= false
            relayout()
        end

        return m(owner, { Visible = opts.Visible, Tooltip = opts.Tooltip, Flag = opts.Flag }, api, holder, "Section")
    end
    do
        -- =====================================================================
        -- Divider / Label / Paragraph
        --
        -- Divider  : :Divider() | :Divider("text") | :Divider({ Text, Icon, Align, Style, Color, Thickness, Padding })
        --            Align = Center | Left | Right      Style = Fade (default) | Solid | Accent
        --            Methods: Set / SetText, Get, SetColor, SetIcon, SetAlign, SetStyle
        --
        -- Label    : :Label("text") | :Label({ Text, Color, Icon, Align, TextSize, Bold, Wrap, Update, UpdateRate })
        --            Methods: Set, Get, SetColor, GetColor, SetIcon, SetAlign, SetUpdateRate
        --
        -- Paragraph: :Paragraph({ Name/Title, Content/Text, Icon, Color })
        --            Color = tone name ("Success", "Warning", "Error", "Accent"...) or Color3 / hex
        --            Methods: Set / SetContent, SetTitle, Get, GetTitle, SetIcon, SetColor
        --
        -- Rich text tags (<Accent>..</Accent>, <Success>.., <font ..>) are re-rendered on every theme change,
        -- so tone colours inside the text always follow the active theme.
        -- =====================================================================
        local FADE_PLAIN = NumberSequence.new({
            NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1),
            NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.14, 0.6),
            NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.36, 0),
            NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.64, 0),
            NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.86, 0.6),
            NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1),
        })
        local FADE_LEFT = NumberSequence.new({
            NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1),
            NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, 0.35),
            NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0),
        })
        local FADE_RIGHT = NumberSequence.new({
            NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0),
            NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, 0.35),
            NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1),
        })
        local FADE_NONE = NumberSequence.new(0)

        local function normAlign(value, default)
            value = type(value) == "string" and string.lower(value) or ""
            if value == "left" or value == "start" then
                return "Left"
            elseif value == "right" or value == "end" then
                return "Right"
            elseif value == "center" or value == "middle" then
                return "Center"
            end
            return default
        end

        local function textAlignment(align)
            if align == "Center" then
                return Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
            elseif align == "Right" then
                return Enum.TextXAlignment.Right
            end
            return Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
        end

        local function normStyle(value)
            value = type(value) == "string" and string.lower(value) or ""
            if value == "solid" then
                return "Solid"
            elseif value == "accent" or value == "glow" or value == "tint" then
                return "Accent"
            end
            return "Fade"
        end

        -- text without rich-text tags (used for the search index)
        local function plainText(text)
            return (string.gsub(tostring(text), "<[^>]*>", ""))
        end

        local function scaleOf(owner)
            local win = owner.Window
            local scale = win and win.Scale and win.Scale.Scale
            return math.max(type(scale) == "number" and scale or 1, 0.01)
        end

        local function resolveColor(spec, fallback)
            local color = spec ~= nil and k._color(spec) or nil
            return color or fallback
        end

        -- puts an icon on an ImageLabel; returns false (and hides it) when the icon can not be resolved
        local function applyIcon(image, icon)
            image.Image = ""
            if icon == nil or icon == false or icon == "" then
                image.Visible = false
                return false
            end
            aq(image, icon)
            local found = image.Image ~= ""
            image.Visible = found
            return found
        end

        local function tintIcon(image, color, time)
            ar(image, color, true, time)
        end

        -- ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        -- Divider
        -- ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        function aS:Divider(opts)
            opts = l(opts, { Name = "Text", Title = "Text" })
            local owner = self
            local compact = aM(owner).Compact
            local state = {
                Text = opts.Text ~= nil and tostring(opts.Text) or "",
                Icon = opts.Icon,
                Align = normAlign(opts.Align or opts.Alignment, "Center"),
                Style = normStyle(opts.Style),
                ColorSpec = opts.Color,
                Thickness = math.clamp(math.floor(tonumber(opts.Thickness) or 1), 1, 4),
            }
            local extraPad = tonumber(opts.Padding or opts.Spacing)
            local plainPad = extraPad and math.max(math.floor(extraPad), 0) or (compact and 4 or 0)
            local textPad = extraPad and math.max(math.floor(extraPad), 0) or 2
            local TEXT_GAP = 8

            local holder = ai("Frame", {
                Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, state.Thickness + plainPad * 2),
                BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                BorderSizePixel = 0,
                LayoutOrder = owner:_nextOrder(),
                Parent = owner.List,
            })
            local function makeLine()
                local line = ai("Frame", {
                    AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5),
                    Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.5, 0),
                    Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 1),
                    BackgroundColor3 = z.Stroke,
                    BorderSizePixel = 0,
                    Parent = holder,
                })
                local gradient = ai("UIGradient", { Parent = line })
                return line, gradient
            end
            local lineA, gradA = makeLine()
            local lineB, gradB = makeLine()

            local content = ai("Frame", {
                Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 14),
                AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X,
                BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                BorderSizePixel = 0,
                Visible = false,
                Parent = holder,
            })
            ai("UIListLayout", {
                FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal,
                VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center,
                SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
                Padding = UDim.new(0, 5),
                Parent = content,
            })
            local icon = ai("ImageLabel", {
                Size = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 12),
                BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                ImageColor3 = z.Muted,
                ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit,
                Visible = false,
                LayoutOrder = 1,
                Parent = content,
            })
            local label = am({
                Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0),
                AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X,
                Text = "",
                TextSize = 11,
                FontFace = D.Medium,
                TextColor3 = z.Muted,
                TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.None,
                RichText = true,
                LayoutOrder = 2,
                Parent = content,
            })

            local function layout()
                local hasIcon = icon.Visible
                local hasText = state.Text ~= ""
                local hasContent = hasIcon or hasText
                local thick = state.Thickness
                local fade = state.Style ~= "Solid"
                label.Visible = hasText
                content.Visible = hasContent
                if not hasContent then
                    local plainEdge = compact and 14 or 0
                    holder.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, thick + plainPad * 2)
                    lineA.Visible = true
                    lineB.Visible = false
                    lineA.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5)
                    lineA.Position = UDim2.new(0, plainEdge, 0.5, 0)
                    lineA.Size = UDim2.new(1, -plainEdge * 2, 0, thick)
                    gradA.Transparency = fade and FADE_PLAIN or FADE_NONE
                    return
                end
                local edge = compact and 14 or 2
                holder.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, math.max(14, thick) + textPad * 2)
                if state.Align == "Left" then
                    content.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5)
                    content.Position = UDim2.new(0, edge, 0.5, 0)
                elseif state.Align == "Right" then
                    content.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5)
                    content.Position = UDim2.new(1, -edge, 0.5, 0)
                else
                    content.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
                    content.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
                end
                local width = content.AbsoluteSize.X / scaleOf(owner)
                if width <= 0 then
                    -- not measured yet: keep the lines hidden so they never cross the text for a frame
                    lineA.Visible = false
                    lineB.Visible = false
                    return
                end
                if state.Align == "Left" then
                    lineA.Visible = false
                    lineB.Visible = true
                    lineB.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5)
                    lineB.Position = UDim2.new(1, -edge, 0.5, 0)
                    lineB.Size = UDim2.new(1, -(edge * 2 + width + TEXT_GAP), 0, thick)
                    gradB.Transparency = fade and FADE_RIGHT or FADE_NONE
                elseif state.Align == "Right" then
                    lineB.Visible = false
                    lineA.Visible = true
                    lineA.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5)
                    lineA.Position = UDim2.new(0, edge, 0.5, 0)
                    lineA.Size = UDim2.new(1, -(edge * 2 + width + TEXT_GAP), 0, thick)
                    gradA.Transparency = fade and FADE_LEFT or FADE_NONE
                else
                    local run = -(edge + width / 2 + TEXT_GAP)
                    lineA.Visible = true
                    lineB.Visible = true
                    lineA.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5)
                    lineA.Position = UDim2.new(0, edge, 0.5, 0)
                    lineA.Size = UDim2.new(0.5, run, 0, thick)
                    lineB.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5)
                    lineB.Position = UDim2.new(1, -edge, 0.5, 0)
                    lineB.Size = UDim2.new(0.5, run, 0, thick)
                    gradA.Transparency = fade and FADE_LEFT or FADE_NONE
                    gradB.Transparency = fade and FADE_RIGHT or FADE_NONE
                end
            end

            local function paint(time)
                local custom = state.ColorSpec ~= nil and k._color(state.ColorSpec) or nil
                local textColor = custom or z.Muted
                local lineColor, lineAlpha = z.Stroke, 0
                if custom then
                    lineColor, lineAlpha = custom, 0.5
                elseif state.Style == "Accent" then
                    lineColor, lineAlpha = z.Accent, 0.55
                end
                ah(lineA, { BackgroundColor3 = lineColor, BackgroundTransparency = lineAlpha }, time)
                ah(lineB, { BackgroundColor3 = lineColor, BackgroundTransparency = lineAlpha }, time)
                ah(label, { TextColor3 = textColor }, time)
                tintIcon(icon, textColor, time)
                label.Text = k._rich(state.Text)
            end

            applyIcon(icon, state.Icon)
            ag(holder, function()
                paint(0)
            end)
            layout()
            content:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(layout)
            task.defer(layout)

            local api = {}
            function api:Set(text)
                state.Text = text == nil and "" or tostring(text)
                label.Text = k._rich(state.Text)
                layout()
            end
            api.SetText = api.Set
            function api:Get()
                return state.Text
            end
            function api:SetColor(color)
                state.ColorSpec = color
                paint(0.25)
            end
            function api:SetIcon(name)
                state.Icon = name
