                applyIcon(icon, name)
                paint(0)
                layout()
            end
            function api:SetAlign(value)
                state.Align = normAlign(value, state.Align)
                layout()
            end
            function api:SetStyle(value)
                state.Style = normStyle(value)
                paint(0.2)
                layout()
            end
            return m(owner, opts, api, holder, "Divider")
        end

        -- ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        -- Label
        -- ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        function aS:Label(opts)
            opts = l(opts, { Name = "Text", Title = "Text" })
            local owner = self
            local compact = aM(owner).Compact
            local state = {
                Text = opts.Text ~= nil and tostring(opts.Text) or "",
                ColorSpec = opts.Color,
                Icon = opts.Icon,
                Align = normAlign(opts.Align or opts.Alignment, "Left"),
            }
            local textSize = math.clamp(math.floor(tonumber(opts.TextSize) or (compact and 12 or 13)), 8, 32)
            local wrap = opts.Wrap ~= false
            local lineHeight = math.max(textSize + 3, 16)
            local ICON_COLUMN = 22

            local holder = ai("Frame", {
                Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0),
                AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
                BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                BorderSizePixel = 0,
                LayoutOrder = owner:_nextOrder(),
                Parent = owner.List,
            })
            if compact then
                al(holder, 14, 14, 1, 1)
            else
                al(holder, 2, 2, 1, 1)
            end
            ai("UIListLayout", {
                FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal,
                HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Left,
                VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Top,
                SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
                Padding = UDim.new(0, 6),
                Parent = holder,
            })
            local iconBox = ai("Frame", {
                Size = UDim2.fromOffset(16, lineHeight),
                BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                BorderSizePixel = 0,
                Visible = false,
                LayoutOrder = 1,
                Parent = holder,
            })
            local icon = ai("ImageLabel", {
                AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
                Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5),
                Size = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 14),
                BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                ImageColor3 = z.Muted,
                ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit,
                Visible = false,
                Parent = iconBox,
            })
            local textLabel = am({
                Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, lineHeight),
                AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
                Text = "",
                TextSize = textSize,
                FontFace = opts.Bold == true and D.Bold or D.Regular,
                TextColor3 = z.Muted,
                TextXAlignment = textAlignment(state.Align),
                TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Center,
                TextWrapped = wrap,
                TextTruncate = wrap and Enum.TextTruncate.None or Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
                RichText = true,
                LayoutOrder = 2,
                Parent = holder,
            })

            local function refreshIcon()
                local has = applyIcon(icon, state.Icon)
                iconBox.Visible = has
                textLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, has and -ICON_COLUMN or 0, 0, lineHeight)
            end
            local function paint(time)
                local color = resolveColor(state.ColorSpec, z.Muted)
                ah(textLabel, { TextColor3 = color }, time)
                tintIcon(icon, color, time)
            end

            refreshIcon()
            ag(textLabel, function()
                textLabel.Text = k._rich(state.Text)
                paint(0)
            end)

            local api = {}
            local function syncSearch()
                local name = plainText(state.Text)
                api._searchName = name
                api._searchKey = string.lower(name)
            end
            local function setText(text)
                text = text == nil and "" or tostring(text)
                if text == state.Text then
                    return
                end
                state.Text = text
                textLabel.Text = k._rich(text)
                syncSearch()
            end
            function api:Set(text)
                setText(text)
            end
            function api:Get()
                return state.Text
            end
            function api:SetColor(color)
                state.ColorSpec = color
                paint(0.25)
            end
            function api:GetColor()
                return resolveColor(state.ColorSpec, z.Muted)
            end
            function api:SetIcon(name)
                state.Icon = name
                refreshIcon()
                paint(0)
            end
            function api:SetAlign(value)
                state.Align = normAlign(value, state.Align)
                textLabel.TextXAlignment = textAlignment(state.Align)
            end

            local item = m(owner, opts, api, holder, "Label")
            syncSearch()

            if type(opts.Update) == "function" then
                local rate = math.max(tonumber(opts.UpdateRate) or 1, 0.05)
                local alive = true
                table.insert(item._listeners, function()
                    alive = false
                end)
                task.spawn(function()
                    while alive and holder.Parent do
                        local ok, value = aK(opts.Update)
                        if ok and value ~= nil then
                            setText(value)
                        elseif not ok then
                            warn("[AirFlow] label update error: " .. tostring(value))
                        end
                        task.wait(rate)
                    end
                end)
                function item:SetUpdateRate(value)
                    rate = math.max(tonumber(value) or rate, 0.05)
                end
            end
            return item
        end

        -- ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        -- Paragraph
        -- ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        function aS:Paragraph(opts)
            opts = l(opts, { Title = "Name", Text = "Content", Desc = "Content", Description = "Content", Body = "Content" })
            local owner = self
            local compact = aM(owner).Compact
            local state = {
                Title = opts.Name ~= nil and tostring(opts.Name) or "",
                Content = opts.Content ~= nil and tostring(opts.Content) or "",
                Icon = opts.Icon,
                ColorSpec = opts.Color,
            }
            local PLATE = 26
            local PLATE_GAP = 10

            local card, stroke = aO(owner, "Frame", 0, opts)
            card.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y

            local bar = ai("Frame", {
                Name = "AccentBar",
                AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5),
                Position = UDim2.new(0, 6, 0.5, 0),
                Size = UDim2.new(0, 3, 1, -16),
                BackgroundColor3 = z.Accent,
                BackgroundTransparency = 0.35,
                BorderSizePixel = 0,
                Visible = false,
                Parent = card,
            })
            aj(bar, UDim.new(1, 0))

            local body = ai("Frame", {
                Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0),
                AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
                BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                BorderSizePixel = 0,
                Parent = card,
            })
            local padding = al(body, 14, 14, compact and 6 or 11, compact and 8 or 12)
            ai("UIListLayout", {
                FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal,
                VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Top,
                SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
                Padding = UDim.new(0, PLATE_GAP),
                Parent = body,
            })

            local plate = ai("Frame", {
                Name = "IconPlate",
                Size = UDim2.fromOffset(PLATE, PLATE),
                BackgroundColor3 = z.Accent,
                BackgroundTransparency = 0.88,
                BorderSizePixel = 0,
                Visible = false,
                LayoutOrder = 1,
                Parent = body,
            })
            aj(plate, UDim.new(0, 7))
            local plateStroke = ak(plate, z.Accent, 0.74)
            local icon = ai("ImageLabel", {
                AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
                Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5),
                Size = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 14),
                BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                ImageColor3 = z.Accent,
                ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit,
                Visible = false,
                Parent = plate,
            })

            local stack = ai("Frame", {
                Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0),
                AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
                BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                BorderSizePixel = 0,
                LayoutOrder = 2,
                Parent = body,
            })
            ai("UIListLayout", { SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder, Padding = UDim.new(0, 3), Parent = stack })
            local titleLabel = am({
                Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0),
                AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
                Text = "",
                TextSize = compact and 13 or 14,
                FontFace = D.Bold,
                TextColor3 = z.Text,
                TextWrapped = true,
                TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.None,
                TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top,
                RichText = true,
                LayoutOrder = 1,
                Parent = stack,
            })
            local contentLabel = am({
                Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0),
                AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
                Text = "",
                TextSize = compact and 12 or 13,
                FontFace = D.Regular,
                TextColor3 = z.Muted,
                TextWrapped = true,
                TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.None,
                TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top,
                LineHeight = 1.1,
                RichText = true,
                LayoutOrder = 2,
                Parent = stack,
            })

            local function renderText()
                titleLabel.Text = k._rich(state.Title)
                contentLabel.Text = k._rich(state.Content)
                titleLabel.Visible = state.Title ~= ""
                contentLabel.Visible = state.Content ~= ""
            end
            local function refreshIcon()
                local has = applyIcon(icon, state.Icon)
                plate.Visible = has
                stack.Size = UDim2.new(1, has and -(PLATE + PLATE_GAP) or 0, 0, 0)
            end
            local function paintTone(time)
                local tone = state.ColorSpec ~= nil and k._color(state.ColorSpec) or nil
                local accent = tone or z.Accent
                local boxed = tone ~= nil and not compact
                if boxed then
                    ah(card, { BackgroundColor3 = tone, BackgroundTransparency = 0.9 }, time)
                    ah(stroke, { Color = tone, Transparency = 0.62 }, time)
                else
                    ah(card, { BackgroundColor3 = z.Surface2, BackgroundTransparency = compact and 1 or 0 }, time)
                    ah(stroke, { Color = z.Stroke, Transparency = compact and 1 or 0 }, time)
                end
                bar.Visible = tone ~= nil
                ah(bar, { BackgroundColor3 = accent }, time)
                padding.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, tone ~= nil and 20 or 14)
                ah(plate, { BackgroundColor3 = accent }, time)
                ah(plateStroke, { Color = accent }, time)
                tintIcon(icon, accent, time)
            end

            refreshIcon()
            ag(card, function()
                renderText()
                paintTone(0)
            end)

            local api = {}
            local function syncSearch()
                local name = plainText(state.Title ~= "" and state.Title or state.Content)
                api._searchName = name
                api._searchKey = string.lower(name)
            end
            function api:Set(content)
                state.Content = content == nil and "" or tostring(content)
                renderText()
                syncSearch()
            end
            api.SetContent = api.Set
            function api:SetTitle(title)
                state.Title = title == nil and "" or tostring(title)
                renderText()
                syncSearch()
            end
            function api:Get()
                return state.Content
            end
            function api:GetTitle()
                return state.Title
            end
            function api:SetIcon(name)
                state.Icon = name
                refreshIcon()
                paintTone(0)
            end
            function api:SetColor(color)
                state.ColorSpec = color
                paintTone(0.25)
            end

            local item = m(owner, opts, api, card, "Paragraph")
            syncSearch()
            return item
        end
    end
    do
        local function tint(key)
            return {
                { key, 0.9, key, 0.65 },
                { key, 0.8, key, 0.3 },
                { key, 0.68, key, 0.1 },
                text = key,
                icon = key,
                arrow = key,
                desc = "Muted",
                bar = key,
            }
        end
        local primary = {
            { "Accent", 0.1, "Accent", 0.35 },
            { "Accent", 0, "Accent", 0 },
            { "Accent", 0.16, "Accent", 0.2 },
            text = "AccentDark",
            icon = "AccentDark",
            arrow = "AccentDark",
            desc = "AccentDark",
            descT = 0.3,
            bar = "AccentDark",
            solid = true,
        }
        k._btnSpec = {
            chip = {
                Default = {
                    { "Surface3", 0.45, "Stroke", 0 },
                    { "Surface3", 0.2, "StrokeHover", 0 },
                    { "Surface3", 0.05, "Accent", 0.55 },
                    text = "Text",
                    icon = "Accent",
                    arrow = "Muted",
                    desc = "Muted",
                    bar = "Accent",
                },
                Primary = primary,
                Danger = tint("Error"),
                Success = tint("Success"),
                Warning = tint("Warning"),
            },
            card = {
                Default = {
                    { "Surface2", 0, "Stroke", 0 },
                    { "Surface3", 0.6, "StrokeHover", 0 },
                    { "Surface3", 0.25, "StrokeHover", 0 },
                    text = "Text",
                    icon = "Accent",
                    arrow = "Muted",
                    desc = "Muted",
                    bar = "Accent",
                },
                Primary = primary,
                Danger = tint("Error"),
                Success = tint("Success"),
                Warning = tint("Warning"),
            },
        }
    end
    function k._btnNorm(v)
        v = type(v) == "string" and v:lower() or ""
        if v == "primary" then
            return "Primary"
        end
        if v == "danger" or v == "destructive" then
            return "Danger"
        end
        if v == "success" then
            return "Success"
        end
        if v == "warning" then
            return "Warning"
        end
        return "Default"
    end

    -- small rotating arc used while a Lock button is running its callback
    function k._spinner(parent, props)
        local size = props.Size or 12
        local layout = props.Layout == true
        local holder = ai("Frame", {
            Name = "Spinner",
            AnchorPoint = props.AnchorPoint or Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
            Position = props.Position or UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5),
            Size = layout and UDim2.fromOffset(0, size) or UDim2.fromOffset(size, size),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            Visible = false,
            LayoutOrder = props.LayoutOrder or 0,
            Parent = parent,
        })
        aj(holder, UDim.new(1, 0))
        local ring = ak(holder, z.Text, 1, 2)
        local sweep = ai("UIGradient", {
            Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
                NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0),
                NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.55, 0.6),
                NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.56, 1),
                NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1),
            }),
            Parent = ring,
        })
        local obj = { Active = false, Frame = holder }
        local spin, gen = nil, 0
        local function stop()
            if spin then
                spin:Cancel()
                spin = nil
            end
        end
        function obj:SetColor(color, dur)
            ah(ring, { Color = color }, dur or 0.15)
        end
        function obj:Set(on)
            on = on == true
            if on == obj.Active then
                return
            end
            obj.Active = on
            gen = gen + 1
            local id = gen
            stop()
            if on then
                holder.Visible = true
                if layout then
                    ah(holder, { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(size, size) }, 0.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint)
                end
                ah(ring, { Transparency = 0 }, 0.18)
                sweep.Rotation = 0
                spin = a:Create(
                    sweep,
                    TweenInfo.new(0.8, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear, Enum.EasingDirection.Out, -1),
                    { Rotation = 360 }
                )
                spin:Play()
            else
                if layout then
                    ah(holder, { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, size) }, 0.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint)
                end
                ah(ring, { Transparency = 1 }, 0.15)
                task.delay(0.22, function()
                    if gen == id and holder.Parent then
                        holder.Visible = false
                    end
                end)
            end
        end
        function obj:Destroy()
            stop()
        end
        return obj
    end

    -- icon + title (+ spinner) centred inside a chip; the title truncates instead of overflowing
    function k._chipContent(host, win, opt, textSize, iconSize)
        local content = ai("Frame", {
            Name = "Content",
            AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
            Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5),
            Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0),
            AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X,
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            Parent = host,
        })
        ai("UIListLayout", {
            FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal,
            VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center,
            SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
            Padding = UDim.new(0, 6),
            Parent = content,
        })
        local spinner = k._spinner(content, { Size = 12, LayoutOrder = 0, Layout = true })
        local icons, iconW = {}, 0
        if opt.Icon then
            local img = ai("ImageLabel", {
                Size = UDim2.fromOffset(iconSize, iconSize),
                BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit,
                LayoutOrder = 1,
                Parent = content,
            })
            aq(img, opt.Icon)
            icons[1] = img
            iconW = iconSize + 6
        end
        local title = am({
            Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0),
            AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X,
            Text = tostring(opt.Name or "Button"),
            TextSize = textSize,
            LayoutOrder = 2,
            Parent = content,
        })
        local cap = ai("UISizeConstraint", { MaxSize = Vector2.new(4096, 4096), Parent = title })
        local out = { Content = content, Title = title, Icons = icons, Spinner = spinner }
        function out.fit()
            local scale = win and win.Scale and win.Scale.Scale or 1
            local width = host.AbsoluteSize.X / (scale > 0 and scale or 1)
            if width <= 0 then
                cap.MaxSize = Vector2.new(4096, 4096)
                return
            end
            cap.MaxSize = Vector2.new(math.max(width - 20 - iconW - (spinner.Active and 18 or 0), 16), 4096)
        end
        host:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(out.fit)
        task.defer(out.fit)
        return out
    end

    function k._btnFx(c)
        local hit, bg, stroke, opts = c.hit, c.bg, c.stroke, c.opts
        local spec = k._btnSpec[c.kind or "chip"]
        local texts, descs, icons, arrows = c.texts or {}, c.descs or {}, c.icons or {}, c.arrows or {}
        local nudges, bar, grad, spin = c.nudges or {}, c.bar, c.grad, c.spinner
        local nudgeBase = {}
        for i, frame in ipairs(nudges) do
            nudgeBase[i] = frame.Position
        end
        local state = {
            style = k._btnNorm(opts.Style or (opts.Danger and "Danger") or (opts.Primary and "Primary")),
            hover = false,
            press = false,
            disabled = opts.Disabled == true,
            loading = false,
        }
        local fx = {}
        local loadingShown = false
        local function paint(dur)
            local sp = spec[state.style] or spec.Default
            local disabled, busy = state.disabled, state.loading
            local idle = not disabled and not busy
            local idx = 1
            if idle then
                idx = state.press and 3 or (state.hover and 2 or 1)
            end
            local lv = sp[idx]
            local veil = disabled and 0.5 or (busy and 0.2 or 0)
            local function fade(t)
                return 1 - (1 - t) * (1 - veil)
            end
            ah(bg, { BackgroundColor3 = z[lv[1]], BackgroundTransparency = fade(lv[2]) }, dur)
            if stroke and not stroke:GetAttribute("Hidden") then
                ah(stroke, { Color = z[lv[3]], Transparency = fade(lv[4]) }, dur)
            end
            if grad then
                grad.Enabled = sp.solid == true
            end
            local tx = disabled and 0.55 or (busy and 0.25 or 0)
            for _, t in ipairs(texts) do
                ah(t, { TextColor3 = z[sp.text], TextTransparency = tx }, dur)
            end
            for _, t in ipairs(descs) do
                ah(t, {
                    TextColor3 = z[sp.desc],
                    TextTransparency = disabled and 0.7 or (busy and 0.5 or (sp.descT or 0)),
                }, dur)
            end
            local function paintIcons(list, key, hide)
                for _, im in ipairs(list) do
                    if im:IsA("TextLabel") then
                        ah(im, { TextColor3 = z[key], TextTransparency = hide and 1 or tx }, dur)
                    else
                        ar(im, z[key], not disabled, dur)
                        if not im:GetAttribute("CustomIcon") then
                            ah(im, { ImageTransparency = hide and 1 or tx }, dur)
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            paintIcons(icons, sp.icon, false)
            paintIcons(arrows, sp.arrow, busy)
            if bar then
                local lit = idle and (state.hover or state.press)
                ah(bar, {
                    BackgroundColor3 = z[sp.bar or "Accent"],
                    BackgroundTransparency = lit and 0.1 or 1,
                    Size = UDim2.fromOffset(2, lit and (state.press and 24 or 16) or 4),
                }, dur, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint)
            end
            for i, frame in ipairs(nudges) do
                local shift = (idle and state.hover) and (state.press and 1 or 3) or 0
                ah(frame, { Position = nudgeBase[i] + UDim2.fromOffset(shift, 0) }, dur, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint)
            end
            if spin then
                spin:Set(busy)
                if busy then
                    spin:SetColor(z[sp.text], dur)
                end
            end
            if loadingShown ~= busy then
                loadingShown = busy
                if c.onLoading then
                    c.onLoading(busy, dur)
                end
            end
        end
        local canClick = c.scroller and ay(hit, c.scroller) or function()
            return true
        end
        local last = 0
        local cooldown = tonumber(opts.Cooldown) or 0
        local function run()
            if state.disabled or state.loading then
                return
            end
            if cooldown > 0 then
                local now = os.clock()
                if now - last < cooldown then
                    return
                end
                last = now
            end
            if opts.Lock then
                state.loading = true
                state.hover, state.press = false, false
                paint(0.12)
                task.spawn(function()
                    aJ(opts.Callback)
                    state.loading = false
                    if hit.Parent then
                        paint(0.2)
                    end
                end)
            else
                aJ(opts.Callback)
            end
        end
        hit.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
            if ax() then
                return
            end
            state.hover = true
            paint(0.12)
        end)
        hit.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
            state.hover, state.press = false, false
            paint(0.25)
        end)
        hit.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
            if aw(input) and not state.disabled then
                state.press = true
                paint(0.06)
            end
        end)
        hit.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
            if aw(input) and state.press then
                state.press = false
                paint(0.14)
            end
        end)
        hit.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            if state.disabled or state.loading or not canClick() then
                return
            end
            local sp = spec[state.style] or spec.Default
            aE(c.ripple or bg, z[sp.text])
            run()
        end)
        function fx:SetStyle(s)
            state.style = k._btnNorm(s)
            paint(0.15)
        end
        function fx:GetStyle()
            return state.style
        end
        function fx:SetDisabled(v)
            state.disabled = v == true
            if state.disabled then
                state.hover, state.press = false, false
            end
            paint(0.15)
        end
        function fx:IsDisabled()
            return state.disabled
        end
        function fx:SetLoading(v)
            state.loading = v == true
            if state.loading then
                state.hover, state.press = false, false
            end
            paint(0.15)
        end
        function fx:IsLoading()
            return state.loading
        end
        function fx:SetCallback(f)
            opts.Callback = f
        end
        function fx:Fire()
            run()
        end
        if spin then
            hit.Destroying:Connect(function()
                spin:Destroy()
            end)
        end
        paint(0)
        return fx
    end
    local function aT(aU, aV)
        local rowH = E and 34 or 28
        local totalH = rowH + 6 + (aV.Desc and 16 or 0)
        local hitFrame = aO(aU, "TextButton", totalH, aV)
        local chip = ai("Frame", {
            Position = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 3),
            Size = UDim2.new(1, -28, 0, rowH),
            BackgroundColor3 = z.Surface3,
            BackgroundTransparency = 0.45,
            BorderSizePixel = 0,
            ClipsDescendants = true,
            Parent = hitFrame,
        })
        aj(chip, UDim.new(0, 6))
        local chipStroke = ak(chip)
        local grad = ai("UIGradient", {
            Rotation = 90,
            Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255), Color3.fromRGB(222, 222, 226)),
            Enabled = false,
            Parent = chip,
        })
        local body = k._chipContent(chip, aU.Window, aV, 13, 14)
        local title = body.Title
        local desc
        if aV.Desc then
            desc = am({
                Position = UDim2.fromOffset(14, rowH + 6),
                Size = UDim2.new(1, -28, 0, 14),
                Text = aV.Desc,
                TextSize = 12,
                FontFace = D.Regular,
                TextColor3 = z.Muted,
                Parent = hitFrame,
            })
        end
        local fx = k._btnFx({
            kind = "chip",
            hit = hitFrame,
            bg = chip,
            stroke = chipStroke,
            opts = aV,
            ripple = chip,
            texts = { title },
            icons = body.Icons,
            grad = grad,
            spinner = body.Spinner,
            onLoading = body.fit,
            scroller = function()
                return hitFrame:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("ScrollingFrame")
            end,
        })
        local api = {
            SetText = function(self, t)
                title.Text = tostring(t)
                self._searchName = tostring(t)
                self._searchKey = string.lower(tostring(t))
            end,
            SetDesc = function(_, t)
                if desc then
                    desc.Text = tostring(t)
                end
            end,
        }
        for name, fn in pairs(fx) do
            api[name] = fn
        end
        return m(aU, aV, api, hitFrame, "Button")
    end
    function aS:Button(aU)
        aU = l(aU, { Title = "Name", Description = "Desc" })
        if aM(self).Compact then
            return aT(self, aU)
        end
        local card, cardStroke = aO(self, "TextButton", aU.Desc and J or I, aU)
        card.ClipsDescendants = true
        local pad, icons = 0, {}
        if aU.Icon then
            local _, img = aB(card, aU.Icon, z.Accent, UDim2.new(0, 14, 0.5, 0))
            icons[1] = img
            pad = 26
        end
        local showArrow = aU.Arrow ~= false
        local title, desc = aP(card, aU.Name or "Button", aU.Desc, showArrow and 36 or 16)
        if pad > 0 then
            for _, lbl in ipairs({ title, desc }) do
                lbl.Position = lbl.Position + UDim2.fromOffset(pad, 0)
                lbl.Size = lbl.Size - UDim2.fromOffset(pad, 0)
            end
        end
        local arrows, nudges = {}, {}
        if showArrow then
            local arrowBox, arrow = aB(card, x, z.Muted, UDim2.new(1, -30, 0.5, 0))
            if arrow.Image == "" then
                arrow:Destroy()
                arrow = am({
                    Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
                    Text = "\u{203a}",
                    TextSize = 22,
                    TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center,
                    TextColor3 = z.Muted,
                    TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.None,
                    Parent = arrowBox,
                })
            end
            arrows[1] = arrow
            nudges[1] = arrowBox
        end
        local spinner = k._spinner(card, {
            Size = 14,
            AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5),
            Position = UDim2.new(1, -29, 0.5, 0),
        })
        local bar = ai("Frame", {
            Name = "HoverBar",
            AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5),
            Position = UDim2.new(0, 5, 0.5, 0),
            Size = UDim2.fromOffset(2, 4),
            BackgroundColor3 = z.Accent,
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            BorderSizePixel = 0,
            Parent = card,
        })
        aj(bar, UDim.new(1, 0))
        local grad = ai("UIGradient", {
            Rotation = 90,
            Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255), Color3.fromRGB(222, 222, 226)),
            Enabled = false,
            Parent = card,
        })
        local fx = k._btnFx({
            kind = "card",
            hit = card,
            bg = card,
            stroke = cardStroke,
            opts = aU,
            texts = { title },
            descs = desc and { desc } or {},
            icons = icons,
            arrows = arrows,
            nudges = nudges,
            bar = bar,
            grad = grad,
            spinner = spinner,
            scroller = function()
                return card:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("ScrollingFrame")
            end,
        })
        local api = {
            SetText = function(self, t)
                title.Text = tostring(t)
                self._searchName = tostring(t)
                self._searchKey = string.lower(tostring(t))
            end,
            SetDesc = function(_, t)
                if desc then
                    desc.Text = tostring(t)
                end
            end,
        }
        for name, fn in pairs(fx) do
            api[name] = fn
        end
        return m(self, aU, api, card, "Button")
    end

    function aS:Toggle(opts)
        local trackW, trackH = E and 46 or 38, E and 26 or 22
        local knobS = E and 20 or 16
        local pad = (trackH - knobS) / 2
        local grow = E and 6 or 5
        local ledS = E and 8 or 6
        local compact = aM(self).Compact
        local card, stroke, _rowH, titleLbl, descLbl
        opts, card, stroke, _rowH, titleLbl, descLbl = aQ(
            self,
            opts,
            { Title = "Name", Description = "Desc", CurrentValue = "Default", Value = "Default" },
            "TextButton",
            trackW + 22,
            "Toggle"
        )
        local customColor = opts.Color ~= nil and k._color(opts.Color) or nil
        local styleKey = { Danger = "Error", Success = "Success", Warning = "Warning" }
        local state = {
            on = opts.Default == true,
            hover = false,
            press = false,
            disabled = opts.Disabled == true,
            style = k._btnNorm(opts.Style or (opts.Danger and "Danger")),
        }
        local function onColor()
            if customColor then
                return customColor
            end
            local key = styleKey[state.style]
            return key and z[key] or z.Accent
        end
        local track = ai("Frame", {
            Name = "Track",
            AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5),
            Position = UDim2.new(1, -14, 0.5, 0),
            Size = UDim2.fromOffset(trackW, trackH),
            BackgroundColor3 = z.Surface3,
            BorderSizePixel = 0,
            Parent = card,
        })
        aj(track, UDim.new(1, 0))
        ai("UIGradient", {
            Rotation = 90,
            Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255), Color3.fromRGB(226, 226, 230)),
            Parent = track,
        })
        local trackStroke = ak(track, z.Stroke)
        local glow = ai("ImageLabel", {
            AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
            Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5),
            Size = UDim2.new(1, 22, 1, 22),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            Image = A.Glow,
            ImageColor3 = z.Accent,
            ImageTransparency = 1,
            ZIndex = 0,
            Parent = track,
        })
        local knob = ai("Frame", {
            Name = "Knob",
            AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5),
            Position = UDim2.new(0, pad, 0.5, 0),
            Size = UDim2.fromOffset(knobS, knobS),
            BackgroundColor3 = z.Muted,
            BorderSizePixel = 0,
            ZIndex = 2,
            Parent = track,
        })
        aj(knob, UDim.new(1, 0))
        ai("UIGradient", {
            Rotation = 90,
            Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255), Color3.fromRGB(222, 222, 226)),
            Parent = knob,
        })
        local led = ai("Frame", {
            Name = "Led",
            AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
            Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5),
            Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0),
            BackgroundColor3 = z.Accent,
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            BorderSizePixel = 0,
            ZIndex = 3,
            Parent = knob,
        })
        aj(led, UDim.new(1, 0))

        local api = { Value = state.on }
        local pulseId = 0

        local function paint(dur, pulse)
            local on, locked = state.on, state.disabled
            local col = onColor()
            local live = on and not locked
            local width = knobS + (((state.press and not locked) or pulse) and grow or 0)
            local knobX = on and (trackW - pad - width) or pad
            ah(track, {
                BackgroundColor3 = on and col or z.Surface3,
                BackgroundTransparency = locked and 0.5 or 0,
            }, dur)
            ah(trackStroke, {
                Color = on and col or ((state.hover and not locked) and z.StrokeHover or z.Stroke),
                Transparency = locked and 0.5 or 0,
            }, dur)
            ah(glow, {
                ImageColor3 = col,
                ImageTransparency = live and (state.hover and 0.66 or 0.76) or 1,
            }, dur)
            ah(knob, {
                Position = UDim2.new(0, knobX, 0.5, 0),
                Size = UDim2.fromOffset(width, knobS),
                BackgroundColor3 = on and z.AccentDark or z.Muted,
                BackgroundTransparency = locked and 0.35 or 0,
            }, dur, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint)
            ah(led, {
                Size = on and UDim2.fromOffset(ledS, ledS) or UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0),
                BackgroundColor3 = col,
                BackgroundTransparency = on and (locked and 0.5 or 0) or 1,
            }, dur, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint)
            local fill = compact and 1 or 0
            if not locked then
                if state.press then
                    fill = compact and 0.72 or 0.25
                elseif state.hover then
                    fill = compact and 0.88 or 0.6
                end
            end
            ah(card, {
                BackgroundColor3 = fill == (compact and 1 or 0) and z.Surface2 or z.Surface3,
                BackgroundTransparency = fill,
            }, dur)
            ah(titleLbl, { TextTransparency = locked and 0.55 or (on and 0 or 0.12) }, dur)
            if descLbl then
                ah(descLbl, { TextTransparency = locked and 0.7 or 0 }, dur)
            end
        end

        local function setValue(value, silent, byUser)
            value = value == true
            if value == state.on then
                return
            end
            state.on = value
            api.Value = value
            pulseId = pulseId + 1
            local id = pulseId
            if state.press then
                paint(0.2)
            else
                paint(0.16, true)
                task.delay(0.14, function()
                    if id == pulseId then
                        paint(0.3)
                    end
                end)
            end
            if not byUser then
                aF(stroke)
            end
            if not silent then
                aJ(opts.Callback, value)
            end
        end

        card.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
            if ax() then
                return
            end
            state.hover = true
            paint(0.12)
        end)
        card.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
            state.hover, state.press = false, false
            paint(0.2)
        end)
        card.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
            if aw(input) and not state.disabled then
                state.press = true
                paint(0.08)
            end
        end)
        card.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
            if aw(input) and state.press then
                state.press = false
                paint(0.15)
            end
        end)

        local canTap = ay(card, function()
            return card:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("ScrollingFrame")
        end)
        card.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            if state.disabled or not canTap() then
                return
            end
            setValue(not state.on, false, true)
        end)

        function api:Set(value, silent)
            setValue(value, silent, false)
        end
        function api:Get()
            return state.on
        end
        function api:Toggle(silent)
            setValue(not state.on, silent, false)
        end
        function api:SetDisabled(v)
            state.disabled = v == true
            if state.disabled then
                state.hover, state.press = false, false
            end
            paint(0.15)
        end
        function api:IsDisabled()
            return state.disabled
        end
        function api:SetStyle(style)
            state.style = k._btnNorm(style)
            customColor = nil
            paint(0.2)
        end
        function api:SetText(text)
            text = tostring(text)
            titleLbl.Text = text
            api._searchName = text
            api._searchKey = string.lower(text)
        end
        function api:SetDesc(text)
            if descLbl then
                descLbl.Text = tostring(text)
            end
        end

        paint(0)
        local control = m(self, opts, api, card, "Toggle")
        if state.on then
            aJ(opts.Callback, true)
        end
        return control
    end

    -- Slider: title + value chip on top, drag bar below. Click the value to type a number.
    -- Options: Name/Title, Min, Max, Step/Increment, Default/CurrentValue/Value, Suffix, Decimals, Format(value) -> text,
    --          Origin (number, or false; default 0 when the range crosses 0, so the fill starts in the middle),
    --          Ticks (true/false; default: dots on the track when there are 20 steps or fewer),
    --          Bubble (value bubble above the thumb while dragging; default: touch devices only),
    --          Keyboard (default true), RightClickReset (default true), Flag, Tooltip, Visible, Disabled,
    --          Callback(value) on every change, OnRelease(value) when a drag ends.
    -- Methods: Set(value, silent), Get(), Reset(silent), SetRange(min, max, step, silent), SetSuffix(text), SetFormat(fn),
    --          SetDisabled(bool), IsDisabled(), SetText(title).   Fields: Value, Dragging.
    -- Hold Shift while dragging for fine control. Hover the bar and press the arrow keys to nudge (Shift = x10).
    -- Right click the bar to reset it to Default.
    function aS:Slider(opts)
        opts = l(opts, {
            Title = "Name",
            Description = "Desc",
            CurrentValue = "Default",
            Value = "Default",
            Increment = "Step",
        })
        local minV = tonumber(opts.Min) or 0
        local maxV = tonumber(opts.Max) or 100
        if minV > maxV then
            minV, maxV = maxV, minV
        end
        local step = tonumber(opts.Step) or 1
        if not (step > 0) then
            step = 1
        end
        local suffix = opts.Suffix ~= nil and tostring(opts.Suffix) or ""
        local formatFn = type(opts.Format) == "function" and opts.Format or nil
        local forcedDecimals = tonumber(opts.Decimals)
        if forcedDecimals then
            forcedDecimals = math.clamp(math.floor(forcedDecimals), 0, 8)
        end

        local decimals = 0
        local function decimalsOf(n)
            local s = string.format("%.8f", math.abs(n)):gsub("0+$", "")
            local dot = s:find(".", 1, true)
            return dot and (#s - dot) or 0
        end
        local function calcDecimals()
            decimals = forcedDecimals or math.min(math.max(decimalsOf(step), decimalsOf(minV)), 8)
        end
        calcDecimals()
        local function round(v)
            local mult = 10 ^ decimals
            v = math.floor(v * mult + 0.5) / mult
            return v == 0 and 0 or v
        end
        local function snap(v)
            v = math.clamp(v, minV, maxV)
            local snapped = minV + math.floor((v - minV) / step + 0.5) * step
            -- the end of the range stays reachable even when it is not on the step grid
            if snapped > maxV or math.abs(maxV - v) < math.abs(snapped - v) then
                snapped = maxV
            end
            return math.clamp(round(snapped), minV, maxV)
        end
        local function fmt(v)
            return string.format("%." .. decimals .. "f", v)
        end
        local function fractionOf(v)
            local range = maxV - minV
            return range == 0 and 0 or math.clamp((v - minV) / range, 0, 1)
        end
        -- text shown in the chip / bubble (Format wins over Suffix)
        local function display(v)
            if formatFn then
                local ok, text = pcall(formatFn, v)
                if ok and text ~= nil then
                    return tostring(text)
                end
            end
            return fmt(v) .. suffix
        end
        local function parseInput(text)
            text = tostring(text):gsub(",", "."):gsub("%s", "")
            return tonumber(text:match("^[%+%-]?%d*%.?%d*"))
        end
        -- the value the fill grows from (the middle for -x..x ranges)
        local origin = minV
        local function calcOrigin()
            local setting = opts.Origin
            if type(setting) == "number" then
                origin = math.clamp(setting, minV, maxV)
            elseif setting == false then
                origin = minV
            elseif minV < 0 and maxV > 0 then
                origin = 0
            else
                origin = minV
            end
        end
        calcOrigin()

        local metrics = aM(self)
        local compact = metrics.Compact
        local rowH = metrics.Slider
        local card, cardStroke = aO(self, "Frame", rowH, opts)
        aG(card, cardStroke)
        local titleLbl = am({
            Position = UDim2.fromOffset(14, compact and 5 or 12),
            Size = UDim2.new(1, -120, 0, 18),
            Text = opts.Name or "Slider",
            TextSize = metrics.TextSize,
            Parent = card,
        })
        local chip = ai("Frame", {
            AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0),
            Position = UDim2.new(1, compact and -14 or -10, 0, compact and 2 or 9),
            Size = UDim2.fromOffset(40, 24),
            BackgroundColor3 = z.Surface,
            BorderSizePixel = 0,
            ClipsDescendants = true,
            Parent = card,
        })
        aj(chip, UDim.new(0, 6))
        local chipStroke = ak(chip)
        local valueLbl = am({
            Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0),
            TextSize = 13,
            TextColor3 = z.Accent,
            TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center,
            TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.None,
            Parent = chip,
        })
        local editBox = ai("TextBox", {
            Position = UDim2.fromOffset(9, 0),
            Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0),
            AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X,
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            Text = "",
            TextColor3 = z.Text,
            TextSize = 13,
            FontFace = D.Medium,
            TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
            ClearTextOnFocus = false,
            Visible = false,
            Parent = chip,
        })
        ai("UISizeConstraint", { MinSize = Vector2.new(14, 0), Parent = editBox })
        local suffixLbl = am({
            Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0),
            AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X,
            Text = suffix,
            TextSize = 13,
            TextColor3 = z.Accent,
            TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.None,
            Visible = false,
            Parent = chip,
        })
        local chipBtn = ai("TextButton", {
            Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            Text = "",
            AutoButtonColor = false,
            ZIndex = 2,
            Parent = chip,
        })

        local thumbIdle = (compact and 12 or 14) + (E and 2 or 0)
        local thumbHover = thumbIdle + 2
        local thumbDrag = thumbIdle + (E and 8 or 6)
        local trackH = compact and 5 or 6
        local barCenter = rowH - (compact and 13 or 18) + 2
        local useBubble = opts.Bubble
        if useBubble == nil then
            useBubble = E -- touch: the finger covers the thumb, so show the value above it
        end
        useBubble = useBubble == true
        local bubbleLift = math.floor(thumbDrag / 2) + 8

        local bar = ai("Frame", {
            AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5),
            Position = UDim2.new(0, 14, 0, barCenter),
            Size = UDim2.new(1, -28, 0, trackH),
            BackgroundColor3 = z.Surface3,
            BorderSizePixel = 0,
            Parent = card,
        })
        aj(bar, UDim.new(1, 0))
        local fill = ai("Frame", {
            Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0),
            BackgroundColor3 = z.Accent,
            BorderSizePixel = 0,
            Parent = bar,
        })
        aj(fill, UDim.new(1, 0))
        -- the fill fades out towards where it started, so the bright end always sits under the thumb
        local fillGrad = ai("UIGradient", {
            Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
                NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.55),
                NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0),
            }),
            Parent = fill,
        })
        local tickHolder = ai("Frame", {
            Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            ZIndex = 2,
            Parent = bar,
        })
        local glow = ai("ImageLabel", {
            AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
            Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.5, 0),
            Size = UDim2.fromOffset(thumbIdle * 2.4, thumbIdle * 2.4),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            Image = A.Glow,
            ImageColor3 = z.Accent,
            ImageTransparency = 0.85,
            ZIndex = 2,
            Parent = bar,
        })
        local thumb = ai("Frame", {
            AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
            Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.5, 0),
            Size = UDim2.fromOffset(thumbIdle, thumbIdle),
            BackgroundColor3 = z.Accent,
            BorderSizePixel = 0,
            ZIndex = 3,
            Parent = bar,
        })
        aj(thumb, UDim.new(1, 0))
        -- ring in the card colour: the thumb looks cut out of the track
        ak(thumb, compact and z.Surface or z.Surface2, 0, 2)

        local bubble, bubbleLbl
        if useBubble then
            bubble = ai("Frame", {
                AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1),
                Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.5, -bubbleLift),
                Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 20),
                AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X,
                BackgroundColor3 = z.Accent,
                BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                BorderSizePixel = 0,
                Visible = false,
                ZIndex = 6,
                Parent = bar,
            })
            aj(bubble, UDim.new(0, 6))
            al(bubble, 8, 8, 0, 0)
            bubbleLbl = am({
                Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0),
                AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X,
                TextSize = 12,
                FontFace = D.Bold,
                TextColor3 = z.AccentDark,
                TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center,
                TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.None,
                TextTransparency = 1,
                ZIndex = 7,
                Parent = bubble,
            })
        end

        local hitTop = math.max((compact and 2 or 9) + 24, math.floor(barCenter - (E and 22 or 15)))
        local hit = ai("TextButton", {
            Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, hitTop),
            Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, rowH - hitTop),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            Text = "",
            AutoButtonColor = false,
            ZIndex = 4,
            Parent = card,
        })

        local state = { dragging = false, hover = false, chipHover = false, editing = false, disabled = opts.Disabled == true }
        local api = { Value = 0, Dragging = false }
        local defaultValue = snap(tonumber(opts.Default) or minV)
        api.Value = defaultValue
        local pulseId = 0
        local dragInput, lockedScroller, fineAnchor
        local bubbleOn = false
        local ticks = {}

        local function paintChip(dur)
            local color, alpha = z.Stroke, 0
            if state.editing then
                color = z.StrokeHover
            elseif state.dragging then
                color, alpha = z.Accent, 0.55
            elseif state.chipHover and not state.disabled then
                color = z.StrokeHover
            end
            ah(chipStroke, { Color = color, Transparency = alpha }, dur)
        end
        local function paintThumb(dur)
            local size, glowAlpha = thumbIdle, 0.85
            if state.disabled then
                glowAlpha = 1
            elseif state.dragging then
                size, glowAlpha = thumbDrag, 0.68
            elseif state.hover then
                size, glowAlpha = thumbHover, 0.78
            end
            local grown = (state.dragging or state.hover) and not state.disabled
            ah(
                thumb,
                { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(size, size) },
                dur,
                state.dragging and Enum.EasingStyle.Back or Enum.EasingStyle.Quint
            )
            ah(
                glow,
                { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(size * 2.4, size * 2.4), ImageTransparency = glowAlpha },
                dur,
                Enum.EasingStyle.Quint
            )
            ah(bar, { Size = UDim2.new(1, -28, 0, grown and trackH + 2 or trackH) }, dur, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint)
        end
        local function paintTitle(dur)
            ah(titleLbl, { TextColor3 = (state.dragging and not state.disabled) and z.Accent or z.Text }, dur)
        end
        local function paintDisabled(dur)
            local locked = state.disabled
            ah(titleLbl, { TextTransparency = locked and 0.55 or 0 }, dur)
            ah(valueLbl, { TextTransparency = locked and 0.55 or 0 }, dur)
            ah(bar, { BackgroundTransparency = locked and 0.5 or 0 }, dur)
            ah(fill, { BackgroundTransparency = locked and 0.6 or 0 }, dur)
            ah(thumb, { BackgroundTransparency = locked and 0.4 or 0 }, dur)
            for _, dot in ipairs(ticks) do
                ah(dot.frame, { BackgroundTransparency = locked and 0.85 or (dot.on and 0.5 or 0.55) }, dur)
            end
        end
        local function paintAll(dur)
            paintDisabled(dur)
            paintThumb(dur)
            paintChip(dur)
            paintTitle(dur)
        end

        -- step dots on the track (few steps only), coloured by whether the fill has reached them
        local function paintTicks()
            if #ticks == 0 then
                return
            end
            local low, high = math.min(origin, api.Value), math.max(origin, api.Value)
            for _, dot in ipairs(ticks) do
                local on = dot.value >= low - 1e-9 and dot.value <= high + 1e-9
                if on ~= dot.on then
                    dot.on = on
                    ah(dot.frame, {
                        BackgroundColor3 = on and z.AccentDark or z.Muted,
                        BackgroundTransparency = state.disabled and 0.85 or (on and 0.5 or 0.55),
                    }, 0)
                end
            end
        end
        local function buildTicks()
            for _, dot in ipairs(ticks) do
                dot.frame:Destroy()
            end
            table.clear(ticks)
            local range = maxV - minV
            local count = range > 0 and math.floor(range / step + 1e-6) or 0
            local show
            if opts.Ticks == nil then
                show = count >= 2 and count <= 20
            else
                show = opts.Ticks == true and count >= 2 and count <= 60
            end
            if not show then
                return
            end
            for index = 1, count do
                local value = minV + index * step
                if value < maxV - step * 1e-3 then
                    local frame = ai("Frame", {
                        AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
                        Position = UDim2.new((value - minV) / range, 0, 0.5, 0),
                        Size = UDim2.fromOffset(2, 2),
                        BackgroundColor3 = z.Muted,
                        BackgroundTransparency = 0.55,
                        BorderSizePixel = 0,
                        Parent = tickHolder,
                    })
                    aj(frame, UDim.new(1, 0))
                    table.insert(ticks, { frame = frame, value = value, on = false })
                end
            end
        end

        local function resizeChip(instant)
            local width
            if state.editing then
                local boxW = editBox.AbsoluteSize.X / self.Window.Scale.Scale
                width = 9 + boxW + suffixLbl.TextBounds.X + 9
                suffixLbl.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(9 + boxW, 0)
            else
                width = valueLbl.TextBounds.X + 18
            end
            width = math.max(width, 36)
            if instant then
                chip.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(width, 24)
            else
                ah(chip, { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(width, 24) }, 0.2)
            end
        end
        valueLbl:GetPropertyChangedSignal("TextBounds"):Connect(function()
            if not state.editing then
                resizeChip(false)
            end
        end)
        editBox:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(function()
            if state.editing then
                resizeChip(false)
            end
        end)

        -- the bubble follows the thumb but never leaves the bar
        local function placeBubble(dur)
            if not bubble then
                return
            end
            local scale = self.Window.Scale.Scale
            local barW = bar.AbsoluteSize.X / scale
            local half = bubble.AbsoluteSize.X / scale / 2
            local x = fractionOf(api.Value) * barW
            if barW > half * 2 then
                x = math.clamp(x, half, barW - half)
            else
                x = barW / 2
            end
            ah(bubble, { Position = UDim2.new(0, x, 0.5, -bubbleLift) }, dur or 0, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad)
        end
        local function showBubble(on)
            if not bubble or on == bubbleOn then
                return
            end
            bubbleOn = on
            if on then
                bubble.Visible = true
                placeBubble(0)
                ah(bubble, { BackgroundTransparency = 0 }, 0.12)
                ah(bubbleLbl, { TextTransparency = 0 }, 0.12)
            else
                ah(bubble, { BackgroundTransparency = 1 }, 0.15)
                ah(bubbleLbl, { TextTransparency = 1 }, 0.15)
                task.delay(0.17, function()
                    if not bubbleOn and bubble.Parent then
                        bubble.Visible = false
                    end
                end)
            end
        end
        if bubble then
            bubble:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(function()
                if bubbleOn then
                    placeBubble(0)
                end
            end)
        end

        local function place(frac, dur, style)
            local originFrac = fractionOf(origin)
            local pos = UDim2.new(frac, 0, 0.5, 0)
            fillGrad.Rotation = frac < originFrac and 180 or 0
            ah(fill, {
                Position = UDim2.new(math.min(originFrac, frac), 0, 0, 0),
                Size = UDim2.new(math.abs(frac - originFrac), 0, 1, 0),
            }, dur, style)
            ah(thumb, { Position = pos }, dur, style)
            ah(glow, { Position = pos }, dur, style)
        end
        local function applyVisual(dur, style)
            place(fractionOf(api.Value), dur, style)
            local text = display(api.Value)
            valueLbl.Text = text
            if bubbleLbl then
                bubbleLbl.Text = text
            end
            paintTicks()
            if bubbleOn then
                placeBubble(dur)
            end
        end
        local function pulse()
            pulseId = pulseId + 1
            local id = pulseId
            ah(thumb, { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(thumbIdle + 3, thumbIdle - 2) }, 0.08)
            ah(glow, { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(thumbIdle * 2.8, thumbIdle * 2.8), ImageTransparency = 0.74 }, 0.12)
            task.delay(0.1, function()
                if id == pulseId and not state.dragging and not api._destroyed then
                    paintThumb(0.25)
                end
            end)
        end

        function api:Set(value, silent)
            value = tonumber(value)
            if not value or value ~= value then
                return
            end
            value = snap(value)
            if value == api.Value then
                return
            end
            api.Value = value
            if state.dragging then
                applyVisual(0.07, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad)
            else
                applyVisual(0.3, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint)
                pulse()
                aF(cardStroke)
            end
            if not silent then
                aJ(opts.Callback, value)
            end
        end
        function api:Get()
            return api.Value
        end
        function api:Reset(silent)
            api:Set(defaultValue, silent)
        end

        local function fineHeld()
            if dragInput and dragInput.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                return false
            end
            local ok, down = pcall(function()
                return b:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift) or b:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.RightShift)
            end)
            return ok and down
        end
        local function valueFromX(x)
            local width = math.max(bar.AbsoluteSize.X, 1)
            if fineHeld() then
                -- Shift: 5x slower, relative to where the pointer was when Shift went down
                if not fineAnchor then
                    fineAnchor = { x = x, value = api.Value }
                end
                api:Set(fineAnchor.value + (x - fineAnchor.x) / width * (maxV - minV) * 0.2)
            else
                fineAnchor = nil
                local frac = math.clamp((x - bar.AbsolutePosition.X) / width, 0, 1)
                api:Set(minV + (maxV - minV) * frac)
            end
        end
        local function unlockScroll()
            if lockedScroller then
                lockedScroller.ScrollingEnabled = true
                lockedScroller = nil
            end
        end
        local function beginDrag(input)
            if state.dragging or state.disabled then
                return
            end
            state.dragging = true
            api.Dragging = true
            dragInput = input
            fineAnchor = nil
            if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                -- a finger on the bar must not scroll the page
                local scroller = card:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("ScrollingFrame")
                if scroller and scroller.ScrollingEnabled then
                    scroller.ScrollingEnabled = false
                    lockedScroller = scroller
                end
            end
            paintThumb(0.15)
            paintChip(0.12)
            paintTitle(0.12)
            showBubble(true)
            valueFromX(input.Position.X)
        end
        local function endDrag()
            if not state.dragging then
                return
            end
            state.dragging = false
            api.Dragging = false
            dragInput = nil
            fineAnchor = nil
            unlockScroll()
            paintThumb(0.2)
            paintChip(0.2)
            paintTitle(0.2)
            showBubble(false)
            applyVisual(0.15, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint)
            aJ(opts.OnRelease, api.Value)
        end

        hit.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
            if aw(input) then
                beginDrag(input)
            elseif
                input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2
                and opts.RightClickReset ~= false
                and not state.disabled
            then
                api:Reset()
            end
        end)
        hit.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
            if ax() then
                return
            end
            state.hover = true
            paintThumb(0.15)
        end)
        hit.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
            state.hover = false
            paintThumb(0.2)
        end)
        self.Window:_listen("Changed", function(input)
            if not (state.dragging and dragInput) then
                return
            end
            if dragInput.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                if input == dragInput then
                    valueFromX(input.Position.X)
                end
            elseif input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then
                -- the button was released outside the window: Ended never arrived
                local ok, pressed = pcall(b.IsMouseButtonPressed, b, Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1)
                if ok and not pressed then
                    endDrag()
                else
                    valueFromX(input.Position.X)
                end
            end
        end, api)
        self.Window:_listen("Ended", function(input)
            if not (state.dragging and dragInput) then
                return
            end
            if input == dragInput
                or (dragInput.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch and input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1)
            then
                endDrag()
            end
        end, api)
        if opts.Keyboard ~= false then
            -- arrow keys nudge the slider while the pointer is over the bar
            self.Window:_listen("Began", function(input, processed)
                if processed or state.disabled or not (state.hover or state.dragging) then
                    return
                end
                local code = input.KeyCode
                local direction = 0
                if code == Enum.KeyCode.Right or code == Enum.KeyCode.Up then
                    direction = 1
                elseif code == Enum.KeyCode.Left or code == Enum.KeyCode.Down then
                    direction = -1
                end
                if direction == 0 then
                    return
                end
                local ok, shift = pcall(function()
                    return b:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift) or b:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.RightShift)
                end)
                api:Set(api.Value + direction * step * ((ok and shift) and 10 or 1))
            end, api)
        end

        api._listeners = api._listeners or {}
        table.insert(api._listeners, unlockScroll)

        chipBtn.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
            if ax() then
                return
            end
            state.chipHover = true
            paintChip(0.12)
        end)
        chipBtn.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
            state.chipHover = false
            paintChip(0.2)
        end)
        chipBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            if state.disabled then
                return
            end
            state.editing = true
            state.chipHover = false
            editBox.Text = fmt(api.Value)
            valueLbl.Visible = false
            editBox.Visible = true
            suffixLbl.Visible = suffix ~= ""
            chipBtn.Visible = false
            paintChip(0.12)
            editBox:CaptureFocus()
            task.defer(resizeChip, false)
        end)
        editBox.Focused:Connect(function()
            -- select everything so typing replaces the number
            task.defer(function()
                if editBox:IsFocused() then
                    editBox.SelectionStart = 1
                    editBox.CursorPosition = #editBox.Text + 1
                end
            end)
        end)
        editBox.FocusLost:Connect(function(_enter, inputObject)
            local cancelled = inputObject ~= nil and inputObject.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Escape
            local parsed = (not cancelled) and parseInput(editBox.Text) or nil
            state.editing = false
            state.chipHover = false
            editBox.Visible = false
            suffixLbl.Visible = false
            valueLbl.Visible = true
            chipBtn.Visible = true
            paintChip(0.2)
            if parsed then
                api:Set(parsed)
            end
            resizeChip(false)
        end)

        function api:SetDisabled(v)
            state.disabled = v == true
            if state.disabled then
                if state.dragging then
                    endDrag()
                end
                if state.editing then
                    editBox:ReleaseFocus()
                end
                state.hover, state.chipHover = false, false
            end
            paintAll(0.15)
        end
        function api:IsDisabled()
            return state.disabled
        end
        function api:SetText(text)
            text = tostring(text)
            titleLbl.Text = text
            api._searchName = text
            api._searchKey = string.lower(text)
        end
        function api:SetSuffix(text)
            suffix = text ~= nil and tostring(text) or ""
            suffixLbl.Text = suffix
            applyVisual(0, nil)
            resizeChip(false)
        end
        function api:SetFormat(fn)
            formatFn = type(fn) == "function" and fn or nil
            applyVisual(0, nil)
            resizeChip(false)
        end

        function api:SetRange(newMin, newMax, newStep, silent)
            newMin = tonumber(newMin) or minV
            newMax = tonumber(newMax) or maxV
            if newMin > newMax then
                newMin, newMax = newMax, newMin
            end
            minV, maxV = newMin, newMax
            newStep = tonumber(newStep)
            if newStep and newStep > 0 then
                step = newStep
            end
            calcDecimals()
            calcOrigin()
            defaultValue = snap(defaultValue)
            buildTicks()
            local clamped = snap(api.Value)
            local changed = clamped ~= api.Value
            api.Value = clamped
            applyVisual(0.25, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint)
            if changed and not silent then
                aJ(opts.Callback, clamped)
            end
        end
        api._onHide = function()
            if state.dragging then
                endDrag()
            end
            if editBox:IsFocused() then
                editBox:ReleaseFocus()
            end
            showBubble(false)
        end

        buildTicks()
        applyVisual(0, nil)
        paintAll(0)
        task.defer(resizeChip, true)
        return m(self, opts, api, card, "Slider")
    end

    -- Dropdown: single or multi select with a searchable, virtualized list.
    -- Options: Name/Title, Desc/Description, Options/Values, Default/CurrentOption/Value (a value, or a list with Multi), Multi,
    --          Stacked (compact rows only: the chip sits under the title), Flag, Tooltip, Visible, Disabled,
    --          Icons = { [option] = "lucide-name" | asset }   icon in front of the option (single mode also shows it on the chip),
    --          Hints = { [option] = "text" }                    small muted text at the right end of the row,
    --          DisabledOptions = { option, ... } | { [option] = true }   shown dimmed, can not be picked, skipped by the arrow keys,
    --          MaxRows, MaxSelected (Multi), AllowNone (single, default true), CloseOnSelect (single, default true),
    --          Searchable (default true), SearchAfter, SearchPlaceholder, AutoFocus, PopupWidth, NoResultsText, EmptyText, NoneText,
    --          SelectAllText / ClearAllText (Multi), Callback(value), OnOpen(), OnClose(value).
    -- Methods: Set(value, silent), Get(), Reset(silent), Clear(silent), Refresh(options, keepSelection, silent), GetOptions(),
    --          AddOption(option), RemoveOption(option), SetOptionDisabled(option, bool), SetOpen(bool), IsOpen(),
    --          SetDisabled(bool), IsDisabled(), SetText(title), SetDesc(text).
    -- Keys while open: Up / Down / PageUp / PageDown / Home / End move, Enter / Space picks, Esc closes.
    -- Without a search box, typing letters jumps to the next option that starts with them.
    function aS:Dropdown(opt)
        opt = l(opt, {
            Title = "Name",
            Description = "Desc",
            CurrentOption = "Default",
            Value = "Default",
            MultipleOptions = "Multi",
            Values = "Options",
        })
        if opt.Multi and type(opt.Default) ~= "table" and opt.Default ~= nil then
            opt.Default = { opt.Default }
        elseif not opt.Multi and type(opt.Default) == "table" then
            opt.Default = opt.Default[1]
        end
        local isMulti = opt.Multi == true
        local iconMap = type(opt.Icons) == "table" and opt.Icons or nil
        local hintMap = type(opt.Hints) == "table" and opt.Hints or nil
        -- DisabledOptions is a list ({ "A", "B" }) or a map ({ A = true }); numbers in a list are options, booleans mark a map entry
        local disabledOptions = {}
        if type(opt.DisabledOptions) == "table" then
            for key, entry in pairs(opt.DisabledOptions) do
                if type(entry) == "boolean" then
                    if entry then
                        disabledOptions[key] = true
                    end
                else
                    disabledOptions[entry] = true
                end
            end
        end
        local controlDisabled = opt.Disabled == true

        local foldMap = k._foldMap
        if not foldMap then
            foldMap = {}
            for _, group in ipairs({
                { "a", "\u{e0}\u{e1}\u{1ea3}\u{e3}\u{1ea1}\u{103}\u{1eb1}\u{1eaf}\u{1eb3}\u{1eb5}\u{1eb7}\u{e2}\u{1ea7}\u{1ea5}\u{1ea9}\u{1eab}\u{1ead}\u{e4}\u{e5}", "\u{c0}\u{c1}\u{1ea2}\u{c3}\u{1ea0}\u{102}\u{1eb0}\u{1eae}\u{1eb2}\u{1eb4}\u{1eb6}\u{c2}\u{1ea6}\u{1ea4}\u{1ea8}\u{1eaa}\u{1eac}\u{c4}\u{c5}" },
                { "e", "\u{e8}\u{e9}\u{1ebb}\u{1ebd}\u{1eb9}\u{ea}\u{1ec1}\u{1ebf}\u{1ec3}\u{1ec5}\u{1ec7}\u{eb}", "\u{c8}\u{c9}\u{1eba}\u{1ebc}\u{1eb8}\u{ca}\u{1ec0}\u{1ebe}\u{1ec2}\u{1ec4}\u{1ec6}\u{cb}" },
                { "i", "\u{ec}\u{ed}\u{1ec9}\u{129}\u{1ecb}\u{ef}", "\u{cc}\u{cd}\u{1ec8}\u{128}\u{1eca}\u{cf}" },
                { "o", "\u{f2}\u{f3}\u{1ecf}\u{f5}\u{1ecd}\u{f4}\u{1ed3}\u{1ed1}\u{1ed5}\u{1ed7}\u{1ed9}\u{1a1}\u{1edd}\u{1edb}\u{1edf}\u{1ee1}\u{1ee3}\u{f6}", "\u{d2}\u{d3}\u{1ece}\u{d5}\u{1ecc}\u{d4}\u{1ed2}\u{1ed0}\u{1ed4}\u{1ed6}\u{1ed8}\u{1a0}\u{1edc}\u{1eda}\u{1ede}\u{1ee0}\u{1ee2}\u{d6}" },
                { "u", "\u{f9}\u{fa}\u{1ee7}\u{169}\u{1ee5}\u{1b0}\u{1eeb}\u{1ee9}\u{1eed}\u{1eef}\u{1ef1}\u{fc}", "\u{d9}\u{da}\u{1ee6}\u{168}\u{1ee4}\u{1af}\u{1eea}\u{1ee8}\u{1eec}\u{1eee}\u{1ef0}\u{dc}" },
                { "y", "\u{1ef3}\u{fd}\u{1ef7}\u{1ef9}\u{1ef5}\u{ff}", "\u{1ef2}\u{dd}\u{1ef6}\u{1ef8}\u{1ef4}\u{178}" },
                { "d", "\u{111}", "\u{110}" },
                { "n", "\u{f1}", "\u{d1}" },
                { "c", "\u{e7}", "\u{c7}" },
            }) do
                for index = 2, #group do
                    for ch in string.gmatch(group[index], utf8.charpattern) do
                        foldMap[ch] = group[1]
                    end
                end
            end
            k._foldMap = foldMap
        end
        local function foldText(text)
            text = string.lower(text)
            if string.find(text, "[\128-\255]") then
                text = string.gsub(text, utf8.charpattern, foldMap)
            end
            return text
        end
        local function escapeRich(text)
            return (text:gsub("&", "&amp;"):gsub("<", "&lt;"):gsub(">", "&gt;"))
        end
        local function utf8Length(text)
            return utf8.len(text) or #text
        end
        local function utf8Prefix(text, count)
            if count <= 0 then
                return ""
            end
            local ok, position = pcall(utf8.offset, text, count + 1)
            if ok and position then
                return string.sub(text, 1, position - 1)
            end
            return string.sub(text, 1, count)
        end
        
        local function foldChars(text)
            local parts, byteChar, charStart, charEnd = {}, {}, {}, {}
            local count, bytes = 0, 0
            for position, ch in string.gmatch(text, "()(" .. utf8.charpattern .. ")") do
                count += 1
                charStart[count] = position
                charEnd[count] = position + #ch - 1
                local folded = foldMap[ch] or string.lower(ch)
                parts[count] = folded
                for _ = 1, #folded do
                    bytes += 1
                    byteChar[bytes] = count
                end
            end
            return table.concat(parts), byteChar, charStart, charEnd
        end

        local options, foldedOf = {}, {}
        local function setOptions(list)
            options, foldedOf = {}, {}
            for _, option in ipairs(type(list) == "table" and list or {}) do
                if option ~= nil and foldedOf[option] == nil then
                    options[#options + 1] = option
                    foldedOf[option] = foldText(tostring(option))
                end
            end
        end
        setOptions(opt.Options)

        local frame, frameStroke, rowHeight
        opt, frame, frameStroke, rowHeight = aQ(self, opt, {}, "Frame")
        local metrics = aM(self)
        local compact = metrics.Compact
        local chipH = metrics.Chip
        local window = self.Window
        local itemH = E and 40 or 30
        local maxRows = math.max(math.floor(tonumber(opt.MaxRows) or 6), 1)
        local stacked = compact and opt.Stacked == true
        local topPad = 2
        if stacked then
            topPad = (opt.Name or "") ~= "" and 20 or 2
            chipH = E and 34 or 30
            rowHeight = topPad + chipH + 4
            frame.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, rowHeight)
        end
        local button = ai("TextButton", {
            Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, rowHeight),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            Text = "",
            AutoButtonColor = false,
            Parent = frame,
        })
        local titleLabel, descLabel
        if not stacked then
            titleLabel, descLabel = aP(button, opt.Name or "Dropdown", opt.Desc, 180, metrics)
        elseif topPad > 2 then
            titleLabel = am({
