            keyTools = { short = {}, alias = {}, byName = {} }
            for fullName, shortName in pairs({
                Zero = "0", One = "1", Two = "2", Three = "3", Four = "4", Five = "5", Six = "6", Seven = "7", Eight = "8", Nine = "9",
                Backquote = "`", Minus = "-", Equals = "=", LeftBracket = "[", RightBracket = "]", Semicolon = ";", Quote = "'",
                Comma = ",", Period = ".", Slash = "/", BackSlash = "\\",
                KeypadZero = "Num0", KeypadOne = "Num1", KeypadTwo = "Num2", KeypadThree = "Num3", KeypadFour = "Num4",
                KeypadFive = "Num5", KeypadSix = "Num6", KeypadSeven = "Num7", KeypadEight = "Num8", KeypadNine = "Num9",
                KeypadPeriod = "Num.", KeypadDivide = "Num/", KeypadMultiply = "Num*", KeypadMinus = "Num-", KeypadPlus = "Num+",
                KeypadEnter = "NumEnter", KeypadEquals = "Num=",
                PageUp = "PgUp", PageDown = "PgDn", Insert = "Ins", Delete = "Del", CapsLock = "Caps", NumLock = "NumLk",
                ScrollLock = "ScrLk", Return = "Enter", Escape = "Esc", LeftSuper = "LWin", RightSuper = "RWin",
                LeftControl = "LCtrl", RightControl = "RCtrl", LeftShift = "LShift", RightShift = "RShift",
                LeftAlt = "LAlt", RightAlt = "RAlt",
            }) do
                keyTools.short[fullName] = shortName
                keyTools.alias[string.lower(shortName)] = fullName
            end
            for _, item in ipairs(Enum.KeyCode:GetEnumItems()) do
                keyTools.byName[string.lower(item.Name)] = item
            end
            k._keyTools = keyTools
        end
        local MOUSE = {
            [Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1] = "M1",
            [Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2] = "M2",
            [Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton3] = "M3",
        }
        local function parseBind(value)
            if value == nil then
                return nil
            end
            if typeof(value) == "EnumItem" then
                if value.EnumType == Enum.KeyCode then
                    return value ~= Enum.KeyCode.Unknown and value or nil
                end
                if value.EnumType == Enum.UserInputType and MOUSE[value] then
                    return value
                end
                return nil
            end
            if type(value) ~= "string" then
                return nil
            end
            local text = string.lower((value:gsub("%s+", "")))
            if text == "" or text == "none" then
                return nil
            end
            local button = text:match("^mousebutton(%d)$") or text:match("^mouse(%d)$") or text:match("^mb(%d)$") or text:match("^m(%d)$")
            if button then
                local item = Enum.UserInputType["MouseButton" .. button]
                return item and MOUSE[item] and item or nil
            end
            return keyTools.byName[text] or keyTools.byName[string.lower(keyTools.alias[text] or "")]
        end
        local function keyText(key)
            if key == nil then
                return "None"
            end
            return MOUSE[key] or keyTools.short[key.Name] or aI(key)
        end

        local blocked = {}
        if type(opts.Blacklist) == "table" then
            for _, item in ipairs(opts.Blacklist) do
                local parsed = parseBind(item)
                if parsed then
                    blocked[parsed] = true
                end
            end
        end
        local allowMouse = opts.AllowMouse ~= false
        local allowClear = opts.AllowClear ~= false

        local MODE_HINT = { Press = "tap", Hold = "while held", Toggle = "on / off" }
        local function cleanMode(value)
            if type(value) ~= "string" then
                return nil
            end
            value = string.lower(value)
            for name in pairs(MODE_HINT) do
                if string.lower(name) == value then
                    return name
                end
            end
            return nil
        end
        local modeList = {}
        if type(opts.Modes) == "table" then
            for _, name in ipairs(opts.Modes) do
                local clean = cleanMode(name)
                if clean and not table.find(modeList, clean) then
                    table.insert(modeList, clean)
                end
            end
        end
        if #modeList == 0 then
            modeList = { "Press", "Hold", "Toggle" }
        end
        local menuEnabled = opts.Modes ~= false and #modeList > 1
        local mode = cleanMode(opts.Mode)
        if not mode or (opts.Modes ~= false and not table.find(modeList, mode)) then
            mode = table.find(modeList, "Press") and "Press" or modeList[1]
        end
        local defaultMode = mode

        local defaultKey = parseBind(opts.Default)
        if opts.Default ~= nil and defaultKey == nil and tostring(opts.Default) ~= "" then
            warn("[AirFlow] Keybind: unknown key '" .. tostring(opts.Default) .. "'")
        end

        local state = { listening = false, disabled = opts.Disabled == true, hover = false, active = false, menuOpen = false }
        local api = { Value = defaultKey, Mode = mode, Active = false, Listening = false, Open = false }

        local chip = ai("TextButton", {
            AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5),
            Position = UDim2.new(1, compact and -14 or -10, 0.5, 0),
            Size = UDim2.fromOffset(44, chipH),
            BackgroundColor3 = z.Surface,
            BorderSizePixel = 0,
            Text = "",
            AutoButtonColor = false,
            ClipsDescendants = true,
            Parent = frame,
        })
        aj(chip, UDim.new(0, 6))
        local chipStroke = ak(chip)
        -- H / T badge: tells the mode at a glance and lights up while the bind is on
        local badge = ai("Frame", {
            AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5),
            Position = UDim2.new(0, 6, 0.5, 0),
            Size = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 14),
            BackgroundColor3 = z.Surface3,
            BorderSizePixel = 0,
            Visible = false,
            Parent = chip,
        })
        aj(badge, UDim.new(0, 4))
        local badgeLbl = am({
            Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
            Text = "",
            TextSize = 10,
            FontFace = D.Bold,
            TextColor3 = z.Muted,
            TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center,
            TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.None,
            Parent = badge,
        })
        local label = am({
            Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
            TextSize = 13,
            TextColor3 = z.Muted,
            TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center,
            TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.None,
            Parent = chip,
        })

        local closeMenu, openMenu
        local bindStamp = 0

        local function fit(instant)
            local badgeW = badge.Visible and 20 or 0
            local width = math.max(label.TextBounds.X + 20 + badgeW, E and 44 or 36)
            label.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(badgeW, 0)
            label.Size = UDim2.new(1, -badgeW, 1, 0)
            aR(titleLbl, descLbl, width + (compact and 24 or 20))
            if instant then
                chip.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(width, chipH)
            else
                ah(chip, { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(width, chipH) }, 0.2)
            end
        end
        label:GetPropertyChangedSignal("TextBounds"):Connect(function()
            fit(false)
        end)

        local function paintChip(dur)
            local hot = not state.disabled and (state.hover or state.menuOpen)
            local color, alpha = z.Stroke, 0
            if state.disabled then
                color = z.Stroke
            elseif state.listening then
                color = z.Accent
            elseif state.menuOpen then
                color, alpha = z.Accent, 0.4
            elseif state.active then
                color, alpha = z.Accent, 0.2
            elseif state.hover then
                color = z.StrokeHover
            end
            ah(chipStroke, { Color = color, Transparency = alpha }, dur)
            ah(chip, { BackgroundColor3 = (hot or state.listening) and z.Surface2 or z.Surface }, dur)
            local textColor = z.Text
            if state.listening or state.active then
                textColor = z.Accent
            elseif api.Value == nil then
                textColor = z.Muted
            end
            ah(label, { TextColor3 = textColor }, dur)
            ah(badge, { BackgroundColor3 = state.active and z.Accent or z.Surface3 }, dur)
            ah(badgeLbl, { TextColor3 = state.active and z.AccentDark or z.Muted }, dur)
        end
        local function paintDisabled(dur)
            local dim = state.disabled and 0.55 or 0
            ah(titleLbl, { TextTransparency = dim }, dur)
            if descLbl then
                ah(descLbl, { TextTransparency = dim }, dur)
            end
            ah(label, { TextTransparency = dim }, dur)
            ah(badge, { BackgroundTransparency = state.disabled and 0.6 or 0 }, dur)
            ah(chip, { BackgroundTransparency = state.disabled and 0.5 or 0 }, dur)
        end
        local function refresh(dur)
            label.Text = state.listening and "..." or keyText(api.Value)
            badge.Visible = mode ~= "Press"
            badgeLbl.Text = mode == "Hold" and "H" or "T"
            api.Mode, api.Active, api.Listening = mode, state.active, state.listening
            paintChip(dur)
            fit(false)
        end

        -- a short flash when a Press bind fires
        local flashId = 0
        local function flash()
            flashId += 1
            local id = flashId
            ah(chipStroke, { Color = z.Accent, Transparency = 0 }, 0.06)
            ah(label, { TextColor3 = z.Accent }, 0.06)
            task.delay(0.14, function()
                if id == flashId and not api._destroyed then
                    paintChip(0.3)
                end
            end)
        end
        -- a rejected key: red-less, just a quick shake
        local shaking = false
        local function shake()
            if shaking then
                return
            end
            shaking = true
            local base = chip.Position
            task.spawn(function()
                for _, dx in ipairs({ -3, 3, -2, 2, 0 }) do
                    if api._destroyed then
                        return
                    end
                    ah(chip, { Position = base + UDim2.fromOffset(dx, 0) }, 0.04, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad)
                    task.wait(0.045)
                end
                shaking = false
            end)
        end

        local function setActive(on, silent)
            on = on == true
            if on == state.active then
                return
            end
            state.active = on
            api.Active = on
            paintChip(0.15)
            if not silent then
                aJ(opts.Callback, on, api.Value)
            end
        end

        -- listening pulse
        local pulseTween, pulseId = nil, 0
        local function stopPulse()
            pulseId += 1
            if pulseTween then
                pulseTween:Cancel()
                pulseTween = nil
            end
        end
        local function startPulse()
            pulseId += 1
            local id = pulseId
            task.spawn(function()
                local dim = true
                while state.listening and pulseId == id and not api._destroyed do
                    pulseTween = ah(chipStroke, { Transparency = dim and 0.65 or 0 }, 0.55, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine)
                    dim = not dim
                    task.wait(0.55)
                end
            end)
        end
        local function stopListening()
            if not state.listening then
                return
            end
            state.listening = false
            if window._listeningKeybind == api then
                window._listeningKeybind = nil
            end
            stopPulse()
            refresh(0.15)
        end
        local function startListening()
            if state.listening or state.disabled then
                return
            end
            if state.menuOpen then
                closeMenu()
            end
            local other = window._listeningKeybind
            if other and other ~= api and type(other.StopListening) == "function" then
                other:StopListening()
            end
            window._listeningKeybind = api
            state.listening = true
            refresh(0.15)
            startPulse()
        end

        local function applyKey(key, silent)
            local wasListening = state.listening
            if state.active then
                setActive(false, silent)
            end
            if wasListening then
                state.listening = false
                if window._listeningKeybind == api then
                    window._listeningKeybind = nil
                end
                stopPulse()
            end
            api.Value = key
            refresh(0.15)
            if not wasListening then
                aF(frameStroke)
            end
            if not silent then
                aJ(opts.OnChanged, key)
            end
        end
        local function bindFromListening(key)
            -- a right click that just bound Mouse 2 must not also open the mode menu
            if key == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2 then
                bindStamp = os.clock()
            end
            applyKey(key, false)
        end

        local function inputMatches(input)
            local key = api.Value
            if key == nil then
                return false
            end
            if key.EnumType == Enum.KeyCode then
                return input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard and input.KeyCode == key
            end
            return input.UserInputType == key
        end
        local function trigger()
            if mode == "Press" then
                flash()
                aJ(opts.Callback, api.Value)
            elseif mode == "Hold" then
                setActive(true)
            else
                setActive(not state.active)
            end
        end

        ------------------------------------------------------------------ mode menu
        local menu = nil
        local renderConn = nil
        local menuToken = 0
        local parentScroller = nil
        local MENU_W, ITEM_H, ITEM_GAP = 150, 28, 2
        local function menuHeight()
            local rowsH = #modeList * (ITEM_H + ITEM_GAP) - ITEM_GAP
            local clearShown = allowClear and api.Value ~= nil
            return rowsH + (clearShown and 9 + ITEM_H or 0) + 12, clearShown
        end
        local function paintMenuRow(row, time)
            local on = row.Mode == mode
            ah(row.Frame, {
                BackgroundColor3 = z.Surface3,
                BackgroundTransparency = row.Hover and 0.55 or 1,
            }, time)
            ah(row.Label, { TextColor3 = row.Danger and z.Error or ((on or row.Hover) and z.Text or z.Muted) }, time)
            if row.Bar then
                ah(row.Bar, {
                    BackgroundTransparency = on and 0 or 1,
                    Size = UDim2.fromOffset(3, on and ITEM_H - 14 or 4),
                }, time, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint)
            end
        end
        local function paintMenu(time)
            if not menu then
                return
            end
            for _, row in ipairs(menu.Rows) do
                paintMenuRow(row, time)
            end
            paintMenuRow(menu.ClearRow, time)
            local height, clearShown = menuHeight()
            menu.Separator.Visible = clearShown
            menu.ClearRow.Frame.Visible = clearShown
            menu.Size = Vector2.new(MENU_W, height)
        end
        local function makeMenuRow(parent, y, name, text, hint, danger)
            local rowFrame = ai("TextButton", {
                Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, y),
                Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, ITEM_H),
                BackgroundColor3 = z.Surface3,
                BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                BorderSizePixel = 0,
                Text = "",
                AutoButtonColor = false,
                Parent = parent,
            })
            aj(rowFrame, UDim.new(0, 7))
            local row = { Frame = rowFrame, Mode = name, Hover = false, Danger = danger }
            if not danger then
                row.Bar = ai("Frame", {
                    AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5),
                    Position = UDim2.new(0, 3, 0.5, 0),
                    Size = UDim2.fromOffset(3, 4),
                    BackgroundColor3 = z.Accent,
                    BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                    BorderSizePixel = 0,
                    Parent = rowFrame,
                })
                aj(row.Bar, UDim.new(1, 0))
            end
            row.Label = am({
                Position = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 0),
                Size = UDim2.new(0.5, -14, 1, 0),
                Text = text,
                TextSize = 13,
                TextColor3 = danger and z.Error or z.Muted,
                Parent = rowFrame,
            })
            am({
                AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0),
                Position = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0, 0),
                Size = UDim2.new(0.5, -10, 1, 0),
                Text = hint,
                TextSize = 11,
                FontFace = D.Regular,
                TextColor3 = z.Muted,
                TextTransparency = 0.25,
                TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right,
                Parent = rowFrame,
            })
            rowFrame.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
                if ax() then
                    return
                end
                row.Hover = true
                paintMenuRow(row, 0.12)
            end)
            rowFrame.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
                row.Hover = false
                paintMenuRow(row, 0.2)
            end)
            return row
        end
        local function buildMenu()
            local popup = ai("Frame", {
                AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0),
                Size = UDim2.fromOffset(MENU_W, 0),
                BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                Visible = false,
                ZIndex = 45,
                Parent = window.Body,
            })
            popup:SetAttribute("NoDrag", true)
            local shadow = ai("ImageLabel", {
                Position = UDim2.fromOffset(-18, -12),
                Size = UDim2.new(1, 36, 1, 36),
                BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                Image = A.Shadow,
                ImageColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0),
                ImageTransparency = 1,
                ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Slice,
                SliceCenter = Rect.new(49, 49, 450, 450),
                Parent = popup,
            })
            local content = ai("Frame", {
                Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
                BackgroundColor3 = z.Background,
                BorderSizePixel = 0,
                ClipsDescendants = true,
                Parent = popup,
            })
            aj(content, UDim.new(0, 10))
            local stroke = ak(content, z.Stroke, 1)
            local inner = ai("Frame", { Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 200), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Parent = content })
            al(inner, 6, 6, 6, 6)
            local built = { Popup = popup, Shadow = shadow, Content = content, Stroke = stroke, Rows = {}, Size = Vector2.new(MENU_W, 60) }
            for index, name in ipairs(modeList) do
                local row = makeMenuRow(inner, (index - 1) * (ITEM_H + ITEM_GAP), name, name, MODE_HINT[name], false)
                row.Frame.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                    api:SetMode(name)
                    closeMenu()
                end)
                built.Rows[index] = row
            end
            local rowsH = #modeList * (ITEM_H + ITEM_GAP) - ITEM_GAP
            built.Separator = ai("Frame", {
                Position = UDim2.fromOffset(6, rowsH + 4),
                Size = UDim2.new(1, -12, 0, 1),
                BackgroundColor3 = z.Stroke,
                BorderSizePixel = 0,
                Parent = inner,
            })
            built.ClearRow = makeMenuRow(inner, rowsH + 9, nil, "Clear bind", allowClear and "Backspace" or "", true)
            built.ClearRow.Frame.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                closeMenu()
                applyKey(nil, false)
            end)
            menu = built
            paintMenu(0)
        end
        local function alignMenu()
            if not menu then
                return
            end
            local host = window:_popupHost(frame)
            local scale = window.Scale.Scale
            if parentScroller then
                local center = chip.AbsolutePosition + chip.AbsoluteSize / 2
                if not az(center, parentScroller) then
                    closeMenu()
                    return
                end
            end
            local hostSize = host.AbsoluteSize / scale
            local chipPos = (chip.AbsolutePosition - host.AbsolutePosition) / scale
            local chipSize = chip.AbsoluteSize / scale
            local width, height = menu.Size.X, menu.Size.Y
            local x = math.clamp(chipPos.X + chipSize.X, width + 8, math.max(hostSize.X - 8, width + 8))
            local y = chipPos.Y + chipSize.Y + 6
            if y + height > hostSize.Y - 8 and chipPos.Y - 6 - height >= 8 then
                menu.Popup.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 1)
                menu.Popup.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x, chipPos.Y - 6)
                menu.Content.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 1)
                menu.Content.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 1)
            else
                menu.Popup.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0)
                menu.Popup.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x, y)
                menu.Content.AnchorPoint = Vector2.zero
                menu.Content.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 0)
            end
        end
        local function menuClose()
            closeMenu()
        end
        openMenu = function()
            if state.disabled or not menuEnabled or state.menuOpen then
                return
            end
            if state.listening then
                stopListening()
            end
            if window._closePopup and window._closePopup ~= menuClose then
                window._closePopup()
            end
            window._closePopup = menuClose
            if not menu then
                buildMenu()
            end
            paintMenu(0)
            state.menuOpen = true
            api.Open = true
            menuToken += 1
            parentScroller = frame:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("ScrollingFrame")
            menu.Popup.Parent = window:_popupHost(frame)
            menu.Popup.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(menu.Size.X, 0)
            alignMenu()
            menu.Popup.Visible = true
            ah(menu.Popup, { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(menu.Size.X, menu.Size.Y) }, 0.26, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint)
            ah(menu.Stroke, { Transparency = 0 }, 0.12)
            ah(menu.Shadow, { ImageTransparency = 0.4 }, 0.26)
            if not renderConn then
                renderConn = window:_listen("Render", alignMenu)
            end
            paintChip(0.15)
        end
        closeMenu = function()
            if not state.menuOpen then
                return
            end
            state.menuOpen = false
            api.Open = false
            if window._closePopup == menuClose then
                window._closePopup = nil
            end
            menuToken += 1
            local token = menuToken
            if menu then
                ah(menu.Popup, { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(menu.Size.X, 0) }, 0.18, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint)
                ah(menu.Shadow, { ImageTransparency = 1 }, 0.14)
                task.delay(0.12, function()
                    if token == menuToken and not state.menuOpen and menu then
                        ah(menu.Stroke, { Transparency = 1 }, 0.06)
                    end
                end)
                task.delay(0.19, function()
                    if token == menuToken and not state.menuOpen then
                        if menu then
                            menu.Popup.Visible = false
                        end
                        if renderConn then
                            renderConn()
                            renderConn = nil
                        end
                    end
                end)
            end
            paintChip(0.2)
        end

        ------------------------------------------------------------------ input
        local suppressClick = false
        chip.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            if suppressClick then
                suppressClick = false
                return
            end
            if state.disabled then
                return
            end
            if state.menuOpen then
                closeMenu()
                return
            end
            if state.listening then
                stopListening()
            else
                startListening()
            end
        end)
        chip.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
            if ax() or state.disabled then
                return
            end
            state.hover = true
            paintChip(0.12)
        end)
        chip.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
            state.hover = false
            paintChip(0.25)
        end)
        local pressId = 0
        chip.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
            if state.disabled or not menuEnabled then
                return
            end
            local kind = input.UserInputType
            if kind == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2 then
                if state.listening or os.clock() - bindStamp < 0.2 then
                    return
                end
                if state.menuOpen then
                    closeMenu()
                else
                    openMenu()
                end
            elseif kind == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                pressId += 1
                local id = pressId
                task.delay(0.45, function()
                    if id == pressId and not state.listening and not state.menuOpen and not state.disabled and not api._destroyed then
                        suppressClick = true
                        openMenu()
                    end
                end)
            end
        end)
        chip.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
            if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                pressId += 1
                if suppressClick then
                    task.delay(0.2, function()
                        suppressClick = false
                    end)
                end
            end
        end)

        window:_listen("Began", function(input, processed)
            local kind = input.UserInputType
            if state.listening then
                if kind == Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard then
                    local code = input.KeyCode
                    window._consumedKey = code
                    window._consumedAt = os.clock()
                    if code == Enum.KeyCode.Escape then
                        stopListening()
                    elseif allowClear and (code == Enum.KeyCode.Backspace or code == Enum.KeyCode.Delete) then
                        bindFromListening(nil)
                    elseif blocked[code] then
                        shake()
                    else
                        bindFromListening(code)
                    end
                elseif kind == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2 or kind == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton3 then
                    if allowMouse and not blocked[kind] then
                        bindFromListening(kind)
                    else
                        shake()
                    end
                elseif aw(input) and not az(av(), chip) then
                    stopListening()
                end
                return
            end
            if state.menuOpen then
                if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Escape then
                    closeMenu()
                    return
                end
                if aw(input) or kind == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2 then
                    local pointer = av()
                    if not (menu and az(pointer, menu.Popup)) and not az(pointer, chip) then
                        closeMenu()
                    end
                    return
                end
            end
            if processed or state.disabled then
                return
            end
            if inputMatches(input) then
                trigger()
            end
        end, api)
        window:_listen("Ended", function(input)
            if mode == "Hold" and state.active and inputMatches(input) then
                setActive(false)
            end
        end, api)

        ------------------------------------------------------------------ api
        function api:Set(value, silent)
            applyKey(parseBind(value), silent)
        end
        function api:Get()
            return api.Value
        end
        function api:Clear(silent)
            applyKey(nil, silent)
        end
        function api:Reset(silent)
            api:SetMode(defaultMode, silent)
            applyKey(defaultKey, silent)
        end
        function api:SetMode(value, silent)
            local clean = cleanMode(value)
            if not clean or clean == mode then
                return
            end
            if state.active then
                setActive(false, silent)
            end
            mode = clean
            refresh(0.15)
            paintMenu(0.15)
            if not silent then
                aJ(opts.OnModeChanged, clean)
            end
        end
        function api:GetMode()
            return mode
        end
        function api:GetState()
            return state.active
        end
        function api:IsActive()
            return state.active
        end
        function api:SetState(on, silent)
            if mode ~= "Press" and not state.disabled then
                setActive(on, silent)
            end
        end
        function api:StartListening()
            startListening()
        end
        function api:StopListening()
            stopListening()
        end
        function api:IsListening()
            return state.listening
        end
        function api:SetOpen(open)
            if open then
                openMenu()
            else
                closeMenu()
            end
        end
        function api:SetDisabled(value)
            state.disabled = value == true
            if state.disabled then
                state.hover = false
                stopListening()
                closeMenu()
                if state.active then
                    setActive(false)
                end
            end
            paintDisabled(0.15)
            paintChip(0.15)
        end
        function api:IsDisabled()
            return state.disabled
        end
        function api:SetText(text)
            text = tostring(text)
            titleLbl.Text = text
            api._searchName = text
            api._searchKey = string.lower(text)
        end
        function api:SetDesc(text)
            if descLbl then
                descLbl.Text = tostring(text)
            end
        end
        api._onHide = function()
            stopListening()
            closeMenu()
        end
        api._listeners = api._listeners or {}
        table.insert(api._listeners, function()
            stopListening()
            closeMenu()
            stopPulse()
            if renderConn then
                renderConn()
                renderConn = nil
            end
            if menu then
                menu.Popup:Destroy()
                menu = nil
            end
        end)

        refresh(0)
        paintDisabled(0)
        task.defer(fit, true)
        return m(self, opts, api, frame, "Keybind")
    end
    -- ColorPicker: [title] hex [swatch]. Click the row to fold the picker open under it.
    -- Options: Name/Title, Desc/Description, Default/Color/CurrentValue/Value (Color3 or "#RRGGBB"),
    --          Transparency (0 = opaque .. 1, also adds the alpha bar), Alpha (true adds the alpha bar),
    --          Rainbow (true adds a rainbow button that cycles the hue), RainbowSpeed (hue turns per second, default 0.25),
    --          Presets (false hides the swatches, or a list of Color3 / "#RRGGBB"), Recent (false hides the recently used colors),
    --          Disabled, Flag, Tooltip, Visible, Callback(color, transparency), OnRelease(color, transparency), OnToggle(open).
    -- Methods: Set(color, silent), Get(), GetHex(), SetHex(text, silent), GetHSV(), SetHSV(h, s, v, silent),
    --          GetTransparency(), SetTransparency(t, silent), SetRainbow(bool, silent), IsRainbow(), Reset(silent),
    --          SetOpen(bool), SetDisabled(bool), IsDisabled(), SetText(title), SetDesc(text).
    -- Fields:  Value (Color3), Transparency (0 = opaque), Rainbow, Open.
    -- The hex box takes #RGB, #RRGGBB, #RRGGBBAA (alpha only when the bar is on) and "r, g, b". Escape puts the old text back.
    -- Callback fires while dragging, OnRelease once when the drag or the edit is finished. While Rainbow is on Callback fires ~30 times a second.
    function aS:ColorPicker(opts)
        local card, cardStroke, rowH
        opts, card, cardStroke, rowH = aQ(
            self,
            opts,
            { Title = "Name", Description = "Desc", Color = "Default", CurrentValue = "Default", Value = "Default" },
            "Frame"
        )
        card.ClipsDescendants = true
        local window = self.Window
        local metrics = aM(self)
        local compact = metrics.Compact
        local hasAlpha = opts.Alpha == true or opts.Transparency ~= nil
        local hasRainbow = opts.Rainbow == true
        local rainbowSpeed = tonumber(opts.RainbowSpeed) or 0.25
        local showRecent = opts.Recent ~= false

        -- Colors the user picks are assigned after creation: the theme claims any color that equals one of its own.
        local INERT = Color3.fromRGB(1, 2, 3)
        local WHITE = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 254)
        local BLACK = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 1)

        local function toByte(x)
            return math.clamp(math.floor(x * 255 + 0.5), 0, 255)
        end
        local function hexOf(color)
            return string.format("#%02X%02X%02X", toByte(color.R), toByte(color.G), toByte(color.B))
        end
        local function sameBytes(a1, a2)
            return toByte(a1.R) == toByte(a2.R) and toByte(a1.G) == toByte(a2.G) and toByte(a1.B) == toByte(a2.B)
        end
        -- Color3 / "#RGB" / "#RRGGBB" / "#RRGGBBAA" / "r, g, b" / { Hex = ... } -> Color3, opacity (only with #RRGGBBAA or #RGBA)
        local function parseColor(input)
            if typeof(input) == "Color3" then
                return input
            end
            if type(input) == "table" then
                input = input.Hex or input.hex
            end
            if type(input) ~= "string" then
                return nil
            end
            local text = input:gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
            local digits = text:match("^#?(%x+)$")
            if digits and (#digits == 3 or #digits == 4 or #digits == 6 or #digits == 8) then
                if #digits <= 4 then
                    digits = digits:gsub(".", "%0%0")
                end
                local r, g, b = tonumber(digits:sub(1, 2), 16), tonumber(digits:sub(3, 4), 16), tonumber(digits:sub(5, 6), 16)
                local a = #digits == 8 and tonumber(digits:sub(7, 8), 16) / 255 or nil
                return Color3.fromRGB(r, g, b), a
            end
            local numbers = {}
            for piece in text:gmatch("%d+%.?%d*") do
                numbers[#numbers + 1] = tonumber(piece)
            end
            if #numbers == 3 or (#numbers == 4 and text:lower():find("rgb")) then
                return Color3.fromRGB(
                    math.clamp(numbers[1], 0, 255),
                    math.clamp(numbers[2], 0, 255),
                    math.clamp(numbers[3], 0, 255)
                )
            end
            return nil
        end

        local presets = {}
        if opts.Presets ~= false then
            local source = type(opts.Presets) == "table" and opts.Presets
                or {
                    Color3.fromRGB(239, 68, 68),
                    Color3.fromRGB(249, 115, 22),
                    Color3.fromRGB(250, 204, 21),
                    Color3.fromRGB(34, 197, 94),
                    Color3.fromRGB(20, 184, 166),
                    Color3.fromRGB(59, 130, 246),
                    Color3.fromRGB(168, 85, 247),
                    Color3.fromRGB(236, 72, 153),
                    Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
                    Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0),
                }
            for _, item in ipairs(source) do
                local parsed = parseColor(item)
                if parsed and #presets < 14 then
                    presets[#presets + 1] = parsed
                end
            end
        end
        local hasPalette = #presets > 0 or showRecent or hasRainbow
        local clipboardFn = (typeof(setclipboard) == "function" and setclipboard) or (typeof(toclipboard) == "function" and toclipboard) or nil

        ------------------------------------------------------------------ geometry
        local SV_H, BAR_H, FIELD_H, SWATCH = 118, 10, 28, 18
        local svY = 2
        local hueY = svY + SV_H + 12
        local alphaY = hueY + BAR_H + 10
        local fieldY = (hasAlpha and (alphaY + BAR_H) or (hueY + BAR_H)) + 14
        local paletteY = fieldY + FIELD_H + 10
        local panelH = (hasPalette and (paletteY + SWATCH) or (fieldY + FIELD_H)) + 12
        local openH = rowH + panelH

        ------------------------------------------------------------------ state
        local value, h, s, v, alpha
        local defaultColor, defaultAlpha
        do
            local start = parseColor(opts.Default) or z.Accent
            value = start
            h, s, v = Color3.toHSV(start)
            alpha = 1
            if opts.Transparency ~= nil then
                alpha = 1 - math.clamp(tonumber(opts.Transparency) or 0, 0, 1)
            end
            defaultColor, defaultAlpha = start, alpha
        end
        local state = { open = false, disabled = opts.Disabled == true, drag = nil, rainbow = false, channels = "RGB" }
        local api = { Value = value, Transparency = 1 - alpha, Rainbow = false, Open = false, _hasAlpha = hasAlpha }

        ------------------------------------------------------------------ header
        local header = ai("TextButton", {
            Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, rowH),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            Text = "",
            AutoButtonColor = false,
            Parent = card,
        })
        local hexW = hasAlpha and 104 or 66
        local titleLbl, descLbl = aP(header, opts.Name or "Color", opts.Desc, 76 + hexW, metrics)
        local chevron = aC(header, 1, compact and -14 or -12)
        local swatch = ai("Frame", {
            AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5),
            Position = UDim2.new(1, compact and -38 or -34, 0.5, 0),
            Size = UDim2.fromOffset(22, 22),
            BackgroundColor3 = INERT,
            BorderSizePixel = 0,
            ClipsDescendants = true,
            Parent = header,
        })
        aj(swatch, UDim.new(0, 6))
        ak(swatch, z.Stroke)
        local CHECK_A, CHECK_B = Color3.fromRGB(108, 108, 113), Color3.fromRGB(72, 72, 77)
        local function makeChecker(parent, cols, rows, cell)
            parent.BackgroundColor3 = CHECK_A
            for row = 0, rows - 1 do
                for col = 0, cols - 1 do
                    if (row + col) % 2 == 1 then
                        ai("Frame", {
                            Position = UDim2.fromOffset(col * cell, row * cell),
                            Size = UDim2.fromOffset(cell, cell),
                            BackgroundColor3 = CHECK_B,
                            BorderSizePixel = 0,
                            Parent = parent,
                        })
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        if hasAlpha then
            makeChecker(swatch, 6, 6, 4)
        end
        local swatchFill = ai("Frame", {
            Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
            BackgroundColor3 = INERT,
            BorderSizePixel = 0,
            ZIndex = 2,
            Parent = swatch,
        })
        local hexLbl = am({
            AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5),
            Position = UDim2.new(1, compact and -68 or -64, 0.5, 0),
            Size = UDim2.fromOffset(hexW, 16),
            TextSize = 12,
            FontFace = D.Regular,
            TextColor3 = z.Muted,
            TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right,
            Parent = header,
        })

        ------------------------------------------------------------------ panel
        local body = ai("Frame", {
            Position = UDim2.fromOffset(14, rowH),
            Size = UDim2.new(1, -28, 0, panelH),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            Visible = false,
            Parent = card,
        })
        local function makeHandle(parent, size, zindex)
            local ring = ai("Frame", {
                AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
                Size = UDim2.fromOffset(size, size),
                BackgroundColor3 = WHITE,
                BorderSizePixel = 0,
                ZIndex = zindex,
                Parent = parent,
            })
            aj(ring, UDim.new(1, 0))
            ak(ring, BLACK, 0.65)
            local fill = ai("Frame", {
                AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
                Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5),
                Size = UDim2.new(1, -5, 1, -5),
                BackgroundColor3 = INERT,
                BorderSizePixel = 0,
                ZIndex = zindex,
                Parent = ring,
            })
            aj(fill, UDim.new(1, 0))
            return ring, fill
        end

        -- saturation / value square
        local sv = ai("TextButton", {
            Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, svY),
            Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, SV_H),
            BackgroundColor3 = WHITE,
            BorderSizePixel = 0,
            Text = "",
            AutoButtonColor = false,
            Parent = body,
        })
        aj(sv, UDim.new(0, 8))
        ak(sv, z.Stroke)
        local svHue = ai("UIGradient", { Color = ColorSequence.new(WHITE, Color3.new(1, 0, 0)), Parent = sv })
        local svShade = ai("Frame", { Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundColor3 = BLACK, BorderSizePixel = 0, Parent = sv })
        aj(svShade, UDim.new(0, 8))
        ai("UIGradient", {
            Transparency = NumberSequence.new({ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0) }),
            Rotation = 90,
            Parent = svShade,
        })
        local svHandle, svHandleFill = makeHandle(sv, 14, 3)

        -- hue bar
        local hue = ai("TextButton", {
            Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, hueY),
            Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, BAR_H),
            BackgroundColor3 = WHITE,
            BorderSizePixel = 0,
            Text = "",
            AutoButtonColor = false,
            Parent = body,
        })
        aj(hue, UDim.new(1, 0))
        ai("UIGradient", {
            Color = ColorSequence.new({
                ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)),
                ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1 / 6, Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 0)),
                ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(2 / 6, Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 0)),
                ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(3 / 6, Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 255)),
                ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(4 / 6, Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 255)),
                ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(5 / 6, Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 255)),
                ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)),
            }),
            Parent = hue,
        })
        local hueHandle, hueHandleFill = makeHandle(hue, 16, 3)
        hueHandle.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 0.5)

        -- alpha bar
        local alphaBar, alphaFill, alphaHandle, alphaHandleFill
        if hasAlpha then
            alphaBar = ai("TextButton", {
                Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, alphaY),
                Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, BAR_H),
                BackgroundColor3 = CHECK_A,
                BorderSizePixel = 0,
                Text = "",
                AutoButtonColor = false,
                ClipsDescendants = true,
                Parent = body,
            })
            aj(alphaBar, UDim.new(1, 0))
            makeChecker(alphaBar, 110, 2, 5)
            alphaFill = ai("Frame", { Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundColor3 = INERT, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 2, Parent = alphaBar })
            aj(alphaFill, UDim.new(1, 0))
            ai("UIGradient", {
                Transparency = NumberSequence.new({ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0) }),
                Parent = alphaFill,
            })
            -- the handle sits outside the clipped bar so it can overhang the ends
            local holder = ai("Frame", {
                Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, alphaY),
                Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, BAR_H),
                BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                Parent = body,
            })
            alphaHandle, alphaHandleFill = makeHandle(holder, 16, 3)
            alphaHandle.Position = UDim2.fromScale(1, 0.5)
        end

        -- text fields
        local function makeField(position, size, anchor, tagText, inset)
            local holder = ai("Frame", {
                AnchorPoint = anchor or Vector2.zero,
                Position = position,
                Size = size,
                BackgroundColor3 = z.Surface,
                BorderSizePixel = 0,
                Parent = body,
            })
            aj(holder, UDim.new(0, 7))
            local stroke = ak(holder)
            local tag
            if tagText then
                tag = am({
                    Position = UDim2.fromOffset(7, 0),
                    Size = UDim2.new(0, 12, 1, 0),
                    Text = tagText,
                    TextSize = 11,
                    FontFace = D.Bold,
                    TextColor3 = z.Muted,
                    TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.None,
                    Parent = holder,
                })
            end
            inset = inset or (tagText and 19 or 8)
            local box = ai("TextBox", {
                Position = UDim2.fromOffset(inset, 0),
                Size = UDim2.new(1, -(inset + 4), 1, 0),
                BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                Text = "",
                TextColor3 = z.Text,
                TextSize = 13,
                FontFace = D.Regular,
                TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
                ClearTextOnFocus = false,
                TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.None,
                ClipsDescendants = true,
                Parent = holder,
            })
            box.Focused:Connect(function()
                ah(stroke, { Color = z.Accent, Transparency = 0.45 }, 0.15)
                if tag then
                    ah(tag, { TextColor3 = z.Accent }, 0.15)
                end
            end)
            box.FocusLost:Connect(function()
                ah(stroke, { Color = z.Stroke, Transparency = 0 }, 0.15)
                if tag then
                    ah(tag, { TextColor3 = z.Muted }, 0.15)
                end
            end)
            return box, holder, stroke, tag
        end

        local hexBox, hexHolder, hexStroke = makeField(UDim2.fromOffset(0, fieldY), UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, FIELD_H), nil, nil, 30)
        local hexDot = ai("Frame", {
            AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5),
            Position = UDim2.new(0, 6, 0.5, 0),
            Size = UDim2.fromOffset(16, 16),
            BackgroundColor3 = INERT,
            BorderSizePixel = 0,
            ClipsDescendants = true,
            Parent = hexHolder,
        })
        aj(hexDot, UDim.new(0, 4))
        ak(hexDot, z.Stroke)
        if hasAlpha then
            makeChecker(hexDot, 4, 4, 4)
        end
        local hexDotFill = ai("Frame", { Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundColor3 = INERT, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 2, Parent = hexDot })

        -- copy button (only where the executor can write the clipboard)
        local copyBtn, copyFrames
        if clipboardFn then
            copyBtn = ai("TextButton", {
                AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5),
                Position = UDim2.new(1, -4, 0.5, 0),
                Size = UDim2.fromOffset(20, 20),
                BackgroundColor3 = z.Surface3,
                BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                Text = "",
                AutoButtonColor = false,
                Parent = hexHolder,
            })
            aj(copyBtn, UDim.new(0, 5))
            -- two overlapping outlines: the usual "copy" glyph, drawn with frames so no icon pack is needed
            local back = ai("Frame", {
                Position = UDim2.fromOffset(4, 4),
                Size = UDim2.fromOffset(9, 9),
                BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                BorderSizePixel = 0,
                Parent = copyBtn,
            })
            aj(back, UDim.new(0, 2))
            local front = ai("Frame", {
                Position = UDim2.fromOffset(7, 7),
                Size = UDim2.fromOffset(9, 9),
                BackgroundColor3 = z.Surface,
                BorderSizePixel = 0,
                Parent = copyBtn,
            })
            aj(front, UDim.new(0, 2))
            copyFrames = { ak(back, z.Muted, 0, 1.2), ak(front, z.Muted, 0, 1.2) }
            hexBox.Size = UDim2.new(1, -(30 + 28), 1, 0)
        end

        -- R G B (or H S V) and alpha boxes, plus the button that swaps RGB <-> HSV
        local BOX_W, BOX_GAP, MODE_W = 52, 4, 40
        local channelCount = hasAlpha and 4 or 3
        local channelBoxes, channelHolders, channelTags = {}, {}, {}
        local TAGS = { RGB = { "R", "G", "B" }, HSV = { "H", "S", "V" } }
        for index = 1, channelCount do
            local isAlpha = hasAlpha and index == channelCount
            local box, holder, _, tag = makeField(
                UDim2.new(1, -((channelCount - index) * (BOX_W + BOX_GAP)), 0, fieldY),
                UDim2.fromOffset(BOX_W, FIELD_H),
                Vector2.new(1, 0),
                isAlpha and "A" or TAGS.RGB[index]
            )
            box.TextSize = 12
            channelBoxes[index], channelHolders[index], channelTags[index] = box, holder, tag
        end
        local modeBtn = ai("TextButton", {
            AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0),
            Position = UDim2.new(1, -(channelCount * (BOX_W + BOX_GAP)), 0, fieldY),
            Size = UDim2.fromOffset(MODE_W, FIELD_H),
            BackgroundColor3 = z.Surface3,
            BackgroundTransparency = 0.35,
            BorderSizePixel = 0,
            Text = "",
            AutoButtonColor = false,
            Parent = body,
        })
        aj(modeBtn, UDim.new(0, 7))
        local modeStroke = ak(modeBtn)
        local modeLbl = am({
            Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
            Text = "RGB",
            TextSize = 11,
            FontFace = D.Bold,
            TextColor3 = z.Muted,
            TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center,
            TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.None,
            Parent = modeBtn,
        })

        -- swatch row: presets, a divider, recent colors, rainbow
        local presetButtons, recentButtons, divider, rainbowBtn, rainbowStroke = {}, {}, nil, nil, nil
        local function makeSwatchButton()
            local button = ai("TextButton", {
                Size = UDim2.fromOffset(SWATCH, SWATCH),
                BackgroundColor3 = INERT,
                BorderSizePixel = 0,
                Text = "",
                AutoButtonColor = false,
                Visible = false,
                Parent = body,
            })
            aj(button, UDim.new(0, 5))
            local stroke = ak(button, z.Stroke)
            local entry = { Button = button, Stroke = stroke, Color = nil, Hover = false }
            button.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
                if ax() then
                    return
                end
                entry.Hover = true
                if entry.Color and not entry.On then
                    ah(stroke, { Color = z.StrokeHover }, 0.1)
                end
            end)
            button.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
                entry.Hover = false
                if not entry.On then
                    ah(stroke, { Color = z.Stroke }, 0.2)
                end
            end)
            return entry
        end
        if hasPalette then
            for index, color in ipairs(presets) do
                local entry = makeSwatchButton()
                entry.Color = color
                entry.Button.BackgroundColor3 = color
                entry.Button.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, paletteY)
                presetButtons[index] = entry
            end
            if showRecent then
                for index = 1, 8 do
                    recentButtons[index] = makeSwatchButton()
                    recentButtons[index].Button.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, paletteY)
                end
                divider = ai("Frame", {
                    Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, paletteY + 2),
                    Size = UDim2.fromOffset(1, SWATCH - 4),
                    BackgroundColor3 = z.Stroke,
                    BorderSizePixel = 0,
                    Visible = false,
                    Parent = body,
                })
            end
            if hasRainbow then
                rainbowBtn = ai("TextButton", {
                    AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0),
                    Position = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, paletteY),
                    Size = UDim2.fromOffset(SWATCH, SWATCH),
                    BackgroundColor3 = WHITE,
                    BorderSizePixel = 0,
                    Text = "",
                    AutoButtonColor = false,
                    Parent = body,
                })
                aj(rainbowBtn, UDim.new(1, 0))
                ai("UIGradient", {
                    Color = ColorSequence.new({
                        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)),
                        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.2, Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 0)),
                        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.4, Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 0)),
                        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.6, Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 255)),
                        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.8, Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 255)),
                        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 255)),
                    }),
                    Rotation = 45,
                    Parent = rainbowBtn,
                })
                rainbowStroke = ak(rainbowBtn, z.Stroke, 0, 1.5)
            end
        end

        ------------------------------------------------------------------ painting
        local function panelWidth()
            return body.AbsoluteSize.X / math.max(window.Scale.Scale, 0.05)
        end
        local function setBoxText(box, text)
            if not box:IsFocused() and box.Text ~= text then
                box.Text = text
            end
        end
        local function updateFields()
            setBoxText(hexBox, hexOf(value))
            if state.channels == "RGB" then
                setBoxText(channelBoxes[1], tostring(toByte(value.R)))
                setBoxText(channelBoxes[2], tostring(toByte(value.G)))
                setBoxText(channelBoxes[3], tostring(toByte(value.B)))
            else
                setBoxText(channelBoxes[1], tostring(math.floor(h * 360 + 0.5) % 360))
                setBoxText(channelBoxes[2], tostring(math.floor(s * 100 + 0.5)))
                setBoxText(channelBoxes[3], tostring(math.floor(v * 100 + 0.5)))
            end
            if hasAlpha then
                setBoxText(channelBoxes[channelCount], tostring(math.floor(alpha * 100 + 0.5)))
            end
        end
        local function paintPalette()
            local r, g, b = toByte(value.R), toByte(value.G), toByte(value.B)
            local function mark(entry)
                if not entry.Color or not entry.Button.Visible then
                    if entry.On then
                        entry.On = false
                        ah(entry.Stroke, { Color = z.Stroke, Thickness = 1 }, 0)
                    end
                    return
                end
                local on = toByte(entry.Color.R) == r and toByte(entry.Color.G) == g and toByte(entry.Color.B) == b
                if on ~= entry.On then
                    entry.On = on
                    ah(entry.Stroke, { Color = on and z.Accent or (entry.Hover and z.StrokeHover or z.Stroke), Thickness = on and 2 or 1 }, 0.12)
                end
            end
            for _, entry in ipairs(presetButtons) do
                mark(entry)
            end
            for _, entry in ipairs(recentButtons) do
                mark(entry)
            end
        end
        local function paintHexLabel()
            if state.rainbow then
                hexLbl.Text = "Rainbow"
            elseif hasAlpha and alpha < 0.995 then
                hexLbl.Text = hexOf(value) .. "  " .. math.floor(alpha * 100 + 0.5) .. "%"
            else
                hexLbl.Text = hexOf(value)
            end
        end
        -- a handle follows the pointer directly while dragging and glides when the color comes from elsewhere
        local handleTweens = {}
        local function moveHandle(handle, position, dur)
            local running = handleTweens[handle]
            if running then
                running:Cancel()
                handleTweens[handle] = nil
            end
            if dur > 0 then
                handleTweens[handle] = ah(handle, { Position = position }, dur, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint)
            else
                handle.Position = position
            end
        end
        local function paint(animate)
            api.Value, api.Transparency = value, 1 - alpha
            swatchFill.BackgroundColor3 = value
            swatchFill.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - alpha
            paintHexLabel()
            if not body.Visible then
                return
            end
            local pure = Color3.fromHSV(h, 1, 1)
            svHue.Color = ColorSequence.new(WHITE, pure)
            svHandleFill.BackgroundColor3 = value
            hueHandleFill.BackgroundColor3 = pure
            hexDotFill.BackgroundColor3 = value
            hexDotFill.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - alpha
            local dur = animate and 0.22 or 0
            moveHandle(svHandle, UDim2.fromScale(s, 1 - v), dur)
            moveHandle(hueHandle, UDim2.fromScale(h, 0.5), dur)
            if hasAlpha then
                alphaFill.BackgroundColor3 = value
                alphaHandleFill.BackgroundColor3 = value
                moveHandle(alphaHandle, UDim2.fromScale(alpha, 0.5), dur)
            end
            updateFields()
            paintPalette()
        end
        local function paintDisabled(dur)
            local dim = state.disabled and 0.55 or 0
            ah(titleLbl, { TextTransparency = dim }, dur)
            if descLbl then
                ah(descLbl, { TextTransparency = dim }, dur)
            end
            ah(hexLbl, { TextTransparency = dim }, dur)
        end
        local function paintMode()
            modeLbl.Text = state.channels
            for index = 1, 3 do
                channelTags[index].Text = TAGS[state.channels][index]
            end
            updateFields()
        end

        local function layoutFields()
            local width = panelWidth()
            local groupW = channelCount * (BOX_W + BOX_GAP) + MODE_W + BOX_GAP
            local wide = width - groupW >= 104
            modeBtn.Visible = wide
            for index = 1, channelCount do
                channelHolders[index].Visible = wide
            end
            hexHolder.Size = UDim2.new(1, wide and -groupW or 0, 0, FIELD_H)
        end
        local function layoutPalette()
            if not hasPalette then
                return
            end
            local width = panelWidth()
            local avail = width - (hasRainbow and SWATCH + 8 or 0)
            local x = 0
            for _, entry in ipairs(presetButtons) do
                if x + SWATCH <= avail then
                    entry.Button.Visible = true
                    entry.Button.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x, paletteY)
                    x += SWATCH + 4
                else
                    entry.Button.Visible = false
                end
            end
            local recent = showRecent and k._recentColors or {}
            local dividerW = #presetButtons > 0 and 10 or 0
            local fits = math.max(math.floor((avail - x - dividerW + 4) / (SWATCH + 4)), 0)
            local count = math.min(#recent, fits, #recentButtons)
            if divider then
                divider.Visible = count > 0 and #presetButtons > 0
                if divider.Visible then
                    divider.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x + 2, paletteY + 2)
                end
            end
            if count > 0 then
                x += dividerW
            end
            for index, entry in ipairs(recentButtons) do
                if index <= count then
                    entry.Color = recent[index]
                    entry.Button.BackgroundColor3 = recent[index]
                    entry.Button.Visible = true
                    entry.Button.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x, paletteY)
                    x += SWATCH + 4
                else
                    entry.Button.Visible = false
                    entry.Color = nil
                end
            end
            paintPalette()
        end
        body:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(function()
            layoutFields()
            layoutPalette()
        end)

        ------------------------------------------------------------------ state changes
        local function notify()
            aJ(opts.Callback, value, 1 - alpha)
        end
        local function released()
            aJ(opts.OnRelease, value, 1 - alpha)
        end
        local function pushRecent(color)
            if not showRecent then
                return
            end
            local list = k._recentColors
            if not list then
                list = {}
                k._recentColors = list
            end
            for index = #list, 1, -1 do
                if toByte(list[index].R) == toByte(color.R) and toByte(list[index].G) == toByte(color.G) and toByte(list[index].B) == toByte(color.B) then
                    table.remove(list, index)
                end
            end
            table.insert(list, 1, color)
            while #list > 8 do
                table.remove(list)
            end
            if body.Visible then
                layoutPalette()
            end
        end
        -- keep the hue and the saturation when a gray or a black comes in, so the sliders do not jump to 0
        local function takeColor(color)
            local nh, ns, nv = Color3.toHSV(color)
            if nv < 0.0001 then
                ns = s
            end
            if ns < 0.0001 or nv < 0.0001 then
                nh = h
            end
            h, s, v = nh, ns, nv
            value = color
        end

        local rainbowConn, rainbowAcc = nil, 0
        local function setRainbow(on, silent)
            on = on == true
            if on == state.rainbow then
                return
            end
            state.rainbow = on
            api.Rainbow = on
            if on then
                if s < 0.3 then
                    s = 1
                end
                if v < 0.3 then
                    v = 1
                end
                rainbowAcc = 0
                if not rainbowConn then
                    rainbowConn = window:_listen("Render", function(dt)
                        h = (h + dt * rainbowSpeed) % 1
                        value = Color3.fromHSV(h, s, v)
                        rainbowAcc += dt
                        if window.Open ~= false then
                            paint(false)
                        else
                            api.Value = value
                        end
                        if rainbowAcc >= 1 / 30 then
                            rainbowAcc = 0
                            notify()
                        end
                    end)
                end
            elseif rainbowConn then
                rainbowConn()
                rainbowConn = nil
            end
            ah(hexLbl, { TextColor3 = on and z.Accent or z.Muted }, 0.15)
            if rainbowStroke then
                ah(rainbowStroke, { Color = on and z.Accent or z.Stroke, Thickness = on and 2 or 1.5 }, 0.15)
            end
            paint(false)
            if not silent then
                notify()
            end
        end

        local function changed(silent, animate)
            paint(animate)
            if not silent then
                notify()
            end
        end
        -- one color from outside the sliders: Set, hex box, swatch, channel boxes
        local function applyColor(color, newAlpha, silent, animate)
            if state.rainbow then
                setRainbow(false, true)
            end
            takeColor(color)
            if newAlpha and hasAlpha then
                alpha = math.clamp(newAlpha, 0, 1)
            end
            changed(silent, animate)
        end

        ------------------------------------------------------------------ open / close
        local openId = 0
        local function reveal()
            pcall(function()
                local scroller = card:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("ScrollingFrame")
                if not scroller or not state.open then
                    return
                end
                local overflow = (card.AbsolutePosition.Y + card.AbsoluteSize.Y) - (scroller.AbsolutePosition.Y + scroller.AbsoluteSize.Y)
                if overflow > 0 then
                    local scale = math.max(window.Scale.Scale, 0.05)
                    local target = scroller.CanvasPosition.Y + overflow / scale + 10
                    ah(scroller, { CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(0, target) }, 0.25, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint)
                end
            end)
        end
        local function setOpen(open, silent)
            open = open == true
            if open and state.disabled then
                return
            end
            if open == state.open then
                return
            end
            state.open = open
            api.Open = open
            openId += 1
            local id = openId
            chevron:Set(open)
            ah(card, { Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, open and openH or rowH) }, 0.35, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint)
            if open then
                body.Visible = true
                layoutFields()
                layoutPalette()
                paintMode()
                paint(false)
                task.delay(0.37, function()
                    if id == openId then
                        reveal()
                    end
                end)
            else
                state.drag = nil
                for _, box in ipairs(channelBoxes) do
                    if box:IsFocused() then
                        box:ReleaseFocus()
                    end
                end
                if hexBox:IsFocused() then
                    hexBox:ReleaseFocus()
                end
                task.delay(0.35, function()
                    if id == openId and not state.open then
                        body.Visible = false
                    end
                end)
            end
            if not silent then
                aJ(opts.OnToggle, open)
            end
        end
        header.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            if state.disabled then
                return
            end
            setOpen(not state.open)
        end)

        ------------------------------------------------------------------ dragging
        local dragInput, lockedScroller = nil, nil
        local function unlockScroll()
            if lockedScroller then
                lockedScroller.ScrollingEnabled = true
                lockedScroller = nil
            end
        end
        local function dragTo(kind, pointer)
            if kind == "sv" then
                s = math.clamp((pointer.X - sv.AbsolutePosition.X) / math.max(sv.AbsoluteSize.X, 1), 0, 1)
                v = 1 - math.clamp((pointer.Y - sv.AbsolutePosition.Y) / math.max(sv.AbsoluteSize.Y, 1), 0, 1)
            elseif kind == "hue" then
                h = math.clamp((pointer.X - hue.AbsolutePosition.X) / math.max(hue.AbsoluteSize.X, 1), 0, 0.999)
                if state.rainbow then
                    setRainbow(false, true)
                end
            else
                alpha = math.clamp((pointer.X - alphaBar.AbsolutePosition.X) / math.max(alphaBar.AbsoluteSize.X, 1), 0, 1)
            end
            value = Color3.fromHSV(h, s, v)
            changed(false, false)
        end
        local function handleFor(kind)
            return kind == "sv" and svHandle or (kind == "hue" and hueHandle or alphaHandle)
        end
        local function beginDrag(kind, input)
            if state.disabled or state.drag then
                return
            end
            state.drag = kind
            dragInput = input
            if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                local scroller = card:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("ScrollingFrame")
                if scroller and scroller.ScrollingEnabled then
                    scroller.ScrollingEnabled = false
                    lockedScroller = scroller
                end
            end
            local handle = handleFor(kind)
            ah(handle, { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(kind == "sv" and 19 or 21, kind == "sv" and 19 or 21) }, 0.15, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint)
            dragTo(kind, av())
        end
        local function endDrag()
            local kind = state.drag
            if not kind then
                return
            end
            state.drag = nil
            dragInput = nil
            unlockScroll()
            ah(handleFor(kind), { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(kind == "sv" and 14 or 16, kind == "sv" and 14 or 16) }, 0.22, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint)
            pushRecent(value)
            released()
        end
        sv.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
            if aw(input) then
                beginDrag("sv", input)
            end
        end)
        hue.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
            if aw(input) then
                beginDrag("hue", input)
            end
        end)
        if hasAlpha then
            alphaBar.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
                if aw(input) then
                    beginDrag("alpha", input)
                end
            end)
        end
        window:_listen("Changed", function(input)
            if not state.drag or not aA(input) then
                return
            end
            if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then
                -- the button was released outside the window, so Ended never arrived
                local ok, pressed = pcall(b.IsMouseButtonPressed, b, Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1)
                if ok and not pressed then
                    endDrag()
                    return
                end
            elseif dragInput and input ~= dragInput and dragInput.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                return
            end
            dragTo(state.drag, av())
        end, api)
        window:_listen("Ended", function(input)
            if state.drag and aw(input) then
                endDrag()
            end
        end, api)

        ------------------------------------------------------------------ fields, swatches, buttons
        local shaking = false
        local function shake(holder)
            if shaking then
                return
            end
            shaking = true
            local base = holder.Position
            task.spawn(function()
                for _, dx in ipairs({ -3, 3, -2, 2, 0 }) do
                    if api._destroyed then
                        return
                    end
                    ah(holder, { Position = base + UDim2.fromOffset(dx, 0) }, 0.04, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad)
                    task.wait(0.045)
                end
                shaking = false
            end)
        end
        local function finishEdit()
            pushRecent(value)
            released()
        end
        hexBox.FocusLost:Connect(function(_, inputObject)
            if inputObject ~= nil and inputObject.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Escape then
                updateFields()
                return
            end
            local parsed, parsedAlpha = parseColor(hexBox.Text)
            if parsed then
                local same = sameBytes(parsed, value) and (not (parsedAlpha and hasAlpha) or math.abs(parsedAlpha - alpha) < 0.003)
                if same and not state.rainbow then
                    updateFields()
                    return
                end
                applyColor(parsed, parsedAlpha, false, true)
                finishEdit()
            else
                updateFields()
                shake(hexHolder)
            end
        end)
        for index, box in ipairs(channelBoxes) do
            box.FocusLost:Connect(function(_, inputObject)
                if inputObject ~= nil and inputObject.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Escape then
                    updateFields()
                    return
                end
                local number = tonumber(box.Text:match("^%s*(%-?%d+%.?%d*)"))
                if not number then
                    updateFields()
                    shake(channelHolders[index])
                    return
                end
                if hasAlpha and index == channelCount then
                    local newAlpha = math.clamp(number / 100, 0, 1)
                    if math.abs(newAlpha - alpha) < 0.005 then
                        updateFields()
                        return
                    end
                    alpha = newAlpha
                    changed(false, true)
                elseif state.channels == "RGB" then
                    local parts = { toByte(value.R), toByte(value.G), toByte(value.B) }
                    local old = parts[index]
                    parts[index] = math.clamp(math.floor(number + 0.5), 0, 255)
                    if parts[index] == old and not state.rainbow then
                        updateFields()
                        return
                    end
                    applyColor(Color3.fromRGB(parts[1], parts[2], parts[3]), nil, false, true)
                else
                    local parts = { h * 360, s * 100, v * 100 }
                    local old = parts[index]
                    parts[index] = number
                    local nh = math.clamp(parts[1] / 360, 0, 0.999)
                    local ns = math.clamp(parts[2] / 100, 0, 1)
                    local nv = math.clamp(parts[3] / 100, 0, 1)
                    if math.abs(number - old) < 0.5 and not state.rainbow then
                        updateFields()
                        return
                    end
                    if state.rainbow then
                        setRainbow(false, true)
                    end
                    h, s, v = nh, ns, nv
                    value = Color3.fromHSV(h, s, v)
                    changed(false, true)
                end
                finishEdit()
            end)
        end
        modeBtn.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
            if not ax() then
                ah(modeStroke, { Color = z.StrokeHover }, 0.12)
                ah(modeLbl, { TextColor3 = z.Text }, 0.12)
            end
        end)
        modeBtn.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
            ah(modeStroke, { Color = z.Stroke }, 0.2)
            ah(modeLbl, { TextColor3 = z.Muted }, 0.2)
        end)
        modeBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            state.channels = state.channels == "RGB" and "HSV" or "RGB"
            paintMode()
        end)

        local function bindSwatch(entry)
            entry.Button.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                if state.disabled or not entry.Color then
                    return
                end
                applyColor(entry.Color, nil, false, true)
                finishEdit()
            end)
        end
        for _, entry in ipairs(presetButtons) do
            bindSwatch(entry)
        end
        for _, entry in ipairs(recentButtons) do
            bindSwatch(entry)
        end
        if rainbowBtn then
            rainbowBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                if state.disabled then
                    return
                end
                setRainbow(not state.rainbow)
                if not state.rainbow then
                    finishEdit()
                end
            end)
            rainbowBtn.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
                if not ax() and not state.rainbow then
                    ah(rainbowStroke, { Color = z.StrokeHover }, 0.1)
                end
            end)
            rainbowBtn.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
                if not state.rainbow then
                    ah(rainbowStroke, { Color = z.Stroke }, 0.2)
                end
            end)
        end
        if copyBtn then
            local copyId = 0
            copyBtn.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
                if ax() then
                    return
                end
                ah(copyBtn, { BackgroundTransparency = 0.4 }, 0.1)
                ah(copyFrames[1], { Color = z.Accent }, 0.1)
                ah(copyFrames[2], { Color = z.Accent }, 0.1)
            end)
            copyBtn.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
                ah(copyBtn, { BackgroundTransparency = 1 }, 0.15)
                ah(copyFrames[1], { Color = z.Muted }, 0.15)
                ah(copyFrames[2], { Color = z.Muted }, 0.15)
            end)
            copyBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                local ok = pcall(clipboardFn, hexOf(value))
                if not ok then
                    return
                end
                copyId += 1
                local id = copyId
                hexBox.Text = "Copied"
                ah(hexBox, { TextColor3 = z.Success }, 0.1)
                task.delay(0.8, function()
                    if id == copyId and not api._destroyed then
                        ah(hexBox, { TextColor3 = z.Text }, 0.2)
                        updateFields()
                    end
                end)
            end)
        end

        ------------------------------------------------------------------ api
        function api:Set(color, silent)
            local parsed, parsedAlpha = parseColor(color)
            if not parsed then
                return
            end
            applyColor(parsed, parsedAlpha, silent, true)
            aF(cardStroke)
        end
        function api:Get()
