            return value
        end
        function api:GetHex()
            return hexOf(value)
        end
        function api:SetHex(text, silent)
            api:Set(text, silent)
        end
        function api:GetHSV()
            return h, s, v
        end
        function api:SetHSV(nh, ns, nv, silent)
            if state.rainbow then
                setRainbow(false, true)
            end
            h = math.clamp(tonumber(nh) or h, 0, 0.999)
            s = math.clamp(tonumber(ns) or s, 0, 1)
            v = math.clamp(tonumber(nv) or v, 0, 1)
            value = Color3.fromHSV(h, s, v)
            changed(silent, true)
        end
        function api:GetTransparency()
            return 1 - alpha
        end
        function api:SetTransparency(t, silent)
            if not hasAlpha then
                return
            end
            alpha = 1 - math.clamp(tonumber(t) or 0, 0, 1)
            changed(silent, true)
        end
        function api:SetRainbow(on, silent)
            setRainbow(on, silent)
        end
        function api:IsRainbow()
            return state.rainbow
        end
        function api:Reset(silent)
            if state.rainbow then
                setRainbow(false, true)
            end
            takeColor(defaultColor)
            alpha = defaultAlpha
            changed(silent, true)
        end
        function api:SetOpen(open)
            setOpen(open)
        end
        function api:SetDisabled(on)
            state.disabled = on == true
            if state.disabled then
                setOpen(false, true)
                state.drag = nil
                unlockScroll()
            end
            paintDisabled(0.15)
        end
        function api:IsDisabled()
            return state.disabled
        end
        function api:SetText(text)
            text = tostring(text)
            titleLbl.Text = text
            api._searchName = text
            api._searchKey = string.lower(text)
        end
        function api:SetDesc(text)
            if descLbl then
                descLbl.Text = tostring(text)
            end
        end
        api._onHide = function()
            state.drag = nil
            unlockScroll()
            for _, box in ipairs(channelBoxes) do
                if box:IsFocused() then
                    box:ReleaseFocus()
                end
            end
            if hexBox:IsFocused() then
                hexBox:ReleaseFocus()
            end
        end
        api._listeners = api._listeners or {}
        table.insert(api._listeners, function()
            unlockScroll()
            if rainbowConn then
                rainbowConn()
                rainbowConn = nil
            end
        end)

        paintMode()
        paint(false)
        paintDisabled(0)
        return m(self, opts, api, card, "ColorPicker")
    end
    -- Stepper: [-] value [+]. Click the value to type a number.
    -- Options: Name/Title, Desc/Description, Default/CurrentValue, Min, Max, Step/Increment, Suffix, Format(value) -> text,
    --          Meter (thin progress line under the number; default: on when the chip is tall enough),
    --          Keyboard (default true), Flag, Tooltip, Visible, Disabled, Callback(value).
    -- Methods: Set(value, silent), Get(), Reset(silent), SetRange(min, max, step, silent), SetSuffix(text), SetFormat(fn),
    --          SetDisabled(bool), IsDisabled(), SetText(title), SetDesc(text).
    -- Holding +/- repeats (and speeds up on wide ranges); Shift multiplies the step by 10 with a mouse.
    -- While typing, the Up/Down arrows change the number; with the pointer over the stepper the arrow keys step it.
    -- Ranges of 1000 or more also accept 1k / 2.5m / 3b when typing.
    function aS:Stepper(opts)
        local card, cardStroke, rowH, titleLbl, descLbl
        opts, card, cardStroke, rowH, titleLbl, descLbl = aQ(
            self,
            opts,
            { Title = "Name", Description = "Desc", CurrentValue = "Default", Value = "Default", Increment = "Step" },
            "Frame",
            150,
            "Stepper"
        )
        local function finite(v, fallback)
            v = tonumber(v)
            if v == nil or v ~= v or v == math.huge or v == -math.huge then
                return fallback
            end
            return v
        end
        local minV = finite(opts.Min, 0)
        local maxV = finite(opts.Max, 100)
        if minV > maxV then
            minV, maxV = maxV, minV
        end
        local step = finite(opts.Step, 1)
        if not (step > 0) then
            step = 1
        end
        local suffix = (opts.Suffix ~= nil and opts.Suffix ~= false) and tostring(opts.Suffix) or ""
        local formatFn = type(opts.Format) == "function" and opts.Format or nil
        local num = aL(minV, maxV, step)
        local compact = aM(self).Compact
        local chipH = aM(self).Chip
        local abbreviations = math.max(math.abs(minV), math.abs(maxV)) >= 1000
        local showMeter = opts.Meter
        if showMeter == nil then
            showMeter = chipH >= 28
        end
        showMeter = showMeter == true
        local state = { disabled = opts.Disabled == true, editing = false, stepping = false }
        local hovers = {}
        local defaultValue = num.snap(finite(opts.Default, minV))
        local api = { Value = defaultValue }

        local chip = ai("Frame", {
            AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5),
            Position = UDim2.new(1, compact and -14 or -10, 0.5, 0),
            Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, chipH),
            AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X,
            BackgroundColor3 = z.Surface,
            BorderSizePixel = 0,
            Parent = card,
        })
        aj(chip, UDim.new(0, 6))
        local chipStroke = ak(chip)
        ai("UIListLayout", {
            FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal,
            SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
            VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center,
            Parent = chip,
        })

        -- [-] and [+]: a soft pill shows on hover/press, the glyph is drawn with frames so it never depends on a font
        local parts = {}
        local glyphLen = E and 12 or 10
        local function makeButton(direction, order)
            local button = ai("TextButton", {
                Size = UDim2.fromOffset(chipH, chipH),
                BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                Text = "",
                AutoButtonColor = false,
                LayoutOrder = order,
                Parent = chip,
            })
            local pill = ai("Frame", {
                AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
                Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5),
                Size = UDim2.new(1, -6, 1, -6),
                BackgroundColor3 = z.Surface3,
                BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                BorderSizePixel = 0,
                Parent = button,
            })
            aj(pill, UDim.new(0, 4))
            local glyph = {}
            local function addPiece(width, height)
                local piece = ai("Frame", {
                    AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
                    Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5),
                    Size = UDim2.fromOffset(width, height),
                    BackgroundColor3 = z.Muted,
                    BorderSizePixel = 0,
                    ZIndex = 2,
                    Parent = button,
                })
                aj(piece, UDim.new(1, 0))
                table.insert(glyph, piece)
            end
            addPiece(glyphLen, 2)
            if direction > 0 then
                addPiece(2, glyphLen)
            end
            local part = { button = button, pill = pill, glyph = glyph, dir = direction, hover = false, press = false }
            table.insert(parts, part)
            return part
        end
        local function makeDivider(order)
            return ai("Frame", {
                Size = UDim2.new(0, 1, 1, -12),
                BackgroundColor3 = z.Stroke,
                BorderSizePixel = 0,
                LayoutOrder = order,
                Parent = chip,
            })
        end
        local minusPart = makeButton(-1, 1)
        makeDivider(2)
        -- the value lives in a clipped holder so the number can roll up/down when it changes
        local holder = ai("Frame", {
            Size = UDim2.new(0, 34, 1, 0),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            ClipsDescendants = true,
            LayoutOrder = 3,
            Parent = chip,
        })
        makeDivider(4)
        local plusPart = makeButton(1, 5)
        local box = ai("TextBox", {
            Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            Text = "",
            TextColor3 = z.Accent,
            TextSize = 13,
            FontFace = D.Medium,
            TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center,
            TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.None,
            ClearTextOnFocus = false,
            TextEditable = not state.disabled,
            Parent = holder,
        })
        local meterFill
        if showMeter then
            local meter = ai("Frame", {
                AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1),
                Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, -3),
                Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 0, 2),
                BackgroundColor3 = z.Surface3,
                BorderSizePixel = 0,
                Parent = holder,
            })
            aj(meter, UDim.new(1, 0))
            meterFill = ai("Frame", {
                Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0),
                BackgroundColor3 = z.Accent,
                BackgroundTransparency = 0.3,
                BorderSizePixel = 0,
                Parent = meter,
            })
            aj(meterFill, UDim.new(1, 0))
        end

        local function paintStroke(dur)
            local color, alpha = z.Stroke, 0
            if state.editing then
                color, alpha = z.Accent, 0.5
            elseif next(hovers) ~= nil and not state.disabled then
                color = z.StrokeHover
            end
            ah(chipStroke, { Color = color, Transparency = alpha }, dur)
        end
        local function setHover(key, on)
            hovers[key] = on or nil
            paintStroke(0.12)
        end
        local function paintPart(part, dur)
            local atLimit = state.disabled
                or (part.dir < 0 and api.Value <= minV)
                or (part.dir > 0 and api.Value >= maxV)
            local live = not atLimit and (part.hover or part.press)
            ah(part.pill, {
                BackgroundTransparency = atLimit and 1 or (part.press and 0.1 or (part.hover and 0.45 or 1)),
            }, dur)
            for _, piece in ipairs(part.glyph) do
                ah(piece, {
                    BackgroundColor3 = live and z.Accent or z.Muted,
                    BackgroundTransparency = atLimit and 0.65 or 0,
                }, dur)
            end
        end
        local function paintLimits(dur)
            paintPart(minusPart, dur)
            paintPart(plusPart, dur)
        end
        local function paintMeter(dur)
            if not meterFill then
                return
            end
            local range = maxV - minV
            local frac = range > 0 and math.clamp((api.Value - minV) / range, 0, 1) or 0
            ah(meterFill, { Size = UDim2.new(frac, 0, 1, 0) }, dur, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint)
        end
        local function paintDisabled(dur)
            local dim = state.disabled and 0.55 or 0
            ah(titleLbl, { TextTransparency = dim }, dur)
            if descLbl then
                ah(descLbl, { TextTransparency = dim }, dur)
            end
            ah(box, { TextTransparency = dim }, dur)
            paintLimits(dur)
        end

        -- while typing the box shows the bare number, otherwise number + suffix (or whatever Format returns)
        local function shown()
            if state.editing then
                return num.format(api.Value)
            end
            if formatFn then
                local ok, text = pcall(formatFn, api.Value)
                if ok and text ~= nil then
                    return tostring(text)
                end
            end
            return num.format(api.Value) .. suffix
        end
        -- direction ~= nil: the old number slides out and the new one slides in (skipped while holding the button)
        local lastRoll = 0
        local function refreshText(direction)
            local text = shown()
            if direction and not state.editing and box.Text ~= "" and box.Text ~= text and os.clock() - lastRoll > 0.1 then
                lastRoll = os.clock()
                local ghost = ai("TextLabel", {
                    Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
                    BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                    Text = box.Text,
                    TextColor3 = z.Accent,
                    TextSize = 13,
                    FontFace = D.Medium,
                    TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center,
                    TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.None,
                    TextTransparency = box.TextTransparency,
                    Parent = holder,
                })
                ah(ghost, { Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, -direction * 10), TextTransparency = 1 }, 0.16, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint)
                task.delay(0.2, function()
                    ghost:Destroy()
                end)
                box.Text = text
                box.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, direction * 10)
                box.TextTransparency = 1
                ah(
                    box,
                    { Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0), TextTransparency = state.disabled and 0.55 or 0 },
                    0.16,
                    Enum.EasingStyle.Quint
                )
            else
                box.Text = text
            end
        end

        local lastWidth, sizeTween
        local function fit(instant)
            local width = math.max(box.TextBounds.X + 18, 34)
            if width == lastWidth then
                return
            end
            lastWidth = width
            if sizeTween then
                sizeTween:Cancel()
                sizeTween = nil
            end
            if instant then
                holder.Size = UDim2.new(0, width, 1, 0)
            else
                sizeTween = ah(holder, { Size = UDim2.new(0, width, 1, 0) }, 0.2)
            end
        end
        box:GetPropertyChangedSignal("TextBounds"):Connect(function()
            fit(state.editing)
        end)
        chip:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(function()
            aR(titleLbl, descLbl, chip.AbsoluteSize.X / self.Window.Scale.Scale + (compact and 24 or 20))
        end)

        function api:Set(value, silent)
            value = tonumber(value)
            if not value or value ~= value then
                return
            end
            value = num.snap(value)
            if value == api.Value then
                return
            end
            local direction = value > api.Value and 1 or -1
            api.Value = value
            refreshText(direction)
            paintLimits(0.15)
            paintMeter(0.25)
            if not state.stepping then
                aF(cardStroke)
            end
            if not silent then
                aJ(opts.Callback, value)
            end
        end
        function api:Get()
            return api.Value
        end
        function api:Reset(silent)
            api:Set(defaultValue, silent)
        end

        -- next value on the step grid in `direction`, `count` steps away (the range ends are always reachable)
        local function stepFrom(value, direction, count)
            local index = (value - minV) / step
            if direction > 0 then
                index = math.floor(index + 1e-6) + count
            else
                index = math.ceil(index - 1e-6) - count
            end
            return num.snap(minV + index * step)
        end
        local function nudge(direction, count)
            if state.disabled or api._destroyed then
                return false
            end
            local target = stepFrom(api.Value, direction, count)
            if target == api.Value then
                return false
            end
            state.stepping = true
            api:Set(target)
            state.stepping = false
            ah(chipStroke, { Color = z.Accent, Transparency = 0.35 }, 0.06)
            task.delay(0.12, function()
                if not api._destroyed then
                    paintStroke(0.25)
                end
            end)
            return true
        end
        local function shiftMultiplier()
            local ok, down = pcall(function()
                return b:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift) or b:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.RightShift)
            end)
            return ok and down and 10 or 1
        end
        -- long holds on wide ranges move in bigger strides
        local function holdMultiplier(ticks)
            if (maxV - minV) / step < 50 then
                return 1
            end
            if ticks >= 40 then
                return 10
            elseif ticks >= 20 then
                return 4
            end
            return 1
        end
        local function bindHold(part)
            local direction = part.dir
            local held, holdId, repeated = false, 0, false
            local canTap = ay(part.button, function()
                return part.button:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("ScrollingFrame")
            end)
            part.button.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
                if ax() then
                    return
                end
                part.hover = true
                setHover(part, true)
                paintPart(part, 0.12)
            end)
            part.button.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
                held = false
                part.hover, part.press = false, false
                setHover(part, false)
                paintPart(part, 0.2)
            end)
            part.button.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
                if not aw(input) or state.disabled then
                    return
                end
                local touch = input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
                held, repeated = true, false
                part.press = true
                paintPart(part, 0.08)
                holdId = holdId + 1
                local myId = holdId
                if not touch then
                    nudge(direction, shiftMultiplier())
                end
                task.delay(0.4, function()
                    if not (held and holdId == myId) or not canTap() then
                        return
                    end
                    repeated = true
                    local ticks = 0
                    while held and holdId == myId and canTap() do
                        if not nudge(direction, math.max(holdMultiplier(ticks), shiftMultiplier())) then
                            break
                        end
                        ticks = ticks + 1
                        task.wait(ticks >= 20 and 0.05 or 0.07)
                    end
                end)
            end)
            part.button.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
                if not aw(input) then
                    return
                end
                -- a touch that started a page scroll must not change the value; a plain tap steps on release
                if held and not repeated and input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch and canTap() then
                    nudge(direction, 1)
                end
                held = false
                part.press = false
                paintPart(part, 0.15)
            end)
        end
        bindHold(minusPart)
        bindHold(plusPart)

        -- typing a value: "12", "12.5", "12,5", with the suffix ("50%"), and "1k" / "2.5m" on wide ranges
        local function parseTyped(text)
            text = tostring(text):gsub("%s", "")
            local bare = suffix:gsub("%s", "")
            if bare ~= "" and text:lower():sub(-#bare) == bare:lower() then
                text = text:sub(1, #text - #bare)
            end
            if abbreviations then
                return k._parseAmount(text)
            end
            text = text:gsub(",", ".")
            return tonumber(text:match("^[%+%-]?%d*%.?%d*$"))
        end
        box.Focused:Connect(function()
            if state.disabled then
                box:ReleaseFocus()
                return
            end
            state.editing = true
            refreshText()
            paintStroke(0.12)
            fit(true)
            task.defer(function()
                if box:IsFocused() then
                    box.SelectionStart = 1
                    box.CursorPosition = #box.Text + 1
                end
            end)
        end)
        box.FocusLost:Connect(function(enterPressed, inputObject)
            local cancelled = inputObject ~= nil and inputObject.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Escape
            local typed = box.Text
            state.editing = false
            if not cancelled then
                local parsed = parseTyped(typed)
                if parsed then
                    api:Set(parsed)
                end
            end
            refreshText()
            paintStroke(0.2)
            fit(false)
        end)
        box.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
            if ax() then
                return
            end
            setHover(box, true)
        end)
        box.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
            setHover(box, false)
        end)
        if opts.Keyboard ~= false then
            self.Window:_listen("Began", function(input)
                if state.disabled then
                    return
                end
                local code = input.KeyCode
                if state.editing then
                    -- typing: Up / Down change the number in the box without leaving it
                    local direction = 0
                    if code == Enum.KeyCode.Up then
                        direction = 1
                    elseif code == Enum.KeyCode.Down then
                        direction = -1
                    end
                    if direction ~= 0 then
                        local base = parseTyped(box.Text)
                        if base == nil then
                            base = api.Value
                        end
                        box.Text = num.format(stepFrom(base, direction, shiftMultiplier()))
                        box.CursorPosition = #box.Text + 1
                    end
                elseif next(hovers) ~= nil then
                    local direction = 0
                    if code == Enum.KeyCode.Right or code == Enum.KeyCode.Up then
                        direction = 1
                    elseif code == Enum.KeyCode.Left or code == Enum.KeyCode.Down then
                        direction = -1
                    end
                    if direction ~= 0 then
                        nudge(direction, shiftMultiplier())
                    end
                end
            end, api)
        end

        function api:SetRange(newMin, newMax, newStep, silent)
            newMin = finite(newMin, minV)
            newMax = finite(newMax, maxV)
            if newMin > newMax then
                newMin, newMax = newMax, newMin
            end
            minV, maxV = newMin, newMax
            newStep = finite(newStep, nil)
            if newStep and newStep > 0 then
                step = newStep
            end
            num = aL(minV, maxV, step)
            abbreviations = math.max(math.abs(minV), math.abs(maxV)) >= 1000
            defaultValue = num.snap(defaultValue)
            local clamped = num.snap(api.Value)
            local changed = clamped ~= api.Value
            api.Value = clamped
            refreshText()
            paintLimits(0.15)
            paintMeter(0.25)
            if changed and not silent then
                aJ(opts.Callback, clamped)
            end
        end
        function api:SetSuffix(text)
            suffix = text ~= nil and tostring(text) or ""
            refreshText()
        end
        function api:SetFormat(fn)
            formatFn = type(fn) == "function" and fn or nil
            refreshText()
        end
        function api:SetDisabled(v)
            state.disabled = v == true
            if state.disabled then
                if box:IsFocused() then
                    box:ReleaseFocus()
                end
                for _, part in ipairs(parts) do
                    part.hover, part.press = false, false
                end
                table.clear(hovers)
                paintStroke(0.15)
            end
            box.TextEditable = not state.disabled
            paintDisabled(0.15)
        end
        function api:IsDisabled()
            return state.disabled
        end
        function api:SetText(text)
            text = tostring(text)
            titleLbl.Text = text
            api._searchName = text
            api._searchKey = string.lower(text)
        end
        function api:SetDesc(text)
            if descLbl then
                descLbl.Text = tostring(text)
            end
        end
        api._onHide = function()
            if box:IsFocused() then
                box:ReleaseFocus()
            end
        end

        refreshText()
        paintDisabled(0)
        paintStroke(0)
        paintMeter(0)
        task.defer(fit, true)
        return m(self, opts, api, card, "Stepper")
    end
    -- Shared helpers for Progress / Status / StatusList / Table.
    -- Stored on `k` (not as new locals) because the enclosing function is close to Luau's 200-local limit.
    -- Names start with "_" so the public-API proxy at the end of the file leaves them unwrapped.
    function k._formatNumber(value, decimals, separator, abbreviate)
        if type(value) ~= "number" or value ~= value or value == math.huge or value == -math.huge then
            return tostring(value)
        end
        local suffix = ""
        if abbreviate then
            local units = { "K", "M", "B", "T", "Qa" }
            local scaled = value
            local step = 0
            while math.abs(scaled) >= 1000 and step < #units do
                scaled = scaled / 1000
                step = step + 1
            end
            if step > 0 then
                value = scaled
                suffix = units[step]
                if decimals == nil then
                    decimals = 1
                end
            end
        end
        local text
        if decimals ~= nil then
            text = string.format("%." .. math.clamp(math.floor(tonumber(decimals) or 0), 0, 8) .. "f", value)
        elseif value == math.floor(value) and math.abs(value) < 1e15 then
            text = string.format("%d", value)
        else
            text = string.format("%.2f", value)
            text = text:gsub("0+$", "")
            text = text:gsub("%.$", "")
        end
        if suffix ~= "" and text:find(".", 1, true) then
            text = text:gsub("0+$", "")
            text = text:gsub("%.$", "")
        end
        if separator ~= false then
            local sign, whole, rest = text:match("^(%-?)(%d+)(.*)$")
            if whole and #whole > 3 then
                whole = whole:reverse():gsub("(%d%d%d)", "%1,"):reverse():gsub("^,", "")
                text = sign .. whole .. rest
            end
        end
        return text .. suffix
    end
    -- Colour thresholds: { { 0, "Error" }, { 0.35, "Warning" }, { 0.7, "Success" } } (fraction 0..1, ascending).
    -- `preset` ("auto" / "inverse") builds a ready-made list when no explicit list is given.
    function k._buildStops(source, preset)
        if source == nil and preset then
            if type(preset) == "string" and (string.lower(preset) == "inverse" or string.lower(preset) == "reverse") then
                source = { { 0, "Success" }, { 0.67, "Warning" }, { 0.9, "Error" } }
            else
                source = { { 0, "Error" }, { 0.34, "Warning" }, { 0.67, "Success" } }
            end
        end
        local stops = {}
        if type(source) == "table" then
            for index, entry in ipairs(source) do
                if type(entry) == "table" then
                    local at = tonumber(entry.At or entry.From or entry[1])
                    local color = entry.Color
                    if color == nil then
                        color = entry.Tone
                    end
                    if color == nil then
                        color = entry[2]
                    end
                    if at ~= nil and color ~= nil then
                        stops[#stops + 1] = { At = at, Color = color }
                    end
                end
            end
            table.sort(stops, function(left, right)
                return left.At < right.At
            end)
        end
        return stops
    end
    function k._pickStop(stops, fraction)
        local picked = nil
        for index = 1, #stops do
            if fraction >= stops[index].At then
                picked = stops[index].Color
            else
                break
            end
        end
        return picked
    end
    -- True while `element` (living in `owner`, a tab / sub-tab / groupbox) can actually be seen by the user.
    function k._isLive(owner, window, element)
        if window._destroyed or not window.Open or window.Minimized or element._userVisible == false then
            return false
        end
        if owner._groupbox then
            if owner._userVisible == false then
                return false
            end
            owner = owner.Parent
        end
        if owner._isSubTab then
            if owner.Parent.CurrentSubTab ~= owner then
                return false
            end
            owner = owner.Parent
        end
        return window.CurrentTab == owner
    end
    -- Runs `step` immediately, then every `getRate()` seconds while `canRun()` allows it, until the element is destroyed.
    function k._poll(element, frame, getRate, canRun, step)
        local running = true
        element._listeners = element._listeners or {}
        table.insert(element._listeners, function()
            running = false
        end)
        task.defer(function()
            local first = true
            while running and frame.Parent do
                if first or canRun() then
                    first = false
                    step()
                end
                task.wait(getRate())
            end
        end)
    end
    -- Tinted pill (soft tone fill + tone stroke + auto-width label), shared by Progress / Status / Table.
    -- Options: Height, TextSize, Font, PadX, Dot (leading dot), Icon (lucide name), Plain (text only, no fill),
    -- RichText, AnchorPoint, Position, LayoutOrder.
    -- Returns { Frame, Label, Stroke, Dot, Icon, Paint(color, time), SetIcon(name) }.
    function k._pill(parent, options)
        options = options or {}
        local plain = options.Plain == true
        local frame = ai("Frame", {
            AnchorPoint = options.AnchorPoint or Vector2.zero,
            Position = options.Position or UDim2.new(),
            Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, options.Height or 20),
            AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X,
            BackgroundColor3 = z.Accent,
            BackgroundTransparency = plain and 1 or 0.88,
            BorderSizePixel = 0,
            LayoutOrder = options.LayoutOrder or 0,
            Parent = parent,
        })
        aj(frame, UDim.new(1, 0))
        local stroke = ak(frame, z.Accent, plain and 1 or 0.62)
        local padX = plain and 0 or (options.PadX or 9)
        al(frame, padX, padX)
        ai("UIListLayout", {
            FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal,
            VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center,
            SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
            Padding = UDim.new(0, 5),
            Parent = frame,
        })
        local pill = { Frame = frame, Stroke = stroke }
        if options.Dot then
            pill.Dot = ai("Frame", {
                Size = UDim2.fromOffset(6, 6),
                BackgroundColor3 = z.Accent,
                BorderSizePixel = 0,
                LayoutOrder = 1,
                Parent = frame,
            })
            aj(pill.Dot, UDim.new(1, 0))
        end
        pill.Label = am({
            Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0),
            AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X,
            TextSize = options.TextSize or 12,
            FontFace = options.Font or D.Medium,
            TextColor3 = z.Accent,
            TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.None,
            RichText = options.RichText == true,
            LayoutOrder = 3,
            Parent = frame,
        })
        function pill.Paint(color, time)
            time = time or 0
            ah(frame, { BackgroundColor3 = color }, time)
            ah(stroke, { Color = color }, time)
            ah(pill.Label, { TextColor3 = color }, time)
            if pill.Dot then
                ah(pill.Dot, { BackgroundColor3 = color }, time)
            end
            if pill.Icon then
                ah(pill.Icon, { ImageColor3 = color }, time)
            end
        end
        function pill.SetIcon(name)
            if name == nil or name == false then
                if pill.Icon then
                    pill.Icon.Visible = false
                end
                return
            end
            if not pill.Icon then
                local size = math.max(math.floor((options.TextSize or 12) - 1), 9)
                pill.Icon = ai("ImageLabel", {
                    Size = UDim2.fromOffset(size, size),
                    BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                    ImageColor3 = z.Accent,
                    ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit,
                    LayoutOrder = 2,
                    Parent = frame,
                })
            end
            pill.Icon.Visible = true
            aq(pill.Icon, name)
        end
        if options.Icon ~= nil then
            pill.SetIcon(options.Icon)
        end
        return pill
    end
    function aS:Progress(options)
        options = l(options, { Title = "Name", Description = "Desc", CurrentValue = "Default", Value = "Default" })
        local metrics = aM(self)
        local compact = metrics.Compact
        local window = self.Window
        local card, cardStroke =
            aO(self, "Frame", (options.Desc and metrics.DescHeight or metrics.Height) + (compact and 6 or 10), options)
        aG(card, cardStroke)
        local textTop
        if options.Desc then
            textTop = math.floor((metrics.DescHeight - (metrics.DescGap + metrics.DescLine)) / 2) - 2
        else
            textTop = compact and 5 or 12
        end
        local titleLabel = am({
            Position = UDim2.fromOffset(14, textTop),
            Size = UDim2.new(1, -110, 0, 18),
            Text = tostring(options.Name or "Progress"),
            TextSize = metrics.TextSize,
            Parent = card,
        })
        local descLabel
        if options.Desc then
            descLabel = am({
                Position = UDim2.fromOffset(14, textTop + metrics.DescGap),
                Size = UDim2.new(1, -28, 0, metrics.DescLine),
                Text = tostring(options.Desc),
                TextSize = metrics.DescSize,
                FontFace = D.Regular,
                TextColor3 = z.Muted,
                Parent = card,
            })
        end
        -- value chip: a soft pill tinted with the bar colour (Chip = false gives the old plain text)
        local chipHeight = compact and 18 or 20
        local chip = k._pill(card, {
            AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0),
            Position = UDim2.new(1, -14, 0, textTop + math.floor((18 - chipHeight) / 2)),
            Height = chipHeight,
            TextSize = compact and 11 or 12,
            Plain = options.Chip == false,
            RichText = true,
        })
        local valueLabel = chip.Label
        -- the title always keeps the room the chip needs (custom Format strings can be long)
        local function fitTitle()
            local scale = math.max(window.Scale.Scale, 0.01)
            local cardWidth = card.AbsoluteSize.X / scale
            local chipWidth = 0
            if chip.Frame.Visible then
                chipWidth = math.min(chip.Frame.AbsoluteSize.X / scale, math.floor(cardWidth * 0.55))
            end
            titleLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, -(36 + math.ceil(chipWidth)), 0, 18)
        end
        chip.Frame:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(fitTitle)
        chip.Frame:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(fitTitle)
        card:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(fitTitle)

        local barHeight = compact and 5 or 6
        local barHolder = ai("Frame", {
            Position = UDim2.new(0, 14, 1, compact and -12 or -17),
            Size = UDim2.new(1, -28, 0, barHeight),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            Parent = card,
        })
        local track = ai("Frame", {
            Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
            BackgroundColor3 = z.Surface3,
            BorderSizePixel = 0,
            ClipsDescendants = true,
            Parent = barHolder,
        })
        aj(track, UDim.new(1, 0))
        local fill = ai("Frame", {
            Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0),
            BackgroundColor3 = z.Accent,
            BorderSizePixel = 0,
            ClipsDescendants = true,
            Parent = track,
        })
        aj(fill, UDim.new(1, 0))
        -- the fill fades out towards its start, so the bright end always sits under the glow
        ai("UIGradient", {
            Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
                NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.4),
                NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0),
            }),
            Parent = fill,
        })
        -- a soft light that travels over the fill while the bar is still running
        local shine = ai("Frame", {
            Position = UDim2.fromScale(-0.5, 0),
            Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 1),
            BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 254),
            BorderSizePixel = 0,
            Visible = false,
            Parent = fill,
        })
        ai("UIGradient", {
            Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
                NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1),
                NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, 0.72),
                NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1),
            }),
            Parent = shine,
        })
        -- indeterminate capsule with soft edges
        local sweep = ai("Frame", {
            Position = UDim2.fromScale(-0.4, 0),
            Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.4, 1),
            BackgroundColor3 = z.Accent,
            BorderSizePixel = 0,
            Visible = false,
            Parent = track,
        })
        aj(sweep, UDim.new(1, 0))
        ai("UIGradient", {
            Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
                NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1),
                NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, 0),
                NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1),
            }),
            Parent = sweep,
        })
        -- thin dark notches over the track turn the bar into segments (Segments = 10)
        local notches = ai("Frame", {
            Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            ZIndex = 3,
            Parent = track,
        })
        local function buildNotches(count)
            notches:ClearAllChildren()
            count = math.clamp(math.floor(tonumber(count) or 0), 0, 40)
            if count < 2 then
                return
            end
            for index = 1, count - 1 do
                ai("Frame", {
                    AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0),
                    Position = UDim2.new(index / count, 0, 0, 0),
                    Size = UDim2.new(0, 2, 1, 0),
                    BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0),
                    BackgroundTransparency = 0.45,
                    BorderSizePixel = 0,
                    Parent = notches,
                })
            end
        end
        buildNotches(options.Segments or options.Ticks)
        -- glow that rides on the leading edge of the fill
        local glow = ai("ImageLabel", {
            AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
            Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.5, 0),
            Size = UDim2.fromOffset(barHeight * 6, barHeight * 6),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            Image = A.Glow,
            ImageColor3 = z.Accent,
            ImageTransparency = 1,
            ZIndex = 4,
            Parent = barHolder,
        })

        local api = { _listeners = {} }
        local minValue = tonumber(options.Min) or 0
        local maxValue = tonumber(options.Max) or 1
        if maxValue <= minValue then
            maxValue = minValue + 1
        end
        local function clampValue(value)
            return math.clamp(tonumber(value) or minValue, minValue, maxValue)
        end
        local function toFraction(value)
            return math.clamp((value - minValue) / (maxValue - minValue), 0, 1)
        end
        api.Value = clampValue(options.Default)
        local barColorSpec = options.Color
        if barColorSpec == nil then
            barColorSpec = options.Tone
        end
        local textColorSpec = options.TextColor
        local completeColorSpec = options.CompleteColor
        local completeText = options.CompleteText
        local formatFunction = options.Format
        local displayMode = string.lower(tostring(options.Display or "percent"))
        local stops = k._buildStops(options.Thresholds, options.AutoColor)
        local indeterminate = options.Indeterminate == true
        local shimmerEnabled = options.Shimmer ~= false
        local sweepTween, shimmerTween = nil, nil
        local shimmerOn = false

        local function barColor(fraction)
            if fraction >= 1 and completeColorSpec ~= nil then
                local done = k._color(completeColorSpec)
                if done then
                    return done
                end
            end
            local spec = barColorSpec
            if spec == nil and #stops > 0 then
                spec = k._pickStop(stops, fraction)
            end
            return k._color(spec) or z.Accent
        end
        local function numberText(value)
            return k._formatNumber(value, options.Decimals, options.Separator, options.Abbreviate)
        end
        local function displayText(fraction)
            if indeterminate then
                return tostring(options.IndeterminateText or "...")
            end
            if completeText ~= nil and fraction >= 1 then
                return tostring(completeText)
            end
            local text
            if displayMode == "none" or displayMode == "hidden" then
                text = ""
            elseif displayMode == "value" then
                text = numberText(api.Value)
            elseif displayMode == "fraction" or displayMode == "ratio" then
                text = numberText(api.Value) .. " / " .. numberText(maxValue)
            else
                local places = math.clamp(math.floor(tonumber(options.PercentDecimals) or 0), 0, 3)
                if places > 0 then
                    text = string.format("%." .. places .. "f%%", fraction * 100)
                else
                    text = string.format("%d%%", math.floor(fraction * 100 + 0.5))
                end
            end
            if type(formatFunction) == "function" then
                local ok, result = pcall(formatFunction, api.Value, fraction, minValue, maxValue)
                if ok and result ~= nil then
                    text = tostring(result)
                end
            end
            return text
        end
        local function updateShimmer(fraction)
            local want = shimmerEnabled and not indeterminate and fraction > 0.04 and fraction < 1
            if want == shimmerOn then
                return
            end
            shimmerOn = want
            if shimmerTween then
                shimmerTween:Cancel()
                shimmerTween = nil
            end
            shine.Visible = want
            if want then
                shine.Position = UDim2.fromScale(-0.5, 0)
                shimmerTween = a:Create(
                    shine,
                    TweenInfo.new(1.5, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut, -1, false, 0.9),
                    { Position = UDim2.fromScale(1, 0) }
                )
                shimmerTween:Play()
            end
        end
        local function render(duration)
            local fraction = toFraction(api.Value)
            local color = barColor(fraction)
            local colorTime = duration > 0 and 0.25 or 0
            if indeterminate then
                ah(sweep, { BackgroundColor3 = color }, colorTime)
            else
                ah(fill, { Size = UDim2.new(fraction, 0, 1, 0), BackgroundColor3 = color }, duration, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint)
            end
            ah(glow, {
                Position = UDim2.new(fraction, 0, 0.5, 0),
                ImageColor3 = color,
                ImageTransparency = (indeterminate or fraction <= 0.001) and 1 or 0.78,
            }, indeterminate and 0 or duration, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint)
            local text = displayText(fraction)
            valueLabel.Text = k._rich(text)
            chip.Frame.Visible = text ~= ""
            local chipColor = color
            if textColorSpec ~= nil then
                chipColor = k._color(textColorSpec) or color
            end
            chip.Paint(chipColor, colorTime)
            updateShimmer(fraction)
        end
        local function setIndeterminate(enabled)
            enabled = enabled and true or false
            if sweepTween then
                sweepTween:Cancel()
                sweepTween = nil
            end
            indeterminate = enabled
            fill.Visible = not enabled
            sweep.Visible = enabled
            if enabled then
                sweep.Position = UDim2.fromScale(-0.4, 0)
                sweepTween = a:Create(
                    sweep,
                    TweenInfo.new(1.15, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut, -1),
                    { Position = UDim2.fromScale(1, 0) }
                )
                sweepTween:Play()
            end
            render(0)
        end
        -- brief light-up of the glow whenever the value moves
        local function pulse()
            if indeterminate or toFraction(api.Value) <= 0.001 then
                return
            end
            ah(glow, { ImageTransparency = 0.35 }, 0.06)
            task.delay(0.08, function()
                if glow.Parent and not indeterminate then
                    ah(glow, { ImageTransparency = 0.78 }, 0.55)
                end
            end)
        end
        local function apply(value, silent, fromUpdate)
            value = clampValue(value)
            if value == api.Value then
                return
            end
            local wasComplete = toFraction(api.Value) >= 1
            api.Value = value
            render(0.35)
            pulse()
            if not silent then
                aJ(options.Callback, value, toFraction(value))
            end
            if toFraction(value) >= 1 and not wasComplete and (not silent or fromUpdate) then
                aJ(options.OnComplete, value)
            end
        end

        function api:Set(value, silent)
            apply(value, silent, false)
        end
        api.SetValue = api.Set
        function api:Get()
            return api.Value
        end
        function api:GetFraction()
            return toFraction(api.Value)
        end
        function api:GetPercent()
            return toFraction(api.Value) * 100
        end
        function api:Add(delta, silent)
            api:Set(api.Value + (tonumber(delta) or 0), silent)
        end
        function api:Reset(silent)
            api:Set(minValue, silent)
        end
        function api:SetRange(newMin, newMax)
            newMin = tonumber(newMin) or minValue
            newMax = tonumber(newMax) or maxValue
            if newMax <= newMin then
                newMax = newMin + 1
            end
            minValue, maxValue = newMin, newMax
            api.Value = clampValue(api.Value)
            render(0.25)
        end
        function api:SetColor(color)
            barColorSpec = color
            render(0.25)
        end
        function api:SetTextColor(color)
            textColorSpec = color
            render(0.25)
        end
        function api:SetThresholds(source)
            stops = k._buildStops(source, nil)
            render(0.25)
        end
        function api:SetFormat(callback)
            formatFunction = callback
            render(0)
        end
        function api:SetDisplay(mode)
            displayMode = string.lower(tostring(mode or "percent"))
            render(0)
        end
        function api:SetCompleteText(text)
            completeText = text
            render(0)
        end
        function api:SetSegments(count)
            buildNotches(count)
        end
        function api:SetShimmer(enabled)
            shimmerEnabled = enabled ~= false
            updateShimmer(toFraction(api.Value))
        end
        function api:SetName(text)
            titleLabel.Text = tostring(text == nil and "" or text)
            api._searchName = titleLabel.Text
            api._searchKey = string.lower(titleLabel.Text)
        end
        function api:SetDescription(text)
            if descLabel then
                descLabel.Text = tostring(text == nil and "" or text)
            end
        end
        function api:SetIndeterminate(enabled)
            setIndeterminate(enabled)
        end
        function api:IsIndeterminate()
            return indeterminate
        end
        table.insert(api._listeners, function()
            if sweepTween then
                sweepTween:Cancel()
                sweepTween = nil
            end
            if shimmerTween then
                shimmerTween:Cancel()
                shimmerTween = nil
            end
        end)

        local updateRate = math.max(tonumber(options.UpdateRate) or 1, 0.05)
        function api:SetUpdateRate(rate)
            updateRate = math.max(tonumber(rate) or updateRate, 0.05)
        end
        if type(options.Update) == "function" then
            k._poll(api, card, function()
                return updateRate
            end, function()
                return options.AlwaysUpdate == true or k._isLive(self, window, api)
            end, function()
                local ok, value, newMax = aK(options.Update)
                if not ok then
                    warn("[AirFlow] progress update error: " .. tostring(value))
                    return
                end
                if type(newMax) == "number" and newMax ~= maxValue then
                    api:SetRange(minValue, newMax)
                end
                if value ~= nil then
                    apply(value, true, true)
                end
            end)
        end

        ag(valueLabel, function()
            render(0)
        end)
        if indeterminate then
            setIndeterminate(true)
        end
        return m(self, options, api, card, "Progress")
    end
    aS.AddProgress = aS.Progress
    function aS:OrderList(opts)
        opts = l(opts, { Title = "Name", Description = "Desc", Options = "Items", Values = "Items" })
        local metrics = aM(self)
        local window = self.Window
        local ROW_H = E and 40 or 32
        local GAP = 4
        local STEP = ROW_H + GAP
        local GRIP_W = E and 34 or 26
        local ARROW_W = E and 30 or 22
        local maxRows = math.max(math.floor(tonumber(opts.MaxRows) or 6), 1)
        local numbered = opts.Numbered ~= false
        local arrows = opts.Arrows ~= false
        local highlightFirst = opts.HighlightFirst ~= false
        local allowReset = opts.Reset ~= false
        local api = {}

        local card = aO(self, "Frame", 0, opts)
        card.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
        if metrics.Compact then
            al(card, 14, 14, 6, 8)
        else
            al(card, 14, 14, 11, 12)
        end
        ai("UIListLayout", { SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder, Padding = UDim.new(0, 6), Parent = card })

        -- header: title on the left, a "Reset" chip on the right that only appears once the order was changed
        local titleText = tostring(opts.Name or "")
        local header = ai("Frame", {
            Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 20),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            Visible = titleText ~= "",
            LayoutOrder = 1,
            Parent = card,
        })
        local titleLabel = am({
            Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
            Text = titleText,
            TextSize = metrics.TextSize,
            Parent = header,
        })
        if opts.Desc then
            am({
                Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0),
                AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
                Text = opts.Desc,
                TextSize = metrics.DescSize,
                FontFace = D.Regular,
                TextColor3 = z.Muted,
                TextWrapped = true,
                TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.None,
                LayoutOrder = 2,
                Parent = card,
            })
        end

        local scroller = ai("ScrollingFrame", {
            Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, ROW_H + 2),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            BorderSizePixel = 0,
            ScrollBarThickness = E and 4 or 3,
            ScrollBarImageColor3 = z.Accent,
            ScrollBarImageTransparency = 0.4,
            ScrollingDirection = Enum.ScrollingDirection.Y,
            CanvasSize = UDim2.new(),
            ScrollingEnabled = false,
            LayoutOrder = 3,
            Parent = card,
        })
        scroller:SetAttribute("NoDrag", true)
        local canvas = ai("Frame", { Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Parent = scroller })

        -- placeholder that shows where the dragged row will land
        local ghost = ai("Frame", {
            Position = UDim2.fromOffset(3, 1),
            Size = UDim2.new(1, -6, 0, ROW_H),
            BackgroundColor3 = z.Accent,
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            BorderSizePixel = 0,
            Visible = false,
            Parent = canvas,
        })
        aj(ghost, UDim.new(0, 7))
        local ghostStroke = ak(ghost, z.Accent, 1)

        local emptyState = ai("Frame", {
            Position = UDim2.fromOffset(3, 1),
            Size = UDim2.new(1, -6, 0, ROW_H),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            Visible = false,
            Parent = canvas,
        })
        aj(emptyState, UDim.new(0, 7))
        ak(emptyState, z.Stroke, 0.35)
        am({
            Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
            Text = tostring(opts.EmptyText or "Nothing to order"),
            TextSize = 13,
            FontFace = D.Regular,
            TextColor3 = z.Muted,
            TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center,
            Parent = emptyState,
        })

        ---------------------------------------------------------------- state
        local rows = {}
        local savedOrder = {}
        local defaultOrder = {}
        local meta = {}
        local dragRow, dragPointer, dragGrab = nil, nil, 0
        local startOrder, renderOff, lockedScroller = nil, nil, nil
        local move, beginDrag, endDrag

        ---------------------------------------------------------------- helpers
        local function slotY(index)
            return 1 + (index - 1) * STEP
        end

        local function labelOf(value)
            local info = meta[value]
            if info then
                return info.Name
            end
            return tostring(value)
        end

        local function iconOf(value)
            local info = meta[value]
            return info and info.Icon or nil
        end

        -- Items may be plain values or { Name = "Shown", Value = "returned", Icon = "lucide-name" }
        local function ingest(list)
            local out = {}
            table.clear(meta)
            for _, item in ipairs(list) do
                local value = item
                if type(item) == "table" then
                    local name = item.Name or item.Text or item.Label or item.Title
                    value = item.Value
                    if value == nil then
                        value = name
                    end
                    if value == nil then
                        value = item
                    end
                    meta[value] = { Name = tostring(name ~= nil and name or value), Icon = item.Icon }
                end
                out[#out + 1] = value
            end
            return out
        end

        -- keeps `preferred` order for everything that still exists, then appends the rest
        local function mergeOrder(current, preferred)
            local remaining = {}
            for _, value in ipairs(current) do
                remaining[value] = (remaining[value] or 0) + 1
            end
            local out = {}
            for _, list in ipairs({ preferred, current }) do
                for _, value in ipairs(list) do
                    if (remaining[value] or 0) > 0 then
                        remaining[value] -= 1
                        table.insert(out, value)
                    end
                end
            end
            return out
        end

        local function values()
            local out = {}
            for index, row in ipairs(rows) do
                out[index] = row.Value
            end
            return out
        end

        local function canMove(row, dir)
            if dragRow then
                return false
            end
            local index = table.find(rows, row)
            return index ~= nil and rows[index + dir] ~= nil
        end

        local function paintIcon(icon, color, fade, duration)
            ah(icon.Object, { [icon.Color] = color, [icon.Fade] = fade }, duration)
        end

        local function iconButton(parent, iconName, glyph, rotation, props, pill)
            props.BackgroundColor3 = z.Surface3
            props.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            props.BorderSizePixel = 0
            props.Text = ""
            props.AutoButtonColor = false
            props.Parent = parent
            local button = ai("TextButton", props)
            if pill then
                aj(button, UDim.new(0, 6))
            end
            local image = ai("ImageLabel", {
                AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
                Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5),
                Size = E and UDim2.fromOffset(16, 16) or UDim2.fromOffset(14, 14),
                BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                ImageColor3 = z.Muted,
                ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit,
                Parent = button,
            })
            aq(image, iconName)
            if image.Image ~= "" then
                return button, { Object = image, Color = "ImageColor3", Fade = "ImageTransparency" }
            end
            image:Destroy()
            local text = am({
                Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
                Text = glyph,
                TextSize = 18,
                TextColor3 = z.Muted,
                TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center,
                TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.None,
                Rotation = rotation,
                Parent = button,
            })
            return button, { Object = text, Color = "TextColor3", Fade = "TextTransparency" }
        end

        local function activeScroller()
            if scroller.ScrollingEnabled then
                return scroller
            end
            return card:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("ScrollingFrame")
        end

        ---------------------------------------------------------------- reset chip
        local resetBtn, resetLabel, resetIcon
        local resetShown = false
        local function setResetShown(show)
            if not resetBtn or show == resetShown then
                return
            end
            resetShown = show
            titleLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, show and -84 or 0, 1, 0)
            local alpha = show and 0 or 1
            if show then
                resetBtn.Visible = true
            end
            ah(resetLabel, { TextTransparency = alpha }, 0.18)
            if resetIcon and not resetIcon:GetAttribute("CustomIcon") then
                ah(resetIcon, { ImageTransparency = alpha }, 0.18)
            end
            if not show then
                task.delay(0.2, function()
                    if not resetShown and resetBtn.Parent then
                        resetBtn.Visible = false
                    end
                end)
            end
        end

        if allowReset then
            resetBtn = ai("TextButton", {
                AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5),
                Position = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0.5, 0),
                Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 20),
                AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X,
                BackgroundColor3 = z.Surface3,
                BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                BorderSizePixel = 0,
                Text = "",
                AutoButtonColor = false,
                ClipsDescendants = true,
                Visible = false,
                Parent = header,
            })
            aj(resetBtn, UDim.new(0, 6))
            al(resetBtn, 7, 8, 0, 0)
            ai("UIListLayout", {
                FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal,
                VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center,
                SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
                Padding = UDim.new(0, 4),
                Parent = resetBtn,
            })
            resetIcon = ai("ImageLabel", {
                Size = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 12),
                BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                ImageColor3 = z.Muted,
                ImageTransparency = 1,
                ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit,
                LayoutOrder = 1,
                Parent = resetBtn,
            })
            aq(resetIcon, "rotate-ccw")
            if resetIcon.Image == "" then
                resetIcon:Destroy()
                resetIcon = nil
            end
            resetLabel = am({
                Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0),
                AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X,
                Text = tostring(opts.ResetText or "Reset"),
                TextSize = 12,
                TextColor3 = z.Muted,
                TextTransparency = 1,
                TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.None,
                LayoutOrder = 2,
                Parent = resetBtn,
            })
            resetBtn.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
                if ax() then
                    return
                end
                ah(resetBtn, { BackgroundTransparency = 0.3 }, 0.12)
                ah(resetLabel, { TextColor3 = z.Text }, 0.12)
                if resetIcon then
                    ar(resetIcon, z.Text, true, 0.12)
                end
            end)
            resetBtn.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
                ah(resetBtn, { BackgroundTransparency = 1 }, 0.2)
                ah(resetLabel, { TextColor3 = z.Muted }, 0.2)
                if resetIcon then
                    ar(resetIcon, z.Muted, true, 0.2)
                end
            end)
            resetBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                aE(resetBtn, z.Text)
                api:Reset()
            end)
        end

        local function isModified()
            if #rows < 2 then
                return false
            end
            local target = mergeOrder(values(), defaultOrder)
            for index, value in ipairs(target) do
                if rows[index].Value ~= value then
                    return true
                end
            end
            return false
        end

        ---------------------------------------------------------------- painting / layout
        local function paintRank(row, rank, instant)
            if not row.Badge then
                return
            end
            local first = highlightFirst and rank == 1
            local duration = instant and 0 or 0.2
            ah(row.Badge, { BackgroundColor3 = first and z.Accent or z.Surface3 }, duration)
            ah(row.Index, { TextColor3 = first and z.AccentDark or z.Muted }, duration)
        end

        local function refreshRows(instant)
            local count = #rows
            for index, row in ipairs(rows) do
                row.Index.Text = tostring(index)
                if row ~= dragRow then
                    ah(
                        row.Frame,
                        { Position = UDim2.fromOffset(3, slotY(index)) },
                        instant and 0 or 0.22,
                        Enum.EasingStyle.Quint
                    )
                end
                paintRank(row, index, instant)
                if row.UpIcon then
                    ah(row.UpIcon.Object, { [row.UpIcon.Fade] = index == 1 and 0.7 or 0 }, instant and 0 or 0.15)
                    ah(row.DownIcon.Object, { [row.DownIcon.Fade] = index == count and 0.7 or 0 }, instant and 0 or 0.15)
                end
            end
        end

        local function layout()
            local count = #rows
            local canvasH = math.max(count, 1) * STEP - GAP + 2
            local viewH = math.clamp(count, 1, maxRows) * STEP - GAP + 2
            local overflow = count > maxRows
            scroller.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, viewH)
            scroller.CanvasSize = UDim2.fromOffset(0, canvasH)
            canvas.Size = UDim2.new(1, overflow and -8 or 0, 0, canvasH)
            if not dragRow then
                scroller.ScrollingEnabled = overflow
            end
            emptyState.Visible = count == 0
            local maxPos = math.max(canvasH - viewH, 0)
            if scroller.CanvasPosition.Y > maxPos then
                scroller.CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(0, maxPos)
            end
        end

        local function commit(silent)
            api.Value = values()
            setResetShown(isModified())
            if not silent then
                aJ(opts.Callback, values())
            end
        end

        local function scrollIntoView(index)
            local top = slotY(index) - 1
            local view = scroller.AbsoluteWindowSize.Y / window.Scale.Scale
            local pos = scroller.CanvasPosition.Y
            if top < pos then
                pos = top
            elseif top + ROW_H + 2 > pos + view then
                pos = top + ROW_H + 2 - view
            end
            if pos ~= scroller.CanvasPosition.Y then
                ah(scroller, { CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(0, math.max(pos, 0)) }, 0.2)
            end
        end

        ---------------------------------------------------------------- rows
        local function buildRow(value)
            local frame = ai("Frame", {
                Size = UDim2.new(1, -6, 0, ROW_H),
                BackgroundColor3 = z.Surface,
                BorderSizePixel = 0,
                Parent = canvas,
            })
            aj(frame, UDim.new(0, 7))
            local row = { Value = value, Frame = frame, IconName = iconOf(value) }
            row.Stroke = ak(frame)
            row.Scale = ai("UIScale", { Parent = frame })

            local grip
            grip, row.GripIcon = iconButton(frame, "grip-vertical", "=", 0, { Size = UDim2.new(0, GRIP_W, 1, 0) })
            local x = GRIP_W

            if numbered then
                row.Badge = ai("Frame", {
                    AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5),
                    Position = UDim2.new(0, x, 0.5, 0),
                    Size = UDim2.fromOffset(20, 20),
                    BackgroundColor3 = z.Surface3,
                    BorderSizePixel = 0,
                    Parent = frame,
                })
                aj(row.Badge, UDim.new(0, 6))
                row.Index = am({
                    Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
                    TextSize = 11,
                    FontFace = D.Bold,
                    TextColor3 = z.Muted,
                    TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center,
                    TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.None,
                    Parent = row.Badge,
                })
                x += 28
            else
                row.Index = am({ Size = UDim2.fromScale(0, 0), Visible = false, Parent = frame })
            end

            if row.IconName then
                local itemIcon = ai("ImageLabel", {
                    AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5),
                    Position = UDim2.new(0, x, 0.5, 0),
                    Size = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 14),
                    BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                    ImageColor3 = z.Muted,
                    ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit,
                    Parent = frame,
                })
                aq(itemIcon, row.IconName)
                if itemIcon.Image == "" then
                    itemIcon:Destroy()
                else
                    x += 22
                end
            end

            local reserve = x + (arrows and (ARROW_W * 2 + 14) or 10)
            row.Text = am({
                Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x, 0),
                Size = UDim2.new(1, -reserve, 1, 0),
                Text = labelOf(value),
                TextSize = 13,
                Parent = frame,
            })

            local hits = {}
            if arrows then
                local upBtn, downBtn
                upBtn, row.UpIcon = iconButton(frame, "chevron-up", "\u{203a}", -90, {
                    AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5),
                    Position = UDim2.new(1, -(ARROW_W + 7), 0.5, 0),
                    Size = UDim2.fromOffset(ARROW_W, ROW_H - 10),
                }, true)
                downBtn, row.DownIcon = iconButton(frame, "chevron-down", "\u{203a}", 90, {
                    AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5),
                    Position = UDim2.new(1, -5, 0.5, 0),
                    Size = UDim2.fromOffset(ARROW_W, ROW_H - 10),
                }, true)
                for _, entry in ipairs({ { upBtn, -1, row.UpIcon }, { downBtn, 1, row.DownIcon } }) do
                    local btn, dir, icon = entry[1], entry[2], entry[3]
                    local notScrolled = ay(btn, activeScroller)
                    btn.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
                        if ax() or not canMove(row, dir) then
                            return
                        end
                        ah(btn, { BackgroundTransparency = 0.35 }, 0.12)
                        ah(icon.Object, { [icon.Color] = z.Accent }, 0.12)
                    end)
                    btn.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
                        ah(btn, { BackgroundTransparency = 1 }, 0.2)
                        ah(icon.Object, { [icon.Color] = z.Muted }, 0.2)
                    end)
                    btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                        if notScrolled() then
                            move(row, dir)
                        end
                    end)
                    table.insert(hits, btn)
                end
            end

            grip.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
                if aw(input) then
                    beginDrag(row)
                end
            end)
            frame.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
                if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
                    return
                end
                local pointer = av()
                for _, hit in ipairs(hits) do
                    if az(pointer, hit) then
                        return
                    end
                end
                beginDrag(row)
            end)
            frame.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
                if not ax() and row ~= dragRow then
                    ah(row.Stroke, { Color = z.StrokeHover }, 0.12)
                    paintIcon(row.GripIcon, z.Text, 0, 0.12)
                end
            end)
            frame.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
                if row ~= dragRow then
                    ah(row.Stroke, { Color = z.Stroke }, 0.25)
                    paintIcon(row.GripIcon, z.Muted, 0, 0.25)
                end
            end)
            return row
        end

        local function syncRows(order)
            local pool = {}
            for _, row in ipairs(rows) do
                pool[row.Value] = pool[row.Value] or {}
                table.insert(pool[row.Value], row)
            end
            local nextRows = {}
            for index, value in ipairs(order) do
                local bucket = pool[value]
                local row = nil
                if bucket then
                    for i, candidate in ipairs(bucket) do
                        if candidate.IconName == iconOf(value) then
                            row = table.remove(bucket, i)
                            break
                        end
                    end
                end
                if row then
                    row.Text.Text = labelOf(value)
                else
                    row = buildRow(value)
                    row.Frame.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(3, slotY(index))
                end
                nextRows[index] = row
            end
            for _, bucket in pairs(pool) do
                for _, row in ipairs(bucket) do
                    row.Frame:Destroy()
                end
            end
            rows = nextRows
        end

        ---------------------------------------------------------------- moving / dragging
        function move(row, dir)
            if dragRow then
                return
            end
            local from = table.find(rows, row)
            local to = from and from + dir
            if not to or to < 1 or to > #rows then
                return
            end
            rows[from], rows[to] = rows[to], rows[from]
            refreshRows(false)
            ah(row.Stroke, { Color = z.Accent }, 0.08)
            task.delay(0.18, function()
                if row ~= dragRow and row.Frame.Parent then
                    ah(row.Stroke, { Color = z.Stroke }, 0.3)
                end
            end)
            scrollIntoView(to)
            commit(false)
        end

        local function placeDragged(pointer)
            local row = dragRow
            if not row then
                return
            end
            local scale = window.Scale.Scale
            local y = (pointer.Y - dragGrab - scroller.AbsolutePosition.Y) / scale + scroller.CanvasPosition.Y
            y = math.clamp(y, slotY(1), slotY(#rows))
            row.Frame.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(3, y)
            local target = math.clamp(math.floor((y - 1) / STEP + 0.5) + 1, 1, #rows)
            local current = table.find(rows, row)
            if current and current ~= target then
                table.remove(rows, current)
                table.insert(rows, target, row)
                refreshRows(false)
                ah(ghost, { Position = UDim2.fromOffset(3, slotY(target)) }, 0.14, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint)
            end
        end

        local function autoScroll(dt)
            if not dragRow or not dragPointer then
                return
            end
            local scale = window.Scale.Scale
            local top = scroller.AbsolutePosition.Y
            local bottom = top + scroller.AbsoluteSize.Y
            local zone = ROW_H * scale
            local speed = 0
            if dragPointer.Y < top + zone then
                speed = -(top + zone - dragPointer.Y) / zone
            elseif dragPointer.Y > bottom - zone then
                speed = (dragPointer.Y - (bottom - zone)) / zone
            end
            if speed == 0 then
                return
            end
            local maxPos = math.max(scroller.CanvasSize.Y.Offset - scroller.AbsoluteWindowSize.Y / scale, 0)
            local pos = math.clamp(scroller.CanvasPosition.Y + math.clamp(speed, -1.5, 1.5) * 360 * dt, 0, maxPos)
            if pos ~= scroller.CanvasPosition.Y then
                scroller.CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(0, pos)
                placeDragged(dragPointer)
            end
        end

        function beginDrag(row)
            if dragRow or #rows < 2 or api._destroyed then
                return
            end
            dragRow = row
            startOrder = table.clone(rows)
            dragPointer = av()
            dragGrab = dragPointer.Y - row.Frame.AbsolutePosition.Y
            row.Frame.ZIndex = 5
            ah(row.Frame, { BackgroundColor3 = z.Surface2 }, 0.12)
            ah(row.Stroke, { Color = z.Accent }, 0.12)
            ah(row.Scale, { Scale = 1.02 }, 0.18, Enum.EasingStyle.Back)
            paintIcon(row.GripIcon, z.Accent, 0, 0.12)
            ghost.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(3, slotY(table.find(rows, row) or 1))
            ghost.Visible = true
            ah(ghost, { BackgroundTransparency = 0.93 }, 0.15)
            ah(ghostStroke, { Transparency = 0.6 }, 0.15)
            scroller.ScrollingEnabled = false
            local outer = card:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("ScrollingFrame")
            if outer and outer.ScrollingEnabled then
                lockedScroller = outer
                outer.ScrollingEnabled = false
            end
            renderOff = window:_listen("Render", autoScroll)
        end

        function endDrag(silent)
            local row = dragRow
            if not row then
                return
            end
            dragRow = nil
            dragPointer = nil
            if renderOff then
                renderOff()
                renderOff = nil
            end
            if lockedScroller then
                lockedScroller.ScrollingEnabled = true
                lockedScroller = nil
            end
            ah(row.Frame, { BackgroundColor3 = z.Surface }, 0.2)
            ah(row.Stroke, { Color = z.Stroke }, 0.25)
            ah(row.Scale, { Scale = 1 }, 0.2)
            paintIcon(row.GripIcon, z.Muted, 0, 0.25)
            ah(ghost, { BackgroundTransparency = 1 }, 0.15)
            ah(ghostStroke, { Transparency = 1 }, 0.15)
            task.delay(0.2, function()
                if not dragRow then
                    ghost.Visible = false
                end
                if row ~= dragRow and row.Frame.Parent then
                    row.Frame.ZIndex = 1
                end
            end)
            refreshRows(false)
            layout()
            for index, current in ipairs(rows) do
                if startOrder[index] ~= current then
                    commit(silent)
                    break
                end
            end
        end

        window:_listen("Changed", function(input)
            if dragRow and aA(input) then
                dragPointer = av()
                placeDragged(dragPointer)
            end
        end, api)
        window:_listen("Ended", function(input)
            if dragRow and aw(input) then
                endDrag(false)
            end
        end, api)
        table.insert(api._listeners, function()
            endDrag(true)
        end)
        api._onHide = function()
            endDrag(false)
        end
