        ---------------------------------------------------------------- public api
        function api:Set(list, silent)
            if type(list) ~= "table" then
                return
            end
            endDrag(true)
            savedOrder = table.clone(list)
            syncRows(mergeOrder(values(), savedOrder))
            refreshRows(false)
            layout()
            commit(silent)
        end

        function api:Get()
            return values()
        end

        function api:Refresh(list, keepOrder, silent)
            endDrag(true)
            local fresh = ingest(type(list) == "table" and table.clone(list) or {})
            defaultOrder = table.clone(fresh)
            local order = fresh
            if keepOrder ~= false then
                order = mergeOrder(fresh, api:_saveValue())
            else
                savedOrder = {}
            end
            syncRows(order)
            refreshRows(false)
            layout()
            commit(silent)
        end

        -- puts the list back to the order the items were given in
        function api:Reset(silent)
            endDrag(true)
            syncRows(mergeOrder(values(), defaultOrder))
            refreshRows(false)
            layout()
            commit(silent)
        end

        function api:_saveValue()
            local out = values()
            local seen = {}
            for _, value in ipairs(out) do
                seen[value] = (seen[value] or 0) + 1
            end
            for _, value in ipairs(savedOrder) do
                if (seen[value] or 0) > 0 then
                    seen[value] -= 1
                else
                    table.insert(out, value)
                end
            end
            return out
        end

        ---------------------------------------------------------------- init
        local initial = ingest(type(opts.Items) == "table" and opts.Items or {})
        defaultOrder = table.clone(initial)
        syncRows(initial)
        refreshRows(true)
        layout()
        api.Value = values()
        return m(self, opts, api, card, "OrderList")
    end

            bw()

            task.delay(0.12, function()
                if flash.Parent then
                    ah(flash, { BackgroundTransparency = 1 }, 0.32, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad)
                end

            ah(rimStroke, { Thickness = 2.5 }, 0.12, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad)

            end)

                    task.wait(0.05)
                    waited += 0.05
                end

                end

            local settle = 0
            while bg.Parent and loadState.shown < 0.995 and settle < 0.6 do

                settle += 0.03
            end

                return
            end

                    return
                end
                if a7._prompts then

                    bA(a7._prompts, 1)
                else
                    bx()
                end
            end)
        end)
    end
    function a2:_fitToScreen(instant)
    local vp = self.Gui.AbsoluteSize
    if vp.X == 0 or vp.Y == 0 then
        return
    end
    local root = self.Root
    local cur = Vector2.new(root.Size.X.Offset, root.Size.Y.Offset)
    if not self._fitApplied or cur ~= self._fitApplied then
        self._wantSize = cur
    end
    local want = self._wantSize
    local size = cur
    if not self._resizeActive then
        local floorScale = E and 0.8 or 0.7
        local minSize = self._minSize or Vector2.zero
        size = Vector2.new(
            math.floor(math.max(math.min(want.X, (vp.X - 24) / floorScale), math.min(minSize.X, want.X))),
            math.floor(math.max(math.min(want.Y, (vp.Y - 24) / floorScale), math.min(minSize.Y, want.Y)))
        )
        if size ~= cur then
            root.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(size.X, size.Y)
        end
        self._fitApplied = size ~= want and size or nil
    end
    local base = (self._uiScale or 1) * (self._adaptive ~= false and k._adaptiveFactor(vp) or 1)
    local fit = math.min(base, (vp.X - 24) / math.max(size.X, 1), (vp.Y - 24) / math.max(size.Y, 1))
    self._fitScale = math.max(fit, 0.45)
    if self._introDone and self.Open then
        if instant then
            self.Scale.Scale = self._fitScale
        else
            ah(self.Scale, { Scale = self._fitScale }, 0.2)
            task.delay(0.22, function()
                if not self._destroyed then
                    self:_clampToScreen()
                end
            end)
        end
    end
end
    function k._adaptiveFactor(a7)
        if E then
            return 1
        end
        local a8 = math.min(a7.X / 1920, a7.Y / 1020)
        if a8 > 0.9 and a8 < 1.15 then
            return 1
        end
        return math.clamp(math.floor(a8 * 20 + 0.5) / 20, 0.85, 1.75)
    end

            end
        end)
    end

    end

    function k._spaced(a7, a8)
        if a7 <= 0 then
            return 0
        end
        return math.max(math.floor(a7 * a8 + (a8 - 1) * 4 + 0.5), 0)
    end
    function k._space(a7, a8)

        if a7:IsA("UIListLayout") or a7:IsA("UIGridLayout") then
            a7:SetAttribute("Space", a8)
            a7.Padding = UDim.new(0, k._spaced(a8, a9))
        elseif a7:IsA("UIPadding") then
            a7:SetAttribute("SpaceL", a8[1])
            a7:SetAttribute("SpaceR", a8[2])
            a7:SetAttribute("SpaceT", a8[3])
            a7:SetAttribute("SpaceB", a8[4])
            a7.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, math.floor(a8[1] * math.sqrt(a9) + 0.5))
            a7.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, math.floor(a8[2] * math.sqrt(a9) + 0.5))
            a7.PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, k._spaced(a8[3], a9))

        end
        return a7
    end

                    break
                end

            a7 = "Default"
        end

        for a8, a9 in ipairs(k.Windows) do
            if a9.Gui and a9.Gui.Parent then

    function a2:_enableResize(a7)
        local a8 = self.MaxSize or Vector2.new(math.huge, math.huge)
        self._minSize = a7
        local a9 = self.Root
        local ba = ai(
            "Frame",
            {
                AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),

            "Frame",
            {

                Size = UDim2.fromOffset(26, 26),
                BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                ZIndex = 20,

            }
        )
        aj(bb, UDim.new(0, 10))
        local bc = ai("UIStroke", { Color = z.Muted, Thickness = 2, Transparency = 0.55, Parent = bb })
        ai(
            "UIGradient",
            {
                Rotation = 45,
                Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
                    NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1),
                    NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.55, 1),
                    NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.85, 0),
                    NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0),
                }),
                Parent = bc,
            }
        )
        local function bd(be)
            ah(
                bc,
                { Color = be and z.Accent or z.Muted, Transparency = be and 0 or 0.55 },
                be and 0.15 or 0.3,
                Enum.EasingStyle.Quint
            )
        end
        local be = 20
        local bf = false
        local bg = Vector2.zero
        local bh = Vector2.zero
        local bi = Vector2.zero
        local bj = Vector2.zero
        local bk = Vector2.zero
        local bl = Vector2.zero
        local function bm()
            return Vector2.new(a9.Size.X.Offset, a9.Size.Y.Offset)
        end
        local function bn()
            if a9.AnchorPoint == Vector2.zero then
                return
            end
            if self._clampTween then
                self._clampTween:Cancel()
                self._clampTween = nil
            end
            local bo = a9.AbsolutePosition - self.Gui.AbsolutePosition
            a9.AnchorPoint = Vector2.zero
            a9.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(bo.X, bo.Y)
        end
        local function bo()
            local bp = a9.AbsolutePosition - self.Gui.AbsolutePosition
            local bq = a9.AbsoluteSize / 2
            a9.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
            a9.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(bp.X + bq.X, bp.Y + bq.Y)
        end
        local function bp(bq)
            return Vector2.new(
                math.floor(math.clamp(bq.X, a7.X, a8.X) + 0.5),
                math.floor(math.clamp(bq.Y, a7.Y, a8.Y) + 0.5)
            )
        end
        ba.InputBegan:Connect(function(bq)
            if not aw(bq) or not self.Open then
                return
            end
            if not self._resizeActive then
                bn()
                bi = bm()
                bj = Vector2.zero
                bl = bi
            end
            self._resizeActive = true
            bf = true
            bg = bi
            bh = av()
            bk = bp(bg)
            bd(true)
        end)
        ba.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
            if not bf then
                bd(true)
            end
        end)
        ba.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
            if not bf then
                bd(false)
            end
        end)
        table.insert(
            self._connections,
            b.InputEnded:Connect(function(bq)
                if bf and aw(bq) then
                    bf = false
                    bd(false)
                end
            end)
        )
        table.insert(self._frameSteps, function(bq)
            if not self._resizeActive then
                return
            end
            if bf then
                local br = (av() - bh) / self.Scale.Scale
                bk = bp(bg + br)
            end
            local br = math.min(bq, 1 / 30)
            local bs = math.exp(-be * br)
            local bt = bi - bk
            local bu = (bj + bt * be) * br
            bj = (bj - bu * be) * bs
            bi = bk + (bt + bu) * bs
            local bv = Vector2.new(math.floor(bi.X + 0.5), math.floor(bi.Y + 0.5))
            if bv ~= bl then
                bl = bv
                a9.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(bv.X, bv.Y)
            end
            if not bf and (bi - bk).Magnitude < 0.3 and bj.Magnitude < 3 then
                bi = bk
                bj = Vector2.zero
                bl = bk
                a9.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(bk.X, bk.Y)
                bo()
                self._resizeActive = false
                self:_fitToScreen()
                self:_clampToScreen()
            end
        end)
    end

end
    function a2:SetSize(a7, a8)
        if typeof(a7) == "UDim2" then
            a7 = Vector2.new(a7.X.Offset, a7.Y.Offset)
        end
        if typeof(a7) ~= "Vector2" or self._resizeActive then
            return
        end
        local a9 = self._minSize or Vector2.zero
        local ba = self.MaxSize or Vector2.new(math.huge, math.huge)
        a7 = Vector2.new(math.floor(math.clamp(a7.X, a9.X, ba.X) + 0.5), math.floor(math.clamp(a7.Y, a9.Y, ba.Y) + 0.5))
        if a7 == self:GetSize() then
            return
        end
        local bb = (a8 or not self.Root.Visible) and 0 or 0.3
        ah(self.Root, { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(a7.X, a7.Y) }, bb, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint)
        task.delay(bb + 0.02, function()
            if not self._destroyed then
                self:_fitToScreen()
                self:_clampToScreen()
            end
        end)
    end
    -- ===== Executor file layer =====
    -- Every config operation goes through these helpers. Executors name their file
    -- functions differently (delfile / deletefile, listfiles / list_files ...), so each
    -- one is resolved by alias, lazily, and is always called inside pcall.
    a2._fsAliases = {
        writefile = { "writefile", "write_file" },
        readfile = { "readfile", "read_file" },
        isfile = { "isfile", "is_file", "fileExists", "file_exists" },
        isfolder = { "isfolder", "is_folder", "folderExists", "folder_exists" },
        makefolder = { "makefolder", "make_folder", "createfolder", "create_folder" },
        delfile = { "delfile", "deletefile", "delete_file", "removefile", "remove_file" },
        delfolder = { "delfolder", "deletefolder", "delete_folder", "removefolder", "remove_folder" },
        listfiles = { "listfiles", "list_files", "listdir", "list_dir" },
    }
    a2._fsCache = {}
    function a2._fsFn(name)
        local cached = a2._fsCache[name]
        if cached then
            return cached
        end
        local envs = {}
        pcall(function()
            if typeof(getgenv) == "function" then
                envs[#envs + 1] = getgenv()
            end
        end)
        pcall(function()
            if typeof(getfenv) == "function" then
                envs[#envs + 1] = getfenv(0)
            end
        end)
        if type(_G) == "table" then
            envs[#envs + 1] = _G
        end
        local synLib
        pcall(function()
            if type(syn) == "table" then
                synLib = syn
            end
        end)
        for _, alias in ipairs(a2._fsAliases[name] or { name }) do
            for _, env in ipairs(envs) do
                local fn
                pcall(function()
                    fn = env[alias]
                end)
                if typeof(fn) == "function" then
                    a2._fsCache[name] = fn
                    return fn
                end
            end
            if synLib then
                local fn
                pcall(function()
                    fn = synLib[alias]
                end)
                if typeof(fn) == "function" then
                    a2._fsCache[name] = fn
                    return fn
                end
            end
        end
        return nil
    end
    function a2._fsHas(name)
        return a2._fsFn(name) ~= nil
    end
    function a2._fsAvailable()
        return a2._fsHas("writefile") and a2._fsHas("readfile")
    end
    function a2._fsIsFile(path)
        local isfileFn = a2._fsFn("isfile")
        if isfileFn then
            local ok, res = pcall(isfileFn, path)
            if ok and type(res) == "boolean" then
                return res
            end
        end
        local readfileFn = a2._fsFn("readfile")
        if readfileFn then
            local ok, content = pcall(readfileFn, path)
            return ok and type(content) == "string"
        end
        return false
    end
    function a2._fsIsFolder(path)
        local isfolderFn = a2._fsFn("isfolder")
        if isfolderFn then
            local ok, res = pcall(isfolderFn, path)
            if ok and type(res) == "boolean" then
                return res
            end
        end
        return false
    end
    function a2._fsMakeFolder(path)
        local makeFn = a2._fsFn("makefolder")
        if not makeFn then
            return false
        end
        local walked = ""
        for segment in tostring(path):gmatch("[^/\\]+") do
            walked = walked == "" and segment or (walked .. "/" .. segment)
            if not a2._fsIsFolder(walked) then
                pcall(makeFn, walked)
            end
        end
        return a2._fsFn("isfolder") == nil or a2._fsIsFolder(path)
    end
    function a2._fsRead(path)
        local readfileFn = a2._fsFn("readfile")
        if not readfileFn then
            return nil, "file API unavailable"
        end
        local ok, data = pcall(readfileFn, path)
        if ok and type(data) == "string" then
            return data
        end
        return nil, ok and "unreadable file" or tostring(data)
    end
    function a2._fsWrite(path, data)
        local writefileFn = a2._fsFn("writefile")
        if not writefileFn then
            return false, "file API unavailable"
        end
        local ok, err = pcall(writefileFn, path, data)
        if not ok then
            return false, tostring(err)
        end
        return true
    end
    function a2._fsDelete(path)
        local delfileFn = a2._fsFn("delfile")
        if not delfileFn then
            return false, "your executor has no delfile"
        end
        if not a2._fsIsFile(path) then
            return true
        end
        local ok, err = pcall(delfileFn, path)
        if not ok then
            return false, tostring(err)
        end
        if a2._fsIsFile(path) then
            return false, "could not delete " .. tostring(path)
        end
        return true
    end
    function a2._fsList(path)
        local listFn = a2._fsFn("listfiles")
        if not listFn then
            return {}
        end
        if a2._fsFn("isfolder") and not a2._fsIsFolder(path) then
            return {}
        end
        local ok, res = pcall(listFn, path)
        if not ok or type(res) ~= "table" then
            return {}
        end
        return res
    end
    function a2._fsRemoveTree(path, depth)
        depth = depth or 0
        if depth > 12 or not a2._fsIsFolder(path) then
            return true
        end
        local delFolderFn = a2._fsFn("delfolder")
        if delFolderFn and pcall(delFolderFn, path) and not a2._fsIsFolder(path) then
            return true
        end
        local clean = true
        for _, entry in ipairs(a2._fsList(path)) do
            if a2._fsIsFolder(entry) then
                if not a2._fsRemoveTree(entry, depth + 1) then
                    clean = false
                end
            elseif not a2._fsDelete(entry) then
                clean = false
            end
        end
        if delFolderFn then
            pcall(delFolderFn, path)
        end
        if not a2._fsIsFolder(path) then
            return true
        end
        -- without delfolder an emptied folder cannot be removed, which still counts as clean
        return clean and delFolderFn == nil
    end
    function a2._clipboardCanWrite()
        return typeof(setclipboard) == "function"
            or typeof(toclipboard) == "function"
            or (typeof(Clipboard) == "table" and typeof(Clipboard.set) == "function")
    end
    function a2._clipboardRead()
        local env
        pcall(function()
            if typeof(getgenv) == "function" then
                env = getgenv()
            end
        end)
        if type(env) ~= "table" then
            env = _G
        end
        if type(env) == "table" then
            for _, name in ipairs({ "getclipboard", "fromclipboard", "get_clipboard", "readclipboard" }) do
                local fn
                pcall(function()
                    fn = env[name]
                end)
                if typeof(fn) == "function" then
                    local ok, res = pcall(fn)
                    if ok and type(res) == "string" and res ~= "" then
                        return res
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        local board
        pcall(function()
            board = Clipboard
        end)
        if type(board) == "table" and typeof(board.get) == "function" then
            local ok, res = pcall(board.get)
            if ok and type(res) == "string" and res ~= "" then
                return res
            end
        end
        return nil
    end

    local a7 = 1
    local a8 = "airflow:"
    local function a9(ba, bb)
        return ba.ConfigFolder .. "/" .. bb .. ".json"
    end
    local function ba()
        return a2._fsAvailable()
    end
    local function bb(bc)
        pcall(a2._fsMakeFolder, bc)
    end
    local function bc(bd)
        return string.format(
            "%02x%02x%02x",
            math.floor(bd.R * 255 + 0.5),
            math.floor(bd.G * 255 + 0.5),
            math.floor(bd.B * 255 + 0.5)
        )
    end
    local function bd(be)
        if type(be) == "table" then
            if type(be.Hex) == "string" then
                be = be.Hex
            elseif type(be[1]) == "number" then
                return Color3.new(be[1], be[2] or 0, be[3] or 0)
            end
        end
        if type(be) == "string" then
            local bf, bg, bh = be:match("^%s*#?(%x%x)(%x%x)(%x%x)%s*$")
            if bf then
                return Color3.fromRGB(tonumber(bf, 16), tonumber(bg, 16), tonumber(bh, 16))
            end
        end
        return nil
    end
    local function be(bf)
        local bg = bf._type
        local bh = bf:Get()
        if type(bf._saveValue) == "function" then
            bh = bf:_saveValue()
        end
        if bg == "Keybind" then
            return { Type = bg, Value = bh and bh.Name or nil, Mode = type(bf.GetMode) == "function" and bf:GetMode() or nil }
        elseif bg == "ColorPicker" then
            if typeof(bh) ~= "Color3" then
                return { Type = bg, Value = nil }
            end
            local saved = { Hex = bc(bh) }
            if bf._hasAlpha and type(bf.GetTransparency) == "function" then
                saved.Transparency = math.floor(bf:GetTransparency() * 1000 + 0.5) / 1000
            end
            if type(bf.IsRainbow) == "function" and bf:IsRainbow() then
                saved.Rainbow = true
            end
            return { Type = bg, Value = saved }
        end
        return { Type = bg, Value = bh }
    end
    local function bf(bg, bh, bi)
        local bj = bg._type
        local bk = bh.Value
        if bj == "Keybind" then
            if type(bh.Mode) == "string" and type(bg.SetMode) == "function" then
                bg:SetMode(bh.Mode, bi)
            end
            bg:Set(type(bk) == "string" and bk or nil, bi)
        elseif bj == "ColorPicker" then
            local bl = bd(bk)
            if bl then
                if type(bk) == "table" and tonumber(bk.Transparency) and type(bg.SetTransparency) == "function" then
                    bg:SetTransparency(tonumber(bk.Transparency), true)
                end
                bg:Set(bl, bi)
                if type(bg.SetRainbow) == "function" then
                    bg:SetRainbow(type(bk) == "table" and bk.Rainbow == true, bi)
                end
            end
        elseif bj == "Dropdown" then
            bg:Set(bk, bi)
        elseif bj == "Toggle" then
            if type(bk) == "boolean" then
                bg:Set(bk, bi)
            end
        elseif bj == "Slider" or bj == "Stepper" or bj == "Progress" then
            local bl = tonumber(bk)
            if bl then
                bg:Set(bl, bi)
            end
        elseif bk ~= nil then
            bg:Set(bk, bi)
        end
    end
    local function bg(bh, bi)
        return type(bi) == "table" and (bi.Type == nil or bi.Type == bh._type)
    end
    local function bh(bi)
        local bj = {}
        if bi and bi._pendingFlags then
            for bk, bl in pairs(bi._pendingFlags) do
                bj[bk] = bl.Entry
            end
        end
        for bk, bl in pairs(k.Flags) do
            if bl._type and type(bl.Get) == "function" then
                local bm, bn = pcall(be, bl)
                if bm then
                    bj[bk] = bn
                end
            end
        end
        return bj
    end
    function a2:_applyFlags(bi, bj, strict)
        bj = bj == true
        self._pendingFlags = {}
        for bk, bl in pairs(bi) do
            local bm = k.Flags[bk]
            if bm and type(bm.Set) == "function" then
                if bg(bm, bl) then
                    pcall(bf, bm, bl, bj)
                end
            elseif type(bl) == "table" then
                self._pendingFlags[bk] = { Entry = bl, Silent = bj }
            end
        end
        if strict then
            for flag, control in pairs(k.Flags) do
                if bi[flag] == nil and control._defaultEntry and type(control.Set) == "function" then
                    pcall(bf, control, control._defaultEntry, bj)
                end
            end
        end
    end
    function a2:_flagCreated(bi, bj)
        local bk, bl = pcall(be, bj)
        if bk then
            bj._defaultEntry = bl
        end
        local bm = self._pendingFlags and self._pendingFlags[bi]
        if not bm then
            return
        end
        task.defer(function()
            if self._pendingFlags[bi] ~= bm or k.Flags[bi] ~= bj or bj._destroyed then
                return
            end
            self._pendingFlags[bi] = nil
            if bg(bj, bm.Entry) then
                pcall(bf, bj, bm.Entry, bm.Silent)
            end
        end)
    end
    function a2:_configChanged()
        for bi, bj in ipairs(self._configListeners) do
            aJ(bj)
        end
    end
    function a2:OnConfigChanged(bi)
        table.insert(self._configListeners, bi)
        return function()
            local bj = table.find(self._configListeners, bi)
            if bj then
                table.remove(self._configListeners, bj)
            end
        end
    end
    local function bi(bj)
        if type(bj) ~= "string" or bj == "" or #bj > 64 then
            return false
        end
        if bj:find('[\\/:%*%?"<>|%c]') or bj == "." or bj == ".." then
            return false
        end
        local up = bj:upper()
        if up == "CON" or up == "PRN" or up == "AUX" or up == "NUL" or up:match("^COM%d$") or up:match("^LPT%d$") then
            return false
        end
        return true
    end
    local function bj(bk, bl, bm)
        return e:JSONEncode({ Folder = bk.ConfigFolder, Name = bl, Version = a7, Config = e:JSONEncode(bm) })
    end
    local bk = [[ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/]]
    local bl = {}
    for bm = 1, #bk do
        bl[bk:byte(bm)] = bm - 1
    end
    local function bm(bn)
        if #bn % 4 ~= 0 then
            return nil
        end
        local bo = {}
        for bp = 1, #bn, 4 do
            local bq, br = 0, 0
            for bs = 0, 3 do
                local bt = bn:byte(bp + bs)
                local bu = bl[bt]
                if bt == 61 and bp + 3 >= #bn then
                    br += 1
                    bu = 0
                elseif bu == nil or br > 0 then
                    return nil
                end
                bq = bq * 64 + bu
            end
            if br > 2 then
                return nil
            end
            local bs = string.char(bit32.extract(bq, 16, 8), bit32.extract(bq, 8, 8), bit32.extract(bq, 0, 8))
            table.insert(bo, bs:sub(1, 3 - br))
        end
        return table.concat(bo)
    end
    local function bn(bo)
        bo = tostring(bo or ""):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")
        if bo:sub(1, #a8) == a8 then
            bo = bm((bo:sub(#a8 + 1):gsub("%s", "")))
            if not bo then
                return nil, "invalid config code"
            end
        end
        local bp, bq = pcall(function()
            return e:JSONDecode(bo)
        end)
        if not bp or type(bq) ~= "table" then
            return nil, "invalid config code"
        end
        local br = {}
        if type(bq.Config) == "string" or (type(bq.Config) == "table" and bq.Config.Type == nil) then
            br.Folder = type(bq.Folder) == "string" and bq.Folder or nil
            br.Name = type(bq.Name) == "string" and bq.Name or nil
            br.Version = tonumber(bq.Version)
            local bs = bq.Config
            if type(bs) == "string" then
                bp, bs = pcall(function()
                    return e:JSONDecode(bq.Config)
                end)
                if not bp then
                    return nil, "invalid config code"
                end
            end
            if type(bs) ~= "table" then
                return nil, "invalid config code"
            end
            bq = bs
        end
        for bs, bt in pairs(bq) do
            if type(bs) == "string" then
                if type(bt) ~= "table" then
                    bq[bs] = { Value = bt }
                end
            end
        end
        return bq, br
    end
    -- writes <name>.json: keeps the previous good copy as <name>.json.bak and reads the
    -- file back, so a silently failed or truncated write is reported instead of trusted
    local function bo(bp, bq, br, isAuto)
        if not bi(bq) then
            return false, "invalid config name"
        end
        if not ba() then
            return false, "file API unavailable"
        end
        local bs, bt = pcall(bj, bp, bq, br)
        if not bs then
            return false, "could not encode config"
        end
        bb(bp.ConfigFolder)
        local path = a9(bp, bq)
        local previous = a2._fsIsFile(path) and a2._fsRead(path) or nil
        if previous == bt then
            return true
        end
        if previous then
            local now = os.clock()
            bp._bakStamp = bp._bakStamp or {}
            if not isAuto or now - (bp._bakStamp[bq] or -math.huge) >= 60 then
                local decoded, parsed = pcall(function()
                    return e:JSONDecode(previous)
                end)
                if decoded and type(parsed) == "table" and a2._fsWrite(path .. ".bak", previous) then
                    bp._bakStamp[bq] = now
                end
            end
        end
        local written, writeErr = a2._fsWrite(path, bt)
        if not written then
            return false, writeErr
        end
        local readBack = a2._fsRead(path)
        -- a missing, empty, truncated or unchanged (write silently ignored) file is a failed save
        if type(readBack) ~= "string" or readBack == "" or #readBack ~= #bt or readBack == previous then
            if previous then
                a2._fsWrite(path, previous)
            end
            return false, "could not verify the saved file"
        end
        return true
    end
    -- returns data, meta, recovered. A damaged file falls back to its .bak copy
    local function bp(bq, br)
        if not ba() then
            return nil, "file API unavailable"
        end
        if not bi(br) then
            return nil, "invalid config name"
        end
        local path = a9(bq, br)
        if not a2._fsIsFile(path) then
            return nil, "no config named " .. tostring(br)
        end
        local raw = a2._fsRead(path)
        if type(raw) ~= "string" then
            return nil, "no config named " .. tostring(br)
        end
        local data, meta = bn(raw)
        if data then
            return data, meta, false
        end
        local backup = a2._fsRead(path .. ".bak")
        if type(backup) == "string" then
            local backupData, backupMeta = bn(backup)
            if backupData then
                a2._fsWrite(path, backup)
                return backupData, backupMeta, true
            end
        end
        return nil, "config is not valid JSON"
    end
    function a2:ConfigExists(bq)
        return bi(bq) and ba() and a2._fsIsFile(a9(self, bq)) or false
    end
    function a2:SaveConfig(bq, isAuto)
        bq = bq or self.ConfigName
        if not bq then
            return false, "no config name"
        end
        local data = bh(self)
        local br, bs = bo(self, bq, data, isAuto == true)
        if br then
            self.ConfigName = bq
            local snapOk, snap = pcall(a2._stable, data)
            if snapOk then
                self._savedSnapshot = snap
                self._snapshotStale = false
            else
                self._snapshotStale = true
            end
        end
        return br, bs
    end
    -- returns true, nil, recovered (recovered = the .bak copy was used)
    function a2:LoadConfig(bq, br, strict)
        bq = bq or self.ConfigName
        if not bq then
            return false, "no config name"
        end
        local bs, bt, recovered = bp(self, bq)
        if not bs then
            return false, bt
        end
        if type(self.ConfigMigrate) == "function" then
            local migrated, result = pcall(self.ConfigMigrate, bs, type(bt) == "table" and bt.Version or nil)
            if migrated and type(result) == "table" then
                bs = result
            end
        end
        if strict == nil then
            strict = self.StrictLoad == true
        end
        self:_applyFlags(bs, br, strict)
        self.ConfigName = bq
        self.LoadedConfig = bq
        self._snapshotStale = true
        self:_configChanged()
        return true, nil, recovered == true
    end
    function a2:DeleteConfig(bq)
        if not ba() then
            return false, "file API unavailable"
        end
        if not a2._fsHas("delfile") then
            return false, "your executor has no delfile"
        end
        if not bi(bq) then
            return false, "invalid config name"
        end
        local br = a9(self, bq)
        if not a2._fsIsFile(br) then
            return false, "no config named " .. bq
        end
        local bs, bt = a2._fsDelete(br)
        if not bs then
            return false, bt
        end
        a2._fsDelete(br .. ".bak")
        if self.LoadedConfig == bq then
            self.LoadedConfig = nil
        end
        if self.ConfigName == bq then
            self.ConfigName = nil
        end
        self:_retargetAutoload(bq, nil)
        self:_configChanged()
        return true
    end
    function a2:RenameConfig(bq, br)
        if not bi(br) then
            return false, "invalid config name"
        end
        if bq == br then
            return true
        end
        -- Windows disks treat Foo and foo as one file, so a case-only rename is special
        local caseOnly = type(bq) == "string" and bq:lower() == br:lower()
        if caseOnly then
            for _, existing in ipairs(self:ListConfigs()) do
                if existing == br then
                    return false, br .. " already exists"
                end
            end
        elseif self:ConfigExists(br) then
            return false, br .. " already exists"
        end
        local bs, bt = bp(self, bq)
        if not bs then
            return false, bt
        end
        if not a2._fsHas("delfile") then
            return false, "rename needs delfile"
        end
        local oldPath, newPath = a9(self, bq), a9(self, br)
        local oldBackup = a2._fsRead(oldPath .. ".bak")
        local bu, writeErr
        if caseOnly then
            local gone, goneErr = a2._fsDelete(oldPath)
            if not gone then
                return false, goneErr
            end
            bu, writeErr = bo(self, br, bs)
            if not bu then
                bo(self, bq, bs)
                return false, writeErr
            end
        else
            bu, writeErr = bo(self, br, bs)
            if not bu then
                return false, writeErr
            end
            local removed, removeErr = a2._fsDelete(oldPath)
            if not removed then
                a2._fsDelete(newPath)
                return false, removeErr or ("could not remove " .. bq)
            end
        end
        a2._fsDelete(oldPath .. ".bak")
        if type(oldBackup) == "string" and oldBackup ~= "" then
            a2._fsWrite(newPath .. ".bak", oldBackup)
        end
        if self.LoadedConfig == bq then
            self.LoadedConfig = br
        end
        if self.ConfigName == bq then
            self.ConfigName = br
        end
        self:_retargetAutoload(bq, br)
        self:_configChanged()
        return true
    end
    function a2:DuplicateConfig(src, dst)
        if not bi(dst) then
            return false, "invalid config name"
        end
        if self:ConfigExists(dst) then
            return false, dst .. " already exists"
        end
        local data, err = bp(self, src)
        if not data then
            return false, err
        end
        local ok, saveErr = bo(self, dst, data)
        if not ok then
            return false, saveErr
        end
        self:_configChanged()
        return true
    end
    function a2:ListConfigs()
        local bq, seen = {}, {}
        for _, entry in ipairs(a2._fsList(self.ConfigFolder)) do
            local bv = tostring(entry):match("([^/\\]+)%.json$")
            if bv and bi(bv) and not seen[bv] then
                seen[bv] = true
                table.insert(bq, bv)
            end
        end
        table.sort(bq, function(bt, bu)
            return bt:lower() < bu:lower()
        end)
        return bq
    end
    function a2:ResetConfig(bq)
        self._pendingFlags = {}
        self._snapshotStale = true
        for br, bs in pairs(k.Flags) do
            if bs._defaultEntry and type(bs.Set) == "function" then
                pcall(bf, bs, bs._defaultEntry, bq == true)
            end
        end
        self:_configChanged()
        return true
    end
    local function bq(br)
        return a2._fsRemoveTree(br)
    end
    function a2:ClearWorkspace()
        local folder = tostring(self.ConfigFolder or "")
        local safeFolder = folder ~= ""
            and folder ~= "."
            and not folder:find("%.%.")
            and not folder:find("^[/\\]")
            and not folder:find(":")
        local br = safeFolder and bq(folder) or false
        self.LoadedConfig = nil
        self.ConfigName = nil
        self._savedSnapshot = nil
        self._snapshotStale = true
        for bs, bt in ipairs(self._workspaceListeners or {}) do
            aJ(bt)
        end
        self:_configChanged()
        return br
    end
    function a2:ExportConfig(br, asCode)
        local bs, bt
        if br then
            bs, bt = bp(self, br)
            if not bs then
                return nil, bt
            end
        else
            bs = bh(self)
            br = self.LoadedConfig or self.ConfigName
        end
        local bu, bv = pcall(bj, self, br, bs)
        if not bu then
            return nil, "could not encode config"
        end
        if asCode == true then
            return a8 .. a2._b64encode(bv)
        end
        return bv
    end
    function a2:DecodeConfig(br)
        return bn(br)
    end
    function a2:ImportConfig(br, bs, bt)
        local bu, bv = bn(br)
        if not bu then
            return false, bv
        end
        if not bt and bv.Folder and bv.Folder ~= self.ConfigFolder then
            return false, "config is for " .. bv.Folder
        end
        if bs == true then
            bs = bv.Name
            if not bi(bs) then
                return false, "config has no usable name"
            end
        end
        if bs then
            local bw, bx = bo(self, bs, bu)
            if not bw then
                return false, bx
            end
        end
        self:_applyFlags(bu, false, self.StrictLoad == true)
        self._snapshotStale = true
        if bs then
            self.ConfigName = bs
            self.LoadedConfig = bs
        end
        self:_configChanged()
        return true, nil, bs
    end
    local function br(bs)
        if not ba() then
            return nil
        end
        local bt = a2._fsRead(bs)
        if type(bt) == "string" and bt ~= "" then
            return bt
        end
        return nil
    end
    -- without delfile an autoload file is blanked instead, and an empty one reads as "none"
    local function bs(bt)
        if not ba() or not a2._fsIsFile(bt) then
            return
        end
        if not a2._fsDelete(bt) then
            a2._fsWrite(bt, "")
        end
    end
    local function bt(bu)
        return bu.ConfigFolder .. "/configsettings.txt"
    end
    function a2:_readConfigSettings()
        local bu = br(bt(self))
        if bu then
            local bv, bw = pcall(function()
                return e:JSONDecode(bu)
            end)
            if bv and type(bw) == "table" then
                return bw
            end
        end
        return {}
    end
    function a2:_writeConfigSettings(bu)
        if not ba() then
            return false, "file API unavailable"
        end
        local bv = self:_readConfigSettings()
        for bw, bx in pairs(bu) do
            bv[bw] = bx
        end
        bb(self.ConfigFolder)
        local encoded, payload = pcall(function()
            return e:JSONEncode(bv)
        end)
        if not encoded then
            return false, "could not encode settings"
        end
        return a2._fsWrite(bt(self), payload)
    end
    local function bu(bv, bw)
        if bw == "Account" then
            local plr = j or f.LocalPlayer
            local uid = (plr and plr.UserId) or (f.LocalPlayer and f.LocalPlayer.UserId) or 0
            return bv.ConfigFolder .. "/autoload_" .. tostring(uid) .. ".txt"
        end
        return bv.ConfigFolder .. "/autoload.txt"
    end
    function a2:GetAutoloadMode()
        return self:_readConfigSettings().AutoloadMode == "Account" and "Account" or "Global"
    end
    function a2:GetAutoload(bv)
        local function readName(mode)
            local raw = br(bu(self, mode))
            raw = raw and raw:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")
            if raw and bi(raw) then
                return raw
            end
            return nil
        end
        if bv then
            return readName(bv)
        end
        local settings = self:_readConfigSettings()
        if settings.AutoloadDisabled == true then
            return nil
        end
        local name = readName("Account") or readName("Global")
        if not name and self.ConfigName and self:ConfigExists(self.ConfigName) then
            return self.ConfigName
        end
        return name
    end
    function a2:SetAutoload(bv, bw)
        if not ba() then
            return false, "file API unavailable"
        end
        if bv ~= nil and bv ~= "" and not bi(bv) then
            return false, "invalid config name"
        end
        bw = bw or self:GetAutoloadMode()
        local bx, by = true, nil
        if bv == nil or bv == "" then
            bs(bu(self, bw))
            if bw == "Global" then
                bs(bu(self, "Account"))
            end
            self:_writeConfigSettings({ AutoloadDisabled = true })
        else
            bb(self.ConfigFolder)
            bx, by = a2._fsWrite(bu(self, bw), tostring(bv))
            if bx then
                if bw == "Global" then
                    bs(bu(self, "Account"))
                end
                self:_writeConfigSettings({ AutoloadDisabled = false })
            end
        end
        self:_configChanged()
        return bx, by
    end
    function a2:SetAutoloadMode(bv)
        bv = bv == "Account" and "Account" or "Global"
        if bv == self:GetAutoloadMode() then
            return true
        end
        local bw = self:GetAutoload()
        local bx, by = self:_writeConfigSettings({ AutoloadMode = bv })
        if not bx then
            return false, by
        end
        bs(bu(self, bv == "Account" and "Global" or "Account"))
        if bw then
            return self:SetAutoload(bw, bv)
        end
        self:_configChanged()
        return true
    end
    -- Delete / Rename use this: only the mode that points at oldName changes, so an
    -- autoload set for the other mode is left alone
    function a2:_retargetAutoload(oldName, newName)
        local changed = false
        for _, mode in ipairs({ "Global", "Account" }) do
            if self:GetAutoload(mode) == oldName then
                changed = true
                if newName then
                    a2._fsWrite(bu(self, mode), tostring(newName))
                else
                    bs(bu(self, mode))
                end
            end
        end
        if changed and not newName and not (self:GetAutoload("Global") or self:GetAutoload("Account")) then
            self:_writeConfigSettings({ AutoloadDisabled = true })
        end
        return changed
    end
    function a2:LoadAutoload(bv)
        local bw = self:GetAutoload() or (self.ConfigName and self:ConfigExists(self.ConfigName) and self.ConfigName)
        if not bw then
            return false, "no autoload config"
        end
        return self:LoadConfig(bw, bv)
    end
    function a2._stable(value, depth)
        depth = depth or 0
        local kind = type(value)
        if kind == "table" and depth < 8 then
            local keys = {}
            for key in pairs(value) do
                keys[#keys + 1] = key
            end
            table.sort(keys, function(x, y)
                return tostring(x) < tostring(y)
            end)
            local parts = {}
            for _, key in ipairs(keys) do
                parts[#parts + 1] = tostring(key) .. "=" .. a2._stable(value[key], depth + 1)
            end
            return "{" .. table.concat(parts, ",") .. "}"
        end
        return kind .. ":" .. tostring(value)
    end
    function a2._b64encode(data)
        local alphabet = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/"
        local out = {}
        for i = 1, #data, 3 do
            local b1, b2, b3 = data:byte(i, i + 2)
            local n = b1 * 65536 + (b2 or 0) * 256 + (b3 or 0)
            local c1 = bit32.extract(n, 18, 6) + 1
            local c2 = bit32.extract(n, 12, 6) + 1
            local c3 = bit32.extract(n, 6, 6) + 1
            local c4 = bit32.extract(n, 0, 6) + 1
            out[#out + 1] = alphabet:sub(c1, c1)
                .. alphabet:sub(c2, c2)
                .. (b2 and alphabet:sub(c3, c3) or "=")
                .. (b3 and alphabet:sub(c4, c4) or "=")
        end
        return table.concat(out)
    end
    function a2:_autoSaveTick()
        local name = self.LoadedConfig or self.ConfigName
        if not name or not bi(name) or not ba() then
            return
        end
        local ok, snapshot = pcall(function()
            return a2._stable(bh(self))
        end)
        if not ok then
            return
        end
        if self._snapshotStale or self._savedSnapshot == nil then
            self._savedSnapshot = snapshot
            self._snapshotStale = false
            return
        end
        if snapshot ~= self._savedSnapshot then
            local saved, saveErr = self:SaveConfig(name, true)
            if saved then
                self._savedSnapshot = snapshot
                self._autoSaveWarned = false
            elseif not self._autoSaveWarned then
                self._autoSaveWarned = true
                warn("[AirFlow] auto-save failed: " .. tostring(saveErr))
            end
        end
    end
    function a2:GetAutoSave()
        return self._autoSave == true
    end
    function a2:SetAutoSave(enabled, interval)
        self._autoSave = enabled == true
        self._autoSaveInterval = math.clamp(tonumber(interval) or self._autoSaveInterval or 3, 1, 60)
        if self._autoSave then
            self._snapshotStale = true
        end
        if self._autoSave and not self._autoSaveRunning then
            self._autoSaveRunning = true
            task.spawn(function()
                while not self._destroyed and self._autoSave do
                    task.wait(self._autoSaveInterval)
                    if self._destroyed or not self._autoSave then
                        break
                    end
                    pcall(self._autoSaveTick, self)
                end
                self._autoSaveRunning = false
            end)
        end
        return true
    end
    k._themeListeners = {}
    local function bv(bw)
        return k._ThemeKit.parse(bw)
    end
    local function bw(bx)
        return string.format(
            "#%02X%02X%02X",
            math.floor(bx.R * 255 + 0.5),
            math.floor(bx.G * 255 + 0.5),
            math.floor(bx.B * 255 + 0.5)
        )
    end
    k._toneTags = {}
    for bx, by in ipairs(n) do
        k._toneTags[string.lower(by)] = by
    end
    function k._color(bx)
        if type(bx) == "string" then
            local by = k._toneTags[string.lower(bx)]
            if by then
                return z[by]
            end
        end
        return bv(bx)
    end
    function k._rich(bx)
        bx = tostring(bx == nil and "" or bx)
        if not string.find(bx, "<", 1, true) then
            return bx
        end
        return (
            string.gsub(bx, "<(/?)(%a+%d*)>", function(by, bz)
                local bA = k._toneTags[string.lower(bz)]
                if not bA then
                    return nil
                end
                if by == "/" then
                    return "</font>"
                end
                return '<font color="' .. bw(z[bA]) .. '">'
            end)
        )
    end
    function k.Colorize(...)
        local bx = { ... }
        if bx[1] == k then
            table.remove(bx, 1)
        end
        local by, bz = tostring(bx[1] == nil and "" or bx[1]), bx[2]
        local bA = type(bz) == "string" and k._toneTags[string.lower(bz)]
        if bA then
            return "<" .. bA .. ">" .. by .. "</" .. bA .. ">"
        end
        local bB = bv(bz)
        if not bB then
            return by
        end
        return '<font color="' .. bw(bB) .. '">' .. by .. "</font>"
    end
    function k:SetCornerRadius(bx, by)
        bx = math.clamp(math.floor((tonumber(bx) or 10) + 0.5), 0, 20)
        k.Roundness = bx / 10
        for bz, bA in pairs(k._cornerBases) do
            if not bz.Parent then
                k._cornerBases[bz] = nil
            else
                local bB = UDim.new(0, math.floor(bA * k.Roundness + 0.5))
                if by then
                    bz.CornerRadius = bB
                else
                    ah(bz, { CornerRadius = bB }, 0.25, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint)
                end
            end
        end
        return bx
    end
    function k:GetCornerRadius()
        return math.floor(k.Roundness * 10 + 0.5)
    end
    function k:SetTheme(bx, by, opts)
        local kit = k._ThemeKit
        local incoming
        if type(bx) == "string" then
            local name = bx
            local preset = k.ThemePresets[name]
            if not preset then
                local wanted = string.lower(name)
                for presetName, presetData in pairs(k.ThemePresets) do
                    if string.lower(presetName) == wanted then
                        name = presetName
                        preset = presetData
                        break
                    end
                end
            end
            if not preset then
                return false
            end
            k.ThemeName = name
            incoming = kit.complete(preset)
        elseif type(bx) == "table" then
            incoming = type(bx.Colors) == "table" and bx.Colors or bx
        else
            return false
        end
        local parsed = {}
        for i, token in ipairs(n) do
            local c = kit.parse(incoming[token])
            if c then
                parsed[token] = c
            end
        end
        -- a new accent without an explicit AccentDark gets a readable one automatically
        if type(bx) == "table" and parsed.Accent and not parsed.AccentDark and not (opts and opts.Exact) then
            parsed.AccentDark = kit.onColor(parsed.Accent)
        end
        local clean = k._themeClean
        local changed = false
        for token, c in pairs(parsed) do
            local old = clean[token]
            if not old or kit.key(old) ~= kit.key(c) then
                clean[token] = c
                changed = true
            end
        end
        if not changed then
            return true
        end
        _()
        Y()
        af(by and 0 or k.ThemeTransition)
        for bA, bB in pairs(S) do
            if bA.Parent then
                pcall(bB)
            end
        end
        local snapshot = k:GetTheme()
        for i, listener in ipairs(table.clone(k._themeListeners)) do
            pcall(listener, snapshot, k.ThemeName)
        end
        return true
    end
    function k:GetTheme()
        local bx = {}
        for by, bz in ipairs(n) do
            bx[bz] = k._themeClean[bz] or z[bz]
        end
        return bx
    end
    function k:GetThemeName()
        return k.ThemeName
    end
    function k:GetThemeNames()
        local names, seen = {}, {}
        for i, name in ipairs(k._themeOrder) do
            if k.ThemePresets[name] then
                table.insert(names, name)
                seen[name] = true
            end
        end
        local extra = {}
        for name in pairs(k.ThemePresets) do
            if not seen[name] then
                table.insert(extra, name)
            end
        end
        table.sort(extra)
        for i, name in ipairs(extra) do
            table.insert(names, name)
        end
        return names
    end
    function k:IsLightTheme()
        return k._ThemeKit.isLight(k._themeClean.Background)
    end
    function k:GenerateTheme(opts)
        return k._ThemeKit.generate(opts)
    end
    -- Library:RegisterTheme("Name", { Background = ..., Accent = ... })
    -- Tokens you leave out are derived from Background + Accent (pass { Derive = false } as 3rd argument to skip that).
    function k:RegisterTheme(name, colors, opts)
        if type(name) ~= "string" or name == "" then
            return false, "theme needs a name"
        end
        if k._themeBuiltin[name] then
            return false, name .. " is a built-in preset"
        end
        if type(colors) ~= "table" then
            return false, "colors must be a table"
        end
        local kit = k._ThemeKit
        local given, count = {}, 0
        for i, token in ipairs(n) do
            local c = kit.parse(colors[token])
            if c then
                given[token] = c
                count += 1
            end
        end
        if count == 0 then
            return false, "no valid colors"
        end
        local theme = given
        if not (type(opts) == "table" and opts.Derive == false) then
            theme = kit.generate(given)
        end
        k.ThemePresets[name] = theme
        k._themeCustom[name] = true
        return true
    end
    function k:UnregisterTheme(name)
        if k._themeCustom[name] then
            k.ThemePresets[name] = nil
            k._themeCustom[name] = nil
            return true
        end
        return false
    end
    -- Library:OnThemeChanged(function(colors, name) ... end) -> connection with :Disconnect()
    function k:OnThemeChanged(fn)
        if type(fn) ~= "function" then
            return nil
        end
        table.insert(k._themeListeners, fn)
        local conn = { Connected = true }
        function conn:Disconnect()
            if not conn.Connected then
                return
            end
            conn.Connected = false
            local index = table.find(k._themeListeners, fn)
            if index then
                table.remove(k._themeListeners, index)
            end
        end
        conn.Destroy = conn.Disconnect
        return conn
    end
    function k:RandomTheme(instant)
        local names = k:GetThemeNames()
        local pool = {}
        for i, name in ipairs(names) do
            if name ~= k.ThemeName then
                table.insert(pool, name)
            end
        end
        if #pool == 0 then
            return nil
        end
        local pick = pool[math.random(1, #pool)]
        k:SetTheme(pick, instant)
        return pick
    end
    function k:CycleTheme(step, instant)
        local names = k:GetThemeNames()
        if #names == 0 then
            return nil
        end
        step = math.floor(tonumber(step) or 1)
        local index = table.find(names, k.ThemeName) or 0
        index = ((index - 1 + step) % #names) + 1
        k:SetTheme(names[index], instant)
        return names[index]
    end
    function k:SetThemeTransition(seconds)
        k.ThemeTransition = math.clamp(tonumber(seconds) or 0.3, 0, 3)
        return k.ThemeTransition
    end
    function k:GetThemeTransition()
        return k.ThemeTransition
    end
    function k:ExportTheme()
        return k._ThemeKit.encode(k:GetTheme(), k.ThemeName)
    end
    -- Library:ImportTheme(code, saveAs?) -> true, themeName | false, reason
    function k:ImportTheme(code, saveAs)
        local tokens, info = k._ThemeKit.decode(code)
        if not tokens then
            return false, info
        end
        local name = type(saveAs) == "string" and saveAs ~= "" and saveAs or nil
        if name then
            local ok, why = k:RegisterTheme(name, tokens, { Derive = false })
            if not ok then
                return false, why
            end
            k.ThemeName = name
        elseif info then
            k.ThemeName = info
        end
        k:SetTheme(tokens, false, { Exact = true })
        return true, name or info
    end

    function a2:SaveTheme(by)
        if not ba() then
            return false, "file API unavailable"
        end
        if type(by) ~= "string" or by == "" then
            return false, "theme needs a name"
        end
        bb(self.ConfigFolder)
        bb(bx(self))
        local bz = {}
        for bA, bB in ipairs(n) do
            bz[bB] = bw(k._themeClean[bB] or z[bB])
        end
        return pcall(function()
            writefile(bx(self) .. "/" .. by .. ".json", e:JSONEncode(bz))
        end)
    end
    function a2:LoadTheme(by, bz)
        if k.ThemePresets[by] then
            return k:SetTheme(by, bz)
        end
        local bA = br(bx(self) .. "/" .. tostring(by) .. ".json")
        if not bA then
            return false, "no theme named " .. tostring(by)
        end
        local bB, bC = pcall(function()
            return e:JSONDecode(bA)
        end)
        if not bB or type(bC) ~= "table" then
            return false, "theme is not valid JSON"
        end
        k.ThemeName = by
        return k:SetTheme(bC, bz)
    end
    function a2:DeleteTheme(by)
        if not ba() or type(delfile) ~= "function" then
            return false, "file API unavailable"
        end
        local bz = bx(self) .. "/" .. tostring(by) .. ".json"
        if not isfile(bz) then
            return false, "no theme named " .. tostring(by)
        end
        delfile(bz)
        if self:GetDefaultTheme() == by then
            self:SetDefaultTheme(nil)
        end
        return true
    end
    function a2:ListThemes()
        local by = {}
        if type(listfiles) ~= "function" or type(isfolder) ~= "function" or not isfolder(bx(self)) then
            return by
        end
        for bz, bA in ipairs(listfiles(bx(self))) do
            local bB = bA:match("([^/\\]+)%.json$")
            if bB then
                table.insert(by, bB)
            end
        end
        table.sort(by)
        return by
    end

        return br(bx(self) .. "/default.txt")
    end
    function a2:SetDefaultTheme(by)
        if not ba() then
            return false, "file API unavailable"
        end
        bb(self.ConfigFolder)
        bb(bx(self))
        local bz = bx(self) .. "/default.txt"
        if by == nil or by == "" then
            if isfile(bz) and type(delfile) == "function" then
                pcall(delfile, bz)

        end
        return pcall(writefile, bz, tostring(by))
    end
    function a2:_applyDefaultTheme()
        local by = self:GetDefaultTheme()
        if by then
            local bz, bA = pcall(self.LoadTheme, self, by, true)
            if bz and bA then
                return
            end
        end
        if k.DefaultTheme ~= nil then
            pcall(k.SetTheme, k, k.DefaultTheme, true)
        end
    end
    k.BackgroundPresets = {
        ["Deep Violet"] = "rbxassetid://136310484943077",
        ["Blood Red"] = "rbxassetid://121343473918667",
        ["Cyanic"] = "rbxassetid://95656189244173",
        ["Amber Glow"] = "rbxassetid://107795771598485",
        ["Bloomings"] = "rbxassetid://133541508207801",
        ["Lavender Pink"] = "rbxassetid://126107479485287",
    }
    k.BackgroundPresetOrder = { "Deep Violet", "Blood Red", "Cyanic", "Amber Glow", "Bloomings", "Lavender Pink" }
    k._imageExtensions = { png = true, jpg = true, jpeg = true, webp = true, gif = true, bmp = true }
    function a2:_backgroundFolder()
        return self.ConfigFolder .. "/backgrounds"
    end
    function a2:_trimBackground(by)
        return (tostring(by or ""):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$"))
    end
    function a2:_resolveBackground(by)
        by = self:_trimBackground(by)
        local bz = k.BackgroundPresets[by]
        if bz then
            return bz
        end
        if by:match("^%d+$") then
            return "rbxassetid://" .. by
        end
        if
            by:match("^rbxassetid://%d+")
            or by:match("^rbxasset://")
            or by:match("^rbxthumb://")
            or by:match("^https?://www%.roblox%.com/asset")
        then
            return by
        end
        local bA = ba() and typeof(getcustomasset) == "function"
        if by:match("^https?://") then
            if not bA then
                return nil, "web images need writefile and getcustomasset"
            end
            local bB = by:match("^[^?#]+") or by
            local bC = (bB:match("%.(%w+)$") or "png"):lower()
            if not k._imageExtensions[bC] then
                bC = "png"
            end
            local bD = (bB:gsub("^https?://", ""):gsub("[^%w]", "_")):sub(-60)
            local bE = self:_backgroundFolder() .. "/cache"
            local bF = bE .. "/" .. bD .. "_" .. #by .. "." .. bC
            if not isfile(bF) then
                local bG, bH = pcall(function()
                    local bG = (syn and syn.request) or http_request or request
                    if bG then
                        local bH = bG({ Url = by, Method = "GET" })
                        return bH and bH.Body
                    end
                    return game:HttpGet(by, true)
                end)
                if not bG or type(bH) ~= "string" or #bH < 128 then
                    return nil, "could not download the image"
                end
                local bI = bH:sub(1, 64):lower()
                if bI:find("<!doctype") or bI:find("<html") then
                    return nil, "that link is a web page, not an image"
                end
                bb(bE)
                if not pcall(writefile, bF, bH) then
                    return nil, "could not save the image"
                end
            end
            local bG, bH = pcall(getcustomasset, bF)
            if bG and type(bH) == "string" and bH ~= "" then
                return bH
            end
            pcall(delfile, bF)
            return nil, "the downloaded file is not an image"
        end
        if bA then
            for bB, bC in ipairs({ self:_backgroundFolder() .. "/" .. by, by }) do
                if isfile(bC) then
                    local bD, bE = pcall(getcustomasset, bC)
                    if bD and type(bE) == "string" and bE ~= "" then
                        return bE
                    end
                    return nil, "could not load " .. by
                end
            end
        end
        return nil, "no image called " .. by
    end
    function a2:SetBackground(by)
        self._backgroundGeneration += 1
        local bz = self._backgroundGeneration
        local bA = self._backgroundImage
        by = by ~= false and self:_trimBackground(by) or ""
        if by == "" or by == "None" then
            self.Background = nil
            ah(bA, { ImageTransparency = 1 }, 0.25)
            task.delay(0.25, function()
                if self._backgroundGeneration == bz then
                    bA.Visible = false
                    bA.Image = ""
                end
            end)
            self:SetTransparent(self.Transparent)
            return true
        end
        local bB, bC = self:_resolveBackground(by)
        if self._backgroundGeneration ~= bz or self._destroyed then
            return false, "replaced by a newer background"
        end
        if not bB then
            return false, bC
        end
        self.Background = by
        bA.Image = bB
        bA.Visible = true
        ah(bA, { ImageTransparency = self.BackgroundTransparency }, 0.3)
        self:SetTransparent(self.Transparent)
        return true
    end
    function a2:GetBackground()
        return self.Background
    end
    function a2:SetBackgroundTransparency(by)
        self.BackgroundTransparency = math.clamp(tonumber(by) or 0.35, 0, 1)
        if self.Background then
            ah(self._backgroundImage, { ImageTransparency = self.BackgroundTransparency }, 0.15)
        end
    end
    function a2:ListBackgrounds()
        local by = table.clone(k.BackgroundPresetOrder)
        local bz = self:_backgroundFolder()
        if type(listfiles) == "function" and type(isfolder) == "function" and isfolder(bz) then
            local bA = {}
            for bB, bC in ipairs(listfiles(bz)) do
                local bD = bC:match("([^/]+)$")
                local bE = bD and bD:match("%.(%w+)$")
                if bE and k._imageExtensions[bE:lower()] then
                    table.insert(bA, bD)
                end
            end
            table.sort(bA)
            for bB, bC in ipairs(bA) do
                table.insert(by, bC)
            end
        end
        return by
    end
    local function by(bz, bA, bB)
        local bC = ai(
            "Frame",
            {
                AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
                Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, -10),
                Size = UDim2.fromOffset(200, 70),
                BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                Parent = bz,
            }
        )
        local bD = ai(
            "ImageLabel",
            {
                AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0),
                Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 0),
                Size = UDim2.fromOffset(26, 26),
                BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                ImageColor3 = z.Muted,
                ImageTransparency = 0.15,
                ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit,
                Parent = bC,
            }
        )
        aq(bD, bA)

    local function bA(bB)
        bB = math.max(math.floor(bB), 0)
        local bC = math.floor(bB / 86400)
        local bD = math.floor(bB / 3600) % 24
        local bE = math.floor(bB / 60) % 60
        if bC > 0 then
            return string.format("%dd %dh", bC, bD)
        elseif bD > 0 then
            return string.format("%dh %dm", bD, bE)
        elseif bE > 0 then
            return string.format("%dm %ds", bE, bB % 60)
        end
        return string.format("%ds", bB)
    end

    end

                Text = k._rich(b0.Name) .. '<font transparency="0.4">  \u{b7}  popped out, click to dock</font>',
                TextSize = 12,
                FontFace = D.Regular,
                TextColor3 = z.Muted,
                TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center,
                RichText = true,
                TextTransparency = 1,
                Parent = cb,
            })
            local cw = cb
            cb.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
                ah(cw, { BackgroundTransparency = 0.35 }, 0.15)
            end)
            cb.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
                ah(cw, { BackgroundTransparency = 0.6 }, 0.25)
            end)
            cb.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                if cb == cw then
                    b0:Dock()
                end
            end)
            ah(cb, { Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 40) }, 0.42, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint)
            ah(cv, { TextTransparency = 0 }, 0.3)
            cb.Visible = bP.Visible
            b8 = ai(
                "Frame",
                {
                    Name = "PopOut",
                    AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0),
                    Position = UDim2.fromOffset(cs.X + ct / 2, cs.Y),
                    Size = UDim2.fromOffset(ct, cu),
                    BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                    Parent = co,
                }
            )
            b8:SetAttribute("NoDrag", true)
            b9 = ai("UIScale", { Parent = b8 })
            ca = ai(
                "ImageLabel",
                {
                    Position = UDim2.fromOffset(-24, -18),
                    Size = UDim2.new(1, 48, 1, 44),
                    BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                    Image = A.Shadow,
                    ImageColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0),
                    ImageTransparency = 1,
                    ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Slice,
                    SliceCenter = Rect.new(49, 49, 450, 450),
                    ZIndex = 0,
                    Parent = b8,
                }
            )
            table.insert(bM._popPanels, b8)
            bP.Parent = b8
            bM._controlsDirty = true
            cm(true)
            local cx = ck(b0._popSpot or Vector2.new(cs.X + ct / 2 + 22, cs.Y - 14), ct, cu)
            ch = true
            b9.Scale = 0.97
            ah(b8, { Position = UDim2.fromOffset(cx.X, cx.Y) }, 0.5, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint)
            ah(b9, { Scale = 1 }, 0.55, Enum.EasingStyle.Back)
            ah(ca, { ImageTransparency = 0.35 }, 0.4)
            task.delay(0.5, function()
                if b7 == cp then
                    ch = false
                end
            end)
            local cy = b8
            cc = bM:_listen("Render", function()
                if b8 ~= cy or not cy.Parent then
                    return
                end
                local cz = bP.AbsoluteSize.Y / ci()
                if math.abs(cy.Size.Y.Offset - cz) > 0.5 then
                    cy.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(cy.Size.X.Offset, cz)
                end
                cy.Visible = bP.Visible
                if cb then
                    cb.Visible = bP.Visible
                end
                if not ch and not cd then
                    local cA = Vector2.new(cy.Position.X.Offset, cy.Position.Y.Offset)
                    local cB = ck(cA, cy.Size.X.Offset, cz)
                    if (cB - cA).Magnitude > 0.5 then
                        cy.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(cB.X, cB.Y)
                    end
                end
            end)
        end
        local function co(cp)
            if not b6 then
                return
            end
            b6 = false
            b0._popped = false
            b7 += 1
            cd, cf, cg = nil, false, false
            cl()
            bM:_closePopups()
            local cq, cr, cs, ct, cu = b8, cb, cc, b9, ca
            b8, cb, cc = nil, nil, nil
            cm(false)
            b0._popSpot = Vector2.new(cq.Position.X.Offset, cq.Position.Y.Offset)
            local cv = false
            local function cw()
                if cv then
                    return
                end
                cv = true
                if b0._settleDock == cw then
                    b0._settleDock = nil
                end
                if cs then
                    cs()
                end
                local cx = table.find(bM._popPanels, cq)
                if cx then
                    table.remove(bM._popPanels, cx)
                end
                if bP.Parent == cq then
                    if cr and cr.Parent and not b0._destroyed then
                        bP.Parent = cr.Parent
                        bP.LayoutOrder = cr.LayoutOrder
                    end
                end
                if cr then
                    cr:Destroy()
                end
                if bP.Parent ~= cq then
                    cq:Destroy()
                end
                ch = false
                bM._controlsDirty = true
            end
            b0._settleDock = cw
            local cx = not cp
                and cr
                and cr.Parent
                and bM.Root.Visible
                and bP.Visible
                and cr.AbsoluteSize.X > 0
                and a3(cr, bM.Body, cr.AbsolutePosition + cr.AbsoluteSize / 2)
            if not cx then
                cw()
                return
            end
            ch = true
            local cy = ci()
            local cz = bP.AbsoluteSize.Y / cy
            local cA = cr.AbsoluteSize.X / cy
            ah(cr, { Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, cz) }, 0.36, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint)
            local cB = cr:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("TextLabel")
            if cB then
                ah(cB, { TextTransparency = 1 }, 0.12)
            end
            local cC = cj(cr.AbsolutePosition)
            ah(
                cq,
                { Position = UDim2.fromOffset(cC.X + cA / 2, cC.Y), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(cA, cz) },
                0.36,
                Enum.EasingStyle.Quint
            )
            ah(ct, { Scale = 1 }, 0.2)
            ah(cu, { ImageTransparency = 1 }, 0.3)
            task.delay(0.37, cw)
        end
        bQ.InputBegan:Connect(function(cp)
            if not b6 or not aw(cp) or not b8 then
                return
            end
            cd = Vector2.new(cp.Position.X, cp.Position.Y)
            ce = Vector2.new(b8.Position.X.Offset, b8.Position.Y.Offset)
            cf = false
            cg = false
        end)
        bM:_listen("Changed", function(cp)
            if not cd or not b8 or not aA(cp) then
                return
            end
            local cq = Vector2.new(cp.Position.X, cp.Position.Y) - cd
            if not cf then
                if cq.Magnitude < (E and 8 or 5) then
                    return
                end
                cf, cg = true, true
                ch = false
                cl()
                bM:_closePopups()
                ah(b9, { Scale = 1.025 }, 0.18, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint)
                ah(ca, { ImageTransparency = 0.15 }, 0.18)
            end
            local cr = ck(ce + cq / ci(), b8.Size.X.Offset, b8.Size.Y.Offset)
            b8.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(cr.X, cr.Y)
        end, b0)
        bM:_listen("Ended", function(cp)
            if not cd or not aw(cp) then
                return
            end
            cd = nil
            if cf and b8 then
                cf = false
                ah(b9, { Scale = 1 }, 0.4, Enum.EasingStyle.Back)
                ah(ca, { ImageTransparency = 0.35 }, 0.3)
                b0._popSpot = Vector2.new(b8.Position.X.Offset, b8.Position.Y.Offset)
            end
        end, b0)
        if bV then
            bV.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
                ah(bV, { BackgroundTransparency = 0 }, 0.15)
                ah(bW, { ImageColor3 = z.Text }, 0.15)
            end)
            bV.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
                ah(bV, { BackgroundTransparency = 1 }, 0.25)
                ah(bW, { ImageColor3 = z.Muted }, 0.25)
            end)
            bV.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                if b6 then
                    co()
                else
                    cn()
                end
            end)
        end
        bQ.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            if cg then
                cg = false
                return
            end
            if b5() then
                b3(not b1)
            end
        end)
        function b0:PopOut()
            cn()
        end
        function b0:Dock()
            co()
        end
        function b0:IsPoppedOut()
            return b6
        end
        function b0:SetCollapsed(cp)
            b3(cp)
        end
        function b0:Collapse()
            b3(true)
        end
        function b0:Expand()
            b3(false)
        end
        function b0:IsCollapsed()
            return b1
        end
        function b0:SetTitle(cp)
            b0.Name = tostring(cp)
            bX.Text = b0.Name
        end
        function b0:SetIcon(cp)
            if gbIcon then
                aq(gbIcon, cp)
            end
        end
        do
            local gbBadge, gbBadgeText
            local gbReserve = bU and 66 or 40
            b0._setBadge = function(cp)
                if cp == nil or cp == false or tostring(cp) == "" then
                    if gbBadge then
                        gbBadge.Visible = false
                    end
                    bX.Size = UDim2.new(1, -(bS + gbReserve), 1, 0)
                    b0.Badge = nil
                    return
                end
                local badgeText = tostring(cp)
                if not gbBadge then
                    gbBadge = ai("Frame", {
                        Name = "Badge",
                        AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5),
                        Position = UDim2.new(1, bU and -62 or -38, 0.5, 0),
                        Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 18),
                        AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X,
                        BackgroundColor3 = z.Accent,
                        BackgroundTransparency = 0.86,
                        BorderSizePixel = 0,
                        ZIndex = 3,
                        Parent = bQ,
                    })
                    aj(gbBadge, UDim.new(1, 0))
                    ak(gbBadge, z.Accent, 0.72)
                    al(gbBadge, 7, 7, 0, 0)
                    gbBadgeText = am({
                        Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0),
                        AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X,
                        TextSize = 10,
                        FontFace = D.Bold,
                        TextColor3 = z.Accent,
                        TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.None,
                        TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center,
                        ZIndex = 3,
                        Parent = gbBadge,
                    })
                end
                gbBadgeText.Text = badgeText
                gbBadge.Visible = true
                b0.Badge = badgeText
                bX.Size = UDim2.new(1, -(bS + gbReserve + math.max(#badgeText * 6 + 14, 20) + 6), 1, 0)
            end
            if bK.Badge ~= nil then
                b0._setBadge(bK.Badge)
            end
        end
        b0._userVisible = bK.Visible ~= false

        end
        function b0:SetVisible(cp)
            cp = cp and true or false
            if cp == b0._userVisible then
                return
            end
            b0._userVisible = cp
            if not cp then
                for cq, cr in ipairs(b0._items) do
                    if cr._onHide then
                        cr._onHide()
                    end

                        cr:SetOpen(false)
                    end

            bM._controlsDirty = true
        end
        if not b0._userVisible then
            bP.Visible = false
        end

            for cp = #b0._items, 1, -1 do
                local cq = b0._items[cp]
                if type(cq.Destroy) == "function" then
                    cq:Destroy()

            if cq then

            bM._controlsDirty = true

        if bK.Collapsed then
            b3(true, true)
        end
        if bK.PoppedOut then
            task.defer(cn)
        end
