    function aS:ButtonRow(bL)
        local raw = type(bL) == "table" and (bL.Buttons or bL) or {}
        local compact = aM(self).Compact
        local h = E and 34 or 30
        local gap = (type(bL) == "table" and tonumber(bL.Gap)) or 6
        local holder = aO(self, "Frame", h + (compact and 4 or 14), {})
        local inset = compact and 14 or 7
        local area = ai("Frame", {
            Position = UDim2.fromOffset(inset, compact and 2 or 7),
            Size = UDim2.new(1, -inset * 2, 0, h),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            Parent = holder,
        })
        local items, names, total = {}, {}, 0
        for _, v in ipairs(raw) do
            if type(v) == "string" then
                v = { Name = v }
            end
            if type(v) == "table" then
                local w = math.max(tonumber(v.Weight) or 1, 0.1)
                table.insert(items, { opt = v, w = w })
                total += w
            end
        end
        local count = #items
        local api = { Buttons = {} }
        local used = 0
        for i, it in ipairs(items) do
            local opt = it.opt
            local name = tostring(opt.Name or opt.Title or "Button")
            table.insert(names, name)
            local btn = ai("TextButton", {
                Position = UDim2.new(used / total, (i - 1) * gap - used / total * (count - 1) * gap, 0, 0),
                Size = UDim2.new(it.w / total, -(count - 1) * gap * it.w / total, 1, 0),
                BackgroundColor3 = z.Surface3,
                BackgroundTransparency = 0.45,
                BorderSizePixel = 0,
                Text = "",
                AutoButtonColor = false,
                ClipsDescendants = true,
                Parent = area,
            })
            aj(btn, UDim.new(0, 6))
            local stroke = ak(btn)
            local grad = ai("UIGradient", {
                Rotation = 90,
                Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255), Color3.fromRGB(222, 222, 226)),
                Enabled = false,
                Parent = btn,
            })
            local body = k._chipContent(btn, self.Window, { Name = name, Icon = opt.Icon }, 13, 14)
            local fx = k._btnFx({
                kind = "chip",
                hit = btn,
                bg = btn,
                stroke = stroke,
                opts = opt,
                texts = { body.Title },
                icons = body.Icons,
                grad = grad,
                spinner = body.Spinner,
                onLoading = body.fit,
                scroller = function()
                    return btn:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("ScrollingFrame")
                end,
            })
            api.Buttons[i] = { Button = btn, Label = body.Title, Icon = body.Icons[1], Fx = fx }
            used += it.w
        end
        function api:SetText(i, text)
            local b = api.Buttons[i]
            if b then
                b.Label.Text = tostring(text)
            end
        end
        function api:SetIcon(i, icon)
            local b = api.Buttons[i]
            if b and b.Icon then
                aq(b.Icon, icon)
            end
        end
        function api:SetStyle(i, style)
            local b = api.Buttons[i]
            if b then
                b.Fx:SetStyle(style)
            end
        end
        function api:SetCallback(i, fn)
            local b = api.Buttons[i]
            if b then
                b.Fx:SetCallback(fn)
            end
        end
        function api:SetDisabled(i, v)
            if type(i) == "boolean" then
                for _, b in ipairs(api.Buttons) do
                    b.Fx:SetDisabled(i)
                end
                return
            end
            local b = api.Buttons[i]
            if b then
                b.Fx:SetDisabled(v)
            end
        end
        function api:IsDisabled(i)
            local b = api.Buttons[i]
            return b ~= nil and b.Fx:IsDisabled()
        end
        function api:SetLoading(i, v)
            if type(i) == "boolean" then
                for _, b in ipairs(api.Buttons) do
                    b.Fx:SetLoading(i)
                end
                return
            end
            local b = api.Buttons[i]
            if b then
                b.Fx:SetLoading(v)
            end
        end
        function api:IsLoading(i)
            local b = api.Buttons[i]
            return b ~= nil and b.Fx:IsLoading()
        end
        function api:Fire(i)
            local b = api.Buttons[i]
            if b then
                b.Fx:Fire()
            end
        end
        return m(self, {
            Name = table.concat(names, " "),
            Visible = not (type(bL) == "table" and bL.Visible == false),
            Tooltip = type(bL) == "table" and bL.Tooltip or nil,
        }, api, holder, "ButtonRow")
    end

    local function bL(bM, bN, bO, bP)
        local bQ = E and 34 or 30
        local bR = aO(bM, "Frame", bQ + 4, {})
        local bS = aM(bM).Compact and 14 or 7
        local bT
        local bU = bO
            and bF(
                bR,
                bO,
                {
                    AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0),
                    Position = UDim2.new(1, -bS, 0, 2),
                    Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, bQ),
                    AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X,
                },
                function()
                    aJ(bP, bT.Text)
                end
            )
        local bV = ai(
            "Frame",
            {
                Position = UDim2.fromOffset(bS, 2),
                Size = UDim2.new(1, -(bS * 2 + (bU and 70 or 0)), 0, bQ),
                BackgroundColor3 = z.Surface,
                BorderSizePixel = 0,
                Parent = bR,
            }
        )
        aj(bV, UDim.new(0, 6))
        local bW = ak(bV)
        bT = ai(
            "TextBox",
            {
                Position = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 0),
                Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 1, 0),
                BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                Text = "",
                PlaceholderText = bN,
                PlaceholderColor3 = z.Muted,
                TextColor3 = z.Text,
                TextSize = 13,
                FontFace = D.Regular,
                TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center,
                TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
                ClearTextOnFocus = false,
                Parent = bV,
            }
        )
        bT.Focused:Connect(function()
            ah(bW, { Color = z.StrokeHover }, 0.15)
        end)
        bT.FocusLost:Connect(function(bX)
            ah(bW, { Color = z.Stroke }, 0.2)
            if bX and bT.Text ~= "" then
                aJ(bP, bT.Text)
            end
        end)
        if bU then
            local function bX()
                local bY = bU.AbsoluteSize.X / bM.Window.Scale.Scale
                bV.Size = UDim2.new(1, -(bS * 2 + bY + 6), 0, bQ)
            end
            bU:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(bX)
            task.defer(bX)
        end
        return m(bM, { Name = bN }, {
            Get = function()
                return bT.Text
            end,
            Set = function(bX, bY)
                bT.Text = tostring(bY or "")
            end,
        }, bR, "ActionInput")
    end
    local function bM(bN)
        return (tostring(bN or ""):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$"))
    end
    local function bN(bO, bP, bQ, bR)
        if bO._groupbox then
            return bO
        end
        local bS = bO:Groupbox({ Name = bP.Name or bQ, Icon = bP.Icon or bR, Side = bP.Side })
        bS._manager = true
        return bS
    end
    function aS:ConfigManager(bO)
        bO = l(bO, { Title = "Name" })
        local bP = bN(self, bO, "Configs", "folder")
        local bQ = self.Window
        local bR = {}
        local bS, bT, bU
        if not a2._fsAvailable() then
            bP:Label("Executor has no file API, configs cannot be saved here")
        end
        local function bV(bW, bX, bY)
            bQ:Notify({ Title = bX, Content = bY, Type = bW and "Success" or "Error", Duration = 3 })
        end
        local function bW()
            bT:Set(("loaded: %s   |   autoload: %s"):format(bQ.LoadedConfig or "none", bQ:GetAutoload() or "none"))
        end
        local function bX()
            local bY = bS:Get()
            if not bY then
                bV(false, "No config selected", "Pick one from the list first")
            end
            return bY
        end
        local bY = bL(bP, bO.Placeholder or "config name", nil, function(bY)
            bR:Create(bY)
        end)
        local bZ = bQ:ListConfigs()
        local b_ = bQ.LoadedConfig or bQ:GetAutoload()
        bS =
            bP:Dropdown({ Stacked = true, Options = bZ, Default = table.find(bZ, b_) and b_ or nil, EmptyText = "--", NoneText = "--" })
        bP:ButtonRow({
            {
                Name = "Create",
                Callback = function()
                    bR:Create(bY:Get())
                end,
            },
            {
                Name = "Save",
                Callback = function()
                    bR:Save()
                end,
            },
        })
        bP:ButtonRow({
            {
                Name = "Load",
                Callback = function()
                    bR:Load()
                end,
            },
            {
                Name = "Delete",
                Style = "Danger",
                Callback = function()
                    bR:Delete()
                end,
            },
        })
        bP:ButtonRow({
            {
                Name = "Set autoload",
                Callback = function()
                    bR:SetAutoload()
                end,
            },
            {
                Name = "Clear autoload",
                Callback = function()
                    bR:ClearAutoload()
                end,
            },
        })
        bP:ButtonRow({
            {
                Name = "Rename",
                Callback = function()
                    bR:Rename(nil, bY:Get())
                end,
            },
            {
                Name = "Duplicate",
                Callback = function()
                    bR:Duplicate(nil, bY:Get())
                end,
            },
        })
        bP:ButtonRow({
            {
                Name = "Reset",
                Style = "Danger",
                Callback = function()
                    bR:Reset()
                end,
            },
        })
        bT = bP:Label("loaded: none   |   autoload: none")
        bU = bP:Dropdown({
            Name = "Autoload mode",
            Stacked = true,
            Options = { "All accounts", "This account" },
            Default = bQ:GetAutoloadMode() == "Account" and "This account" or "All accounts",
            AllowNone = false,
            Callback = function(b0)
                bR:SetAutoloadMode(b0 == "This account" and "Account" or "Global")
            end,
        })
        local autoSaveToggle = bP:Toggle({
            Name = "Auto-save",
            Default = bQ:GetAutoSave(),
            Callback = function(enabled)
                enabled = enabled == true
                if enabled == bQ:GetAutoSave() then
                    return
                end
                bQ:SetAutoSave(enabled)
                bQ:_writeConfigSettings({ AutoSave = enabled })
            end,
        })
        bP:Button({
            Name = "Refresh list",
            Callback = function()
                bR:Refresh()
            end,
        })

        bP:Button({
            Name = "Copy code",
            Callback = function()
                bR:Export()
            end,
        })
        local b0 = bL(bP, "paste a config code...", nil, function(b0)
            bR:Import(b0)
        end)
        bP:Button({
            Name = "Import code",
            Callback = function()
                bR:Import(b0:Get(), true)
            end,
        })
        function bR:Refresh()
            local b1 = bQ:ListConfigs()
            local b2 = bS:Get()
            bS:Refresh(b1, true, true)
            if b2 and not table.find(b1, b2) then
                bS:Set(bQ.LoadedConfig and table.find(b1, bQ.LoadedConfig) and bQ.LoadedConfig or nil, true)
            end
            bW()
        end
        local function b1(b2)
            bR:Refresh()
            bS:Set(b2, true)
        end
        function bR:Create(b2)
            b2 = bM(b2)
            if b2 == "" then
                bV(false, "Name the config", "Type a name before creating it")
                return
            end
            if not bi(b2) then
                bV(false, "Invalid name", 'Up to 64 characters, none of \\ / : * ? " < > |')
                return
            end
            if bQ:ConfigExists(b2) then
                bV(false, "Create failed", b2 .. " already exists. Select it and press Save to overwrite")
                return
            end
            local b3, b4 = bQ:SaveConfig(b2)
            if b3 then
                bQ.LoadedConfig = b2
                bY:Set("")
                b1(b2)
            end
            bV(b3, b3 and "Config created" or "Create failed", b3 and b2 or tostring(b4))
        end
        function bR:Save(b2)
            b2 = b2 or bS:Get()
            if not b2 then
                local b3 = bM(bY:Get())
                if b3 == "" then
                    bV(false, "No config selected", "Pick one from the list or type a name")
                    return
                end
                return bR:Create(b3)
            end
            local b3, b4 = bQ:SaveConfig(b2)
            if b3 then
                bQ.LoadedConfig = b2
                bW()
            end
            bV(b3, b3 and "Config saved" or "Save failed", b3 and b2 or tostring(b4))
        end
        function bR:Load(b2)
            b2 = b2 or bX()
            if not b2 then
                return
            end
            local b3, b4, b5 = bQ:LoadConfig(b2)
            bV(
                b3,
                b3 and "Config loaded" or "Load failed",
                b3 and (b5 and (b2 .. " (restored from backup)") or b2) or tostring(b4)
            )
        end
        function bR:Delete(b2)
            b2 = b2 or bX()
            if not b2 then
                return
            end
            bQ:Confirm({
                Title = "Delete config",
                Content = "Remove " .. b2 .. "? This cannot be undone.",
                Icon = "trash-2",
                ConfirmText = "Delete",
                Callback = function()
                    local b3, b4 = bQ:DeleteConfig(b2)
                    if b3 then
                        if bQ:GetAutoload("Account") == b2 then
                            bQ:SetAutoload(nil, "Account")
                        end
                        if bQ:GetAutoload("Global") == b2 then
                            bQ:SetAutoload(nil, "Global")
                        end
                        bS:Set(nil, true)
                    end
                    bR:Refresh()
                    bV(b3, b3 and "Config deleted" or "Delete failed", b3 and b2 or tostring(b4))
                end,
            })
        end
        function bR:Rename(b2, b3)
            b2 = b2 or bX()
            if not b2 then
                return
            end
            b3 = bM(b3)
            if b3 == "" then
                bV(false, "Name the config", "Type the new name in the name box")
                return
            end
            if not bi(b3) then
                bV(false, "Invalid name", 'Up to 64 characters, none of \\ / : * ? " < > |')
                return
            end
            local b4, b5 = bQ:RenameConfig(b2, b3)
            if b4 then
                bY:Set("")
                b1(b3)
            end
            bV(b4, b4 and "Config renamed" or "Rename failed", b4 and (b2 .. " -> " .. b3) or tostring(b5))
        end
        function bR:Duplicate(b2, b3)
            b2 = b2 or bX()
            if not b2 then
                return
            end
            b3 = bM(b3)
            if b3 == "" then
                b3 = b2 .. " copy"
                local copyIndex = 2
                while bQ:ConfigExists(b3) do
                    b3 = ("%s copy %d"):format(b2, copyIndex)
                    copyIndex += 1
                end
            end
            if not bi(b3) then
                bV(false, "Invalid name", 'Up to 64 characters, none of \\ / : * ? " < > |')
                return
            end
            local b4, b5 = bQ:DuplicateConfig(b2, b3)
            if b4 then
                bY:Set("")
                b1(b3)
            end
            bV(b4, b4 and "Config duplicated" or "Duplicate failed", b4 and (b2 .. " -> " .. b3) or tostring(b5))
        end
        function bR:Reset()
            bQ:Confirm({
                Title = "Reset settings",
                Content = [[Put every setting back to its default and delete this script's folder? Saved configs, themes and autoload are removed for good.]],
                Icon = "rotate-ccw",
                ConfirmText = "Reset",
                Callback = function()
                    bQ:ResetConfig()
                    local b2 = bQ:ClearWorkspace()
                    bQ:_applyDefaultTheme()
                    bS:Set(nil, true)
                    bR:Refresh()
                    bU:Set("All accounts", true)
                    if bQ:GetAutoSave() then
                        bQ:SetAutoSave(false)
                    end
                    if autoSaveToggle then
                        autoSaveToggle:Set(false, true)
                    end
                    bV(
                        b2,
                        b2 and "Settings reset" or "Reset incomplete",
                        b2 and "Everything is back to its default"
                            or "Some files in " .. bQ.ConfigFolder .. " could not be deleted"
                    )
                end,
            })
        end
        function bR:SetAutoload(b2)
            b2 = b2 or bX()
            if not b2 then
                return
            end
            local b3, b4 = bQ:SetAutoload(b2)
            bV(b3, b3 and "Autoload set" or "Autoload failed", b3 and b2 or tostring(b4))
        end
        function bR:ClearAutoload()
            local b2 = bQ:GetAutoload()
            if not b2 then
                bV(false, "No autoload", "Nothing is set to autoload")
                return
            end
            local b3, b4 = bQ:SetAutoload(nil)
            bV(b3, b3 and "Autoload cleared" or "Clear failed", b3 and b2 or tostring(b4))
        end
        function bR:ToggleAutoload(b2)
            b2 = b2 or bX()
            if not b2 then
                return
            end
            if bQ:GetAutoload() == b2 then
                bR:ClearAutoload()
            else
                bR:SetAutoload(b2)
            end
        end
        function bR:SetAutoloadMode(b2)
            local b3, b4 = bQ:SetAutoloadMode(b2)
            local b5 = b2 == "Account" and "This account" or "All accounts"
            if bU:Get() ~= b5 then
                bU:Set(b5, true)
            end
            bV(b3 ~= false, b3 ~= false and "Autoload mode" or "Mode change failed", b3 ~= false and b5 or tostring(b4))
        end
        function bR:Export(b2)
            local b3, b4 = bQ:ExportConfig(b2, true)
            if not b3 then
                bV(false, "Export failed", tostring(b4))
                return nil
            end
            if not a2._clipboardCanWrite() and a2._fsAvailable() then
                local exportName = b2 or bQ.LoadedConfig or bQ.ConfigName or "config"
                if not bi(exportName) then
                    exportName = "config"
                end
                local exportDir = bQ.ConfigFolder .. "/exports"
                a2._fsMakeFolder(exportDir)
                local exportPath = exportDir .. "/" .. exportName .. ".txt"
                local wrote, wroteErr = a2._fsWrite(exportPath, b3)
                bV(wrote, wrote and "Code saved to file" or "Export failed", wrote and exportPath or tostring(wroteErr))
                return b3
            end
            bQ:CopyToClipboard(b3, "Config code")
            return b3
        end
        function bR:Import(b2, useClipboard)
            b2 = bM(b2)
            if b2 == "" and useClipboard then
                b2 = bM(a2._clipboardRead() or "")
            end
            if b2 == "" then
                bV(false, "Nothing to import", "Paste a config code first")
                return
            end
            local b3, b4 = bQ:DecodeConfig(b2)
            if not b3 then
                bV(false, "Import failed", "Invalid config code")
                return
            end
            local b5 = bM(bY:Get())
            if b5 == "" then
                b5 = nil
                if bi(b4.Name) then
                    b5 = b4.Name
                    local b6 = 2
                    while bQ:ConfigExists(b5) do
                        b5 = ("%s (%d)"):format(b4.Name, b6)
                        b6 += 1
                    end
                end
            elseif not bi(b5) then
                bV(false, "Invalid name", 'Up to 64 characters, none of \\ / : * ? " < > |')
                return
            elseif bQ:ConfigExists(b5) then
                bV(false, "Import failed", b5 .. " already exists. Pick another name")
                return
            end
            local function b6()
                local b7, b8 = bQ:ImportConfig(b2, b5, true)
                if b7 then
                    b0:Set("")
                    if b5 then
                        bY:Set("")
                        b1(b5)
                    end
                end
                bV(
                    b7,
                    b7 and "Config imported" or "Import failed",
                    b7 and (b5 or "Applied to current settings") or tostring(b8)
                )
            end
            if b4.Folder and b4.Folder ~= bQ.ConfigFolder then
                bQ:Confirm({
                    Title = "Different script",
                    Content = ([[This config was made for %s. Import it anyway? Only matching settings are applied.]]):format(
                        b4.Folder
                    ),
                    Icon = "triangle-alert",
                    ConfirmText = "Import",
                    Callback = b6,
                })
                return
            end
            b6()
        end
        local b2 = bQ:OnConfigChanged(function()
            bR:Refresh()
            if bQ.LoadedConfig and bS:Get() == nil then
                bS:Set(bQ.LoadedConfig, true)
            end
        end)
        bT._listeners = bT._listeners or {}
        table.insert(bT._listeners, b2)
        bW()
        return bR
    end
    local bO = k._themeOrder
    local function bP()
        local bQ, bR = {}, {}
        for bS, bT in ipairs(bO) do
            if k.ThemePresets[bT] then
                table.insert(bQ, bT)
                bR[bT] = true
            end
        end
        local bS = {}
        for bT in pairs(k.ThemePresets) do
            if not bR[bT] then
                table.insert(bS, bT)
            end
        end
        table.sort(bS)
        for bT, bU in ipairs(bS) do
            table.insert(bQ, bU)
        end
        return bQ
    end
    -- =====================================================================================
    -- UI Settings (ThemeManager v3)
    --
    -- :ThemeManager(opts?) builds the whole "look & feel" panel for a window. On a Tab it creates cards
    -- (Themes / Colors / Interface / Window / Effects / Executor), inside a Groupbox it uses sections.
    --   Every part can be turned off with `false`: Weather, Dim, Transparent, DragStyle, IslandStyle,
    --   AdaptiveSize, Scale, Density, CornerRadius, Transition, Background, Share, Customize (Smart, Advanced,
    --   Colors), Notifications, Window, Executor, Flag.   Name / Icon / Side / Placeholder still work.
    --   Executor = the part that talks to the executor API: UI host (gethui / CoreGui / PlayerGui), layer
    --   (DisplayOrder), the detected capabilities and what is missing because of them.
    --
    -- Where things are saved:
    --   * look (colors, scale, density, radius, weather, background ...) -> the "__Theme" flag, so configs carry it
    --   * executor-local choices (UI host, layer, menu key, keep on screen, island lock, floating button,
    --     notification limit) -> <ConfigFolder>/configsettings.txt, never inside a config that can be shared
    --
    -- Returned manager: Refresh, Create, Save, Load, Delete, ToggleDefault, Export, Import, ResetInterface
    -- =====================================================================================
    function aS:ThemeManager(bQ)
        bQ = l(bQ, { Title = "Name" })
        local bS = self.Window
        local inGroup = self._groupbox and true or false
        local bT = {}
        local ui = {}
        local function on(name)
            return bQ[name] ~= false
        end

        -- executor facts (names, versions and the capability map come from the host layer) ---------------
        local exec = { Name = "Unknown", Version = nil, Features = {} }
        do
            local okExec, found = pcall(function()
                return k:GetExecutor()
            end)
            if okExec and type(found) == "table" then
                exec.Name = tostring(found.Name or exec.Name)
                exec.Version = found.Version
                exec.Features = type(found.Features) == "table" and found.Features or {}
            end
        end
        local hasFiles = a2._fsAvailable()
        local canCopy = a2._clipboardCanWrite()
        local canBackground = hasFiles and typeof(getcustomasset) == "function"

        -- executor-local preferences: written once the user stops changing things --------------------
        local prefs = {}
        do
            local okRead, stored = pcall(function()
                return bS:_readConfigSettings().UI
            end)
            if okRead and type(stored) == "table" then
                prefs = stored
            end
        end
        local flushing = false
        local function writePrefs()
            flushing = false
            if bS._destroyed then
                return
            end
            pcall(function()
                bS:_writeConfigSettings({ UI = prefs })
            end)
        end
        local function pref(key, value)
            prefs[key] = value
            if not flushing then
                flushing = true
                task.delay(0.4, writePrefs)
            end
        end

        local function say(kind, title, body)
            local label = "Error"
            if kind == true then
                label = "Success"
            elseif kind == "warn" then
                label = "Warning"
            elseif kind == "info" then
                label = "Info"
            end
            bS:Notify({ Title = title, Content = body, Type = label, Duration = 3 })
        end

        -- layout: cards on a Tab, sections inside a Groupbox ------------------------------------------
        local boxCount = 0
        local function box(title, icon, side, hint)
            boxCount = boxCount + 1
            if inGroup then
                if boxCount > 1 then
                    self:Section({ Name = title, Icon = icon, Desc = hint })
                end
                return self
            end
            local card = self:Groupbox({ Name = title, Icon = icon, Side = bQ.Side or side })
            card._manager = true
            return card
        end
        local function sub(container, title, icon)
            container:Section({ Name = title, Icon = icon })
        end

        ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
        -- Themes
        ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
        local themeBox = box(bQ.Name or "Themes", bQ.Icon or "palette", "Left")

        local function updateDefault()
            local current = bS:GetDefaultTheme()
            ui.defaultLabel:Set("Default theme: " .. (current or "none"))
            local picked = ui.saved:Get() or ui.preset:Get()
            ui.manageRow:SetText(2, (picked and picked == current) and "Clear Default" or "Set Default")
        end
        local function needTheme()
            local picked = ui.saved:Get()
            if not picked then
                say(false, "No theme selected", "Pick one from the list first")
            end
            return picked
        end

        local presetHints = {}
        for _, name in ipairs(bP()) do
            local preset = k.ThemePresets[name]
            if type(preset) == "table" and preset.Background then
                local okLight, light = pcall(k._ThemeKit.isLight, preset.Background)
                if okLight then
                    presetHints[name] = light and "Light" or "Dark"
                end
            end
        end
        local function currentPreset()
            return k.ThemePresets[k.ThemeName or ""] and k.ThemeName or nil
        end
        ui.preset = themeBox:Dropdown({
            Name = "Preset",
            Desc = "Built-in color schemes",
            Options = bP(),
            Hints = presetHints,
            Default = currentPreset(),
            NoneText = "custom",
            AllowNone = false,
            Callback = function(name)
                if name then
                    k:SetTheme(name)
                    ui.saved:Set(nil, true)
                    updateDefault()
                end
            end,
        })
        local function picked(name)
            if name then
                ui.preset:Set(name, true)
                ui.saved:Set(nil, true)
                updateDefault()
            end
        end
        themeBox:ButtonRow({
            {
                Name = "Previous",
                Icon = "chevron-left",
                Callback = function()
                    picked(k:CycleTheme(-1))
                end,
            },
            {
                Name = "Next",
                Icon = "chevron-right",
                Callback = function()
                    picked(k:CycleTheme(1))
                end,
            },
        })
        themeBox:ButtonRow({
            {
                Name = "Random",
                Icon = "shuffle",
                Callback = function()
                    picked(k:RandomTheme())
                end,
            },
            {
                Name = "Reset",
                Icon = "rotate-ccw",
                Callback = function()
                    local target = currentPreset() or "Noir"
                    k:SetTheme(target)
                    picked(target)
                end,
            },
        })

        sub(themeBox, "My themes", "folder")
        if not hasFiles then
            themeBox:Paragraph({
                Title = "Themes can't be saved",
                Content = "This executor has no file API (writefile / readfile), so custom themes only live until you leave the game.",
                Icon = "info",
                Color = "Warning",
            })
        end
        ui.nameInput = bL(themeBox, bQ.Placeholder or "theme name", "Create", function(text)
            bT:Create(text)
        end)
        ui.saved = themeBox:Dropdown({
            Name = "Theme",
            Options = bS:ListThemes(),
            Default = (function()
                local default = bS:GetDefaultTheme()
                return default and not k.ThemePresets[default] and default or nil
            end)(),
            EmptyText = "no themes",
            NoneText = "select",
            Callback = function()
                updateDefault()
            end,
        })
        ui.saveRow = themeBox:ButtonRow({
            {
                Name = "Save",
                Icon = "save",
                Callback = function()
                    bT:Save()
                end,
            },
            {
                Name = "Load",
                Icon = "download",
                Callback = function()
                    bT:Load()
                end,
            },
        })
        ui.manageRow = themeBox:ButtonRow({
            {
                Name = "Delete",
                Icon = "trash-2",
                Style = "Danger",
                Callback = function()
                    bT:Delete()
                end,
            },
            {
                Name = "Set Default",
                Icon = "star",
                Callback = function()
                    bT:ToggleDefault()
                end,
            },
        })
        if not hasFiles then
            ui.saveRow:SetDisabled(true)
            ui.manageRow:SetDisabled(true)
        end
        ui.defaultLabel = themeBox:Label("Default theme: none")

        local codeInput
        if on("Share") then
            sub(themeBox, "Share", "share-2")
            themeBox:ButtonRow({
                {
                    Name = "Copy Code",
                    Icon = "copy",
                    Callback = function()
                        bT:Export()
                    end,
                },
                {
                    Name = "Paste Code",
                    Icon = "clipboard-paste",
                    Callback = function()
                        bT:Import(nil, true)
                    end,
                },
            })
            codeInput = bL(themeBox, "paste theme code", "Import", function(text)
                bT:Import(text)
            end)
        end

        ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
        -- Colors
        ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
        local smartOn = bQ.Smart ~= false
        local pickers, advancedPickers = {}, {}
        if on("Customize") then
            local colorBox = box("Colors", "paintbrush", "Left", "Accent, surfaces and text")
            if bQ.Smart ~= false then
                colorBox:Toggle({
                    Name = "Smart Colors",
                    Default = true,
                    Tooltip = "Background and Accent also retune the surfaces, borders, text and on-accent color",
                    Callback = function(enabled)
                        smartOn = enabled == true
                    end,
                })
            end
            local function addPicker(token, label, hidden)
                local pending, busy = nil, false
                local picker
                picker = colorBox:ColorPicker({
                    Name = label,
                    Default = k._themeClean[token] or z[token],
                    Visible = not hidden,
                    Callback = function(color)
                        pending = color
                        if busy then
                            return
                        end
                        busy = true
                        task.delay(0.08, function()
                            busy = false
                            local update = smartOn and k._ThemeKit.smart(token, pending, k:GetTheme()) or { [token] = pending }
                            k:SetTheme(update, true, { Exact = not smartOn })
                            ui.preset:Set(nil, true)
                        end)
                    end,
                })
                pickers[token] = picker
                if hidden then
                    table.insert(advancedPickers, picker)
                end
                return picker
            end
            local list = bQ.Colors
                or {
                    { "Accent", "Accent" },
                    { "Background", "Background" },
                    { "Surface2", "Surface" },
                    { "Text", "Text" },
                    { "Muted", "Muted text" },
                }
            for _, entry in ipairs(list) do
                addPicker(entry[1], entry[2] or entry[1], false)
            end
            if bQ.Advanced ~= false and not bQ.Colors then
                colorBox:Toggle({
                    Name = "Advanced Colors",
                    Default = false,
                    Callback = function(shown)
                        for _, picker in ipairs(advancedPickers) do
                            picker:SetVisible(shown == true)
                        end
                    end,
                })
                for _, entry in ipairs({
                    { "Surface", "Surface low" },
                    { "Surface3", "Surface high" },
                    { "Stroke", "Border" },
                    { "StrokeHover", "Border hover" },
                    { "AccentDark", "On accent" },
                    { "Warning", "Warning" },
                    { "Success", "Success" },
                    { "Error", "Error" },
                }) do
                    addPicker(entry[1], entry[2], true)
                end
            end
            local themeConn = k:OnThemeChanged(function()
                local current = k._themeClean
                for token, picker in pairs(pickers) do
                    local value = current[token]
                    if value and picker.Value ~= value then
                        picker:Set(value, true)
                    end
                end
            end)
            if themeConn then
                table.insert(bS._connections, themeConn)
            end
        end

        ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
        -- Interface (everything that changes how big / dense / round the window is)
        ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
        local wantInterface = on("Scale") or on("AdaptiveSize") or on("Density") or on("CornerRadius")
            or on("Transparent") or on("Transition") or on("Notifications")
        local faceBox
        if wantInterface then
            faceBox = box("Interface", "sliders-horizontal", "Right", "Size, density and shape")
        end
        if faceBox and on("Scale") then
            ui.scale = faceBox:Slider({
                Name = "UI Scale",
                Desc = "Resizes the whole window",
                Min = 60,
                Max = 150,
                Increment = 5,
                Default = math.floor(bS:GetUIScale() * 100 + 0.5),
                Suffix = "%",
                Callback = function(value)
                    if not (ui.scale and ui.scale.Dragging) then
                        bS:SetUIScale(value / 100)
                    end
                end,
                OnRelease = function(value)
                    bS:SetUIScale(value / 100)
                end,
            })
        end
        if faceBox and on("AdaptiveSize") then
            ui.adaptive = faceBox:Toggle({
                Name = "Adaptive Size",
                Desc = "Fit the window to the screen automatically",
                Default = bS:GetAdaptiveSize(),
                Callback = function(value)
                    bS:SetAdaptiveSize(value)
                end,
            })
        end
        if faceBox and on("Density") then
            ui.density = faceBox:Dropdown({
                Name = "Density",
                Desc = "Spacing between controls",
                Options = { "Compact", "Default", "Comfortable" },
                Default = k.Density,
                AllowNone = false,
                Callback = function(value)
                    if value then
                        k:SetDensity(value)
                    end
                end,
            })
        end
        if faceBox and on("CornerRadius") then
            ui.radius = faceBox:Slider({
                Name = "Corner Radius",
                Min = 0,
                Max = 20,
                Increment = 1,
                Default = k:GetCornerRadius(),
                Suffix = "px",
                Callback = function(value)
                    k:SetCornerRadius(value)
                end,
            })
        end
        if faceBox and on("Transparent") then
            ui.transparent = faceBox:Toggle({
                Name = "Transparent",
                Desc = "See-through window body",
                Default = bS.Transparent == true,
                Callback = function(value)
                    bS:SetTransparent(value)
                end,
            })
        end
        if faceBox and on("Transition") then
            ui.fade = faceBox:Slider({
                Name = "Theme Fade",
                Desc = "How long a theme change takes",
                Min = 0,
                Max = 1000,
                Increment = 50,
                Default = math.floor(k:GetThemeTransition() * 1000 + 0.5),
                Suffix = "ms",
                Callback = function(value)
                    k:SetThemeTransition(value / 1000)
                end,
            })
        end
        if faceBox and on("Notifications") then
            ui.notifyMax = faceBox:Stepper({
                Name = "Max Notifications",
                Desc = "Toasts on screen at the same time",
                Min = 1,
                Max = 8,
                Step = 1,
                Default = math.clamp(math.floor(tonumber(bS.MaxNotifications) or 4), 1, 8),
                Callback = function(value)
                    value = math.clamp(math.floor(tonumber(value) or 4), 1, 8)
                    bS.MaxNotifications = value
                    pref("MaxNotifications", value)
                end,
            })
        end

        ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
        -- Window (behaviour: keys, dragging, island, floating button)
        ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
        local showDrag = bQ.DragSkeleton ~= false and bQ.DragStyle ~= false
        local showIsland = on("IslandStyle")
        local showButton = bS.ToggleButton ~= nil
        local wantWindow = on("Window")
        local winBox
        if wantWindow then
            winBox = box("Window", "app-window", "Right", "Keys, dragging and island")
            if not E then
                ui.menuKey = winBox:Keybind({
                    Name = "Menu Key",
                    Desc = "Shows or hides the window",
                    Default = typeof(bS.Keybind) == "EnumItem" and bS.Keybind or nil,
                    Modes = false,
                    AllowMouse = false,
                    AllowClear = false,
                    Blacklist = { Enum.KeyCode.Escape, Enum.KeyCode.Return, Enum.KeyCode.Backspace },
                    OnChanged = function(key)
                        if typeof(key) == "EnumItem" and key.EnumType == Enum.KeyCode then
                            bS:SetKeybind(key)
                            pref("MenuKey", key.Name)
                        end
                    end,
                })
            end
            ui.keepOnScreen = winBox:Toggle({
                Name = "Keep On Screen",
                Desc = "Stops the window being dragged out of view",
                Default = bS.KeepOnScreen ~= false,
                Callback = function(value)
                    bS:SetKeepOnScreen(value)
                    pref("KeepOnScreen", value == true)
                end,
            })
            if showDrag then
                ui.dragStyle = winBox:Dropdown({
                    Name = "Drag Style",
                    Desc = "What you see while moving the window",
                    Options = k.DragStyles,
                    Default = bS.DragStyle,
                    AllowNone = false,
                    Callback = function(value)
                        if value then
                            bS:SetDragStyle(value)
                        end
                    end,
                })
            end
            if showIsland then
                ui.islandStyle = winBox:Dropdown({
                    Name = "Dynamic Island",
                    Desc = "The pill shown while the window is minimized",
                    Options = k.IslandStyles,
                    Default = bS.IslandStyle,
                    AllowNone = false,
                    Callback = function(value)
                        if value then
                            bS:SetIslandStyle(value)
                        end
                    end,
                })
                ui.islandDrag = winBox:Toggle({
                    Name = "Draggable Island",
                    Desc = "Move the island anywhere on screen",
                    Default = bS._islandLocked ~= true,
                    Callback = function(value)
                        bS:SetIslandDraggable(value)
                        pref("IslandDraggable", value == true)
                    end,
                })
                winBox:ButtonRow({ {
                    Name = "Reset Island Position",
                    Icon = "move",
                    Callback = function()
                        bS:ResetIslandPosition()
                        say(true, "Island reset", "Back to the top center")
                    end,
                } })
            end
            if showButton then
                ui.floatButton = winBox:Toggle({
                    Name = "Floating Button",
                    Desc = "Round button that opens and closes the window",
                    Default = bS._toggleEnabled ~= false,
                    Callback = function(value)
                        bS:SetToggleButton(value)
                        pref("ToggleButton", value == true)
                    end,
                })
                ui.floatPlatform = winBox:Dropdown({
                    Name = "Button Shows On",
                    Options = { "Touch only", "Everywhere" },
                    Default = bS._togglePlatform == "Both" and "Everywhere" or "Touch only",
                    AllowNone = false,
                    Callback = function(value)
                        if value then
                            local mode = value == "Everywhere" and "Both" or "Mobile"
                            bS:SetToggleButtonPlatform(mode)
                            pref("TogglePlatform", mode)
                        end
                    end,
                })
            end
        end

        ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
        -- Reset
        ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
        function bT:ResetInterface()
            bS:SetUIScale(1)
            bS:SetAdaptiveSize(true)
            k:SetDensity("Default")
            k:SetCornerRadius(10)
            k:SetThemeTransition(0.3)
            bS:SetTransparent(false)
            bS:SetKeepOnScreen(true)
            bS:SetDragStyle("Outline")
            bS:SetIslandStyle("Show on Hover")
            bS:SetIslandDraggable(true)
            bS.MaxNotifications = 4
            if showButton then
                bS:SetToggleButton(true)
                bS:SetToggleButtonPlatform("Mobile")
            end
            if ui.scale then
                ui.scale:Set(100, true)
            end
            if ui.adaptive then
                ui.adaptive:Set(true, true)
            end
            if ui.density then
                ui.density:Set("Default", true)
            end
            if ui.radius then
                ui.radius:Set(10, true)
            end
            if ui.fade then
                ui.fade:Set(300, true)
            end
            if ui.transparent then
                ui.transparent:Set(false, true)
            end
            if ui.notifyMax then
                ui.notifyMax:Set(4, true)
            end
            if ui.keepOnScreen then
                ui.keepOnScreen:Set(true, true)
            end
            if ui.dragStyle then
                ui.dragStyle:Set("Outline", true)
            end
            if ui.islandStyle then
                ui.islandStyle:Set("Show on Hover", true)
            end
            if ui.islandDrag then
                ui.islandDrag:Set(true, true)
            end
            if ui.floatButton then
                ui.floatButton:Set(true, true)
            end
            if ui.floatPlatform then
                ui.floatPlatform:Set("Touch only", true)
            end
            for _, key in ipairs({ "KeepOnScreen", "IslandDraggable", "MaxNotifications", "ToggleButton", "TogglePlatform" }) do
                prefs[key] = nil
            end
            writePrefs()
            say(true, "Interface reset", "Scale, density, shape and window behavior are back to default")
        end
        if faceBox or winBox then
            local resetHolder = winBox or faceBox
            resetHolder:ButtonRow({ {
                Name = "Reset Interface",
                Icon = "rotate-ccw",
                Style = "Danger",
                Callback = function()
                    bS:Confirm({
                        Title = "Reset interface",
                        Content = "Put scale, density, corner radius and window behavior back to their defaults? Theme colors are not changed.",
                        Icon = "rotate-ccw",
                        ConfirmText = "Reset",
                        Callback = function()
                            bT:ResetInterface()
                        end,
                    })
                end,
            } })
        end

        ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
        -- Effects (weather, dim, background)
        ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
        local hasBackdrop = bS._backdrop and true or false
        local showWeather = hasBackdrop and on("Weather")
        local showDim = hasBackdrop and on("Dim")
        local showBackground = on("Background")
        local weatherNames = {
            None = "None",
            Snow = "Snow",
            Rain = "Rain",
            Ember = "Hell Fire",
            Sakura = "Sakura",
            Fireflies = "Fireflies",
            Matrix = "Matrix",
        }
        local fxBox
        if showWeather or showDim or showBackground then
            fxBox = box("Effects", "sparkles", "Left", "Weather and background")
        end
        local function syncWeather()
            local off = bS.Weather == nil or bS.Weather == "None"
            if ui.weatherMode then
                ui.weatherMode:SetDisabled(off)
            end
            if ui.weatherDensity then
                ui.weatherDensity:SetDisabled(off)
            end
            if ui.weatherSpeed then
                ui.weatherSpeed:SetDisabled(off)
            end
        end
        if showWeather then
            ui.weather = fxBox:Dropdown({
                Name = "Weather",
                Options = { "Snow", "Rain", "Hell Fire", "Sakura", "Fireflies", "Matrix", "None" },
                Icons = {
                    Snow = "snowflake",
                    Rain = "cloud-rain",
                    ["Hell Fire"] = "flame",
                    Sakura = "flower",
                    Fireflies = "sparkles",
                    Matrix = "binary",
                    None = "ban",
                },
                Default = weatherNames[bS.Weather] or "None",
                AllowNone = false,
                Callback = function(value)
                    if value then
                        bS:SetWeather(value)
                        syncWeather()
                    end
                end,
            })
            ui.weatherMode = fxBox:Dropdown({
                Name = "Weather Mode",
                Desc = "Screen = over the game, UI = inside the window",
                Options = { "Screen", "UI" },
                Default = bS.WeatherMode,
                AllowNone = false,
                Callback = function(value)
                    if value then
                        bS:SetWeatherMode(value)
                    end
                end,
            })
            ui.weatherDensity = fxBox:Slider({
                Name = "Weather Density",
                Min = 0,
                Max = 300,
                Increment = 10,
                Default = math.floor((tonumber(bS._weatherDensity) or 1) * 100 + 0.5),
                Suffix = "%",
                Callback = function(value)
                    bS:SetWeatherDensity(value / 100)
                end,
            })
            ui.weatherSpeed = fxBox:Slider({
                Name = "Weather Speed",
                Min = 10,
                Max = 300,
                Increment = 10,
                Default = math.floor((tonumber(bS._weatherSpeed) or 1) * 100 + 0.5),
                Suffix = "%",
                Callback = function(value)
                    bS:SetWeatherSpeed(value / 100)
                end,
            })
            syncWeather()
        end
        if showDim then
            ui.dim = fxBox:Toggle({
                Name = "Dim",
                Desc = "Darken the game behind the window",
                Default = bS._backdropDim,
                Callback = function(value)
                    bS:SetDim(value)
                end,
            })
            ui.tint = fxBox:Slider({
                Name = "Backdrop Tint",
                Min = 0,
                Max = 100,
                Increment = 5,
                Default = math.floor((tonumber(bS._backdropTint) or 0.45) * 100 + 0.5),
                Suffix = "%",
                Callback = function(value)
                    bS:SetBackdropTint(value / 100)
                end,
            })
        end
        local function bgOption(name)
            if name == nil or name == "" then
                return "None"
            end
            return table.find(bS:ListBackgrounds(), name) and name or nil
        end
        local function backgroundList()
            local list = bS:ListBackgrounds()
            table.insert(list, 1, "None")
            return list
        end
        local function applyBackground(name, fromList)
            task.spawn(function()
                local okSet, why = bS:SetBackground(name)
                if okSet and not fromList then
                    ui.background:Set(bgOption(bS.Background), true)
                elseif not okSet and why ~= "replaced by a newer background" then
                    say(false, "Background failed", tostring(why))
                end
            end)
        end
        if showBackground then
            if showWeather or showDim then
                sub(fxBox, "Background", "image")
            end
            if not canBackground then
                fxBox:Paragraph({
                    Title = "Limited backgrounds",
                    Content = "Links and files need writefile and getcustomasset, which this executor lacks. Built-in backgrounds and asset ids still work.",
                    Icon = "info",
                    Color = "Warning",
                })
            end
            ui.background = fxBox:Dropdown({
                Name = "Background",
                Options = backgroundList(),
                Default = bgOption(bS.Background),
                NoneText = "custom",
                AllowNone = false,
                Callback = function(value)
                    if value then
                        applyBackground(value, true)
                    end
                end,
            })
            ui.backgroundInput = bL(fxBox, canBackground and "asset id, link or file name" or "asset id", "Set", function(text)
                text = bM(text)
                if text == "" then
                    say(false, "No image", "Paste an image id or link first")
                    return
                end
                applyBackground(text)
            end)
            ui.backgroundOpacity = fxBox:Slider({
                Name = "Background Opacity",
                Min = 0,
                Max = 100,
                Default = math.floor((1 - bS.BackgroundTransparency) * 100 + 0.5),
                Suffix = "%",
                Callback = function(value)
                    bS:SetBackgroundTransparency(1 - value / 100)
                end,
            })
        end

        ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
        -- Executor (UI host, layer, capabilities)
        ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
        local function hostText()
            local info = bS:GetHost()
            if type(info) ~= "table" then
                return "unknown"
            end
            local names = { Hidden = "Hidden (gethui)", CoreGui = "CoreGui", PlayerGui = "PlayerGui", Custom = "Custom parent" }
            local text = names[info.Mode] or tostring(info.Mode)
            if info.Protected then
                text = text .. " \u{b7} protected"
            end
            return text
        end
        if on("Executor") then
            local exBox = box("Executor", "terminal", "Right", "Host and capabilities")
            ui.executorStatus = exBox:Status({
                Name = "Executor",
                Value = exec.Name .. (exec.Version and (" " .. tostring(exec.Version)) or ""),
                Icon = "terminal",
            })
            ui.hostStatus = exBox:Status({ Name = "UI host", Value = hostText(), Icon = "monitor" })
            local features = exec.Features
            ui.host = exBox:Dropdown({
                Name = "UI Host",
                Desc = "Where the window lives. Hidden keeps it away from the game.",
                Options = { "Auto", "Hidden", "CoreGui", "PlayerGui" },
                Icons = { Auto = "zap", Hidden = "eye-off", CoreGui = "shield", PlayerGui = "user" },
                Hints = {
                    Auto = "best available",
                    Hidden = features.Hidden and "gethui" or "no gethui",
                    CoreGui = "elevated",
                    PlayerGui = "game can see it",
                },
                DisabledOptions = features.Hidden and {} or { "Hidden" },
                Default = k:GetHostMode(),
                AllowNone = false,
                Callback = function(mode)
                    if not mode then
                        return
                    end
                    k:SetHost(mode)
                    pref("Host", mode)
                    ui.hostStatus:Set(hostText())
                    local info = bS:GetHost()
                    if mode ~= "Auto" and type(info) == "table" and info.Mode ~= mode then
                        say("warn", mode .. " is not usable here", "Using " .. tostring(info.Mode) .. " instead")
                    end
                end,
            })
            ui.layer = exBox:Stepper({
                Name = "Layer",
                Desc = "DisplayOrder: higher draws above other executor UIs",
                Min = 0,
                Max = 9999,
                Step = 1,
                Default = math.clamp(math.floor(tonumber(bS:GetDisplayOrder()) or 999), 0, 9999),
                Callback = function(value)
                    value = math.floor(tonumber(value) or 999)
                    bS:SetDisplayOrder(value)
                    pref("DisplayOrder", value)
                end,
            })

            local checks = {
                { features.Hidden, "No gethui: the window can't be hidden from the game" },
                { features.Protect or features.Hidden, "No protect_gui or gethui: the window is easier to detect" },
                { hasFiles, "No file API: themes, configs and these preferences can't be saved" },
                { canCopy, "No clipboard: theme codes are shown in the box instead of copied" },
                { canBackground, "No getcustomasset: link and file backgrounds are off" },
            }
            local issues = {}
            for _, check in ipairs(checks) do
                if not check[1] then
                    table.insert(issues, "\u{2022} " .. check[2])
                end
            end
            local keys = { "Hidden", "Protect", "Files", "Folders", "Clipboard", "Http", "CustomAsset", "Identity" }
            local supported = 0
            for _, key in ipairs(keys) do
                if features[key] then
                    supported = supported + 1
                end
            end
            local tone = "Error"
            if supported == #keys then
                tone = "Success"
            elseif supported >= 5 then
                tone = "Warning"
            end
            ui.featureStatus = exBox:Status({
                Name = "Features",
                Value = supported .. " / " .. #keys,
                Style = "Badge",
                Tone = tone,
                Icon = "cpu",
            })
            if #issues > 0 then
                exBox:Paragraph({
                    Title = "Limited by this executor",
                    Content = table.concat(issues, "\n"),
                    Icon = "info",
                    Color = "Warning",
                })
            end
        end

        ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
        -- Theme library actions
        ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
        function bT:Refresh()
            ui.saved:Refresh(bS:ListThemes(), true)
            if ui.background then
                ui.background:Refresh(backgroundList(), true, true)
            end
            updateDefault()
        end
        function bT:Create(name)
            name = bM(name)
            if name == "" then
                say(false, "Name the theme", "Type a name before creating it")
                return
            end
            if k.ThemePresets[name] then
                say(false, "Name taken", name .. " is a built-in preset")
                return
            end
            local okSave, why = bS:SaveTheme(name)
            bT:Refresh()
            if okSave then
                ui.saved:Set(name, true)
                ui.nameInput:Set("")
                updateDefault()
            end
            say(okSave, okSave and "Theme created" or "Create failed", okSave and name or tostring(why))
        end
        function bT:Save(name)
            name = name or needTheme()
            if not name then
                return
            end
            local okSave, why = bS:SaveTheme(name)
            say(okSave, okSave and "Theme saved" or "Save failed", okSave and name or tostring(why))
        end
        function bT:Load(name)
            name = name or needTheme()
            if not name then
                return
            end
            local okLoad, why = bS:LoadTheme(name)
            if okLoad then
                ui.preset:Set(nil, true)
            end
            say(okLoad ~= false, okLoad and "Theme loaded" or "Load failed", okLoad and name or tostring(why))
        end
        function bT:Delete(name)
            name = name or needTheme()
            if not name then
                return
            end
            bS:Confirm({
                Title = "Delete theme",
                Content = "Remove " .. name .. "? This cannot be undone.",
                Icon = "trash-2",
                ConfirmText = "Delete",
                Callback = function()
                    local okDelete, why = bS:DeleteTheme(name)
                    bT:Refresh()
                    say(okDelete, okDelete and "Theme deleted" or "Delete failed", okDelete and name or tostring(why))
                end,
            })
        end
        function bT:ToggleDefault(name)
            name = name or ui.saved:Get() or ui.preset:Get()
            if not name then
                say(false, "Nothing selected", "Pick a theme or a preset first")
                return
            end
            local wasDefault = bS:GetDefaultTheme() == name
            local okSet, why = bS:SetDefaultTheme(not wasDefault and name or nil)
            updateDefault()
            say(okSet ~= false, wasDefault and "Default cleared" or "Default theme set", okSet ~= false and name or tostring(why))
        end
        function bT:Export()
            local code = bS:ExportTheme()
            if not code then
                say(false, "Export failed", "Could not encode the theme")
                return nil
            end
            if not canCopy then
                -- no setclipboard: put the code where the user can select and copy it by hand
                if codeInput then
                    codeInput:Set(code)
                end
                say("warn", "Clipboard unavailable", "The code is in the box below, copy it from there")
                return code
            end
            bS:CopyToClipboard(code, "Theme code")
            return code
        end
        function bT:Import(code, useClipboard)
            code = bM(code)
            if code == "" and useClipboard then
                code = bM(a2._clipboardRead() or "")
            end
            if code == "" then
                say(false, "Nothing to import", "Paste a theme code first")
                return
            end
            local okImport, info = bS:ImportTheme(code)
            if okImport then
                ui.preset:Set(currentPreset(), true)
                ui.saved:Set(nil, true)
                if codeInput then
                    codeInput:Set("")
                end
                updateDefault()
            end
            say(okImport, okImport and "Theme imported" or "Import failed", okImport and tostring(info or "custom") or tostring(info))
        end

        ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
        -- Flag: everything that is "look" is saved with configs
        ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
        if bQ.Flag ~= false then
            local flagName = type(bQ.Flag) == "string" and bQ.Flag or "__Theme"
            local flag = { _type = "Theme", _searchName = "Theme", _searchKey = "theme", _listeners = {} }
            function flag:Get()
                local colors = {}
                for _, token in ipairs(n) do
                    colors[token] = bc(k._themeClean[token] or z[token])
                end
                local out = { Name = ui.preset:Get() or ui.saved:Get(), Colors = colors }
                if ui.weather then
                    out.Weather = bS.Weather
                    out.WeatherMode = bS.WeatherMode
                    out.WeatherDensity = bS._weatherDensity
                    out.WeatherSpeed = bS._weatherSpeed
                end
                if ui.dim then
                    out.Dim = bS._backdropDim == true
                    out.BackdropTint = bS._backdropTint
                end
                if ui.transparent then
                    out.Transparent = bS.Transparent == true
                end
                if ui.dragStyle then
                    out.DragStyle = bS.DragStyle
                end
                if ui.islandStyle then
                    out.IslandStyle = bS.IslandStyle
                end
                if ui.radius then
                    out.CornerRadius = k:GetCornerRadius()
                end
                if ui.scale then
                    out.UIScale = bS:GetUIScale()
                end
                if ui.adaptive then
                    out.AdaptiveSize = bS:GetAdaptiveSize()
                end
                if ui.density then
                    out.Density = k.Density
                end
                if ui.fade then
                    out.Transition = k:GetThemeTransition()
                end
                if ui.background then
                    out.Background = bS.Background or ""
                    out.BackgroundTransparency = bS.BackgroundTransparency
                end
                return out
            end
            function flag:Set(data)
                if type(data) ~= "table" then
                    return
                end
                if type(data.Colors) == "table" then
                    k:SetTheme(data.Colors)
                end
                local name = type(data.Name) == "string" and data.Name or nil
                if name and k.ThemePresets[name] then
                    k.ThemeName = name
                    ui.preset:Set(name, true)
                    ui.saved:Set(nil, true)
                else
                    if name then
                        k.ThemeName = name
                    end
                    ui.preset:Set(nil, true)
                    ui.saved:Set(name and table.find(bS:ListThemes(), name) and name or nil, true)
                end
                if ui.weather and type(data.Weather) == "string" then
                    bS:SetWeather(data.Weather)
                    ui.weather:Set(weatherNames[bS.Weather] or "None", true)
                end
                if ui.weatherMode and type(data.WeatherMode) == "string" then
                    bS:SetWeatherMode(data.WeatherMode)
                    ui.weatherMode:Set(bS.WeatherMode, true)
                end
                if ui.weatherDensity and tonumber(data.WeatherDensity) then
                    bS:SetWeatherDensity(tonumber(data.WeatherDensity))
                    ui.weatherDensity:Set(math.floor((tonumber(bS._weatherDensity) or 1) * 100 + 0.5), true)
                end
                if ui.weatherSpeed and tonumber(data.WeatherSpeed) then
                    bS:SetWeatherSpeed(tonumber(data.WeatherSpeed))
                    ui.weatherSpeed:Set(math.floor((tonumber(bS._weatherSpeed) or 1) * 100 + 0.5), true)
                end
                syncWeather()
                if ui.dim and type(data.Dim) == "boolean" then
                    bS:SetDim(data.Dim)
                    ui.dim:Set(data.Dim, true)
                end
                if ui.tint and tonumber(data.BackdropTint) then
                    bS:SetBackdropTint(tonumber(data.BackdropTint))
                    ui.tint:Set(math.floor((tonumber(bS._backdropTint) or 0.45) * 100 + 0.5), true)
                end
                if ui.transparent and type(data.Transparent) == "boolean" then
                    bS:SetTransparent(data.Transparent)
                    ui.transparent:Set(data.Transparent, true)
                end
                if ui.dragStyle and type(data.DragStyle) == "string" then
                    ui.dragStyle:Set(bS:SetDragStyle(data.DragStyle), true)
                elseif ui.dragStyle and type(data.DragSkeleton) == "boolean" then
                    bS:SetDragSkeleton(data.DragSkeleton)
                    ui.dragStyle:Set(bS.DragStyle, true)
                end
                if ui.islandStyle and type(data.IslandStyle) == "string" then
                    ui.islandStyle:Set(bS:SetIslandStyle(data.IslandStyle), true)
                end
                if ui.radius and tonumber(data.CornerRadius) then
                    ui.radius:Set(k:SetCornerRadius(data.CornerRadius), true)
                end
                if ui.adaptive and type(data.AdaptiveSize) == "boolean" then
                    bS:SetAdaptiveSize(data.AdaptiveSize)
                    ui.adaptive:Set(data.AdaptiveSize, true)
                end
                if ui.scale and tonumber(data.UIScale) then
                    bS:SetUIScale(tonumber(data.UIScale))
                    ui.scale:Set(math.floor(bS:GetUIScale() * 100 + 0.5), true)
                end
                if ui.density and type(data.Density) == "string" then
                    ui.density:Set(k:SetDensity(data.Density), true)
                end
                if ui.fade and tonumber(data.Transition) then
                    ui.fade:Set(math.floor(k:SetThemeTransition(data.Transition) * 1000 + 0.5), true)
                end
                if ui.background and tonumber(data.BackgroundTransparency) then
                    bS:SetBackgroundTransparency(tonumber(data.BackgroundTransparency))
                    ui.backgroundOpacity:Set(math.floor((1 - bS.BackgroundTransparency) * 100 + 0.5), true)
                end
                if ui.background and type(data.Background) == "string" and data.Background ~= (bS.Background or "") then
                    local wanted = data.Background
                    ui.background:Set(bgOption(wanted), true)
                    task.spawn(bS.SetBackground, bS, wanted)
                end
                updateDefault()
            end
            k.Flags[flagName] = flag
            bS:_flagCreated(flagName, flag)
        end
        bS._workspaceListeners = bS._workspaceListeners or {}
        table.insert(bS._workspaceListeners, function()
            ui.saved:Set(nil, true)
            bT:Refresh()
        end)
        updateDefault()
        return bT
    end
    aS.CreateButtonRow = aS.ButtonRow
    aS.CreateConfigManager = aS.ConfigManager
    aS.CreateThemeManager = aS.ThemeManager
    local bQ = { Plain = 22, Row = 24, Badge = 28, Dot = 24, Bar = 38, Stat = 46 }
    local function bR(bS)
        return k._color(bS) or z.Accent
    end
    local function bS(bT)
        if bT == math.floor(bT) then
            return tostring(math.floor(bT))
        end
        return string.format("%.1f", bT)
    end
    local function bT(bU, bV)
        if type(bU) == "number" and type(bV) == "number" then
            return bU, bV
        end
        if type(bU) == "string" then
            local bW = (bU:gsub(",", ""))
            local bX, bY = bW:match("^%s*(%-?[%d%.]+)%s*/%s*(%-?[%d%.]+)")
            if bX then
                return tonumber(bX), tonumber(bY)
            end
        end
        return nil, nil
    end
    function aS:Status(options)
        options = l(options, { Title = "Name", Text = "Value", Content = "Value", CurrentValue = "Value", Default = "Value" })
        local style = "Plain"
        if type(options.Style) == "string" then
            local wanted = string.lower(options.Style)
            for name in pairs(bQ) do
                if string.lower(name) == wanted then
                    style = name
                    break
                end
            end
        end
        local compact = aM(self).Compact
        local window = self.Window
        local height = bQ[style]
        -- `_host` is set by Statuses(..., { Columns = n }): the status then lives inside a grid tile instead of its own card
        local host = options._host
        local pad = host and (options._padY or 8) or (compact and 0 or 8)
        local padX = host and (options._padX or 10) or 14
        local card = host or aO(self, "Frame", height + pad * 2, options)
        local body = ai("Frame", {
            Position = UDim2.fromOffset(padX, pad),
            Size = UDim2.new(1, -padX * 2, 0, height),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            Parent = card,
        })
        local api = {
            Value = options.Value,
            Max = options.Max,
            Tone = options.Tone or "Accent",
            Name = options.Name or "",
            Color = options.Color or options.ValueColor,
            _listeners = {},
        }
        local prefix = tostring(options.Prefix or "")
        local suffix = tostring(options.Suffix or "")
        local stops = k._buildStops(options.Thresholds, options.AutoTone)
        local nameLabel, valueLabel, pill, dot, pulseRing, barFill, barGlow
        local iconImage, iconTinted = nil, false
        local sparkBars, trendPill = nil, nil
        local history, historyLimit = {}, 0
        local trendEnabled = style == "Stat" and options.Trend ~= nil and options.Trend ~= false
        local lastTrend = nil
        local isBadge = false
        local pulseTween = nil
        local pulseEnabled = options.Pulse ~= false
        local fraction = nil
        local lastText = nil

        local function displayName()
            local name = tostring(api.Name)
            return style == "Plain" and (name .. ":") or name
        end

        if style == "Plain" then
            ai("UIListLayout", {
                FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal,
                VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center,
                SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
                Padding = UDim.new(0, 5),
                Parent = body,
            })
            local iconWidth = 0
            if options.Icon ~= nil then
                local iconFrame
                iconFrame, iconImage = aB(body, options.Icon, z.Muted, UDim2.new())
                iconFrame.AnchorPoint = Vector2.zero
                iconFrame.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 14)
                iconFrame.LayoutOrder = 0
                iconWidth = 19
            end
            nameLabel = am({
                Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0),
                AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X,
                TextSize = 12,
                FontFace = D.Regular,
                TextColor3 = z.Muted,
                TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.None,
                LayoutOrder = 1,
                Parent = body,
            })
            -- the value takes whatever width the name leaves and is cut with "..." instead of spilling out of the card
            valueLabel = am({
                Size = UDim2.new(1, -5, 1, 0),
                TextSize = 12,
                TextColor3 = z.Text,
                LayoutOrder = 2,
                Parent = body,
            })
            local function fitValue()
                local nameWidth = math.ceil(nameLabel.AbsoluteSize.X / math.max(window.Scale.Scale, 0.01))
                valueLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, -(nameWidth + 5 + iconWidth), 1, 0)
            end
            nameLabel:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(fitValue)
            fitValue()
        elseif style == "Stat" then
            local nameOffset = 0
            if options.Icon ~= nil then
                local iconFrame
                iconFrame, iconImage = aB(body, options.Icon, z.Muted, UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 8))
                iconFrame.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 12)
                nameOffset = 17
            end
            nameLabel = am({
                Position = UDim2.fromOffset(nameOffset, 1),
                Size = UDim2.new(1, -nameOffset, 0, 14),
                TextSize = 11,
                TextColor3 = z.Muted,
                Parent = body,
            })
            if trendEnabled then
                trendPill = k._pill(body, {
                    AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0),
                    Position = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, -1),
                    Height = 16,
                    TextSize = 10,
                    PadX = 6,
                })
                trendPill.Frame.Visible = false
                -- the name never runs underneath the trend pill
                local function fitName()
                    local scale = math.max(window.Scale.Scale, 0.01)
                    local taken = trendPill.Frame.Visible and (math.ceil(trendPill.Frame.AbsoluteSize.X / scale) + 6) or 0
                    nameLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, -(nameOffset + taken), 0, 14)
                end
                trendPill.Frame:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(fitName)
