                trendPill.Frame:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(fitName)
            end
            local sparkOn = options.Spark ~= nil and options.Spark ~= false
            valueLabel = am({
                Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 16),
                Size = UDim2.new(sparkOn and 0.55 or 1, 0, 0, 26),
                TextSize = 20,
                FontFace = D.Bold,
                TextColor3 = z.Text,
                Parent = body,
            })
            -- mini bar chart of the latest numeric values (Spark = true, or Spark = <bar count>)
            if sparkOn then
                historyLimit = math.clamp(math.floor(tonumber(options.Spark) or tonumber(options.History) or 20), 4, 60)
                local sparkFrame = ai("Frame", {
                    AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0),
                    Position = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 18),
                    Size = UDim2.new(0.4, 0, 0, 24),
                    BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                    Parent = body,
                })
                sparkBars = {}
                for index = 1, historyLimit do
                    local sparkBar = ai("Frame", {
                        AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 1),
                        Position = UDim2.new((index - 1) / historyLimit, 0, 1, 0),
                        Size = UDim2.new(1 / historyLimit, -1, 0, 0),
                        BackgroundColor3 = z.Accent,
                        BorderSizePixel = 0,
                        Visible = false,
                        Parent = sparkFrame,
                    })
                    aj(sparkBar, UDim.new(0, 1))
                    sparkBars[index] = sparkBar
                end
                if type(api.Value) == "number" and api.Value == api.Value then
                    history[1] = api.Value
                end
            end
        else
            local textOffset = 0
            if style == "Dot" then
                textOffset = 18
                pulseRing = ai("Frame", {
                    AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
                    Position = UDim2.new(0, 5, 0.5, 0),
                    Size = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 8),
                    BackgroundColor3 = bR(api.Tone),
                    BackgroundTransparency = 0.4,
                    BorderSizePixel = 0,
                    Parent = body,
                })
                aj(pulseRing, UDim.new(1, 0))
                dot = ai("Frame", {
                    AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
                    Position = UDim2.new(0, 5, 0.5, 0),
                    Size = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 8),
                    BackgroundColor3 = bR(api.Tone),
                    BorderSizePixel = 0,
                    Parent = body,
                })
                aj(dot, UDim.new(1, 0))
            elseif options.Icon ~= nil then
                local iconFrame
                iconFrame, iconImage = aB(
                    body,
                    options.Icon,
                    z.Muted,
                    style == "Bar" and UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 9) or UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.5, 0)
                )
                iconFrame.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 14)
                iconTinted = style == "Badge" or style == "Bar"
                textOffset = 20
            end
            local labelHeight = style == "Bar" and 18 or height
            nameLabel = am({
                Position = UDim2.fromOffset(textOffset, 0),
                Size = UDim2.new(0.55, -textOffset, 0, labelHeight),
                TextSize = 12,
                FontFace = D.Regular,
                TextColor3 = z.Muted,
                Parent = body,
            })
            if style == "Badge" then
                isBadge = true
                pill = k._pill(body, {
                    AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5),
                    Position = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0.5, 0),
                    Height = 22,
                    TextSize = 12,
                    Dot = options.Dot ~= false,
                    RichText = true,
                })
                valueLabel = pill.Label
            else
                valueLabel = am({
                    AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0),
                    Position = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0),
                    Size = UDim2.new(0.45, 0, 0, labelHeight),
                    TextSize = 12,
                    TextColor3 = z.Text,
                    TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right,
                    Parent = body,
                })
            end
            if style == "Bar" then
                local holder = ai("Frame", {
                    Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 26),
                    Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 6),
                    BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                    Parent = body,
                })
                local track = ai("Frame", {
                    Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
                    BackgroundColor3 = z.Surface3,
                    BorderSizePixel = 0,
                    ClipsDescendants = true,
                    Parent = holder,
                })
                aj(track, UDim.new(1, 0))
                barFill = ai("Frame", {
                    Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0),
                    BackgroundColor3 = bR(api.Tone),
                    BorderSizePixel = 0,
                    Parent = track,
                })
                aj(barFill, UDim.new(1, 0))
                ai("UIGradient", {
                    Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
                        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.4),
                        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0),
                    }),
                    Parent = barFill,
                })
                barGlow = ai("ImageLabel", {
                    AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
                    Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.5, 0),
                    Size = UDim2.fromOffset(34, 34),
                    BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                    Image = A.Glow,
                    ImageColor3 = bR(api.Tone),
                    ImageTransparency = 1,
                    ZIndex = 4,
                    Parent = holder,
                })
            end
        end
        nameLabel.RichText = true
        valueLabel.RichText = true

        local function applyPulse(enabled)
            pulseEnabled = enabled and true or false
            if pulseTween then
                pulseTween:Cancel()
                pulseTween = nil
            end
            if not pulseRing then
                return
            end
            if pulseEnabled then
                pulseRing.Visible = true
                pulseRing.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 8)
                pulseRing.BackgroundTransparency = 0.4
                pulseTween = a:Create(
                    pulseRing,
                    TweenInfo.new(1.4, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out, -1),
                    { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(20, 20), BackgroundTransparency = 1 }
                )
                pulseTween:Play()
            else
                pulseRing.Visible = false
            end
        end
        applyPulse(pulseEnabled)
        table.insert(api._listeners, function()
            if pulseTween then
                pulseTween:Cancel()
                pulseTween = nil
            end
        end)

        -- tone actually shown: thresholds (opt-in) win over the static Tone while a fraction is known
        local function effectiveTone()
            if #stops > 0 and fraction ~= nil then
                local spec = k._pickStop(stops, fraction)
                if spec ~= nil then
                    return spec
                end
            end
            return api.Tone
        end
        local function valueColor()
            if api.Color ~= nil then
                return k._color(api.Color) or z.Text
            end
            if #stops > 0 and fraction ~= nil then
                return bR(effectiveTone())
            end
            return z.Text
        end
        local function formatValue(value)
            if type(options.Format) == "function" then
                local ok, result = pcall(options.Format, value, api.Max)
                if ok and result ~= nil then
                    return tostring(result)
                end
            end
            if type(value) == "number" then
                return k._formatNumber(value, options.Decimals, options.Separator, options.Abbreviate)
            end
            return tostring(value)
        end

        -- bars of the Stat mini chart: newest bar is solid, older ones fade out
        local function drawSpark(tone)
            if not sparkBars then
                return
            end
            local count = #history
            local low, high = math.huge, -math.huge
            for index = 1, count do
                local sample = history[index]
                if sample < low then
                    low = sample
                end
                if sample > high then
                    high = sample
                end
            end
            local fixedLow, fixedHigh = tonumber(options.SparkMin), tonumber(options.SparkMax)
            if fixedLow or fixedHigh then
                low = fixedLow or math.min(low, 0)
                high = fixedHigh or high
            elseif count > 0 then
                low = low - (high - low) * 0.35
            end
            local range = high - low
            for slot = 1, historyLimit do
                local sparkBar = sparkBars[slot]
                local sample = history[count - (historyLimit - slot)]
                if sample ~= nil then
                    local share = range > 0 and math.clamp((sample - low) / range, 0.12, 1) or 0.5
                    sparkBar.Visible = true
                    sparkBar.Size = UDim2.new(1 / historyLimit, -1, share, 0)
                    sparkBar.BackgroundTransparency = 0.7 * (1 - slot / historyLimit)
                    ah(sparkBar, { BackgroundColor3 = tone }, 0)
                else
                    sparkBar.Visible = false
                end
            end
        end
        local function paintTrend()
            if not trendPill then
                return
            end
            if not lastTrend then
                trendPill.Frame.Visible = false
                return
            end
            local good = lastTrend.Up
            if options.InvertTrend == true then
                good = not good
            end
            if trendPill.IconUp ~= lastTrend.Up then
                trendPill.IconUp = lastTrend.Up
                trendPill.SetIcon(lastTrend.Up and "chevron-up" or "chevron-down")
            end
            trendPill.Label.Text = lastTrend.Text
            trendPill.Paint(bR(good and "Success" or "Error"), 0)
            trendPill.Frame.Visible = true
        end
        -- numeric values feed the mini chart and the trend pill (only real changes of the value set it)
        local function record(previous, value)
            if type(value) ~= "number" or value ~= value then
                return
            end
            if historyLimit > 0 then
                history[#history + 1] = value
                if #history > historyLimit then
                    table.remove(history, 1)
                end
            end
            if trendEnabled and type(previous) == "number" and previous == previous and value ~= previous then
                local delta = value - previous
                local text
                if string.lower(tostring(options.Trend)) == "percent" and previous ~= 0 then
                    text = string.format("%.1f%%", math.abs(delta / previous) * 100)
                else
                    text = k._formatNumber(math.abs(delta), options.Decimals, options.Separator, options.Abbreviate)
                end
                lastTrend = { Up = delta > 0, Text = text }
            end
        end

        local function refresh(animate)
            nameLabel.Text = k._rich(displayName())
            local value = api.Value
            local current, maximum = bT(value, api.Max)
            local text
            local barFraction = 0
            fraction = nil
            if current and maximum then
                api.Max = maximum
                fraction = maximum > 0 and math.clamp(current / maximum, 0, 1) or 0
            end
            if value == nil then
                text = tostring(options.Placeholder or "-")
            elseif style == "Bar" and current and maximum then
                text = k._formatNumber(current, options.Decimals, options.Separator, options.Abbreviate)
                    .. " / "
                    .. k._formatNumber(maximum, options.Decimals, options.Separator, options.Abbreviate)
                barFraction = fraction
            elseif style == "Bar" and type(value) == "number" and value <= 1 then
                text = string.format("%d%%", math.floor(value * 100 + 0.5))
                barFraction = math.clamp(value, 0, 1)
                fraction = barFraction
            else
                text = formatValue(value)
            end
            text = k._rich(prefix .. text .. suffix)
            local changed = lastText ~= nil and text ~= lastText
            lastText = text
            valueLabel.Text = text
            local tone = bR(effectiveTone())
            local colorTime = animate and 0.25 or 0
            local flash = changed and animate and not isBadge and options.Flash ~= false
            if not isBadge and not flash then
                ah(valueLabel, { TextColor3 = valueColor() }, colorTime)
            end
            if pill then
                pill.Paint(tone, colorTime)
                pill.Frame.Visible = text ~= ""
            end
            if dot then
                ah(dot, { BackgroundColor3 = tone }, colorTime)
                ah(pulseRing, { BackgroundColor3 = tone }, 0)
            end
            if iconImage then
                local iconColor = options.IconColor ~= nil and k._color(options.IconColor) or nil
                if not iconColor and iconTinted then
                    iconColor = tone
                end
                ah(iconImage, { ImageColor3 = iconColor or z.Muted }, colorTime)
            end
            if barFill then
                local duration = animate and 0.4 or 0
                ah(barFill, { Size = UDim2.new(barFraction, 0, 1, 0), BackgroundColor3 = tone }, duration, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint)
                ah(barGlow, {
                    Position = UDim2.new(barFraction, 0, 0.5, 0),
                    ImageColor3 = tone,
                    ImageTransparency = barFraction <= 0.001 and 1 or 0.82,
                }, duration, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint)
            end
            drawSpark(tone)
            paintTrend()
            if flash then
                ah(valueLabel, { TextColor3 = z.Accent }, 0.08)
                task.delay(0.1, function()
                    if valueLabel.Parent then
                        ah(valueLabel, { TextColor3 = valueColor() }, 0.45)
                    end
                end)
            end
        end
        ag(body, function()
            if lastText ~= nil then
                refresh(false)
            end
        end)

        function api:Set(value, maximum)
            local previous = api.Value
            api.Value = value
            if maximum ~= nil then
                api.Max = maximum
            end
            record(previous, value)
            refresh(true)
        end
        function api:Get()
            return api.Value
        end
        function api:GetMax()
            return api.Max
        end
        function api:SetTone(tone)
            api.Tone = tone
            refresh(true)
        end
        function api:SetColor(color)
            api.Color = color
            refresh(true)
        end
        function api:SetName(name)
            api.Name = tostring(name)
            refresh(false)
        end
        function api:SetPrefix(text)
            prefix = tostring(text or "")
            refresh(false)
        end
        function api:SetSuffix(text)
            suffix = tostring(text or "")
            refresh(false)
        end
        function api:SetFormat(callback)
            options.Format = callback
            refresh(false)
        end
        function api:SetThresholds(source)
            stops = k._buildStops(source, nil)
            refresh(true)
        end
        function api:SetPulse(enabled)
            applyPulse(enabled)
        end
        function api:SetIcon(name)
            if iconImage and name ~= nil then
                aq(iconImage, name)
            end
        end
        function api:GetHistory()
            return table.clone(history)
        end
        function api:ClearHistory()
            table.clear(history)
            lastTrend = nil
            refresh(false)
        end
        function api:Text()
            return valueLabel.Text
        end
        function api._shownColor()
            if api.Color ~= nil then
                return k._color(api.Color) or z.Text
            end
            if style == "Badge" or style == "Dot" or style == "Bar" or (#stops > 0 and fraction ~= nil) then
                return bR(effectiveTone())
            end
            return z.Text
        end

        local updateRate = math.max(tonumber(options.UpdateRate) or 1, 0.05)
        function api:SetUpdateRate(rate)
            updateRate = math.max(tonumber(rate) or updateRate, 0.05)
        end
        if type(options.Update) == "function" then
            -- pinned statuses feed the island HUD, so they keep updating while the window is closed or minimized
            k._poll(api, card, function()
                return updateRate
            end, function()
                if options.Pin or options.AlwaysUpdate == true then
                    return not window._destroyed
                end
                return k._isLive(self, window, api)
            end, function()
                local ok, value, extra = aK(options.Update)
                if not ok then
                    warn("[AirFlow] status update error: " .. tostring(value))
                    return
                end
                local previous = api.Value
                if value ~= nil then
                    api.Value = value
                end
                if type(extra) == "number" then
                    api.Max = extra
                elseif type(extra) == "string" or typeof(extra) == "Color3" then
                    api.Tone = extra
                end
                if value ~= nil then
                    record(previous, value)
                end
                refresh(true)
            end)
        end
        if options.Pin then
            table.insert(window._pinned, api)
            table.insert(api._listeners, function()
                local index = table.find(window._pinned, api)
                if index then
                    table.remove(window._pinned, index)
                end
            end)
        end
        refresh(false)
        return m(self, options, api, card, "Status")
    end
    -- Statuses({ { Name = "FPS", Value = 60 }, ... }, defaults)
    -- Without `Columns` every entry is its own Status card. With `defaults.Columns = n` (2+) the entries become
    -- tiles of one grid card (`Header` = optional title above the grid, `Gap` = tile spacing, default 8).
    function aS:Statuses(list, defaults)
        defaults = type(defaults) == "table" and defaults or {}
        local result = {}
        local methods = {}
        local holder = nil
        local function statusHeight(styleName)
            local wanted = string.lower(tostring(styleName or "Plain"))
            for name, size in pairs(bQ) do
                if string.lower(name) == wanted then
                    return size
                end
            end
            return bQ.Plain
        end
        function methods:Set(name, value, maximum)
            local status = rawget(self, name)
            if not status then
                return false
            end
            status:Set(value, maximum)
            return true
        end
        function methods:SetAll(values)
            for name, value in pairs(values or {}) do
                local status = rawget(self, name)
                if status then
                    status:Set(value)
                end
            end
        end
        function methods:Get(name)
            local status = rawget(self, name)
            if status == nil then
                return nil
            end
            return status:Get()
        end
        function methods:GetAll()
            local values = {}
            for name, status in pairs(self) do
                if type(status) == "table" and type(status.Get) == "function" then
                    values[name] = status:Get()
                end
            end
            return values
        end
        function methods:Has(name)
            return rawget(self, name) ~= nil
        end
        function methods:Each(callback)
            for name, status in pairs(self) do
                if type(status) == "table" and type(status.Destroy) == "function" then
                    pcall(callback, name, status)
                end
            end
        end
        function methods:SetVisible(visible)
            for name, status in pairs(self) do
                if type(status) == "table" and type(status.SetVisible) == "function" then
                    status:SetVisible(visible)
                end
            end
            if holder then
                holder.Visible = visible and true or false
            end
        end
        function methods:Destroy()
            for name, status in pairs(self) do
                if type(status) == "table" and type(status.Destroy) == "function" then
                    status:Destroy()
                end
            end
            if holder then
                holder:Destroy()
                holder = nil
            end
        end
        setmetatable(result, { __index = methods })

        local columns = math.floor(tonumber(defaults.Columns) or 0)
        local grid, gridPad, tileHeight
        if columns >= 2 then
            local gap = math.clamp(math.floor(tonumber(defaults.Gap) or 8), 0, 24)
            local compact = aM(self).Compact
            local tallest = 0
            for index, entry in ipairs(type(list) == "table" and list or {}) do
                local entryStyle = type(entry) == "table" and entry.Style or nil
                tallest = math.max(tallest, statusHeight(entryStyle or defaults.Style or "Stat"))
            end
            tileHeight = math.max(tallest, bQ.Plain) + 16
            gridPad = 8
            holder = aO(self, "Frame", 0, defaults)
            holder.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
            if compact then
                al(holder, 10, 10, 6, 8)
            else
                al(holder, 10, 10, 10, 10)
            end
            ai("UIListLayout", { SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder, Padding = UDim.new(0, 8), Parent = holder })
            local header = defaults.Header
            if header ~= nil and tostring(header) ~= "" then
                am({
                    Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 16),
                    Text = string.upper(tostring(header)),
                    TextSize = 11,
                    TextColor3 = z.Muted,
                    LayoutOrder = 1,
                    Parent = holder,
                })
            end
            grid = ai("Frame", {
                Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0),
                AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
                BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                LayoutOrder = 2,
                Parent = holder,
            })
            ai("UIGridLayout", {
                CellSize = UDim2.new(1 / columns, -math.ceil(gap * (columns - 1) / columns), 0, tileHeight),
                CellPadding = UDim2.fromOffset(gap, gap),
                FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal,
                HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Left,
                SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
                Parent = grid,
            })
        end
        local groupOnly = { Columns = true, Gap = true, Header = true }

        for index, entry in ipairs(type(list) == "table" and list or {}) do
            local config
            if type(entry) == "table" then
                config = table.clone(entry)
                if config.Name == nil and config.Title == nil and type(config[1]) == "string" then
                    config.Name = config[1]
                    if config.Value == nil and config[2] ~= nil then
                        config.Value = config[2]
                    end
                end
            else
                config = { Name = tostring(entry) }
            end
            for key, value in pairs(defaults) do
                if config[key] == nil and not groupOnly[key] then
                    config[key] = value
                end
            end
            if grid then
                if config.Style == nil then
                    config.Style = "Stat"
                end
                local tile = ai("Frame", {
                    BackgroundColor3 = z.Surface,
                    BorderSizePixel = 0,
                    LayoutOrder = index,
                    Parent = grid,
                })
                tile:SetAttribute("NoDrag", true)
                aj(tile, UDim.new(0, 8))
                aG(tile, ak(tile))
                config._host = tile
                config._padX = 10
                config._padY = 8
            end
            local status = self:Status(config)
            local key = config.Name or config.Title or index
            if rawget(result, key) ~= nil or methods[key] ~= nil then
                key = index
            end
            result[key] = status
        end
        return result
    end
    function aS:StatusList(options)
        options = l(options, { Title = "Name" })
        local compact = aM(self).Compact
        local window = self.Window
        local maxRows = math.max(math.floor(tonumber(options.MaxRows) or 5), 1)
        local bullets = options.Bullets ~= false
        local gutter = bullets and 16 or 0
        local card = aO(self, "Frame", 0, options)
        card.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
        if compact then
            al(card, 14, 14, 6, 8)
        else
            al(card, 14, 14, 11, 12)
        end
        ai("UIListLayout", { SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder, Padding = UDim.new(0, 4), Parent = card })
        local headerText = tostring(options.Name or "")
        local header = ai("Frame", {
            Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 16),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            Visible = headerText ~= "",
            LayoutOrder = 1,
            Parent = card,
        })
        local titleLabel = am({
            Size = UDim2.new(1, -48, 1, 0),
            Text = string.upper(headerText),
            TextSize = 11,
            TextColor3 = z.Muted,
            Parent = header,
        })
        -- number of rows, shown once the list scrolls (ShowCount = true / false overrides)
        local countLabel = am({
            AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0),
            Position = UDim2.fromScale(1, 0),
            Size = UDim2.new(0, 44, 1, 0),
            Text = "",
            TextSize = 11,
            FontFace = D.Regular,
            TextColor3 = z.Muted,
            TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right,
            TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.None,
            Visible = false,
            Parent = header,
        })
        local scroll = ai("ScrollingFrame", {
            Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            BorderSizePixel = 0,
            ScrollBarThickness = 2,
            ScrollBarImageColor3 = z.Accent,
            ScrollBarImageTransparency = 0.4,
            ScrollingDirection = Enum.ScrollingDirection.Y,
            AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
            CanvasSize = UDim2.new(),
            ScrollingEnabled = false,
            LayoutOrder = 2,
            Parent = card,
        })
        scroll:SetAttribute("NoDrag", true)
        local content = ai("Frame", {
            Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0),
            AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            Parent = scroll,
        })
        local contentPadding = al(content, 0, 0, 0, 0)
        ai("UIListLayout", { SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder, Padding = UDim.new(0, 2), Parent = content })
        local emptyLabel = am({
            Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 24),
            AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
            Text = tostring(options.EmptyText or "Nothing yet"),
            TextSize = 13,
            LineHeight = 1.1,
            FontFace = D.Regular,
            TextColor3 = z.Muted,
            TextWrapped = true,
            TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.None,
            LayoutOrder = 0,
            Parent = content,
        })
        local rowObjects, normalized, lastKey, rawRows = {}, {}, nil, {}
        local api = { _listeners = {} }
        local populated = false

        local function updateCount()
            local count = #normalized
            local show = headerText ~= "" and (options.ShowCount == true or (options.ShowCount ~= false and count > maxRows))
            countLabel.Visible = show
            countLabel.Text = tostring(count)
        end
        local function fitHeight()
            if api._destroyed then
                return
            end
            local scale = math.max(window.Scale.Scale, 0.01)
            local count = #normalized
            local height = 0
            if count == 0 then
                height = emptyLabel.AbsoluteSize.Y / scale
            else
                local shown = math.min(count, maxRows)
                for index = 1, shown do
                    height = height + rowObjects[index].Frame.AbsoluteSize.Y / scale
                end
                height = height + (shown - 1) * 2
            end
            height = math.ceil(height)
            local scrollable = count > maxRows
            scroll.ScrollingEnabled = scrollable
            contentPadding.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, scrollable and 8 or 0)
            if scroll.Size.Y.Offset ~= height then
                scroll.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, height)
            end
            local maxScroll = math.max(scroll.AbsoluteCanvasSize.Y - scroll.AbsoluteWindowSize.Y, 0) / scale
            if scroll.CanvasPosition.Y > maxScroll then
                scroll.CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(0, maxScroll)
            end
            updateCount()
        end
        -- keeps the text clear of the right-aligned value
        local function fitText(row)
            local scale = math.max(window.Scale.Scale, 0.01)
            if row.Value.Visible then
                row.Text.Size = UDim2.new(1, -(gutter + math.ceil(row.Value.AbsoluteSize.X / scale) + 12), 0, 24)
            else
                row.Text.Size = UDim2.new(1, -gutter, 0, 24)
            end
        end
        local function createRow(order)
            local frame = ai("Frame", {
                Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0),
                AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
                BackgroundColor3 = z.Accent,
                BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                BorderSizePixel = 0,
                LayoutOrder = order,
                Parent = content,
            })
            aj(frame, UDim.new(0, 5))
            local row = {
                Frame = frame,
                Text = am({
                    Position = UDim2.fromOffset(gutter, 0),
                    Size = UDim2.new(1, -gutter, 0, 24),
                    AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
                    Text = "",
                    TextSize = 13,
                    LineHeight = 1.1,
                    FontFace = D.Regular,
                    TextColor3 = z.Muted,
                    TextWrapped = true,
                    TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.None,
                    RichText = true,
                    Parent = frame,
                }),
                Value = am({
                    AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0),
                    Position = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0),
                    Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 24),
                    AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X,
                    Text = "",
                    TextSize = 12,
                    FontFace = D.Medium,
                    TextColor3 = z.Text,
                    RichText = true,
                    TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right,
                    TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.None,
                    Visible = false,
                    Parent = frame,
                }),
            }
            if bullets then
                row.Dot = ai("Frame", {
                    AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
                    Position = UDim2.fromOffset(6, 12),
                    Size = UDim2.fromOffset(6, 6),
                    BackgroundColor3 = z.StrokeHover,
                    BorderSizePixel = 0,
                    Parent = frame,
                })
                aj(row.Dot, UDim.new(1, 0))
            end
            row.Connections = {
                frame:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(fitHeight),
                row.Value:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(function()
                    fitText(row)
                end),
            }
            return row
        end
        -- accepts "text", { Text = "...", Value = ..., Tone = ..., Icon = "..." } and { "text", value, tone, icon }
        local function normalizeRow(source)
            if type(source) == "table" then
                local text = source.Text
                if text == nil then
                    text = source.Name
                end
                if text == nil then
                    text = source[1]
                end
                local value = source.Value
                if value == nil then
                    value = source[2]
                end
                local tone = source.Tone
                if tone == nil then
                    tone = source.Color
                end
                if tone == nil then
                    tone = source[3]
                end
                local icon = source.Icon
                if icon == nil then
                    icon = source[4]
                end
                local valueText = nil
                if value ~= nil then
                    if type(value) == "number" then
                        valueText = k._formatNumber(value, source.Decimals, source.Separator, source.Abbreviate)
                    else
                        valueText = tostring(value)
                    end
                end
                return {
                    Text = tostring(text == nil and "" or text),
                    Value = valueText,
                    Tone = (type(tone) == "string" or typeof(tone) == "Color3") and tone or nil,
                    Icon = type(icon) == "string" and icon or nil,
                }
            end
            return { Text = tostring(source) }
        end
        local function rowKey(row)
            return row.Text
                .. "\0"
                .. (row.Value or "\1")
                .. "\0"
                .. tostring(row.Tone or "")
                .. "\0"
                .. tostring(row.Icon or "")
        end
        local function paintRow(row, data, flash)
            local key = rowKey(data)
            if row.Key == key then
                return
            end
            local iconChanged = row.IconName ~= data.Icon
            -- a row lights up when it is new or when its tone / icon changes
            -- (FlashChanges = true also lights it up on every text or value change)
            local styleKey = tostring(data.Tone or "") .. "\0" .. tostring(data.Icon or "")
            local firstPaint = row.StyleKey == nil
            local restyled = row.StyleKey ~= nil and row.StyleKey ~= styleKey
            row.StyleKey = styleKey
            row.Key = key
            row.IconName = data.Icon
            row.Text.Text = k._rich(data.Text)
            local tone = data.Tone and k._color(data.Tone) or nil
            if row.Dot then
                if data.Icon ~= nil then
                    row.Dot.Visible = false
                    if not row.Icon then
                        row.Icon = ai("ImageLabel", {
                            AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
                            Position = UDim2.fromOffset(6, 12),
                            Size = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 12),
                            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                            ImageColor3 = z.Muted,
                            ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit,
                            Parent = row.Frame,
                        })
                        iconChanged = true
                    end
                    if iconChanged then
                        aq(row.Icon, data.Icon)
                    end
                    row.Icon.Visible = true
                    ah(row.Icon, { ImageColor3 = tone or z.Muted }, 0)
                else
                    if row.Icon then
                        row.Icon.Visible = false
                    end
                    row.Dot.Visible = true
                    ah(row.Dot, { BackgroundColor3 = tone or z.StrokeHover }, 0)
                end
            end
            if data.Value then
                row.Value.Text = k._rich(data.Value)
                row.Value.Visible = true
                ah(row.Value, { TextColor3 = tone or z.Text }, 0)
                ah(row.Text, { TextColor3 = z.Muted }, 0)
            else
                row.Value.Visible = false
                ah(row.Text, { TextColor3 = tone or z.Muted }, 0)
            end
            fitText(row)
            if flash and options.Flash ~= false and (firstPaint or restyled or options.FlashChanges == true) then
                ah(row.Frame, { BackgroundTransparency = 0.88 }, 0.08)
                task.delay(0.1, function()
                    if row.Frame.Parent then
                        ah(row.Frame, { BackgroundTransparency = 1 }, 0.7)
                    end
                end)
            end
        end
        local function destroyRow(row)
            for index, connection in ipairs(row.Connections) do
                connection:Disconnect()
            end
            row.Frame:Destroy()
        end

        function api:Set(rows)
            if type(rows) ~= "table" or api._destroyed then
                return
            end
            local fresh, keys = {}, {}
            rawRows = {}
            for index, source in ipairs(rows) do
                rawRows[index] = type(source) == "table" and table.clone(source) or source
                local data = normalizeRow(source)
                fresh[index] = data
                keys[index] = rowKey(data)
            end
            local signature = table.concat(keys, "\2") .. "#" .. #fresh
            if signature == lastKey then
                return
            end
            lastKey = signature
            normalized = fresh
            for index, data in ipairs(normalized) do
                local row = rowObjects[index]
                if not row then
                    row = createRow(index)
                    rowObjects[index] = row
                end
                paintRow(row, data, populated)
            end
            for index = #rowObjects, #normalized + 1, -1 do
                destroyRow(rowObjects[index])
                rowObjects[index] = nil
            end
            emptyLabel.Visible = #normalized == 0
            fitHeight()
            -- AutoScroll keeps the newest rows in view (log style)
            if options.AutoScroll == true and #normalized > maxRows then
                task.defer(function()
                    if scroll.Parent and not api._destroyed then
                        local scale = math.max(window.Scale.Scale, 0.01)
                        local bottom = math.max(scroll.AbsoluteCanvasSize.Y - scroll.AbsoluteWindowSize.Y, 0) / scale
                        scroll.CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(0, bottom)
                    end
                end)
            end
        end
        api.SetRows = api.Set
        function api:Get()
            local copy = {}
            for index, source in ipairs(rawRows) do
                copy[index] = type(source) == "table" and table.clone(source) or source
            end
            return copy
        end
        function api:Count()
            return #normalized
        end
        function api:Clear()
            api:Set({})
        end
        function api:Add(row, position)
            local rows = api:Get()
            if tonumber(position) then
                table.insert(rows, math.clamp(math.floor(position), 1, #rows + 1), row)
            else
                table.insert(rows, row)
            end
            api:Set(rows)
            return #rows
        end
        -- Push(row): append like Add, but drop the oldest rows beyond `Limit` (log style)
        function api:Push(row)
            local rows = api:Get()
            table.insert(rows, row)
            local limit = tonumber(options.Limit)
            if limit and limit >= 1 then
                while #rows > limit do
                    table.remove(rows, 1)
                end
            end
            api:Set(rows)
            return #rows
        end
        -- Remove(index) or Remove("text of the row")
        function api:Remove(target)
            local rows = api:Get()
            local position = nil
            if type(target) == "number" then
                position = rows[target] ~= nil and target or nil
            else
                for index, source in ipairs(rows) do
                    if normalizeRow(source).Text == tostring(target) then
                        position = index
                        break
                    end
                end
            end
            if not position then
                return false
            end
            table.remove(rows, position)
            api:Set(rows)
            return true
        end
        function api:SetName(text)
            text = tostring(text or "")
            headerText = text
            titleLabel.Text = string.upper(text)
            header.Visible = text ~= ""
            updateCount()
            api._searchName = text
            api._searchKey = string.lower(text)
        end
        function api:SetEmptyText(text)
            emptyLabel.Text = tostring(text or "")
        end
        function api:SetMaxRows(count)
            maxRows = math.max(math.floor(tonumber(count) or maxRows), 1)
            fitHeight()
        end
        local updateRate = math.max(tonumber(options.UpdateRate) or 1, 0.05)
        function api:SetUpdateRate(rate)
            updateRate = math.max(tonumber(rate) or updateRate, 0.05)
        end
        ag(content, function()
            for index, row in ipairs(rowObjects) do
                if normalized[index] then
                    row.Key = nil
                    paintRow(row, normalized[index], false)
                end
            end
        end)
        local emptyConnection = emptyLabel:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(fitHeight)
        table.insert(api._listeners, function()
            api._destroyed = true
            emptyConnection:Disconnect()
            for index, row in ipairs(rowObjects) do
                for index2, connection in ipairs(row.Connections) do
                    connection:Disconnect()
                end
            end
        end)
        if type(options.Update) == "function" then
            k._poll(api, card, function()
                return updateRate
            end, function()
                return options.AlwaysUpdate == true or k._isLive(self, window, api)
            end, function()
                local ok, rows = aK(options.Update)
                if not ok then
                    warn("[AirFlow] status list update error: " .. tostring(rows))
                    return
                end
                if rows ~= nil then
                    api:Set(rows)
                end
            end)
        end
        api:Set(options.Rows or {})
        populated = true
        updateCount()
        return m(self, options, api, card, "StatusList")
    end
    aS.CreateStatus = aS.Status
    aS.AddStatus = aS.Status
    aS.CreateStatuses = aS.Statuses
    aS.CreateStatusList = aS.StatusList
    aS.AddStatusList = aS.StatusList
    -- =========================================================================
    -- Media card (shared by Image and Viewport)
    --
    -- Options : Name/Title, Desc, Height (40-600), Aspect (width / height, overrides Height),
    --           Caption, Badge/Tag
    -- Parts   : title row, framed media area with placeholder, loading shimmer + spinner,
    --           error message, caption bar and badge chip
    -- =========================================================================
    function aS:_mediaCard(opts, defaultHeight, config)
        opts = l(opts, { Title = "Name", Description = "Desc", Tag = "Badge" })
        config = config or {}
        local owner = self
        local metrics = aM(owner)
        local compact = metrics.Compact
        local side = compact and 14 or 8
        local hasTitle = type(opts.Name) == "string" and opts.Name ~= ""
        local titleTop = compact and 4 or 10
        local mediaTop = hasTitle and (titleTop + (opts.Desc and 38 or 22)) or (compact and 4 or side)
        local bottomPad = compact and 6 or side
        local mediaHeight = math.clamp(tonumber(opts.Height) or defaultHeight, 40, 600)
        local aspect = tonumber(opts.Aspect or opts.AspectRatio)
        if aspect and aspect <= 0 then
            aspect = nil
        end

        local card, cardStroke = aO(owner, "Frame", mediaTop + mediaHeight + bottomPad, opts)
        aG(card, cardStroke)

        local titleLabel, descLabel
        if hasTitle then
            titleLabel = am({
                Position = UDim2.fromOffset(14, titleTop),
                Size = UDim2.new(1, -28, 0, metrics.TitleHeight),
                Text = opts.Name,
                TextSize = metrics.TextSize,
                Parent = card,
            })
            if opts.Desc then
                descLabel = am({
                    Position = UDim2.fromOffset(14, titleTop + metrics.TitleHeight + 1),
                    Size = UDim2.new(1, -28, 0, metrics.DescLine),
                    Text = tostring(opts.Desc),
                    TextSize = metrics.DescSize,
                    FontFace = D.Regular,
                    TextColor3 = z.Muted,
                    Parent = card,
                })
            end
        end

        local media = ai("Frame", {
            Name = "Media",
            Position = UDim2.fromOffset(side, mediaTop),
            Size = UDim2.new(1, -side * 2, 0, mediaHeight),
            BackgroundColor3 = z.Surface3,
            BackgroundTransparency = 0.5,
            BorderSizePixel = 0,
            ClipsDescendants = true,
            Parent = card,
        })
        aj(media, UDim.new(0, 6))
        local mediaStroke = ak(media, z.Stroke)
        ai("UIGradient", {
            Rotation = 90,
            Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), Color3.fromRGB(205, 205, 210)),
            Parent = media,
        })

        -- loading shimmer (a soft light band sweeping across the empty frame)
        local shimmer = ai("Frame", {
            Name = "Shimmer",
            Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
            BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
            BorderSizePixel = 0,
            Visible = false,
            ZIndex = 1,
            Parent = media,
        })
        aj(shimmer, UDim.new(0, 6))
        local shimmerGradient = ai("UIGradient", {
            Rotation = 20,
            Offset = Vector2.new(-1, 0),
            Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
                NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1),
                NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, 0.92),
                NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1),
            }),
            Parent = shimmer,
        })
        local shimmerTween
        local function setShimmer(on)
            if on then
                if shimmerTween then
                    return
                end
                shimmer.Visible = true
                shimmerGradient.Offset = Vector2.new(-1, 0)
                shimmerTween = a:Create(
                    shimmerGradient,
                    TweenInfo.new(1.3, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut, -1),
                    { Offset = Vector2.new(1, 0) }
                )
                shimmerTween:Play()
            elseif shimmerTween then
                shimmerTween:Cancel()
                shimmerTween = nil
                shimmer.Visible = false
            end
        end

        local placeholder = ai("ImageLabel", {
            Name = "Placeholder",
            AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
            Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5),
            Size = UDim2.fromOffset(22, 22),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            ImageColor3 = z.Muted,
            ImageTransparency = 0.3,
            ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit,
            ZIndex = 2,
            Parent = media,
        })
        local stateLabel = am({
            Name = "State",
            AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0),
            Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 10),
            Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 14),
            Text = "",
            TextSize = 11,
            FontFace = D.Regular,
            TextColor3 = z.Error,
            TextTransparency = 1,
            TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center,
            ZIndex = 2,
            Parent = media,
        })
        local spinner = k._spinner(media, { Size = 18 })
        spinner.Frame.ZIndex = 3
        spinner:SetColor(z.Accent, 0)

        local cleanups = {}
        table.insert(cleanups, function()
            setShimmer(false)
            spinner:Destroy()
        end)

        -- mode: "empty" | "loading" | "ready" | "error"
        local function setState(mode, message)
            local showIcon = mode == "empty" or mode == "error"
            local hasMessage = mode == "error" and type(message) == "string" and message ~= ""
            spinner:Set(mode == "loading")
            setShimmer(mode == "loading")
            if hasMessage then
                stateLabel.Text = message
            end
            ah(placeholder, {
                ImageTransparency = showIcon and 0.3 or 1,
                ImageColor3 = mode == "error" and z.Error or z.Muted,
                Position = hasMessage and UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, -9) or UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5),
            }, 0.2)
            ah(stateLabel, { TextTransparency = hasMessage and 0.1 or 1 }, 0.2)
        end

        -- hover highlight (accent rim + optional light veil)
        local hoverVeil = ai("Frame", {
            Name = "Hover",
            Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
            BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            BorderSizePixel = 0,
            ZIndex = 5,
            Parent = media,
        })
        aj(hoverVeil, UDim.new(0, 6))
        local hovered = false
        local function setHover(on)
            on = on and true or false
            if on == hovered then
                return
            end
            hovered = on
            ah(mediaStroke, { Color = on and z.Accent or z.Stroke, Transparency = on and 0.45 or 0 }, on and 0.12 or 0.25)
            if config.HoverTint then
                ah(hoverVeil, { BackgroundTransparency = on and config.HoverTint or 1 }, 0.15)
            end
        end
        if not config.PollHover then
            media.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
                setHover(true)
            end)
            media.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
                setHover(false)
            end)
        end

        -- caption bar
        local captionBar = ai("Frame", {
            Name = "Caption",
            AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 1),
            Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 1),
            Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 34),
            BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0),
            BackgroundTransparency = 0.25,
            BorderSizePixel = 0,
            Visible = false,
            ZIndex = 6,
            Parent = media,
        })
        aj(captionBar, UDim.new(0, 6))
        ai("UIGradient", { Rotation = 90, Transparency = NumberSequence.new(1, 0), Parent = captionBar })
        local captionLabel = am({
            Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 10),
            Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 1, -14),
            TextSize = 12,
            TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
            ZIndex = 7,
            Parent = captionBar,
        })
        local function setCaption(text)
            text = text ~= nil and tostring(text) or ""
            captionLabel.Text = text
            captionBar.Visible = text ~= ""
        end

        -- badge chip (top-left)
        local badge = ai("Frame", {
            Name = "Badge",
            Position = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 8),
            Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 18),
            AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X,
            BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0),
            BackgroundTransparency = 0.38,
            BorderSizePixel = 0,
            Visible = false,
            ZIndex = 6,
            Parent = media,
        })
        aj(badge, UDim.new(1, 0))
        ak(badge, Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 0.86)
        al(badge, 8, 8, 0, 0)
        local badgeLabel = am({
            Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0),
            AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X,
            Text = "",
            TextSize = 10,
            FontFace = D.Bold,
            TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
            TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.None,
            ZIndex = 7,
            Parent = badge,
        })
        local function setBadge(text)
            text = text ~= nil and tostring(text) or ""
            badgeLabel.Text = string.upper(text)
            badge.Visible = text ~= ""
        end

        local function setHeight(height)
            mediaHeight = math.clamp(math.floor((tonumber(height) or mediaHeight) + 0.5), 40, 600)
            media.Size = UDim2.new(1, -side * 2, 0, mediaHeight)
            card.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, mediaTop + mediaHeight + bottomPad)
        end
        if aspect then
            local function fitAspect()
                local win = owner.Window
                local scale = win and win.Scale and win.Scale.Scale
                scale = math.max(type(scale) == "number" and scale or 1, 0.01)
                local width = media.AbsoluteSize.X / scale
                if width > 0 then
                    setHeight(width / aspect)
                end
            end
            media:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(fitAspect)
            task.defer(fitAspect)
        end

        setCaption(opts.Caption)
        setBadge(opts.Badge)

        return opts,
            {
                Frame = card,
                Stroke = cardStroke,
                Media = media,
                Placeholder = placeholder,
                Title = titleLabel,
                Desc = descLabel,
                Cleanups = cleanups,
                SetState = setState,
                SetHover = setHover,
                SetCaption = setCaption,
                SetBadge = setBadge,
                SetHeight = setHeight,
            }
    end

    -- =========================================================================
    -- Image
    --
    -- :Image({ Name, Desc, Image, Height | Aspect, ScaleType, Color, Caption, Badge, Callback })
    --   Image = asset id / rbxassetid / rbxthumb / http link / file name / background preset
    --           or "avatar" | "headshot" | "bust" | "fullbody" for the local player
    -- Methods: SetImage / Set, Get, Reload, SetCaption, SetBadge, SetScaleType, SetColor,
    --          SetTitle, SetHeight, SetCallback
    -- =========================================================================
    function aS:Image(imageOpts)
        local parts
        imageOpts, parts = self:_mediaCard(imageOpts, 160, { HoverTint = 0.94 })
        local win = self.Window
        local media = parts.Media
        aq(parts.Placeholder, "image")

        local AVATAR_KINDS = {
            avatar = "AvatarHeadShot",
            headshot = "AvatarHeadShot",
            bust = "AvatarBust",
            fullbody = "Avatar",
            body = "Avatar",
        }
        local function toScaleType(value, fallback)
            if typeof(value) == "EnumItem" then
                return value
            end
            local ok, result = pcall(function()
                return Enum.ScaleType[tostring(value)]
            end)
            return ok and result or fallback
        end

        local image = ai("ImageLabel", {
            Name = "Content",
            Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            ImageTransparency = 1,
            ScaleType = toScaleType(imageOpts.ScaleType or "Crop", Enum.ScaleType.Crop),
            ZIndex = 4,
            Parent = media,
        })
        aj(image, UDim.new(0, 6))
        local startTint = imageOpts.Color ~= nil and k._color(imageOpts.Color) or nil
        if startTint then
            image.ImageColor3 = startTint
        end

        local contentProvider
        pcall(function()
            contentProvider = game:GetService("ContentProvider")
        end)

        local api = { Value = nil, _listeners = parts.Cleanups }
        local token = 0
        local callback = imageOpts.Callback or imageOpts.OnClick

        local function resolve(source)
            if type(source) == "number" then
                return "rbxassetid://" .. string.format("%.0f", source)
            end
            local text = tostring(source)
            local thumb = AVATAR_KINDS[string.lower(text)]
            if thumb then
                return "rbxthumb://type=" .. thumb .. "&id=" .. j.UserId .. "&w=420&h=420"
            end
            local ok, url, reason = pcall(win._resolveBackground, win, text)
            if ok then
                return url, reason
            end
            return nil, tostring(url)
        end

        -- true = loaded, false = failed, nil = replaced / destroyed meanwhile
        local function awaitLoaded(label, myToken)
            local status
            local preloaded = false
            if contentProvider then
                preloaded = pcall(function()
                    contentProvider:PreloadAsync({ label }, function(_, fetchStatus)
                        status = fetchStatus
                    end)
                end)
            end
            if token ~= myToken or not label.Parent then
                return nil
            end
            if status == Enum.AssetFetchStatus.Failure or status == Enum.AssetFetchStatus.TimedOut then
                return false
            end
            local waited = 0
            local limit = preloaded and 1.5 or 5
            while not label.IsLoaded and waited < limit and token == myToken and label.Parent do
                waited += task.wait(0.05)
            end
            if token ~= myToken or not label.Parent then
                return nil
            end
            return true
        end

        function api:SetImage(source)
            token += 1
            local myToken = token
            api.Value = source
            if source == nil or source == "" or source == "None" then
                ah(image, { ImageTransparency = 1 }, 0.2)
                parts.SetState("empty")
                task.delay(0.2, function()
                    if token == myToken and image.Parent then
                        image.Image = ""
                    end
                end)
                return true
            end
            parts.SetState("loading")
            local url, reason = resolve(source)
            if token ~= myToken then
                return false, "replaced by a newer image"
            end
            if not url then
                reason = reason or "could not load the image"
                ah(image, { ImageTransparency = 1 }, 0.15)
                parts.SetState("error", "Image unavailable")
                warn("[AirFlow] image: " .. tostring(reason))
                return false, reason
            end
            image.ImageTransparency = 1
            image.Image = url
            task.spawn(function()
                local loaded = awaitLoaded(image, myToken)
                if loaded == nil then
                    return
                end
                if loaded then
                    ah(image, { ImageTransparency = 0 }, 0.35)
                    parts.SetState("ready")
                else
                    ah(image, { ImageTransparency = 1 }, 0.15)
                    parts.SetState("error", "Image failed to load")
                end
            end)
            return true
        end
        api.Set = api.SetImage
        function api:Get()
            return api.Value
        end
        function api:Reload()
            return api:SetImage(api.Value)
        end
        function api:SetCaption(text)
            parts.SetCaption(text)
        end
        function api:SetBadge(text)
            parts.SetBadge(text)
        end
        function api:SetScaleType(scaleType)
            image.ScaleType = toScaleType(scaleType, image.ScaleType)
        end
        function api:SetColor(color)
            image.ImageColor3 = color ~= nil and k._color(color) or Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
        end
        function api:SetTitle(text)
            if parts.Title then
                parts.Title.Text = tostring(text)
            end
        end
        function api:SetHeight(height)
            parts.SetHeight(height)
        end
        function api:SetCallback(fn)
            callback = type(fn) == "function" and fn or nil
        end

        -- optional click action (ignored while the page is being scrolled)
        local pressed = false
        local scrollGuard = ay(media, function()
            return media:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("ScrollingFrame")
        end)
        media.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
            if callback and aw(input) then
                pressed = true
            end
        end)
        media.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
            if not (pressed and aw(input)) then
                return
            end
            pressed = false
            if callback and scrollGuard() and az(av(), media) then
                aE(media)
                aJ(callback, api.Value)
            end
        end)
        win:_listen("Ended", function(input)
            if aw(input) then
                task.defer(function()
                    pressed = false
                end)
            end
        end, api)

        local source = imageOpts.Image
        if source == nil then
            source = imageOpts.Source or imageOpts.Url
        end
        if source ~= nil then
            task.spawn(api.SetImage, api, source)
        end
        return m(self, imageOpts, api, parts.Frame, "Image")
    end

    -- =========================================================================
    -- Viewport
    --
    -- :Viewport({ Name, Desc, Model, Height | Aspect, Spin, SpinSpeed, Angle, Pitch, Distance,
    --             FieldOfView, Ambient, LightColor, Clone, Controls, Caption, Badge })
    --   Model = Model / BasePart / Player / function returning one / "avatar" / player name / user id
    --   Drag to orbit (mouse: yaw + pitch, touch: yaw), release to coast, auto-spin resumes when idle.
    --   Controls = false hides the hover toolbar (spin, zoom, reset).
    -- Methods: SetModel / Set, Get, Refresh, SetSpin, SetSpinSpeed, SetAngle, SetPitch, SetDistance,
    --          ZoomIn, ZoomOut, ResetView, SetFieldOfView, SetControls, SetCaption, SetBadge,
    --          SetTitle, SetHeight
    -- =========================================================================
    function aS:Viewport(viewOpts)
        local parts
        viewOpts, parts = self:_mediaCard(viewOpts, 180, { PollHover = true })
        local win = self.Window
        local media = parts.Media
        aq(parts.Placeholder, "box")

        local PITCH_MIN, PITCH_MAX = math.rad(-30), math.rad(80)
        local ZOOM_MIN, ZOOM_MAX = 0.25, 6
        local TAU = math.pi * 2
        local LIGHT_FROM_CAMERA = Vector3.new(0.55, -0.7, -0.6)

        -- soft accent halo behind the model
        local glow = ai("ImageLabel", {
            Name = "Glow",
            AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
            Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.58),
            Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.85, 0.95),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            Image = A.Glow,
            ImageColor3 = z.Accent,
            ImageTransparency = 1,
            ZIndex = 1,
            Parent = media,
        })

        local viewport = ai("ViewportFrame", {
            Name = "Content",
            Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            ImageTransparency = 1,
            Ambient = viewOpts.Ambient or Color3.fromRGB(165, 160, 175),
            LightColor = viewOpts.LightColor or Color3.fromRGB(255, 250, 245),
            LightDirection = Vector3.new(-0.6, -1, -0.8),
            ZIndex = 4,
            Parent = media,
        })
        local camera = Instance.new("Camera")
        camera.FieldOfView = math.clamp(tonumber(viewOpts.FieldOfView) or 35, 10, 90)
        camera.Parent = viewport
        viewport.CurrentCamera = camera
        local world = Instance.new("WorldModel")
        world.Parent = viewport

        local api = {
            Model = nil,
            Spin = viewOpts.Spin ~= false,
            SpinSpeed = tonumber(viewOpts.SpinSpeed) or 25,
            _listeners = parts.Cleanups,
        }
        local startYaw = math.rad(tonumber(viewOpts.Angle) or 0)
        local startPitch = math.clamp(math.rad(tonumber(viewOpts.Pitch) or 10), PITCH_MIN, PITCH_MAX)
        local startZoom = math.clamp(tonumber(viewOpts.Distance) or 1, ZOOM_MIN, ZOOM_MAX)
        local yaw, pitch, zoom = startYaw, startPitch, startZoom
        local pitchGoal, zoomGoal, yawGoal = pitch, zoom, nil
        local yawVelocity = 0
        local spinBlend = 0
        local idleUntil = 0
        local dragging, lastX, lastY, lastMoveAt = false, 0, 0, 0
        local focus, modelRadius, baseDistance, baseRotation = nil, 1, 10, CFrame.new()
        local source, generation = nil, 0

        local function updateCamera()
            if not focus then
                return
            end
            local cosPitch = math.cos(pitch)
            local direction = baseRotation:VectorToWorldSpace(
                Vector3.new(math.sin(yaw) * cosPitch, math.sin(pitch), -math.cos(yaw) * cosPitch)
            )
            local cameraCFrame = CFrame.lookAt(focus + direction * (baseDistance * zoom), focus)
            camera.CFrame = cameraCFrame
            viewport.LightDirection = cameraCFrame:VectorToWorldSpace(LIGHT_FROM_CAMERA)
        end

        -- distance that keeps the model's bounding sphere inside the frame (wide or tall)
        local function computeDistance()
            local halfFov = math.rad(camera.FieldOfView / 2)
            local size = media.AbsoluteSize
            local ratio = size.Y > 0 and size.X / size.Y or 1
            local half = math.min(halfFov, math.atan(math.tan(halfFov) * ratio))
            baseDistance = modelRadius / math.tan(math.max(half, 0.05))
        end

        local function frameModel(target)
            local boxCFrame, boxSize
            if target:IsA("Model") then
                boxCFrame, boxSize = target:GetBoundingBox()
                baseRotation = target:GetPivot().Rotation
            elseif target:IsA("BasePart") then
                boxCFrame, boxSize = target.CFrame, target.Size
                baseRotation = target.CFrame.Rotation
            else
                return false
            end
            focus = boxCFrame.Position
            modelRadius = math.max(boxSize.Magnitude / 2, 0.5)
            computeDistance()
            updateCamera()
            return true
        end

        local function prepare(target)
            local copy = target
            if viewOpts.Clone ~= false then
                local wasArchivable = target.Archivable
                pcall(function()
                    target.Archivable = true
                end)
                local ok, cloned = pcall(target.Clone, target)
                pcall(function()
                    target.Archivable = wasArchivable
                end)
                copy = ok and cloned or nil
            end
            if not copy then
                return nil
            end
            for _, descendant in ipairs(copy:GetDescendants()) do
                pcall(function()
                    if descendant:IsA("LuaSourceContainer") or descendant:IsA("Sound") or descendant:IsA("ForceField") then
                        descendant:Destroy()
                    elseif descendant:IsA("BasePart") then
                        descendant.Anchored = true
                        descendant.CanCollide = false
                    end
                end)
            end
            if copy:IsA("BasePart") then
                copy.Anchored = true
            end
            local humanoid = copy:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if humanoid then
                humanoid.DisplayDistanceType = Enum.HumanoidDisplayDistanceType.None
            end
            return copy
        end

        -- Instance | Player | function | "avatar" | player name | user id  ->  Instance (or nil)
        local function resolveTarget(value, myGeneration)
            if type(value) == "function" then
                local ok, result = pcall(value)
                value = ok and result or nil
            end
            local players = game:GetService("Players")
            if type(value) == "string" then
                if ({ avatar = true, player = true, character = true })[string.lower(value)] then
                    value = j
                else
                    local found = players:FindFirstChild(value)
                    value = found and found:IsA("Player") and found or value
                end
            elseif type(value) == "number" then
                value = players:GetPlayerByUserId(value)
            end
            if typeof(value) == "Instance" and value:IsA("Player") then
                local character = value.Character
                if not character then
                    local started = os.clock()
                    while not value.Character and os.clock() - started < 6 and generation == myGeneration do
                        task.wait(0.1)
                    end
                    character = value.Character
                    if character then
                        task.wait(0.4)
                    end
                end
                value = character
            end
            return typeof(value) == "Instance" and value or nil
        end

        function api:SetModel(target)
            generation += 1
            local myGeneration = generation
            source = target
            if api.Model then
                api.Model:Destroy()
                api.Model = nil
            end
            focus = nil
            if target == nil then
                ah(viewport, { ImageTransparency = 1 }, 0.2)
                ah(glow, { ImageTransparency = 1 }, 0.2)
                parts.SetState("empty")
                return true
            end
            ah(glow, { ImageTransparency = 1 }, 0.15)
            parts.SetState("loading")
            local instance = resolveTarget(target, myGeneration)
            if generation ~= myGeneration then
                return false, "replaced by a newer model"
            end
            if not instance then
                parts.SetState("error", "No model to show")
                return false, "no model to show"
            end
            local copy = prepare(instance)
            if not copy then
                parts.SetState("error", "Could not copy the model")
                return false, "could not copy the model"
            end
            copy.Parent = world
            api.Model = copy
            if not frameModel(copy) then
                copy:Destroy()
                api.Model = nil
                parts.SetState("error", "Not a model or part")
                return false, "not a Model or a part"
            end
            viewport.ImageTransparency = 1
            ah(viewport, { ImageTransparency = 0 }, 0.35)
            ah(glow, { ImageTransparency = 0.88 }, 0.6)
            parts.SetState("ready")
            return true
        end
        api.Set = api.SetModel
        function api:Get()
            return api.Model
        end
        function api:Refresh()
            return api:SetModel(source)
        end

        -- hover toolbar (spin / zoom / reset) -------------------------------------------------
        local controlsOn = viewOpts.Controls ~= false
        local buttonSize = E and 28 or 22
        local toolbar = ai("CanvasGroup", {
            Name = "Controls",
            AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0),
            Position = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 8),
            Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, buttonSize + 6),
            AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X,
            BackgroundColor3 = z.Surface,
            BackgroundTransparency = 0.2,
            BorderSizePixel = 0,
            GroupTransparency = E and 0.2 or 1,
            Visible = controlsOn,
            ZIndex = 8,
            Parent = media,
        })
        aj(toolbar, UDim.new(0, 8))
        ak(toolbar, z.Stroke)
        al(toolbar, 3, 3, 3, 3)
        ai("UIListLayout", {
            FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal,
            VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center,
            SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
            Padding = UDim.new(0, 2),
            Parent = toolbar,
        })

        local function makeControl(order, iconName, fallbackText, onClick)
            local button = ai("TextButton", {
                Name = "Control" .. order,
                Size = UDim2.fromOffset(buttonSize, buttonSize),
                BackgroundColor3 = z.Accent,
                BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                BorderSizePixel = 0,
                AutoButtonColor = false,
                Text = "",
                LayoutOrder = order,
                ZIndex = 9,
                Parent = toolbar,
            })
            aj(button, UDim.new(0, 6))
            local glyph = ai("ImageLabel", {
                AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
                Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5),
                Size = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 14),
                BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                ImageColor3 = z.Muted,
                ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit,
                ZIndex = 10,
                Parent = button,
            })
            aq(glyph, iconName)
            local textGlyph
            if glyph.Image == "" then
                glyph:Destroy()
                glyph = nil
                textGlyph = am({
                    Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
                    Text = fallbackText,
                    TextSize = 14,
                    TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center,
                    TextColor3 = z.Muted,
                    TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.None,
                    ZIndex = 10,
                    Parent = button,
                })
            end
            button.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
                ah(button, { BackgroundTransparency = 0.86 }, 0.1)
                if glyph then
                    ah(glyph, { ImageColor3 = z.Text }, 0.1)
                else
                    ah(textGlyph, { TextColor3 = z.Text }, 0.1)
                end
            end)
            button.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
                ah(button, { BackgroundTransparency = 1 }, 0.18)
                if glyph then
                    ah(glyph, { ImageColor3 = z.Muted }, 0.18)
                else
                    ah(textGlyph, { TextColor3 = z.Muted }, 0.18)
                end
            end)
            button.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                aJ(onClick)
            end)
            return button, glyph, textGlyph
        end

        local spinButton, spinGlyph, spinText
        local function refreshSpinIcon()
            if spinGlyph then
                aq(spinGlyph, api.Spin and "pause" or "play")
            elseif spinText then
                spinText.Text = api.Spin and "||" or ">"
            end
        end
        function api:SetSpin(on)
            api.Spin = on ~= false
            spinBlend = 0
            refreshSpinIcon()
        end
        function api:SetSpinSpeed(speed)
            api.SpinSpeed = tonumber(speed) or api.SpinSpeed
        end
        function api:SetAngle(degrees)
            yaw = math.rad(tonumber(degrees) or 0)
            yawGoal, yawVelocity = nil, 0
            updateCamera()
        end
        function api:SetPitch(degrees)
            pitchGoal = math.clamp(math.rad(tonumber(degrees) or 0), PITCH_MIN, PITCH_MAX)
        end
        function api:SetDistance(value)
            zoomGoal = math.clamp(tonumber(value) or 1, ZOOM_MIN, ZOOM_MAX)
        end
        function api:ZoomIn()
            zoomGoal = math.clamp(zoomGoal * 0.8, ZOOM_MIN, ZOOM_MAX)
        end
        function api:ZoomOut()
            zoomGoal = math.clamp(zoomGoal * 1.25, ZOOM_MIN, ZOOM_MAX)
        end
        function api:ResetView()
            yawGoal = startYaw
            yawVelocity = 0
            pitchGoal = startPitch
            zoomGoal = startZoom
            idleUntil = os.clock() + 0.8
        end
        function api:SetFieldOfView(degrees)
            camera.FieldOfView = math.clamp(tonumber(degrees) or camera.FieldOfView, 10, 90)
            if focus then
                computeDistance()
                updateCamera()
            end
        end
        function api:SetControls(on)
            controlsOn = on ~= false
            toolbar.Visible = controlsOn
        end
        function api:SetCaption(text)
            parts.SetCaption(text)
        end
        function api:SetBadge(text)
            parts.SetBadge(text)
        end
        function api:SetTitle(text)
            if parts.Title then
                parts.Title.Text = tostring(text)
            end
        end
        function api:SetHeight(height)
            parts.SetHeight(height)
        end

        spinButton, spinGlyph, spinText = makeControl(1, api.Spin and "pause" or "play", api.Spin and "||" or ">", function()
            api:SetSpin(not api.Spin)
        end)
        makeControl(2, "zoom-in", "+", function()
            api:ZoomIn()
        end)
        makeControl(3, "zoom-out", "-", function()
            api:ZoomOut()
        end)
        makeControl(4, "rotate-ccw", "R", function()
            api:ResetView()
        end)

        local toolbarShown = false
        local function showToolbar(on)
