            on = (on and controlsOn) and true or false
            if on == toolbarShown or E then
                return
            end
            toolbarShown = on
            ah(toolbar, { GroupTransparency = on and 0 or 1 }, 0.18)
        end

        media:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(function()
            if focus then
                computeDistance()
                updateCamera()
            end
        end)

        -- drag to orbit ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        local function pointerOnToolbar()
            return controlsOn and az(av(), toolbar)
        end
        media.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
            if aw(input) and api.Model and not pointerOnToolbar() then
                dragging = true
                yawGoal = nil
                yawVelocity = 0
                local pointer = av()
                lastX, lastY = pointer.X, pointer.Y
                lastMoveAt = os.clock()
            end
        end)
        win:_listen("Changed", function(input)
            if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then
                local inside = win.Open and not win.Minimized and az(av(), media)
                parts.SetHover(inside)
                showToolbar(inside)
            end
            if dragging and aA(input) then
                local pointer = av()
                local dx, dy = pointer.X - lastX, pointer.Y - lastY
                lastX, lastY = pointer.X, pointer.Y
                local now = os.clock()
                local dt = math.max(now - lastMoveAt, 1 / 240)
                lastMoveAt = now
                local deltaYaw = -dx * 0.012
                yaw += deltaYaw
                yawVelocity = math.clamp(yawVelocity * 0.5 + (deltaYaw / dt) * 0.5, -12, 12)
                if not ax() then
                    pitchGoal = math.clamp(pitchGoal + dy * 0.008, PITCH_MIN, PITCH_MAX)
                    pitch = pitchGoal
                end
                updateCamera()
            end
        end, api)
        win:_listen("Ended", function(input)
            if dragging and aw(input) then
                dragging = false
                idleUntil = os.clock() + 1.5
                if os.clock() - lastMoveAt > 0.08 then
                    yawVelocity = 0
                end
            end
        end, api)
        win:_listen("Render", function(dt)
            if not (api.Model and focus and win.Open and not win.Minimized and parts.Frame.Visible) then
                return
            end
            local changed = false
            local blend = 1 - math.exp(-12 * dt)
            if not dragging then
                if yawGoal then
                    local diff = (yawGoal - yaw + math.pi) % TAU - math.pi
                    yaw += diff * blend
                    if math.abs(diff) < 0.002 then
                        yaw = yawGoal
                        yawGoal = nil
                    end
                    changed = true
                else
                    if yawVelocity ~= 0 then
                        yaw += yawVelocity * dt
                        yawVelocity *= math.exp(-3.2 * dt)
                        if math.abs(yawVelocity) < 0.03 then
                            yawVelocity = 0
                        end
                        changed = true
                    end
                    if api.Spin and os.clock() >= idleUntil then
                        spinBlend = math.min(spinBlend + dt * 1.4, 1)
                        yaw += math.rad(api.SpinSpeed) * dt * spinBlend
                        changed = true
                    else
                        spinBlend = 0
                    end
                end
                if math.abs(pitchGoal - pitch) > 0.0005 then
                    pitch += (pitchGoal - pitch) * blend
                    changed = true
                end
            end
            if math.abs(zoomGoal - zoom) > 0.0005 then
                zoom += (zoomGoal - zoom) * blend
                changed = true
            end
            if changed then
                updateCamera()
            end
        end, api)

        local initial = viewOpts.Model
        if initial == nil then
            initial = viewOpts.Target or viewOpts.Instance
        end
        if initial ~= nil then
            task.spawn(api.SetModel, api, initial)
        end
        return m(self, viewOpts, api, parts.Frame, "Viewport")
    end

                TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,

        local tableFrame = ai("Frame", {

            BackgroundTransparency = 0.2,
            BorderSizePixel = 0,

            Parent = card,

        ak(tableFrame, z.Stroke)
        local headerFrame = ai("Frame", {
            Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, headerHeight),
            BackgroundColor3 = z.Surface3,
            BackgroundTransparency = 0.45,
            BorderSizePixel = 0,
            Parent = tableFrame,
        })
        ai("Frame", {
            AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 1),
            Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 1),
            Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 1),
            BackgroundColor3 = z.Stroke,
            BorderSizePixel = 0,
            Parent = headerFrame,
        })

        -- positioned by hand inside a fixed-height canvas, so big data sets stay cheap.
        local scroll = ai("ScrollingFrame", {
            Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, headerHeight),
            Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, -headerHeight),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            BorderSizePixel = 0,
            ScrollBarThickness = 2,

            ScrollBarImageTransparency = 0.4,

            FontFace = D.Regular,

            TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center,

        local footerLabel
        if footerEnabled then
            footerLabel = am({
                AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 1),
                Position = UDim2.new(0, sidePad + 4, 1, -(bottomPad + 1)),
                Size = UDim2.new(1, -(sidePad * 2 + 8), 0, 16),
                Text = "",
                TextSize = 11,
                FontFace = D.Regular,
                TextColor3 = z.Muted,
                Parent = card,
            })
        end

        local api = { Rows = {}, _listeners = {} }
        local columns = {}
        local headerCells = {}
        local pool = {}
        local poolSize = maxRows + 2
        local view = {}
        local viewVersion = 0
        local lastFirst = nil
        local lastCardHeight = nil
        local searchQuery = ""
        local sortColumn, sortDescending = nil, false
        local searchCache = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
        local medalColors = { Color3.fromRGB(245, 200, 90), Color3.fromRGB(200, 206, 218), Color3.fromRGB(214, 146, 96) }
        local rebuildView, renderRows
        local selectedRow = nil

        local function alignmentOf(column)
            local align = type(column.Align) == "string" and column.Align:lower() or nil
            if align == "right" then
                return Enum.TextXAlignment.Right
            elseif align == "center" or align == "centre" then
                return Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
            end
            return Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
        end
        -- Width > 1: pixels, 0 < Width <= 1: share of what the fixed columns leave, nil: split what is left evenly
        local function layoutColumns()
            local fixed, fractions, flexible = 0, 0, 0
            for index, column in ipairs(columns) do
                local width = tonumber(column.Width)
                if width and width > 1 then
                    fixed = fixed + width
                elseif width and width > 0 then
                    fractions = fractions + width
                else
                    flexible = flexible + 1
                end
            end
            local remaining = math.max(1 - fractions, 0)
            for index, column in ipairs(columns) do
                local width = tonumber(column.Width)
                if width and width > 1 then
                    column.UDim = UDim.new(0, width)
                else
                    local share = (width and width > 0) and width or (flexible > 0 and remaining / flexible or 0)
                    column.UDim = UDim.new(share, -fixed * share)
                end
            end
        end
        local function cellValue(row, column)
            if column.Rank then
                return nil
            end
            if row[1] ~= nil or column.Key == nil then
                return row[column.Index]
            end
            return row[column.Key]
        end
        local function formatCell(value, column, row)
            if type(column.Format) == "function" then
                local ok, result = pcall(column.Format, value, row)
                if ok and result ~= nil then
                    return tostring(result)
                end
            end
            local text
            if type(value) == "number" then
                text = k._formatNumber(value, column.Decimals, column.Separator, column.Abbreviate)
            elseif value == nil then
                return ""
            else
                text = tostring(value)
            end
            if column.Prefix ~= nil or column.Suffix ~= nil then
                text = tostring(column.Prefix or "") .. text .. tostring(column.Suffix or "")
            end
            return text
        end
        local function findColumn(target)
            if type(target) == "number" then
                return columns[target + (options.Rank and 1 or 0)]
            end
            for index, column in ipairs(columns) do
                if not column.Rank and (column.Key == target or column.Name == target) then
                    return column
                end
            end
            return nil
        end
        local function invalidateSearch()
            searchCache = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
        end
        local function searchTextOf(row)
            local cached = searchCache[row]
            if cached then
                return cached
            end
            local parts = {}
            for index, column in ipairs(columns) do
                if not column.Rank then
                    local text = formatCell(cellValue(row, column), column, row)
                    parts[#parts + 1] = string.lower((string.gsub(text, "<[^>]->", "")))
                end
            end
            cached = table.concat(parts, "\n")
            searchCache[row] = cached
            return cached
        end
        -- numbers sort before text, text before empty cells; empty cells stay last in both directions
        local function sortKeyOf(row, column)
            local raw = cellValue(row, column)
            if raw == nil then
                return 3, nil
            end
            local number = tonumber(raw)
            if number ~= nil and number == number then
                return 1, number
            end
            return 2, string.lower(tostring(raw))
        end
        local function computeView()
            local entries = {}
            for index, row in ipairs(api.Rows) do
                entries[index] = { Row = row, Index = index }
            end
            if sortColumn then
                for index, entry in ipairs(entries) do
                    entry.TypeRank, entry.SortKey = sortKeyOf(entry.Row, sortColumn)
                end
                local descending = sortDescending
                table.sort(entries, function(left, right)
                    if left.TypeRank ~= right.TypeRank then
                        return left.TypeRank < right.TypeRank
                    end
                    if left.TypeRank ~= 3 and left.SortKey ~= right.SortKey then
                        if descending then
                            return left.SortKey > right.SortKey
                        end
                        return left.SortKey < right.SortKey
                    end
                    return left.Index < right.Index
                end)
            end
            -- rank follows the sort order but ignores the search filter
            for position, entry in ipairs(entries) do
                entry.Rank = position
            end
            if searchQuery == "" then
                return entries
            end
            local matches = {}
            for index, entry in ipairs(entries) do
                if string.find(searchTextOf(entry.Row), searchQuery, 1, true) then
                    matches[#matches + 1] = entry
                end
            end
            return matches
        end

        local function updateHeaderStyle()
            for index, cell in ipairs(headerCells) do
                local sorted = sortColumn ~= nil and sortColumn == cell.Column
                ah(cell.Label, { TextColor3 = sorted and z.Text or z.Muted }, 0.15)
                cell.Arrow.Visible = sorted
                if sorted then
                    ah(cell.Arrow, { Rotation = sortDescending and 0 or 180 }, 0.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint)
                end
            end
        end
        local function buildHeader()
            for index, cell in ipairs(headerCells) do
                cell.Frame:Destroy()
            end
            table.clear(headerCells)
            local container = headerFrame:FindFirstChild("Cells")
                or ai("Frame", { Name = "Cells", Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Parent = headerFrame })
            if not container:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIListLayout") then
                al(container, 10, 10)
                ai("UIListLayout", {
                    FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal,
                    VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center,
                    SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
                    Parent = container,
                })
            end
            for columnIndex, column in ipairs(columns) do
                local button = ai("TextButton", {
                    Size = UDim2.new(column.UDim.Scale, column.UDim.Offset, 1, 0),
                    BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                    AutoButtonColor = false,
                    Text = "",
                    LayoutOrder = columnIndex,
                    Parent = container,
                })
                local alignment = column.Rank and Enum.TextXAlignment.Center or alignmentOf(column)
                local rightAligned = alignment == Enum.TextXAlignment.Right
                local label = am({
                    Size = UDim2.new(1, alignment == Enum.TextXAlignment.Center and 0 or -16, 1, 0),
                    Position = UDim2.fromOffset(rightAligned and 16 or 0, 0),
                    Text = string.upper(tostring(column.Name)),
                    TextSize = 11,
                    FontFace = D.Bold,
                    TextColor3 = z.Muted,
                    TextXAlignment = alignment,
                    Parent = button,
                })
                local arrow = ai("ImageLabel", {
                    AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5),
                    Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.5, 0),
                    Size = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 12),
                    BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                    ImageColor3 = z.Accent,
                    ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit,
                    Visible = false,
                    Parent = button,
                })
                aq(arrow, "chevron-down")
                local function placeArrow()
                    local textWidth = label.TextBounds.X
                    if rightAligned then
                        arrow.Position = UDim2.new(1, -(textWidth + 15), 0.5, 0)
                    elseif alignment == Enum.TextXAlignment.Center then
                        arrow.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, textWidth / 2 + 3, 0.5, 0)
                    else
                        local cellWidth = button.AbsoluteSize.X / math.max(window.Scale.Scale, 0.01)
                        arrow.Position = UDim2.new(0, math.clamp(textWidth + 4, 0, math.max(cellWidth - 12, 0)), 0.5, 0)
                    end
                end
                label:GetPropertyChangedSignal("TextBounds"):Connect(placeArrow)
                button:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(placeArrow)
                task.defer(placeArrow)
                if column.Sortable and not column.Rank then
                    button.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
                        if sortColumn ~= column then
                            ah(label, { TextColor3 = z.Text }, 0.12)
                        end
                    end)
                    button.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
                        if sortColumn ~= column then
                            ah(label, { TextColor3 = z.Muted }, 0.2)
                        end
                    end)
                    -- click cycle: first direction (numbers high to low, text A to Z) -> reversed -> unsorted
                    button.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                        if sortColumn ~= column then
                            local numeric = false
                            for index, row in ipairs(api.Rows) do
                                local value = cellValue(row, column)
                                if value ~= nil then
                                    numeric = tonumber(value) ~= nil
                                    break
                                end
                            end
                            sortColumn, sortDescending = column, numeric
                            column.FirstDescending = numeric
                        elseif sortDescending == column.FirstDescending then
                            sortDescending = not sortDescending
                        else
                            sortColumn = nil
                        end
                        updateHeaderStyle()
                        rebuildView()
                    end)
                end
                table.insert(headerCells, { Frame = button, Label = label, Arrow = arrow, Column = column })
            end
            updateHeaderStyle()
        end

        -- click selects a row when Selectable = true (click it again to deselect)
        local function selectRow(row, rowIndex)
            if row == selectedRow then
                row, rowIndex = nil, nil
            end
            selectedRow = row
            renderRows(true)
            aJ(options.OnSelect, row, rowIndex)
        end
        local function createSlot()
            local button = ai("TextButton", {
                Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, rowHeight),
                BackgroundColor3 = z.Surface3,
                BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                BorderSizePixel = 0,
                AutoButtonColor = false,
                Text = "",
                Parent = scroll,
            })
            local marker = ai("Frame", {
                Position = UDim2.new(0, 3, 0.5, 0),
                AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5),
                Size = UDim2.new(0, 2, 1, -10),
                BackgroundColor3 = z.Accent,
                BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                BorderSizePixel = 0,
                Parent = button,
            })
            aj(marker, UDim.new(1, 0))
            local cellsFrame = ai("Frame", { Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Parent = button })
            al(cellsFrame, 10, 10)
            ai("UIListLayout", {
                FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal,
                VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center,
                SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
                Parent = cellsFrame,
            })
            local slot = { Frame = button, Marker = marker, Cells = {}, Hover = false }
            for columnIndex, column in ipairs(columns) do
                local cellFrame = ai("Frame", {
                    Size = UDim2.new(column.UDim.Scale, column.UDim.Offset, 1, 0),
                    BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                    LayoutOrder = columnIndex,
                    Parent = cellsFrame,
                })
                local label = am({
                    Size = UDim2.new(1, -6, 1, 0),
                    TextSize = cellTextSize,
                    FontFace = column.Rank and D.Bold or D.Regular,
                    TextColor3 = z.Text,
                    TextXAlignment = alignmentOf(column),
                    RichText = not column.Rank,
                    Parent = cellFrame,
                })
                local badge
                if column.Rank then
                    label.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
                    label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
                    badge = ai("Frame", {
                        AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
                        Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5),
                        Size = UDim2.fromOffset(rowHeight - 8, rowHeight - 8),
                        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                        BorderSizePixel = 0,
                        ZIndex = 0,
                        Parent = cellFrame,
                    })
                    aj(badge, UDim.new(1, 0))
                end
                local pillObject, barTrack, barFill
                if column.Type == "Badge" then
                    label.Visible = false
                    local anchorX = 0
                    local alignName = type(column.Align) == "string" and column.Align:lower() or ""
                    if alignName == "right" then
                        anchorX = 1
                    elseif alignName == "center" or alignName == "centre" then
                        anchorX = 0.5
                    end
                    pillObject = k._pill(cellFrame, {
                        AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(anchorX, 0.5),
                        Position = UDim2.new(anchorX, anchorX == 1 and -6 or 0, 0.5, 0),
                        Height = math.max(rowHeight - 10, 14),
                        TextSize = math.max(cellTextSize - 1, 10),
                        PadX = 8,
                        Dot = column.Dot ~= false,
                        RichText = true,
                    })
                elseif column.Type == "Bar" then
                    local showValue = column.ShowValue ~= false
                    local textWidth = showValue and 42 or 0
                    label.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0)
                    label.Position = UDim2.new(1, -6, 0, 0)
                    label.Size = UDim2.new(0, textWidth, 1, 0)
                    label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right
                    label.Visible = showValue
                    barTrack = ai("Frame", {
                        AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5),
                        Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.5, 0),
                        Size = UDim2.new(1, -(textWidth + 10), 0, 4),
                        BackgroundColor3 = z.Surface3,
                        BorderSizePixel = 0,
                        ClipsDescendants = true,
                        Parent = cellFrame,
                    })
                    aj(barTrack, UDim.new(1, 0))
                    barFill = ai("Frame", {
                        Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0),
                        BackgroundColor3 = z.Accent,
                        BorderSizePixel = 0,
                        Parent = barTrack,
                    })
                    aj(barFill, UDim.new(1, 0))
                end
                slot.Cells[columnIndex] = { Label = label, Badge = badge, Pill = pillObject, Track = barTrack, Fill = barFill }
            end
            local canClick = ay(button, function()
                return scroll
            end)
            local function setHover(on)
                if slot.Hover == on then
                    return
                end
                slot.Hover = on
                if on then
                    ah(button, { BackgroundTransparency = slot.Highlighted and 0.74 or 0.35 }, 0.1)
                else
                    ah(button, {
                        BackgroundColor3 = slot.Highlighted and z.Accent or z.Surface3,
                        BackgroundTransparency = slot.Rest or 1,
                    }, 0.2)
                end
            end
            button.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
                setHover(true)
            end)
            button.MouseMoved:Connect(function()
                setHover(true)
            end)
            button.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
                setHover(false)
            end)
            button.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                if slot.Data and canClick() then
                    if options.Selectable == true then
                        selectRow(slot.Data, slot.Index)
                    end
                    aJ(options.Callback, slot.Data, slot.Index)
                end
            end)
            return slot
        end
        local function bindSlot(slot, entry, viewIndex)
            local row = entry.Row
            slot.Data = row
            slot.Index = entry.Index
            slot.BoundIndex = viewIndex
            slot.BoundVersion = viewVersion
            slot.Frame.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, (viewIndex - 1) * rowHeight)
            slot.Frame.Visible = true
            local highlighted = row.Highlight == true
            if not highlighted and type(options.Highlight) == "function" then
                local ok, result = pcall(options.Highlight, row, entry.Index)
                highlighted = ok and result == true
            end
            local selected = selectedRow ~= nil and row == selectedRow
            local accented = highlighted or selected
            slot.Highlighted = accented
            slot.Rest = selected and 0.82 or (highlighted and 0.86 or (viewIndex % 2 == 0 and 0.78 or 1))
            slot.Hover = false
            ah(slot.Frame, {
                BackgroundColor3 = accented and z.Accent or z.Surface3,
                BackgroundTransparency = slot.Rest,
            }, 0)
            slot.Marker.BackgroundTransparency = accented and 0 or 1
            for columnIndex, column in ipairs(columns) do
                local cell = slot.Cells[columnIndex]
                if column.Rank then
                    local medal = medalColors[entry.Rank]
                    cell.Label.Text = tostring(entry.Rank)
                    ah(cell.Label, { TextColor3 = medal and Color3.fromRGB(28, 22, 18) or z.Muted }, 0)
                    ah(cell.Badge, {
                        BackgroundColor3 = medal or z.Surface3,
                        BackgroundTransparency = medal and 0.05 or 1,
                    }, 0)
                else
                    local value = cellValue(row, column)
                    local cellText = formatCell(value, column, row)
                    cell.Label.Text = k._rich(cellText)
                    local colorSpec = column.Color
                    if colorSpec == nil and column.Tones ~= nil and value ~= nil then
                        colorSpec = column.Tones[string.lower(tostring(value))]
                    end
                    if type(colorSpec) == "function" then
                        local ok, result = pcall(colorSpec, value, row)
                        colorSpec = ok and result or nil
                    end
                    if type(row.Colors) == "table" then
                        local override = row.Colors[column.Key or column.Index]
                        if override == nil then
                            override = row.Colors[column.Index]
                        end
                        if override ~= nil then
                            colorSpec = override
                        end
                    end
                    if cell.Pill then
                        cell.Pill.Frame.Visible = cellText ~= ""
                        cell.Pill.Label.Text = k._rich(cellText)
                        cell.Pill.Paint(k._color(colorSpec) or z.Muted, 0)
                    else
                        ah(cell.Label, { TextColor3 = k._color(colorSpec) or (highlighted and z.Accent or z.Text) }, 0)
                    end
                    if cell.Fill then
                        local number = tonumber(value)
                        local share = 0
                        if number ~= nil then
                            local maximum = tonumber(column.Max) or (number <= 1 and 1 or 100)
                            share = maximum > 0 and math.clamp(number / maximum, 0, 1) or 0
                        end
                        cell.Track.Visible = number ~= nil
                        local barColor = k._color(colorSpec)
                        if not barColor and column.Stops and #column.Stops > 0 then
                            barColor = k._color(k._pickStop(column.Stops, share))
                        end
                        cell.Fill.Size = UDim2.new(share, 0, 1, 0)
                        ah(cell.Fill, { BackgroundColor3 = barColor or z.Accent }, 0)
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        local function resetPool()
            for index, slot in ipairs(pool) do
                slot.Frame:Destroy()
            end
            pool = {}
            poolSize = maxRows + 2
            lastFirst = nil
        end
        function renderRows(force)
            local count = #view
            local first = math.clamp(math.floor(scroll.CanvasPosition.Y / rowHeight) + 1, 1, math.max(count, 1))
            if not force and first == lastFirst then
                return
            end
            lastFirst = first
            for slotNumber = 1, poolSize do
                local viewIndex = first + ((slotNumber - first) % poolSize)
                local slot = pool[slotNumber]
                if viewIndex <= count then
                    if not slot then
                        slot = createSlot()
                        pool[slotNumber] = slot
                    end
                    if force or slot.BoundIndex ~= viewIndex or slot.BoundVersion ~= viewVersion then
                        bindSlot(slot, view[viewIndex], viewIndex)
                    end
                elseif slot then
                    slot.Frame.Visible = false
                    slot.Data = nil
                    slot.BoundIndex = nil
                end
            end
        end
        local function updateLayout(instant)
            local count = #view
            local visibleRows = math.clamp(count, 1, maxRows)
            local tableHeight = headerHeight + visibleRows * rowHeight
            local cardHeight = tableTop + tableHeight + footerHeight + bottomPad
            scroll.CanvasSize = UDim2.fromOffset(0, count * rowHeight)
            local maxScroll = math.max(count - visibleRows, 0) * rowHeight
            if scroll.CanvasPosition.Y > maxScroll then
                scroll.CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(0, maxScroll)
            end
            if lastCardHeight == cardHeight then
                return
            end
            local duration = (instant or lastCardHeight == nil) and 0 or 0.25
            lastCardHeight = cardHeight
            ah(tableFrame, { Size = UDim2.new(1, -sidePad * 2, 0, tableHeight) }, duration, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint)
            ah(card, { Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, cardHeight) }, duration, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint)
        end
        local function updateFooter()
            if not footerLabel then
                return
            end
            local total, shown = #api.Rows, #view
            local text
            if type(options.FooterFormat) == "function" then
                local ok, result = pcall(options.FooterFormat, shown, total, sortColumn and sortColumn.Name or nil, sortDescending)
                if ok and result ~= nil then
                    text = tostring(result)
                end
            end
            if text == nil then
                if total == 0 then
                    text = ""
                elseif shown ~= total then
                    text = shown .. " of " .. total .. " rows"
                else
                    text = total .. (total == 1 and " row" or " rows")
                end
                if sortColumn and total > 0 then
                    text = text .. "  \u{b7}  sorted by " .. tostring(sortColumn.Name) .. (sortDescending and " (desc)" or " (asc)")
                end
            end
            footerLabel.Text = text
        end
        function rebuildView()
            if selectedRow ~= nil and not table.find(api.Rows, selectedRow) then
                selectedRow = nil
            end
            view = computeView()
            viewVersion = viewVersion + 1
            emptyLabel.Visible = #view == 0
            emptyLabel.Text = (#view == 0 and searchQuery ~= "" and #api.Rows > 0) and tostring(options.NoMatchText or "No rows match")
                or tostring(options.EmptyText or "Nothing here yet")
            if countLabel then
                countLabel.Visible = searchQuery ~= ""
                countLabel.Text = #view .. " / " .. #api.Rows
            end
            if clearButton then
                clearButton.Visible = searchQuery ~= ""
            end
            updateFooter()
            updateLayout(false)
            renderRows(true)
        end
        scroll:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CanvasPosition"):Connect(function()
            renderRows(false)
        end)
        local function flashRow(rowIndex)
            for index, slot in ipairs(pool) do
                if slot.Index == rowIndex and slot.Frame.Visible then
                    local restColor = slot.Highlighted and z.Accent or z.Surface3
                    ah(slot.Frame, { BackgroundColor3 = z.Accent, BackgroundTransparency = 0.7 }, 0.08)
                    task.delay(0.1, function()
                        if not slot.Hover and slot.Frame.Parent then
                            ah(slot.Frame, { BackgroundColor3 = restColor, BackgroundTransparency = slot.Rest }, 0.5)
                        end
                    end)
                    break
                end
            end
        end

        function api:SetColumns(newColumns)
            table.clear(columns)
            if options.Rank then
                table.insert(columns, { Name = "#", Rank = true, Width = E and 40 or 36, Sortable = false })
            end
            for index, entry in ipairs(type(newColumns) == "table" and newColumns or {}) do
                if type(entry) ~= "table" then
                    entry = { Name = tostring(entry) }
                end
                local name = entry.Name or entry.Title or ("Column " .. index)
                -- Type = "Badge" (tinted pill) or "Bar" (mini progress bar)
                local typeName = type(entry.Type) == "string" and string.lower(entry.Type) or ""
                local typeKey = nil
                if typeName == "badge" or typeName == "tag" then
                    typeKey = "Badge"
                elseif typeName == "bar" or typeName == "progress" then
                    typeKey = "Bar"
                end
                local toneMap = nil
                if type(entry.Tones) == "table" then
                    toneMap = {}
                    for toneKey, toneValue in pairs(entry.Tones) do
                        toneMap[string.lower(tostring(toneKey))] = toneValue
                    end
                end
                table.insert(columns, {
                    Name = name,
                    Key = entry.Key or name,
                    Index = index,
                    Width = entry.Width,
                    Align = entry.Align,
                    Format = entry.Format,
                    Color = entry.Color,
                    Sortable = entry.Sortable ~= false and options.Sortable ~= false,
                    Type = typeKey,
                    Tones = toneMap,
                    Max = entry.Max,
                    Stops = (entry.Thresholds ~= nil or entry.AutoColor ~= nil) and k._buildStops(entry.Thresholds, entry.AutoColor)
                        or nil,
                    Decimals = entry.Decimals,
                    Separator = entry.Separator,
                    Abbreviate = entry.Abbreviate,
                    Prefix = entry.Prefix,
                    Suffix = entry.Suffix,
                    Dot = entry.Dot,
                    ShowValue = entry.ShowValue,
                })
            end
            sortColumn = nil
            layoutColumns()
            buildHeader()
            resetPool()
            invalidateSearch()
            rebuildView()
        end
        function api:SetRows(newRows)
            api.Rows = {}
            for index, row in ipairs(type(newRows) == "table" and newRows or {}) do
                api.Rows[index] = type(row) == "table" and row or { row }
            end
            invalidateSearch()
            rebuildView()
        end
        api.Set = api.SetRows
        function api:GetRows()
            return api.Rows
        end
        api.Get = api.GetRows
        function api:Count()
            return #api.Rows
        end
        -- rows in the order they are shown right now (sorted and filtered)
        function api:GetView()
            local shown = {}
            for index, entry in ipairs(view) do
                shown[index] = entry.Row
            end
            return shown
        end
        function api:Refresh()
            invalidateSearch()
            rebuildView()
        end
        function api:AddRow(row, position)
            row = type(row) == "table" and row or { row }
            if tonumber(position) then
                table.insert(api.Rows, math.clamp(math.floor(position), 1, #api.Rows + 1), row)
            else
                table.insert(api.Rows, row)
            end
            invalidateSearch()
            rebuildView()
            return #api.Rows
        end
        function api:AddRows(list)
            for index, row in ipairs(type(list) == "table" and list or {}) do
                table.insert(api.Rows, type(row) == "table" and row or { row })
            end
            invalidateSearch()
            rebuildView()
            return #api.Rows
        end
        function api:UpdateRow(rowIndex, row)
            if not api.Rows[rowIndex] then
                return false
            end
            local replacement = type(row) == "table" and row or { row }
            if selectedRow ~= nil and selectedRow == api.Rows[rowIndex] then
                selectedRow = replacement
            end
            api.Rows[rowIndex] = replacement
            invalidateSearch()
            rebuildView()
            flashRow(rowIndex)
            return true
        end
        function api:UpdateCell(rowIndex, columnTarget, value)
            local row = api.Rows[rowIndex]
            local column = findColumn(columnTarget)
            if not row or not column then
                return false
            end
            if row[1] ~= nil or column.Key == nil then
                row[column.Index] = value
            else
                row[column.Key] = value
            end
            invalidateSearch()
            rebuildView()
            flashRow(rowIndex)
            return true
        end
        function api:FindRow(predicate)
            for index, row in ipairs(api.Rows) do
                local ok, matched = pcall(predicate, row, index)
                if ok and matched then
                    return index, row
                end
            end
            return nil
        end
        function api:RemoveRow(rowIndex)
            if not api.Rows[rowIndex] then
                return false
            end
            table.remove(api.Rows, rowIndex)
            invalidateSearch()
            rebuildView()
            return true
        end
        function api:Clear()
            api:SetRows({})
        end
        function api:Sort(columnTarget, descending)
            sortColumn = columnTarget ~= nil and findColumn(columnTarget) or nil
            sortDescending = descending == true
            if sortColumn then
                sortColumn.FirstDescending = sortDescending
            end
            updateHeaderStyle()
            rebuildView()
        end
        function api:SetTitle(text)
            if titleLabel then
                titleLabel.Text = tostring(text)
            end
        end
        function api:SetEmptyText(text)
            options.EmptyText = text
            rebuildView()
        end
        function api:SetHighlight(callback)
            options.Highlight = callback
            renderRows(true)
        end
        function api:SetMaxRows(count)
            maxRows = math.max(math.floor(tonumber(count) or maxRows), 1)
            resetPool()
            updateLayout(false)
            renderRows(true)
        end
        function api:GetSelected()
            if selectedRow == nil then
                return nil
            end
            return selectedRow, table.find(api.Rows, selectedRow)
        end
        function api:SetSelected(rowIndex)
            local row = rowIndex ~= nil and api.Rows[rowIndex] or nil
            if row == selectedRow then
                return
            end
            selectedRow = row
            renderRows(true)
            aJ(options.OnSelect, row, row ~= nil and rowIndex or nil)
        end
        function api:ClearSelection()
            api:SetSelected(nil)
        end
        -- scrolls so that the row with this index (in api.Rows) is at the top of the visible window
        function api:ScrollTo(rowIndex)
            for position, entry in ipairs(view) do
                if entry.Index == rowIndex then
                    local maxScroll = math.max(#view - math.clamp(#view, 1, maxRows), 0) * rowHeight
                    scroll.CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(0, math.clamp((position - 1) * rowHeight, 0, maxScroll))
                    return true
                end
            end
            return false
        end
        function api:SetSearch(text)
            if searchBox then
                searchBox.Text = tostring(text or "")
            end
        end

        api:SetColumns(options.Columns or {})
        api:SetRows(options.Rows or {})
        if options.SortBy ~= nil then
            api:Sort(options.SortBy, options.SortDescending ~= false)
        end
        updateLayout(true)
        if searchBox then
            searchBox:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(function()
                local query = string.lower(bM(searchBox.Text))
                if query ~= searchQuery then
                    searchQuery = query
                    scroll.CanvasPosition = Vector2.zero
                    rebuildView()
                end
            end)
        end
        ag(tableFrame, function()
            renderRows(true)
        end)
        return m(self, options, api, card, "Table")
    end
    aS.CreateImage = aS.Image
    aS.AddImage = aS.Image
    aS.CreateViewport = aS.Viewport
    aS.AddViewport = aS.Viewport
    aS.CreateTable = aS.Table
    aS.AddTable = aS.Table
    aS.CreateLeaderboard = aS.Table
    local function bU(bV)
        if bV.OutFrame then
            bV.OutFrame.Parent = bV.Area
            bV.OutFrame.Visible = false
            bV.OutFrame = nil
        end
        bV.Out.Visible = false
    end
    local function bV(bW)
        if bW.InFrame then
            bW.InFrame.Parent = bW.Area
            bW.InFrame.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0)
            bW.InFrame = nil
        end
        bW.In.Visible = false
    end
    function aS:_setupSubTabs()
        local bW = self._headerBottom
        local bX = self._page
        local subTrack = ai("Frame", {
            Name = "SubTabTrack",
            Position = UDim2.fromOffset(24, bW - 4),
            Size = UDim2.new(1, -48, 0, 32),
            BackgroundColor3 = z.Surface2,
            BackgroundTransparency = 0.3,
            BorderSizePixel = 0,
            ZIndex = 0,
            Parent = bX,
        })
        aj(subTrack, UDim.new(0, 9))
        ak(subTrack, z.Stroke, 0.35)
        local bY = ai(
            "ScrollingFrame",
            {
                Name = "SubTabs",
                Position = UDim2.fromOffset(24, bW - 4),
                Size = UDim2.new(1, -48, 0, 32),
                BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                BorderSizePixel = 0,
                ScrollBarThickness = 0,
                ScrollingDirection = Enum.ScrollingDirection.X,
                AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X,
                CanvasSize = UDim2.new(),
                Parent = bX,
            }
        )
        bY:SetAttribute("NoDrag", true)
        -- mouse wheel scrolls the sub-tab strip sideways when it overflows
        bY.InputChanged:Connect(function(wheelInput)
            if wheelInput.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseWheel then
                local wheelScale = math.max(self.Window.Scale.Scale, 0.05)
                local maxScroll = math.max((bY.AbsoluteCanvasSize.X - bY.AbsoluteWindowSize.X) / wheelScale, 0)
                if maxScroll > 0 then
                    local target = math.clamp(bY.CanvasPosition.X - wheelInput.Position.Z * 70, 0, maxScroll)
                    ah(bY, { CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(target, 0) }, 0.22, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint)
                end
            end
        end)
        local bZ = ai(
            "Frame",
            {
                Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 26),
                BackgroundColor3 = z.Surface3,
                BackgroundTransparency = 0.12,
                BorderSizePixel = 0,
                Visible = false,
                Parent = bY,
            }
        )
        aj(bZ, UDim.new(0, 7))
        ak(bZ, z.StrokeHover, 0.4)
        ai(
            "UIGradient",
            { Rotation = 90, Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), Color3.fromRGB(170, 170, 170)), Parent = bZ }
        )
        aj(
            ai("Frame", {
                Name = "Tint",
                Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
                BackgroundColor3 = z.Accent,
                BackgroundTransparency = 0.9,
                BorderSizePixel = 0,
                ZIndex = 1,
                Parent = bZ,
            }),
            UDim.new(0, 7)
        )
        aj(
            ai(
                "Frame",
                {
                    Name = "Underline",
                    AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1),
                    Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, -2),
                    Size = UDim2.fromOffset(22, 2),
                    BackgroundColor3 = z.Accent,
                    BorderSizePixel = 0,
                    ZIndex = 2,
                    Parent = bZ,
                }
            ),
            UDim.new(1, 0)
        )
        local b_ = ai(
            "Frame",
            { Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X, BackgroundTransparency = 1, ZIndex = 2, Parent = bY }
        )
        ai(
            "UIListLayout",
            {
                FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal,
                VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center,
                SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
                Padding = UDim.new(0, 4),
                Parent = b_,
            }
        )
        al(b_, 3, 3, 0, 0)
        self.Window:_overflowHint(bX, bY, b_, false, z.Background)
        local b0 = bW + 36
        local b1 = ai(
            "Frame",
            {
                Name = "SubPages",
                Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, b0),
                Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, -b0),
                BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                ClipsDescendants = true,
                Parent = bX,
            }
        )
        local b2 = {
            Strip = bY,
            Row = b_,
            Highlight = bZ,
            Area = b1,
            Out = ai(
                "CanvasGroup",
                { Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Visible = false, ZIndex = 2, Parent = b1 }
            ),
            In = ai(
                "CanvasGroup",
                { Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Visible = false, ZIndex = 3, Parent = b1 }
            ),
            Generation = 0,
        }
        self._sub = b2
        self._subTabs = {}
        self.List.Visible = false
        self:_refreshEmpty()
        b_:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(function()
            if self.CurrentSubTab and not b2.Moving then
                self:_placeSubHighlight(self.CurrentSubTab, true)
            end
        end)
    end
    function aS:_placeSubHighlight(bW, bX)
        local bY = self._sub
        local bZ = self.Window.Scale.Scale
        local b_ = bW._button
        local b0 = b_.AbsoluteSize.X / bZ
        if b0 <= 0 then
            return
        end
        local b1 = (b_.AbsolutePosition.X - bY.Row.AbsolutePosition.X) / bZ
        local b2 = { Position = UDim2.fromOffset(b1, 3), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(b0, 26) }
        if bX or not bY.Highlight.Visible then
            bY.Highlight.Visible = true
            bY.Highlight.Position = b2.Position
            bY.Highlight.Size = b2.Size
        else
            bY.Moving = true
            ah(bY.Highlight, b2, 0.35, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint)
            task.delay(0.36, function()
                bY.Moving = false
            end)
        end
        -- the accent underline springs open every time the selection moves
        if not bX then
            local underline = bY.Highlight:FindFirstChild("Underline")
            if underline then
                underline.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(6, 2)
                ah(underline, { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(22, 2) }, 0.5, Enum.EasingStyle.Back)
            end
        end
        local b3 = bY.Strip.AbsoluteSize.X / bZ
        local b4 = bY.Strip.CanvasPosition.X
        if b1 < b4 then
            ah(bY.Strip, { CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(math.max(b1 - 8, 0), 0) }, 0.3, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint)
        elseif b1 + b0 > b4 + b3 then
            ah(bY.Strip, { CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(b1 + b0 - b3 + 8, 0) }, 0.3, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint)
        end
    end
    function aS:SetBadge(badgeValue, tone)
        if self._setBadge then
            self._setBadge(badgeValue, tone)
        end
        return self
    end
    function aS:SubTab(bW, bX)
        if self._groupbox or self._isSubTab then
            return self.Parent:SubTab(bW, bX)
        end
        bW = l(bW, { Title = "Name", Description = "Desc" })
        if bX ~= nil and bW.Icon == nil then
            bW.Icon = bX
        end
        if not self._subTabs then
            self:_setupSubTabs()
        end
        local bY = self._sub
        local bZ = #self._subTabs + 1
        local b_ = setmetatable(
            {
                Name = bW.Name or ("Page " .. bZ),
                Window = self.Window,
                Parent = self,
                _order = 0,
                _isSubTab = true,
                _index = bZ,
                _iconName = bW.Icon,
            },
            aS
        )
        local b0 = ai(
            "Frame",
            { Name = b_.Name, Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Visible = false, Parent = bY.Area }
        )
        b_._frame = b0
        bJ(b_, b0, 0, bW.Icon or self._iconName or "layout-grid", bW.EmptyText or "Nothing here yet")
        local b1 = ai(
            "TextButton",
            {
                Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0),
                AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X,
                BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                Text = "",
                AutoButtonColor = false,
                LayoutOrder = bZ,
                Parent = bY.Row,
            }
        )
        ah(b1, { BackgroundColor3 = z.Surface3 }, 0)
        aj(b1, UDim.new(0, 7))
        al(b1, 14, 14)
        ai(
            "UIListLayout",
            {
                FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal,
                VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center,
                SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
                Padding = UDim.new(0, 6),
                Parent = b1,
            }
        )
        if bW.Icon then
            local b2 = ai(
                "ImageLabel",
                {
                    Size = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 14),
                    BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                    ImageColor3 = z.Muted,
                    ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit,
                    LayoutOrder = 1,
                    Parent = b1,
                }
            )
            aq(b2, bW.Icon)
            if b2:GetAttribute("CustomIcon") then
                b2.ImageTransparency = 0.4
            end
            b_._iconImage = b2
        end
        b_._label = am({
            Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0),
            AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X,
            Text = b_.Name,
            TextSize = 13,
            TextColor3 = z.Muted,
            TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.None,
            LayoutOrder = 2,
            Parent = b1,
        })
        do
            -- Badge: text, number or `true` (a small dot); second argument / BadgeTone picks the colour
            local subBadge, subBadgeText, subBadgeStroke, subBadgePad, subBadgeScale
            b_._setBadge = function(badgeValue, tone)
                if tone ~= nil then
                    b_.BadgeTone = tone
                end
                if badgeValue == nil or badgeValue == false or tostring(badgeValue) == "" then
                    if subBadge then
                        subBadge.Visible = false
                    end
                    b_.Badge = nil
                    return
                end
                local isDot = badgeValue == true
                local badgeString = isDot and "" or tostring(badgeValue)
                local toneColor = k._badgeTone(b_.BadgeTone)
                if not subBadge then
                    subBadge = ai("Frame", {
                        Name = "Badge",
                        Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 16),
                        AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X,
                        BackgroundColor3 = z.Accent,
                        BackgroundTransparency = 0.86,
                        BorderSizePixel = 0,
                        LayoutOrder = 3,
                        Parent = b1,
                    })
                    aj(subBadge, UDim.new(1, 0))
                    subBadgeStroke = ak(subBadge, z.Accent, 0.72)
                    subBadgePad = al(subBadge, 6, 6, 0, 0)
                    subBadgeScale = ai("UIScale", { Parent = subBadge })
                    subBadgeText = am({
                        Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0),
                        AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X,
                        TextSize = 10,
                        FontFace = D.Bold,
                        TextColor3 = z.Accent,
                        TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.None,
                        TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center,
                        Parent = subBadge,
                    })
                end
                local stored = isDot and true or badgeString
                local changed = b_.Badge ~= stored
                b_.Badge = stored
                subBadgePad.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, isDot and 0 or 6)
                subBadgePad.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, isDot and 0 or 6)
                subBadge.AutomaticSize = isDot and Enum.AutomaticSize.None or Enum.AutomaticSize.X
                subBadge.Size = isDot and UDim2.fromOffset(8, 8) or UDim2.fromOffset(0, 16)
                subBadgeText.Visible = not isDot
                subBadgeText.Text = badgeString
                subBadge.Visible = true
                ah(subBadge, { BackgroundColor3 = toneColor, BackgroundTransparency = isDot and 0 or 0.86 }, 0.2)
                ah(subBadgeStroke, { Color = toneColor, Transparency = isDot and 1 or 0.72 }, 0.2)
                ah(subBadgeText, { TextColor3 = toneColor }, 0.2)
                if changed then
                    subBadgeScale.Scale = 0.55
                    ah(subBadgeScale, { Scale = 1 }, 0.4, Enum.EasingStyle.Back)
                end
            end
            if bW.Badge ~= nil then
                b_._setBadge(bW.Badge, bW.BadgeTone or bW.BadgeColor)
            end
        end
        b_._button = b1
        local subPress = ai("UIScale", { Parent = b1 })
        local function subRelease()
            ah(subPress, { Scale = 1 }, 0.3, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint)
        end
        b1.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
            if self.CurrentSubTab ~= b_ then
                ah(b_._label, { TextColor3 = z.Text }, 0.12)
                ah(b1, { BackgroundTransparency = 0.8 }, 0.15)
                if b_._iconImage then
                    ar(b_._iconImage, z.Text, false, 0.12)
                end
            end
        end)
        b1.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
            subRelease()
            if self.CurrentSubTab ~= b_ then
                ah(b_._label, { TextColor3 = z.Muted }, 0.2)
                ah(b1, { BackgroundTransparency = 1 }, 0.2)
                if b_._iconImage then
                    ar(b_._iconImage, z.Muted, false, 0.2)
                end
            end
        end)
        b1.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function()
            ah(subPress, { Scale = 0.95 }, 0.12, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint)
        end)
        b1.MouseButton1Up:Connect(subRelease)
        b1.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            subRelease()
            self:SelectSubTab(b_)
        end)
        table.insert(self._subTabs, b_)
        if bZ == 1 then
            self:SelectSubTab(b_, true)
        elseif self.Window:_tabStateLoad().Sub[self.Name] == b_.Name and self.CurrentSubTab ~= b_ then
            -- the page the user had open last time (kept through the executor file API)
            self:SelectSubTab(b_, true)
        end
        return b_
    end

    function aS:SelectSubTab(bW, bX)
        if type(bW) ~= "table" then
            for bY, bZ in ipairs(self._subTabs or {}) do
                if bZ.Name == bW or bY == bW then
                    bW = bZ
                    break
                end
            end
        end
        if type(bW) ~= "table" or not self._sub then
            return
        end
        local bY = self.CurrentSubTab
        if bY == bW then
            return
        end
        self.Window:_resetSearch()
        self.Window:_closePopups()
        self.CurrentSubTab = bW
        if not bX then
            self.Window:_noteSubTab(self, bW)
        end
        local bZ = self._sub
        bU(bZ)
        bV(bZ)
        bZ.Generation += 1
        local b_ = bZ.Generation
        local b0 = bX and 0 or 0.2
        if bY then
            ah(bY._label, { TextColor3 = z.Muted }, b0)
            if bY._iconImage then
                ar(bY._iconImage, z.Muted, false, b0)
            end
        end
        ah(bW._label, { TextColor3 = z.Text }, b0)
        ah(bW._button, { BackgroundTransparency = 1 }, b0)
        if bW._iconImage then
            ar(bW._iconImage, z.Accent, true, b0)
        end
        self:_placeSubHighlight(bW, bX)
        if bX or not bY then
            if bY then
                bY._frame.Visible = false
            end
            bW._frame.Visible = true
            return
        end
        local b1 = bW._index > bY._index and 1 or -1
        bZ.OutFrame = bY._frame
        bY._frame.Parent = bZ.Out
        bZ.Out.GroupTransparency = 0
        bZ.Out.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0)
        bZ.Out.Visible = true
        ah(bZ.Out, { GroupTransparency = 1, Position = UDim2.fromOffset(-b1 * 28, 0) }, 0.2)
        bZ.InFrame = bW._frame
        bW._frame.Visible = true
        bW._frame.Parent = bZ.In
        bZ.In.GroupTransparency = 1
        bZ.In.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(b1 * 28, 0)
        bZ.In.Visible = true
        ah(bZ.In, { GroupTransparency = 0, Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0) }, 0.34, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint)
        task.delay(0.2, function()
            if bZ.Generation == b_ then
                bU(bZ)
            end
        end)
        task.delay(0.34, function()
            if bZ.Generation == b_ then
                bV(bZ)
            end
        end)
    end

    function a2:_searchResults(bW)
        local bX = {}
        local function bY(bZ, b_)
            if type(bZ) ~= "string" or bZ == "" then
                return
            end
            local b0 = string.find(string.lower(bZ), bW, 1, true)
            if not b0 then
                return
            end
            b_.Name = bZ
            b_.At = b0
            b_.Rank = b0 == 1 and 0 or (string.find(string.sub(bZ, b0 - 1, b0 - 1), "[%s%p]") and 1 or 2)
            b_.Order = #bX + 1
            table.insert(bX, b_)
        end
        local function bZ(b_)
            return not b_._destroyed
                and b_._type ~= "Section"
                and b_._type ~= "Divider"
                and (b_._isShown == nil or b_:_isShown())
        end
        for b_, b0 in ipairs(self:_visibleTabs()) do
            bY(b0.Name, { Kind = "Tab", Tab = b0, Icon = b0._iconName })
            for b1, b2 in ipairs(b0._subTabs or { b0 }) do
                local b3 = b2._isSubTab and b2 or nil
                local b4 = b0.Name
                if b3 then
                    bY(b3.Name, { Kind = "Page", Tab = b0, Sub = b3, Path = b0.Name })
                    b4 = b0.Name .. "  \u{203a}  " .. b3.Name
                end
                if not b2._noSearch then
                    for b5, b6 in ipairs(b2._items or {}) do
                        if bZ(b6) then
                            bY(b6._searchName, { Kind = b6._type, Tab = b0, Sub = b3, Target = b6, Path = b4 })
                        end
                    end
                    for b5, b6 in ipairs(b2._groupboxes or {}) do
                        if b6._userVisible ~= false then
                            bY(b6.Name, { Kind = "Groupbox", Tab = b0, Sub = b3, Target = b6, Path = b4 })
                            local b7 = b4 .. "  \u{203a}  " .. b6.Name
                            for b8, b9 in ipairs(b6._items) do
                                if bZ(b9) then
                                    bY(
                                        b9._searchName,
                                        { Kind = b9._type, Tab = b0, Sub = b3, Target = b9, Group = b6, Path = b7 }
                                    )
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        table.sort(bX, function(b_, b0)
            if b_.Rank ~= b0.Rank then
                return b_.Rank < b0.Rank
            end
            return b_.Order < b0.Order
        end)
        return bX
    end

        for bY, bZ in ipairs({ "SearchFlash", "SearchGlow" }) do

            ah(b1, { BackgroundTransparency = 1 }, 0.55, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad)

            ah(b0, { Thickness = b6, Transparency = 1 }, 0.65, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad)

            b_:Destroy()
            if b7 then

            end

    function a2:_revealResult(bW)
        local bX, bY, bZ, b_ = bW.Tab, bW.Sub, bW.Target, bW.Group
        if self.CurrentTab ~= bX then
            self:SelectTab(bX)
        end
        if bY then
            bX:SelectSubTab(bY)
        end
        if not bZ then
            local b0 = bY and bY._button or bX._button
            task.delay(0.1, function()
                if b0.Parent then
                    self:_flash(b0, bY and 8 or 10)
                end
            end)
            return
        end
        local b0 = b_ ~= nil and b_:IsCollapsed()
        if b0 then
            b_:Expand()
        end
        local b1 = (bY or bX).List
        task.spawn(function()
            task.wait()
            task.wait()
            if b0 then
                task.wait(0.3)
            end
            local b2 = bZ._frame
            if self._destroyed or bZ._destroyed or not b2 or not b2.Parent or not b1 then
                return
            end
            local b3 = self.Scale.Scale
            local b4 = (b2.AbsolutePosition.Y - b1.AbsolutePosition.Y) / b3 + b1.CanvasPosition.Y
            local b5 = b2.AbsoluteSize.Y / b3
            local b6 = b1.AbsoluteWindowSize.Y / b3
            local b7 = math.max(b1.AbsoluteCanvasSize.Y / b3 - b6, 0)
            local b8 = math.clamp(b4 + b5 / 2 - b6 / 2, 0, b7)
            if math.abs(b8 - b1.CanvasPosition.Y) > 2 then
                ah(b1, { CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(0, b8) }, 0.45, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint)
                task.wait(0.25)
            end
            if b2.Parent then
                self:_flash(b2, bZ._groupbox and 10 or 8)
            end
        end)
    end
    function a2:_resetSearch()
        if self.SearchBox and self.SearchBox.Text ~= "" then
            self.SearchBox.Text = ""
        end
    end

    end

        local ca = {}

        local function ci()
            local cj = self.Scale.Scale
            local ck = self.Body.AbsolutePosition
            local cl = self.Body.AbsoluteSize.X / cj
            local cm = (bX.AbsolutePosition.X + bX.AbsoluteSize.X - ck.X) / cj
            local cn = (bX.AbsolutePosition.Y + bX.AbsoluteSize.Y - ck.Y) / cj + 6
            cm = math.clamp(cm, cf.X + 8, math.max(cl - 8, cf.X + 8))
            b4.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(cm, cn)
        end
        local function cj()
            local ck = self.Scale.Scale
            local cl = self.Body.AbsoluteSize / ck
            local cm = (bX.AbsolutePosition.Y + bX.AbsoluteSize.Y - self.Body.AbsolutePosition.Y) / ck + 6
            local cn = math.max(#ca, 1)
            local co = math.min(cn, b3) * (b2 + 2) - 2 + 12
            co = math.max(math.min(co, cl.Y - cm - 12), b2 + 12)
            local cp = math.min(math.max(bX.AbsoluteSize.X / ck, 300), math.max(cl.X - 16, 160))
            cf = Vector2.new(cp, co)
        end
        local function ck()
            for cl, cm in ipairs(ca) do
                local cn = cl == cc
                ah(cm.Button, { BackgroundTransparency = cn and 0.35 or 1 }, 0.12)
                ar(cm.Icon, cn and z.Accent or z.Muted, cn, 0.12)
            end
        end
        local function cl()
            local cm = (cc - 1) * (b2 + 2)
            local cn = b8.AbsoluteWindowSize.Y / self.Scale.Scale
            local co = b8.CanvasPosition.Y
            if cm < co then
                co = cm
            elseif cm + b2 > co + cn then
                co = cm + b2 - cn
            else
                return
            end
            b8.CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(0, math.max(co, 0))
        end
        local function cm(cn)
            if cn == cd then
                return
            end
            cd = cn
            ce += 1
            local co = ce
            if cn then
                if self._closePopup and self._closePopup ~= ch then
                    self._closePopup()
                end
                self._closePopup = ch
                ci()
                b4.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(cf.X, 0)
                b4.Visible = true
                ah(b4, { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(cf.X, cf.Y) }, 0.26, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint)
                ah(b7, { Transparency = 0 }, 0.12)
                ah(b5, { ImageTransparency = 0.55 }, 0.26)
                if not cg then
                    cg = self:_listen("Render", ci)
                end
            else
                if self._closePopup == ch then
                    self._closePopup = nil
                end
                ah(b4, { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(cf.X, 0) }, 0.18, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint)
                ah(b5, { ImageTransparency = 1 }, 0.14)
                task.delay(0.19, function()
                    if ce == co and not cd then
                        b4.Visible = false
                        b7.Transparency = 1
                        if cg then
                            cg()
                            cg = nil
                        end
                    end
                end)
            end
        end
        ch = function()
            cm(false)
        end
        local function cn(co)
            if not co then
                return
            end
            cm(false)
            b1.Text = ""
            if b1:IsFocused() then
                b1:ReleaseFocus()
            end
            self:_revealResult(co)
        end
        local function co(cp)
            return (string.gsub(string.gsub(string.gsub(cp, "&", "&amp;"), "<", "&lt;"), ">", "&gt;"))
        end
        local function cp(cq)
            for cr, cs in ipairs(ca) do
                cs.Button:Destroy()
            end
            table.clear(ca)
            cb = self:_searchResults(cq)
            cc = 1
            local cr = bc(z.Accent)
            for cs, ct in ipairs(cb) do
                if cs > 50 then
                    break
                end
                local cu = ai(
                    "TextButton",
                    {
                        Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, b2),
                        BackgroundColor3 = z.Surface3,
                        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                        Text = "",
                        AutoButtonColor = false,
                        LayoutOrder = cs,
                        Parent = b8,
                    }
                )
                aj(cu, UDim.new(0, 7))
                local cv = ai(
                    "Frame",
                    {
                        Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 0),
                        Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 1, 0),
                        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                        ClipsDescendants = true,
                        Parent = cu,
                    }
                )
                ai(
                    "UIListLayout",
                    {
                        FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal,
                        VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center,
                        SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
                        Padding = UDim.new(0, 5),
                        Parent = cv,
                    }
                )
                local cw = 0
                local cx = nil
                local function cy(cz)
                    if not cz then
                        return
                    end
                    cw += 1
                    local cA = ai(

    function a2:Rejoin()
        self:Notify({ Title = "Rejoining", Content = "Teleporting back into this server", Icon = "refresh-cw", Duration = 3 })
        task.spawn(function()
            local bX, bY = pcall(function()
                if #f:GetPlayers() <= 1 or game.JobId == "" then
                    g:Teleport(game.PlaceId, j)
                else
                    g:TeleportToPlaceInstance(game.PlaceId, game.JobId, j)
                end
            end)
            if not bX then
                self:Notify({ Title = "Rejoin failed", Content = tostring(bY), Type = "Error", Duration = 4 })
            end
        end)
    end
    local function bX(bY, bZ, b_, b0)
        task.spawn(function()
            local b1 = bD(bZ)
            if not b1 then
                bY:Notify({ Title = b0 .. " failed", Content = "Could not load the server list", Type = "Error", Duration = 4 })
                return
            end
            local b2 = {}
            for b3, b4 in ipairs(b1) do
                if type(b4) == "table" and b4.id ~= game.JobId then
                    local b5, b6 = tonumber(b4.playing), tonumber(b4.maxPlayers)
                    if b5 and b6 and b5 < b6 then
                        table.insert(b2, b4)
                    end
                end
            end
            local b3 = #b2 > 0 and b_(b2) or nil
            if not b3 then
                bY:Notify({ Title = b0 .. " failed", Content = "No other open server found", Type = "Warning", Duration = 4 })
                return
            end
            bY:Notify({
                Title = b0,
                Content = string.format("Joining a server with %d/%d players", b3.playing, b3.maxPlayers),
                Icon = "server",
                Duration = 3,
            })
            local b4, b5 = pcall(function()
                g:TeleportToPlaceInstance(game.PlaceId, b3.id, j)
            end)
            if not b4 then
                bY:Notify({ Title = b0 .. " failed", Content = tostring(b5), Type = "Error", Duration = 4 })
            end
        end)
    end

    function a2:_featureGroups()
        local bY, bZ = {}, {}
        for b_, b0 in ipairs(self:_visibleTabs()) do
            if b0 ~= self.Home and b0._userVisible ~= false then
                local b1 = { Name = b0.Name, Icon = b0._iconName, Items = {} }
                for b2, b3 in ipairs(b0._subTabs or { b0 }) do
                    local b5 = b3._isSubTab and b3 or nil
                    local function b6(b7, b8, b9, ca)
                        if type(b7) ~= "string" or b7 == "" then
                            return
                        end
                        local cb = {
                            Name = b7,
                            Kind = b8._type == "ButtonRow" and "Button" or b8._type,
                            Path = ca,
                            Result = { Tab = b0, Sub = b5, Target = b8, Group = b9 },
                        }
                        table.insert(b1.Items, cb)
                        bZ[string.lower(b7)] = bZ[string.lower(b7)] or cb
                    end
                    local function b7(b8, b9, ca)
                        if b8._destroyed or not self._featureKinds[b8._type] or (b8._isShown and not b8:_isShown()) then
                            return
                        end
                        if b8._type == "ButtonRow" and b8.Buttons then
                            for cb, cc in ipairs(b8.Buttons) do
                                b6(cc.Label.Text, b8, b9, ca)
                            end
                        else
                            b6(b8._searchName, b8, b9, ca)
                        end
                    end
                    if not b3._noSearch then
                        for b8, b9 in ipairs(b3._items or {}) do
                            b7(b9, nil, b5 and b5.Name or nil)
                        end
                        for b8, b9 in ipairs(b3._groupboxes or {}) do
                            if b9._userVisible ~= false and not b9._manager then
                                for ca, cb in ipairs(b9._items) do
                                    b7(cb, b9, b5 and (b5.Name .. "  \u{203a}  " .. b9.Name) or b9.Name)
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
                if #b1.Items > 0 then
                    table.insert(bY, b1)
                end
            end
        end
        local b_ = self._features
        if type(b_) ~= "table" then
            return bY
        end
        local function b0(b1)
            if type(b1) ~= "table" then
                b1 = { Name = b1 }
            end
            local b2 = tostring(b1.Name or b1.Title or b1[1] or "")
            local b3 = bZ[string.lower(b2)]

                Path = b3 and b3.Path,
                Result = b3 and b3.Result,
                Callback = b1.Callback,
            }
        end
