    -- ===== TAB SYSTEM v2 =====
    -- Sidebar tabs, tab sections and sub-tabs.
    --  * executor file API (a2._fs*) remembers the last open tab / sub-tab / collapsed sections between
    --    executions (Window option RememberTab = false or ConfigurationSaving.Enabled = false turns it off)
    --  * Tab options: Name, Icon, Desc, PageTitle, EmptyText, Badge, BadgeTone, Visible, Disabled
    --    Badge can be text, a number or `true` (pulsing dot); BadgeTone = Accent / Success / Warning / Error / Color3
    --  * TabSection options: Name, Collapsible (default true), Collapsed. Click a section title to fold its tabs.
    --  * Tab methods: Select, SetName, SetIcon, SetBadge, GetBadge, SetVisible, IsVisible, SetDisabled, IsDisabled
    --  * Window methods: SelectTab (tab / name / index), NextTab, PreviousTab, GetTab, GetTabs, OnTabChanged
    --  * Ctrl+Tab / Ctrl+Shift+Tab cycle through the tabs while the window is open
    function k._badgeTone(tone)
        if typeof(tone) == "Color3" then
            return tone
        end
        if type(tone) == "string" then
            local key = string.lower(tone)
            if key == "success" or key == "green" or key == "ok" then
                return z.Success
            elseif key == "warning" or key == "warn" or key == "orange" or key == "yellow" then
                return z.Warning
            elseif key == "error" or key == "danger" or key == "red" then
                return z.Error
            end
        end
        return z.Accent
    end
    function a2:_tabStateLoad()
        if self._tabState then
            return self._tabState
        end
        local state = { Tab = nil, Sub = {}, Collapsed = {} }
        self._tabState = state
        if self._keepTab and a2._fsAvailable() then
            local okRead, saved = pcall(function()
                return self:_readConfigSettings().TabState
            end)
            if okRead and type(saved) == "table" then
                if type(saved.Tab) == "string" then
                    state.Tab = saved.Tab
                end
                if type(saved.Sub) == "table" then
                    for tabName, subName in pairs(saved.Sub) do
                        if type(tabName) == "string" and type(subName) == "string" then
                            state.Sub[tabName] = subName
                        end
                    end
                end
                if type(saved.Collapsed) == "table" then
                    for sectionName, flag in pairs(saved.Collapsed) do
                        if type(sectionName) == "string" and type(flag) == "boolean" then
                            state.Collapsed[sectionName] = flag
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        return state
    end
    function a2:_tabStateSave()
        if not self._keepTab or self._destroyed or self._tabSaving or not a2._fsAvailable() then
            return
        end
        self._tabSaving = true
        task.delay(0.6, function()
            self._tabSaving = false
            local state = self._tabState
            if self._destroyed or not state then
                return
            end
            pcall(function()
                self:_writeConfigSettings({
                    TabState = { Tab = state.Tab, Sub = state.Sub, Collapsed = state.Collapsed },
                })
            end)
        end)
    end
    function a2:_noteTab(tab)
        local state = self:_tabStateLoad()
        if state.Tab ~= tab.Name then
            state.Tab = tab.Name
            self:_tabStateSave()
        end
    end
    function a2:_noteSubTab(tab, sub)
        local state = self:_tabStateLoad()
        if state.Sub[tab.Name] ~= sub.Name then
            state.Sub[tab.Name] = sub.Name
            self:_tabStateSave()
        end
    end
    function a2:_noteSection(name, collapsed)
        local state = self:_tabStateLoad()
        if state.Collapsed[name] ~= collapsed then
            state.Collapsed[name] = collapsed
            self:_tabStateSave()
        end
    end
    function a2:_startTab()
        local wanted = self:_tabStateLoad().Tab
        if not wanted then
            return nil
        end
        for _, tab in ipairs(self.Tabs) do
            if tab.Name == wanted and not tab._hidden and not tab._disabled then
                return tab
            end
        end
        return nil
    end
    function a2:_visibleTabs()
        local list = {}
        for _, tab in ipairs(self.Tabs) do
            if not tab._hidden and not tab._disabled then
                table.insert(list, tab)
            end
        end
        return list
    end
    function a2:_stepTab(from, direction)
        local list = self.Tabs
        local count = #list
        if count == 0 then
            return nil
        end
        local start = table.find(list, from) or (direction > 0 and 0 or count + 1)
        for step = 1, count do
            local tab = list[((start - 1 + direction * step) % count) + 1]
            if tab ~= from and not tab._hidden and not tab._disabled then
                return tab
            end
        end
        return nil
    end
    function a2:StepTab(direction)
        local target = self:_stepTab(self.CurrentTab, direction >= 0 and 1 or -1)
        if target then
            self._tabTouched = true
            self:SelectTab(target)
        end
        return target
    end
    function a2:NextTab()
        return self:StepTab(1)
    end
    function a2:PreviousTab()
        return self:StepTab(-1)
    end
    function a2:GetTab(which)
        for index, tab in ipairs(self.Tabs) do
            if index == which or tab.Name == which then
                return tab
            end
        end
        if type(which) == "string" then
            local lowered = string.lower(which)
            for _, tab in ipairs(self.Tabs) do
                if string.lower(tab.Name) == lowered then
                    return tab
                end
            end
        end
        return nil
    end
    function a2:GetTabs()
        return table.clone(self.Tabs)
    end
    function a2:OnTabChanged(callback)
        if type(callback) ~= "function" then
            return function() end
        end
        self._tabListeners = self._tabListeners or {}
        table.insert(self._tabListeners, callback)
        return function()
            local index = table.find(self._tabListeners, callback)
            if index then
                table.remove(self._tabListeners, index)
            end
        end
    end
    function a2:_bindTabKeys()
        if self._tabKeysBound then
            return
        end
        self._tabKeysBound = true
        self:_listen("Began", function(input, processed)
            if processed or input.KeyCode ~= Enum.KeyCode.Tab or self._destroyed or not self.Open or self.Minimized then
                return
            end
            local ctrl = (self.Keybind ~= Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl and b:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl))
                or (self.Keybind ~= Enum.KeyCode.RightControl and b:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.RightControl))
            if not ctrl or b:GetFocusedTextBox() then
                return
            end
            local shift = b:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift) or b:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.RightShift)
            self:StepTab(shift and -1 or 1)
        end)
    end
    function a2:Tab(bZ, b_)
        bZ = l(bZ, { Title = "Name", Description = "Desc" })
        if b_ ~= nil and bZ.Icon == nil then
            bZ.Icon = b_
        end
        local window = self
        local b0 = setmetatable({ Name = bZ.Name or "Tab", Window = self, _order = 0 }, aS)
        local section = self._currentTabSection
        local b1 = ai(
            "TextButton",
            {
                Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, H),
                BackgroundColor3 = z.Surface3,

                    while not window._destroyed and badgeRing and badgeRing.Parent and b0._badgeDot do

            b0._setBadge = function(badgeValue, tone)
                if tone ~= nil then

                ah(badgeText, { TextColor3 = toneColor }, 0.2)

                    end
                    badgeRing.Visible = true
                    ah(badgeRing, { BackgroundColor3 = toneColor }, 0)
                    pulse()
                elseif badgeRing then
                    badgeRing.Visible = false
                end
                local reserve = isDot and 16 or math.max(#badgeString * 6 + 12, 18)
                b0._label.Size = UDim2.new(1, -(labelPad + reserve), 1, 0)
                if changed then
                    badgeScale.Scale = 0.55
                    ah(badgeScale, { Scale = 1 }, 0.4, Enum.EasingStyle.Back)
                end
            end
            if bZ.Badge ~= nil then
                b0._setBadge(bZ.Badge, bZ.BadgeTone or bZ.BadgeColor)
            end
        end
        local b5 = ai(
            "Frame",
            { Name = b0.Name, Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Visible = false, Parent = self.Content }
        )
        b0._page = b5
        local b6 = 24
        if b3 then
            local headPlate = ai("Frame", {
                Name = "IconPlate",
                AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5),
                Position = UDim2.new(0, 24, 0, bZ.Desc and 40 or 32),
                Size = UDim2.fromOffset(34, 34),
                BackgroundColor3 = z.Accent,
                BackgroundTransparency = 0.88,
                BorderSizePixel = 0,
                Parent = b5,
            })
            aj(headPlate, UDim.new(0, 10))
            ak(headPlate, z.Accent, 0.72)
            ai("UIGradient", {
                Rotation = 135,
                Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
                    NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0),
                    NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0.6),
                }),
                Parent = headPlate,
            })
            headIcon = ai("ImageLabel", {
                AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
                Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5),
                Size = UDim2.fromOffset(18, 18),
                BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                ImageColor3 = z.Accent,
                ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit,
                Parent = headPlate,
            })
            aq(headIcon, bZ.Icon)
            b6 = 70
        end
        b0._titleX = b6
        b0._title = am({
            Position = UDim2.fromOffset(b6, 20),
            Size = UDim2.new(1, -b6, 0, 24),
            Text = bZ.PageTitle or b0.Name,
            TextSize = 22,
            FontFace = D.Bold,
            Parent = b5,
        })
        if bZ.Desc then
            b0._desc = am({
                Position = UDim2.fromOffset(b6, 44),
                Size = UDim2.new(1, -b6, 0, 16),
                Text = bZ.Desc,
                TextSize = 13,
                FontFace = D.Regular,
                TextColor3 = z.Muted,
                Parent = b5,
            })
        end
        local b7 = bZ.Desc and 70 or 58
        b0._headerBottom = b7
        b0._iconName = bZ.Icon
        bJ(b0, b5, b7, bZ.Icon or "layout-grid", bZ.EmptyText or "Nothing here yet")

        -- ----- public tab methods -----
        function b0._refreshVisible()
            b1.Visible = window._introDone == true and not b0._hidden and not b0._collapsedHidden
        end
        function b0:Select()
            window:SelectTab(b0)
            return b0
        end
        function b0:SetName(text)
            text = tostring(text == nil and "" or text)
            b0.Name = text
            b0._label.Text = text
            b5.Name = text
            if not bZ.PageTitle then
                b0._title.Text = text
            end
            return b0
        end
        function b0:SetIcon(name)
            if b0._icon then
                aq(b0._icon, name)
                if headIcon then
                    aq(headIcon, name)
                end
                b0._iconName = name
            end
            return b0
        end
        function b0:IsVisible()
            return not b0._hidden
        end
        function b0:SetVisible(state)
            local hide = state == false
            if (b0._hidden == true) == hide then
                return b0
            end
            b0._hidden = hide
            b0._refreshVisible()
            if hide and window.CurrentTab == b0 then
                local alternative = window:_stepTab(b0, 1) or window:_stepTab(b0, -1)
                if alternative then
                    window:SelectTab(alternative)
                end
            end
            if b0._section then
                b0._section._refresh()
            end
            window:_followIndicator(0.12)
            return b0
        end
        function b0:IsDisabled()
            return b0._disabled == true
        end
        function b0:SetDisabled(state)
            state = state == true
            if (b0._disabled == true) == state then
                return b0
            end
            b0._disabled = state
            ah(b0._label, { TextTransparency = state and 0.6 or 0 }, 0.2)
            if b0._icon then
                local resting = b0._icon:GetAttribute("CustomIcon") and (window.CurrentTab == b0 and 0 or 0.4) or 0
                ah(b0._icon, { ImageTransparency = state and 0.65 or resting }, 0.2)
            end
            ah(b1, { BackgroundTransparency = 1 }, 0.15)
            ah(b2, { Transparency = 1 }, 0.15)
            return b0
        end

        -- ----- interaction -----
        local press = ai("UIScale", { Parent = b1 })
        local function release()
            ah(press, { Scale = 1 }, 0.3, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint)
        end
        local function setHover(on)
            if b0._disabled then
                return
            end
            local active = window.CurrentTab == b0
            if b0._icon then
                local iconSize = active and (on and 18 or 17) or (on and 17 or 16)
                ah(b0._icon, { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(iconSize, iconSize) }, 0.25, Enum.EasingStyle.Back)
            end
            if active then
                return
            end
            ah(b1, { BackgroundTransparency = on and 0.78 or 1 }, 0.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint)
            ah(b2, { Transparency = on and 0.8 or 1 }, 0.2)
            ah(b0._label, { TextColor3 = on and z.Text or z.Muted }, 0.2)
            if b0._icon then
                ar(b0._icon, on and z.Text or z.Muted, on, 0.2)
            end
        end
        b1.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
            if not ax() then
                setHover(true)
            end
        end)
        b1.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
            release()
            setHover(false)
        end)
        b1.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function()
            if not b0._disabled then
                ah(press, { Scale = 0.97 }, 0.15, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint)
            end
        end)
        b1.MouseButton1Up:Connect(release)
        local ca = ay(b1, function()
            return self.TabList
        end)
        b1.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            release()
            if b0._disabled or not ca() then
                return
            end
            window._tabTouched = true
            window:SelectTab(b0)
        end)
        self:_fitTitle(b0)
        if not self._introDone then
            b1.Visible = false
        end
        b0._section = section
        if section then
            table.insert(section._tabs, b0)
            if section._collapsed then
                b0._collapsedHidden = true
                b1.ClipsDescendants = true
                b1.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0)
                b1.Visible = false
            end
            section._render()
        end
        table.insert(self.Tabs, b0)
        self:_bindTabKeys()
        if bZ.Visible == false then
            b0:SetVisible(false)
        end
        if bZ.Disabled == true then
            b0:SetDisabled(true)
        end
        if #self.Tabs == 1 then
            task.defer(function()
                if self.CurrentTab or self._destroyed then
                    return
                end
                local first = self:_startTab() or b0
                self._autoTab = first
                self:SelectTab(first, true)
            end)
        elseif
            self._autoTab
            and self.CurrentTab == self._autoTab
            and not self._tabTouched
            and not b0._hidden
            and not b0._disabled
            and self:_tabStateLoad().Tab == b0.Name
        then
            -- tab declared after the first one was already shown (the script yielded): it is the one the user left open
            self._autoTab = b0
            self:SelectTab(b0, true)
        end
        return b0
    end
    a2.CreateTab = a2.Tab
    function a2:TabSection(bZ)
        bZ = l(bZ, { Title = "Name" })
        local owner = self
        local sectionName = tostring(bZ.Name or "")
        self._tabSections = self._tabSections or {}
        local collapsible = bZ.Collapsible ~= false and sectionName ~= ""
        local holder = ai("TextButton", {
            Name = "TabSection",
            Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 28),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            Text = "",
            AutoButtonColor = false,
            LayoutOrder = #self.Tabs * 10 + 5,
            Visible = self._introDone == true,
            Parent = self._tabStack,
        })
        local caption = am({
            Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 10),
            Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 14),
            Text = string.upper(sectionName),
            TextSize = 10,
            FontFace = D.Bold,
            TextColor3 = z.Muted,
            Parent = holder,
        })
        local rule = ai("Frame", {
            AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5),
            Position = UDim2.new(0, 60, 0, 17),
            Size = UDim2.new(1, -72, 0, 1),
            BackgroundColor3 = z.Stroke,
            BorderSizePixel = 0,
            Parent = holder,
        })
        ai("UIGradient", {
            Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
                NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0),
                NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1),
            }),
            Parent = rule,
        })
        local chevron, chevronText
        local expandedRotation, collapsedRotation = 0, -90
        if collapsible then
            chevron = ai("ImageLabel", {
                AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5),
                Position = UDim2.new(1, -12, 0, 17),
                Size = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 10),
                BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                ImageColor3 = z.Muted,
                ImageTransparency = 0.45,
                ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit,
                Parent = holder,
            })
            aq(chevron, "chevron-down")
            if chevron.Image == "" then
                chevron:Destroy()
                chevronText = true
                expandedRotation, collapsedRotation = 90, 0
                chevron = am({
                    AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5),
                    Position = UDim2.new(1, -12, 0, 17),
                    Size = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 14),
                    Text = "\u{203a}",
                    TextSize = 16,
                    TextColor3 = z.Muted,
                    TextTransparency = 0.45,
                    TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center,
                    TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.None,
                    Parent = holder,
                })
            end
        end
        local chevronColorKey = chevronText and "TextColor3" or "ImageColor3"
        local chevronAlphaKey = chevronText and "TextTransparency" or "ImageTransparency"
        local handle = { _frame = holder, _tabs = {}, _collapsed = false, _gen = 0, Name = sectionName }
        local saved = self:_tabStateLoad().Collapsed[sectionName]
        if collapsible then
            if saved ~= nil then
                handle._collapsed = saved
            else
                handle._collapsed = bZ.Collapsed == true
            end
        end
        if chevron then
            chevron.Rotation = handle._collapsed and collapsedRotation or expandedRotation
        end
        local function fitRule()
            local used = 12 + caption.TextBounds.X + 8
            rule.Position = UDim2.new(0, used, 0, 17)
            rule.Size = UDim2.new(1, -(used + (collapsible and 30 or 10)), 0, 1)
            rule.Visible = sectionName ~= ""
        end
        local function render()
            local text = string.upper(sectionName)
            if handle._collapsed and #handle._tabs > 0 then
                text = text .. "  \u{b7}  " .. #handle._tabs
            end
            caption.Text = text
            fitRule()
        end
        handle._render = render
        caption:GetPropertyChangedSignal("TextBounds"):Connect(fitRule)
        render()
        table.insert(self._tabSections, holder)
        self._currentTabSection = handle

        -- fold / unfold every tab that belongs to this section (tabs declared after it, up to the next section)
        local function applyCollapse(state, animate)
            handle._collapsed = state
            handle._gen += 1
            local gen = handle._gen
            if chevron then
                local rotation = state and collapsedRotation or expandedRotation
                if animate then
                    ah(chevron, { Rotation = rotation }, 0.3, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint)
                else
                    chevron.Rotation = rotation
                end
            end
            render()
            local foldedSize = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0)
            local openSize = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, H)
            for _, tab in ipairs(handle._tabs) do
                local button = tab._button
                if button and button.Parent then
                    button.ClipsDescendants = true
                    if state then
                        ah(tab._stroke, { Transparency = 1 }, 0.1)
                        if animate and button.Visible then
                            ah(button, { Size = foldedSize }, 0.26, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint)
                        else
                            button.Size = foldedSize
                        end
                    else
                        tab._collapsedHidden = false
                        if animate then
                            button.Visible = owner._introDone == true and not tab._hidden
                            ah(button, { Size = openSize }, 0.3, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint)
                        else
                            button.Size = openSize
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            local function settle()
                if handle._gen ~= gen or owner._destroyed then
                    return
                end
                for _, tab in ipairs(handle._tabs) do
                    local button = tab._button
                    if button and button.Parent then
                        if state then
                            tab._collapsedHidden = true
                            button.Visible = false
                        else
                            button.ClipsDescendants = false
                            tab._refreshVisible()
                        end
                    end
                end
                owner:_followIndicator(0.05)
            end
            if animate then
                task.delay(state and 0.28 or 0.32, settle)
                owner:_followIndicator(state and 0.3 or 0.34)
            else
                settle()
            end
        end
        function handle:IsCollapsed()
            return handle._collapsed == true
        end
        function handle:Collapse()
            if collapsible and not handle._collapsed then
                applyCollapse(true, owner._introDone == true)
                owner:_noteSection(sectionName, true)
            end
        end
        function handle:Expand()
            if collapsible and handle._collapsed then
                applyCollapse(false, owner._introDone == true)
                owner:_noteSection(sectionName, false)
            end
        end
        function handle:Toggle()
            if handle._collapsed then
                handle:Expand()
            else
                handle:Collapse()
            end
        end
        function handle._refresh()
            if handle._userVisible == false then
                return
            end
            local any = #handle._tabs == 0
            for _, tab in ipairs(handle._tabs) do
                if not tab._hidden then
                    any = true
                    break
                end
            end
            holder.Visible = owner._introDone == true and any
        end
        holder.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
            if not collapsible or ax() then
                return
            end
            ah(caption, { TextColor3 = z.Text }, 0.15)
            ah(chevron, { [chevronColorKey] = z.Text, [chevronAlphaKey] = 0 }, 0.15)
        end)
        holder.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
            if not collapsible then
                return
            end
            ah(caption, { TextColor3 = z.Muted }, 0.2)
            ah(chevron, { [chevronColorKey] = z.Muted, [chevronAlphaKey] = 0.45 }, 0.2)
        end)
        holder.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            if collapsible then
                handle:Toggle()
            end
        end)
        function handle:SetText(text)
            sectionName = tostring(text or "")
            render()
        end
        function handle:SetVisible(visible)
            handle._userVisible = visible and true or false
            holder.Visible = visible and true or false
        end
        function handle:Destroy()
            local index = table.find(owner._tabSections, holder)
            if index then
                table.remove(owner._tabSections, index)
            end
            if owner._currentTabSection == handle then
                owner._currentTabSection = nil
            end
            holder:Destroy()
        end
        return handle
    end

    a2.AddTabSection = a2.TabSection

        end
        if self._titleLabel then
            ah(self._titleLabel, { Position = UDim2.new(0, 76, 0.5, has and -16 or -9) }, 0.25, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint)
        end
    end

    function a2:CloudConfigs(bZ)

            self:Tab({ Name = bZ.Name or "Cloud", Desc = bZ.Desc, Icon = bZ.Icon or "cloud", PageTitle = bZ.PageTitle })

        b0.List.Visible = false

            b0._empty:Destroy()

        end
        local b1 = 116
        local b2 = E and 36 or 32
        local b3 = E and 30 or 26

        local b6 = { Popular = "Popular", New = "Newest", Top = "Top rated", Installs = "Most installed" }

        local cb = type(bZ.Tags) == "table" and bZ.Tags or {}

        local ci, cj, ck = false, 0, 0

        local cn, co = {}, nil

        local ct = type(cs.CloudFavorites) == "table" and cs.CloudFavorites or {}

        end
        local function cy(cz)
            local cA = type(cz) == "string" and b_:DecodeConfig(cz)
            if not cA then
                return nil
            end
            local cB = 0
            for cC in pairs(cA) do
                cB += 1
            end
            return cB
        end
        local function cz(cA)
            cA = math.max(math.floor(tonumber(cA) or 0), 0)
            if cA >= 1e6 then
                return (("%.1f"):format(cA / 1e6):gsub("%.0$", "")) .. "m"
            elseif cA >= 1e3 then
                return (("%.1f"):format(cA / 1e3):gsub("%.0$", "")) .. "k"
            end
            return tostring(cA)
        end
        local function cA(cB)
            cB = tonumber(cB)
            if not cB then
                return nil
            end
            local cC = os.time() - cB
            if cC < 60 then
                return "just now"
            elseif cC < 3600 then
                return math.floor(cC / 60) .. "m ago"
            elseif cC < 86400 then
                return math.floor(cC / 3600) .. "h ago"
            elseif cC < 604800 then
                return math.floor(cC / 86400) .. "d ago"
            elseif cC < 2592000 then
                return math.floor(cC / 604800) .. "w ago"
            end
            return os.date("%d %b %Y", cB)
        end
        local function cB(cC)
            return (cC:gsub("&", "&amp;"):gsub("<", "&lt;"):gsub(">", "&gt;"):gsub('"', "&quot;"):gsub("'", "&apos;"))
        end
        local function cC(cD)
            local cE = string.lower(cm.Search)
            if cE == "" then
                return cB(cD)
            end
            local cF = string.lower(cD)
            local cG = bc(z.Accent)
            local cH, cI = {}, 1
            while true do
                local cJ, cK = string.find(cF, cE, cI, true)
                if not cJ then
                    break
                end
                table.insert(cH, cB(cD:sub(cI, cJ - 1)))
                table.insert(cH, ('<font color="#%s"><b>%s</b></font>'):format(cG, cB(cD:sub(cJ, cK))))
                cI = cK + 1
            end
            table.insert(cH, cB(cD:sub(cI)))
            return table.concat(cH)
        end
        local function cD(cE)
            if type(cE) ~= "table" then
                return nil
            end
            local cF = cE.Id ~= nil and tostring(cE.Id) or e:GenerateGUID(false)
            local cG = cg[cF] or { Id = cF }
            for cH, cI in pairs(cE) do
                if cH ~= "Id" then
                    cG[cH] = cI
                end
            end
            cG.Name = tostring(cG.Name or "Untitled")
            cG.Author = tostring(cG.Author or "Unknown")
            cG.Description = cG.Description ~= nil and tostring(cG.Description) or ""
            local cH = {}
            for cI, cJ in ipairs(type(cG.Tags) == "table" and cG.Tags or {}) do
                table.insert(cH, tostring(cJ))
            end
            cG.Tags = cH
            cG.Installs = tonumber(cG.Installs) or 0
            cG.Likes = tonumber(cG.Likes) or 0
            cG.Updated = tonumber(cG.Updated or cG.Created)
            cG.Liked = cG.Liked == true
            if type(cG.Code) ~= "string" or cG.Code == "" then
                cG.Code = nil
            end
            cG.Count = tonumber(cG.Count) or cy(cG.Code)
            cG.Mine = cG.Mine == true or tonumber(cG.AuthorId) == j.UserId or tonumber(cG.OwnerId) == j.UserId
            cg[cF] = cG
            return cG
        end
        local function cE(cF)
            return {
                Id = cF.Id,
                Name = cF.Name,
                Description = cF.Description,
                Author = cF.Author,
                AuthorId = cF.AuthorId,
                Tags = table.clone(cF.Tags),
                Installs = cF.Installs,
                Likes = cF.Likes,
                Liked = cF.Liked,
                Updated = cF.Updated,
                Code = cF.Code,
                Count = cF.Count,
                Folder = cF.Folder,
                Mine = cF.Mine,
            }
        end
        local function cF(cG)
            local cH = cE(cG)
            cH.Code = nil
            cH.Liked = nil
            return cH
        end
        local function cG(cH)
            local cI = cu[cH.Id]

                return nil
            end
            if cH.Updated and tonumber(cI.Updated) and cH.Updated > tonumber(cI.Updated) then

        end

        local function dK()
            local dL = cm.Filter == "Favorites" and ct or cu
            local dM = string.lower(cm.Search)
            local dN = {}
            for dO, dP in pairs(dL) do
                local dQ = cm.Filter == "Favorites" and dP or (type(dP) == "table" and dP.Record)
                if type(dQ) == "table" then
                    dQ = table.clone(dQ)
                    dQ.Id = dO
                    local dR = cD(dQ)
                    local dS = dM == ""
                        or string.find(string.lower(dR.Name), dM, 1, true)
                        or string.find(string.lower(dR.Description), dM, 1, true)
                    if dS and cm.Tag then
                        dS = table.find(dR.Tags, cm.Tag) ~= nil
                    end
                    if dS then
                        table.insert(dN, dR)
                    end
                end
            end
            table.sort(dN, function(dO, dP)
                if cm.Sort == "New" then
                    return (dO.Updated or 0) > (dP.Updated or 0)
                elseif cm.Sort == "Installs" then
                    return dO.Installs > dP.Installs
                end
                return dO.Likes > dP.Likes
            end)
            return dN
        end
        local function dL()
            if cm.Filter == "Favorites" then
                return [[No favorites yet. Open a config and press Favorite to keep it here.]]
            elseif cm.Filter == "Installed" then
                return "Nothing installed from the cloud yet"
            elseif cm.Filter == "Mine" then
                return "You haven't published anything yet"
            elseif cm.Search ~= "" or cm.Tag then
                return "No configs match your search"
            end
            return tostring(bZ.EmptyText or "No configs shared yet. Be the first!")
        end
        function c7(dM)
            ck += 1
            local dN = ck
            if cm.Filter == "Favorites" or cm.Filter == "Installed" then
                du(false)
                dC()
                cf = dK()
                ci = false
                dJ()
                dy.Visible = false
                dD(#cf == 0 and "empty" or nil, dL())
                return
            end
            if type(bZ.OnFetch) ~= "function" then
                dJ()
                dD(#cf == 0 and "empty" or nil, dL())
                return
            end
            if dM then
                if not ci then
                    return
                end
                cj += 1
            else
                cj = 1
                cf = {}
                dJ()
                dl.CanvasPosition = Vector2.zero
            end
            du(true)
            dC()
            dB(dM and 2 or 4)
            dy.Visible = false
            dD(nil)
            local dO = {
                Search = cm.Search,
                Sort = cm.Sort,
                Filter = cm.Filter,
                Tag = cm.Tag,
                Page = cj,
                PageSize = ca,
                Folder = b_.ConfigFolder,
                UserId = j.UserId,
            }
            task.spawn(function()
                local dP, dQ, dR = aK(function()
                    return bZ.OnFetch(dO)
                end)
                if dN ~= ck then
                    return
                end
                du(false)
                dC()
                if not dP or type(dQ) ~= "table" then
                    if dM then
                        cj -= 1
                    end
                    if not dP then
                        warn("[AirFlow] cloud OnFetch error: " .. tostring(dQ))
                    end
                    ci = dM and ci or false
                    dy.Visible = false
                    dD("error", not dP and "Could not load configs" or tostring(dR or "Could not load configs"))
                    return
                end
                ci = dR == true
                local dS = {}
                for dT, dU in ipairs(cf) do
                    dS[dU] = true
                end
                for dT, dU in ipairs(dQ) do
                    local dV = cD(dU)
                    if dV and not dS[dV] then
                        dS[dV] = true
                        table.insert(cf, dV)
                        dI(dV, #cf)
                    end
                end
                dy.Visible = ci
                dD(#cf == 0 and "empty" or nil, dL())
            end)
        end
        dl:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CanvasPosition"):Connect(function()
            if not ci or cl then
                return

            local dM = b_.Scale.Scale
            local dN = dl.AbsoluteCanvasSize.Y / dM - dl.AbsoluteWindowSize.Y / dM - dl.CanvasPosition.Y
            if dN < 160 then
                c7(true)

        end)
        local dM, dN = {}, {}

                dR.Set(cm.Filter == dQ, dP)

            for dQ, dR in pairs(dN) do
                dR.Set(cm.Tag == dQ, dP)

        for dP, dQ in ipairs(b7) do

        b_:_listen("Began", function(dP, dQ)
            if dQ or dP.KeyCode ~= Enum.KeyCode.Slash then

            if b_.Open and b_.CurrentTab == b0 and co == cn.Browse and not b:GetFocusedTextBox() then

        local function dP(dQ, dR, dS)
            if dQ.Code then
                dR(dQ.Code)
                return
            end
            local function dT(dU)
                if dS then
                    dS(dU)
                else
                    cw(false, "Could not load config", dU)
                end
            end
            if type(bZ.OnFetchCode) ~= "function" then
                dT("This config has no code")
                return
            end
            task.spawn(function()
                local dU, dV, dW = aK(function()
                    return bZ.OnFetchCode(cE(dQ))
                end)
                if dU and type(dV) == "string" and dV ~= "" then
                    dQ.Code = dV
                    dQ.Count = dQ.Count or cy(dV)
                    dR(dV)
                else
                    dT(tostring(dW or (not dU and "the request failed") or "no code came back"))
                end
            end)
        end
        function dF(dQ)
            if dQ._busy then
                return
            end
            dQ._busy = true
            dP(dQ, function(dR)
                dQ._busy = nil
                local dS, dT = b_:DecodeConfig(dR)
                if not dS then
                    cw(false, "Install failed", "The config code is invalid")
                    return
                end
                local dU = 0
                for dV in pairs(dS) do
                    dU += 1
                end
                local dV = cu[dQ.Id]
                local dW = nil
                if ba() then
                    dW = type(dV) == "table" and type(dV.Name) == "string" and b_:ConfigExists(dV.Name) and dV.Name
                        or cS(dQ.Name)
                end
                local dX = dT.Folder and dT.Folder ~= b_.ConfigFolder
                local function dY(dZ)
                    local d_ = dZ and dW or nil
                    local d0, d1 = b_:ImportConfig(dR, d_, true)
                    if not d0 then
                        cw(false, "Install failed", tostring(d1))
                        return
                    end
                    cu[dQ.Id] = { Updated = dQ.Updated or os.time(), Name = d_, At = os.time(), Record = cF(dQ) }
                    cv("CloudInstalled", cu)
                    dQ.Installs += 1
                    dG(dQ)
                    cw(true, "Config installed", d_ and ("Saved as " .. d_) or "Applied to your current settings")
                    if bZ.OnInstall then
                        task.spawn(aJ, bZ.OnInstall, cE(dQ), d_)
                    end
                end
                local dZ = ("%s by %s changes %d setting%s."):format(dQ.Name, dQ.Author, dU, dU == 1 and "" or "s")
                if dX then
                    dZ ..= (" It was made for %s, so only matching settings apply."):format(dT.Folder)
                end
                if dW then
                    dZ ..= (" Install also saves it as %s; Apply only doesn't."):format(dW)
                end
                local d_ = { { Title = "Cancel" } }
                table.insert(d_, {
                    Title = "Apply only",
                    Variant = not dW and "Primary" or nil,
                    Callback = function()
                        dY(false)
                    end,
                })
                if dW then
                    table.insert(d_, {
                        Title = "Install",
                        Variant = "Primary",
                        Callback = function()
                            dY(true)
                        end,
                    })
                end
                b_:Dialog({
                    Title = cG(dQ) == "Update" and "Update config" or "Install config",
                    Content = dZ,
                    Icon = dX and "triangle-alert" or "download",
                    Buttons = d_,
                })
            end, function(dR)
                dQ._busy = nil
                cw(false, "Could not load config", dR)
            end)
        end
        local function dQ(dR)
            if type(bZ.OnLike) ~= "function" or dR._liking then
                return
            end
            local dS = not dR.Liked
            dR.Liked = dS
            dR.Likes = math.max(dR.Likes + (dS and 1 or -1), 0)
            dR._liking = true
            dG(dR)
            task.spawn(function()
                local dT, dU, dV = aK(function()
                    return bZ.OnLike(cE(dR), dS)
                end)
                dR._liking = nil
                if not dT or dU == false then
                    dR.Liked = not dS
                    dR.Likes = math.max(dR.Likes + (dS and -1 or 1), 0)
                    dG(dR)
                    cw(false, "Like not saved", tostring(dV or "Try again in a moment"))
                end
            end)
        end
        local function dR(dS)
            local dT = ct[dS.Id] == nil
            ct[dS.Id] = dT and cF(dS) or nil
            cv("CloudFavorites", ct)
            dG(dS)
            b_:Notify({
                Title = dT and "Added to favorites" or "Removed from favorites",
                Content = dS.Name,
                Icon = "star",
                Duration = 2,
            })
        end
        local function dS(dT)
            local dU = table.find(cf, dT)
            if dU then
                table.remove(cf, dU)
            end
            cg[dT.Id] = nil
            local dV = ch[dT.Id]
            if dV then
                dV.Frame:Destroy()
                ch[dT.Id] = nil
            end
            if #cf == 0 and not cl then
                dD("empty", dL())
            end
        end
        local function dT(dU)
            b_:Confirm({
                Title = "Delete config",
                Content = ([[Remove %s from the cloud? People who installed it keep their copy.]]):format(dU.Name),
                Icon = "trash-2",
                ConfirmText = "Delete",
                Callback = function()
                    task.spawn(function()
                        local dV, dW, dX = aK(function()
                            return bZ.OnDelete(cE(dU))
                        end)
                        if not dV or dW == false then
                            cw(false, "Delete failed", tostring(dX or "Try again in a moment"))
                            return
                        end
                        ct[dU.Id] = nil
                        cv("CloudFavorites", ct)
                        dS(dU)
                        cV(cn.Browse)
                        cw(true, "Config deleted", dU.Name)
                    end)
                end,
            })
        end
        local function dU(dV)

        local function dW(dX)
            local dY = type(dX) == "table" and dX.Value or nil
            if dY == nil then
                return "None"
            elseif type(dY) == "boolean" then
                return dY and "On" or "Off"
            elseif type(dY) == "number" then
                return (("%.2f"):format(dY):gsub("%.?0+$", ""))
            elseif type(dY) == "table" then
                if type(dY.Hex) == "string" then
                    return "#" .. string.upper(dY.Hex)
                elseif type(dY.Colors) == "table" then
                    local dZ = type(dY.Name) == "string" and dY.Name or "Custom"
                    if type(dY.Background) == "string" and dY.Background ~= "" then
                        dZ ..= ", image"
                    end
                    return dZ
                end
                local dZ = {}
                for d_, d0 in ipairs(dY) do
                    dZ[d_] = tostring(d0)
                end
                return #dZ > 0 and table.concat(dZ, ", ") or "None"
            end
            return tostring(dY)
        end

        local function dZ(d_, d0)

                d_.Count = #d5

                    or ("%d settings, %d different from yours"):format(#d5, d6)

                        Text = d8.Value,

                        TextColor3 = d8.Changed and z.Accent or z.Muted,
                        TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right,
                        Parent = d9,

                if ch[d_.Id] then
                    dH(ch[d_.Id])
                end
            end, d1)

        function ce:_submit()
            if d_.Busy then
                return
            end
            local ek = bM(d2.Text)
            if ek == "" then
                ej("Give your config a name")
                return
            end
            local el, em, en = ef(ek)
            if en then
                ej(en)
                return
            end
            if d_.Source ~= "Keep" and (em or 0) == 0 then
                ej("There are no settings to share")
                return
            end
            local eo = d_.Mode == "Edit" and d_.Record or nil
            local ep = eo and bZ.OnUpdate or bZ.OnPublish
            if type(ep) ~= "function" then
                ej(eo and "Editing isn't available" or "Publishing isn't available")
                return
            end
            local eq = cx()
            local er = {
                Name = ek,
                Description = bM(d3.Text),
                Tags = table.clone(d_.Tags),
                Code = el,
                Count = em,
                Folder = b_.ConfigFolder,
                Author = eq and cd or j.DisplayName,
                AuthorId = not eq and j.UserId or nil,
                OwnerId = j.UserId,
                Streamer = eq,
            }
            d_.Busy = true
            ec.Text = eo and "Saving..." or "Publishing..."
            d9.Visible = false
            task.spawn(function()
                local es, et, eu = aK(function()
                    if eo then
                        return ep(cE(eo), er)
                    end
                    return ep(er)
                end)
                d_.Busy = false
                ec.Text = eo and "Save changes" or "Publish"
                if not es or et == false then
                    if not es then
                        warn("[AirFlow] cloud publish error: " .. tostring(et))
                    end
                    ej(es and eu and tostring(eu) or "Something went wrong, try again")
                    return
                end
                local ev = table.clone(er)
                ev.Code = el or (eo and eo.Code)
                ev.Updated = os.time()
                if type(et) == "table" then
                    for ew, ex in pairs(et) do
                        ev[ew] = ex
                    end
                end
                if eo then
                    ev.Id = eo.Id
                    cD(ev)
                    if ct[eo.Id] then
                        ct[eo.Id] = cF(eo)
                        cv("CloudFavorites", ct)
                    end
                    dG(eo)
                    cw(true, "Config updated", ek)
                    dE(eo)
                else
                    d2.Text = ""
                    d3.Text = ""
                    d_.Tags = {}
                    d_.Source = false
                    if type(et) == "table" then
                        ev.Mine = true
                        local ew = cD(ev)
                        if cm.Filter == "All" or cm.Filter == "Mine" then
                            table.insert(cf, 1, ew)
                            dJ()
                            dD(nil)
                        end
                        cw(true, "Config published", ek)
                        dE(ew)
                    else
                        cw(true, "Config published", ek)
                        cV(cn.Browse)
                        c7(false)
                    end
                end
            end)
        end

        dO(true)
        cV(cn.Browse)
        local ek = false
        local function el()
            if not ek and b0._page.Visible then
                ek = true
                c7(false)
            end
        end
        b0._page:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(el)
        if type(bZ.OnFetch) ~= "function" then
            ek = true
            dD("empty", dL())
        else
            task.defer(el)
        end
        return ce
    end

            ["check"] = "Success",
        }
        local CANCEL_WORDS = {
            ["cancel"] = true,
            ["close"] = true,
            ["dismiss"] = true,
            ["back"] = true,
            ["no"] = true,
            ["not now"] = true,
            ["no thanks"] = true,
            ["later"] = true,
            ["skip"] = true,
        }

        local function kindOf(value)
            if type(value) ~= "string" then
                return nil
            end
            local lowered = value:lower()
            if lowered == "success" then
                return "Success"
            elseif lowered == "warning" or lowered == "warn" then
                return "Warning"
            elseif lowered == "error" or lowered == "danger" then
                return "Error"
            elseif lowered == "info" then
                return "Info"
            end
            return nil
        end

        local function readable(color)
            if color.R * 0.299 + color.G * 0.587 + color.B * 0.114 > 0.58 then
                return Color3.fromRGB(14, 14, 14)
            end
            return Color3.fromRGB(250, 250, 250)
        end

        local function variantOf(spec)
            if spec.Danger == true or spec.Destructive == true then
                return "Danger"
            end
            if spec.Primary == true then
                return "Primary"
            end
            local lowered = tostring(spec.Variant or spec.Style or spec.Type or ""):lower()
            if lowered == "primary" or lowered == "accent" or lowered == "filled" then
                return "Primary"
            elseif lowered == "danger" or lowered == "destructive" or lowered == "error" then
                return "Danger"
            elseif lowered == "ghost" or lowered == "text" or lowered == "tertiary" or lowered == "link" then
                return "Ghost"
            end
            return "Secondary"
        end

        local kind = kindOf(opts.Type) or kindOf(opts.Kind)
        if not kind and type(opts.Icon) == "string" then
            local iconKey = (opts.Icon:gsub("^lucide:", ""))
            kind = ICON_KINDS[iconKey]
        end
        kind = kind or "Info"
        local tintColor = typeof(opts.Color) == "Color3" and opts.Color or nil
        if not tintColor then
            if kind == "Success" then
                tintColor = z.Success
            elseif kind == "Warning" then
                tintColor = z.Warning
            elseif kind == "Error" then
                tintColor = z.Error
            else
                tintColor = z.Accent
            end
        end

        local PAD = E and 18 or 20
        local BADGE = 40
        local BTN_H = E and 40 or 34
        local WIDTH = math.clamp(tonumber(opts.Width) or 340, 240, 560)
        local hasBadge = opts.Icon ~= false
        local titleText = tostring(opts.Title ~= nil and opts.Title or "Notice")
        local contentText = opts.Content ~= nil and tostring(opts.Content) or nil
        if contentText == "" then
            contentText = nil
        end
        local dismissable = opts.CloseOnBackdrop ~= false
        local handle = {}
        local closed = false
        local armed = false
        local unlisten = nil
        local body = self.Body
        local function bodySize()
            local scale = self.Scale.Scale
            if scale <= 0 then
                scale = 1
            end
            return body.AbsoluteSize / scale
        end

        -- dim layer + centred card (shadow lives beside the clipped card, not inside it)
        local backdrop = ai("TextButton", {
            Name = "Dialog",
            Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
            BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            Text = "",
            AutoButtonColor = false,
            Active = true,
            ZIndex = 50,
            Parent = body,
        })
        local holder = ai("Frame", {
            AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
            Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 14),
            Size = UDim2.fromOffset(WIDTH, 0),
            AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            Parent = backdrop,
        })
        local holderScale = ai("UIScale", { Scale = 0.94, Parent = holder })
        local shadow = ai("ImageLabel", {
            Position = UDim2.fromOffset(-30, -20),
            Size = UDim2.new(1, 60, 1, 60),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            Image = A.Shadow,
            ImageColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0),
            ImageTransparency = 1,
            ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Slice,
            SliceCenter = Rect.new(49, 49, 450, 450),
            ZIndex = 1,
            Parent = holder,
        })
        local card = ai("CanvasGroup", {
            Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0),
            AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
            BackgroundColor3 = z.Surface,
            BorderSizePixel = 0,
            GroupTransparency = 1,
            Active = true,
            ZIndex = 2,
            Parent = holder,
        })
        aj(card, UDim.new(0, 12))
        local cardStroke = ak(card, z.Stroke, 1)

        -- soft tint wash + thin accent line along the top edge
        local wash = ai("Frame", {
            Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 100),
            BackgroundColor3 = tintColor,
            BackgroundTransparency = 0.88,
            BorderSizePixel = 0,
            ZIndex = 1,
            Parent = card,
        })
        ai("UIGradient", {
            Rotation = 90,
            Transparency = NumberSequence.new({ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1) }),
            Parent = wash,
        })
        local line = ai("Frame", {
            Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 2),
            BackgroundColor3 = tintColor,
            BorderSizePixel = 0,
            ZIndex = 3,
            Parent = card,
        })
        ai("UIGradient", {
            Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
                NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.1),
                NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.6, 0.55),
                NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1),
            }),
            Parent = line,
        })

        local stack = ai("Frame", {
            Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0),
            AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            ZIndex = 2,
            Parent = card,
        })
        ai("UIListLayout", { SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder, Parent = stack })
        local main = ai("Frame", {
            LayoutOrder = 1,
            Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0),
            AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            Parent = stack,
        })
        al(main, PAD, PAD, PAD + 2, PAD)
        ai("UIListLayout", { SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder, Padding = UDim.new(0, 14), Parent = main })

        -- header: icon badge + title / subtitle
        local header = ai("Frame", {
            LayoutOrder = 1,
            Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, hasBadge and BADGE or 0),
            AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            Parent = main,
        })
        local badgeScale = nil
        if hasBadge then
            local badge = ai("Frame", {
                AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
                Position = UDim2.fromOffset(BADGE / 2, BADGE / 2),
                Size = UDim2.fromOffset(BADGE, BADGE),
                BackgroundColor3 = tintColor,
                BackgroundTransparency = 0.86,
                BorderSizePixel = 0,
                Parent = header,
            })
            aj(badge, UDim.new(0, 10))
            ak(badge, tintColor, 0.7, 1)
            badgeScale = ai("UIScale", { Scale = 0.6, Parent = badge })
            local iconName = opts.Icon
            if iconName == nil then
                iconName = KIND_ICONS[kind]
            end
            local icon = ai("ImageLabel", {
                AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
                Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5),
                Size = UDim2.fromOffset(20, 20),
                BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                ImageColor3 = tintColor,
                ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit,
                Parent = badge,
            })
            aq(icon, iconName)
            if icon.Image == "" then
                icon:Destroy()
                am({
                    Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
                    Text = KIND_GLYPHS[kind],
                    TextSize = 20,
                    FontFace = D.Bold,
                    TextColor3 = tintColor,
                    TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center,
                    Parent = badge,
                })
            end
        end
        local titleX = hasBadge and (BADGE + 12) or 0
        local titleBlock = ai("Frame", {
            Position = UDim2.fromOffset(titleX, 0),
            Size = UDim2.new(1, -titleX, 0, hasBadge and BADGE or 0),
            AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            Parent = header,
        })
        ai("UIListLayout", {
            SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
            VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center,
            Padding = UDim.new(0, 2),
            Parent = titleBlock,
        })
        am({
            LayoutOrder = 1,
            Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0),
            AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
            Text = titleText,
            TextSize = 16,
            FontFace = D.Bold,
            TextWrapped = true,
            TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.None,
            Parent = titleBlock,
        })
        if opts.Subtitle ~= nil and tostring(opts.Subtitle) ~= "" then
            am({
                LayoutOrder = 2,
                Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0),
                AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
                Text = tostring(opts.Subtitle),
                TextSize = 12,
                FontFace = D.Regular,
                TextColor3 = z.Muted,
                TextWrapped = true,
                TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.None,
                Parent = titleBlock,
            })
        end

        -- content: scrolls instead of growing past the window
        local fitContent = function() end
        if contentText then
            local scroller = ai("ScrollingFrame", {
                LayoutOrder = 2,
                Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 18),
                BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                BorderSizePixel = 0,
                ScrollBarThickness = E and 4 or 3,
                ScrollBarImageColor3 = z.Accent,
                ScrollBarImageTransparency = 0.4,
                ScrollingDirection = Enum.ScrollingDirection.Y,
                VerticalScrollBarInset = Enum.ScrollBarInset.None,
                ElasticBehavior = Enum.ElasticBehavior.Never,
                AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
                CanvasSize = UDim2.new(),
                Parent = main,
            })
            local label = am({
                Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0),
                AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
                Text = contentText,
                TextSize = 13,
                FontFace = D.Regular,
                TextColor3 = z.Muted,
                TextWrapped = true,
                TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.None,
                TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top,
                RichText = opts.RichText == true,
                LineHeight = 1.12,
                Parent = scroller,
            })
            fitContent = function()
                local maxHeight = math.max(72, math.floor(bodySize().Y * 0.5))
                local textHeight = math.ceil(label.TextBounds.Y)
                local capped = textHeight > maxHeight
                scroller.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, math.clamp(textHeight, 16, maxHeight))
                scroller.ScrollingEnabled = capped
                label.Size = UDim2.new(1, capped and -10 or 0, 0, 0)
            end
            label:GetPropertyChangedSignal("TextBounds"):Connect(fitContent)
            fitContent()
        end

        -- footer: inset strip with the buttons
        ai("Frame", {
            LayoutOrder = 2,
            Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 1),
            BackgroundColor3 = z.Stroke,
            BackgroundTransparency = 0.35,
            BorderSizePixel = 0,
            Parent = stack,
        })
        local footer = ai("Frame", {
            LayoutOrder = 3,
            Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0),
            AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
            BackgroundColor3 = z.Background,
            BackgroundTransparency = 0.25,
            BorderSizePixel = 0,
            Parent = stack,
        })
        al(footer, 14, 14, 12, 12)

        local specs = {}
        if type(opts.Buttons) == "table" then
            for _, spec in ipairs(opts.Buttons) do
                if type(spec) == "table" then
                    table.insert(specs, spec)
                elseif type(spec) == "string" then
                    table.insert(specs, { Title = spec })
                end
            end
        end
        if #specs == 0 then
            specs[1] = { Title = "OK", Variant = "Primary" }
        end
        local stacked = #specs > 2
        local fillWidth = stacked or E

        local entries = {}
        local defaultEntry = nil
        for index, spec in ipairs(specs) do
            local title = tostring(spec.Title or spec.Name or spec.Text or spec.Label or "OK")
            local entry = {
                Spec = spec,
                Title = title,
                Variant = variantOf(spec),
                Cancel = spec.Cancel == true or CANCEL_WORDS[title:lower()] == true,
            }
            if stacked and entry.Cancel and entry.Variant == "Secondary" then
                entry.Variant = "Ghost"
            end
            if spec.Default == true and not defaultEntry then
                defaultEntry = entry
            end
            entries[index] = entry
        end
        if not defaultEntry then
            for _, entry in ipairs(entries) do
                if entry.Variant == "Primary" and entry.Spec.Default ~= false then
                    defaultEntry = entry
                    break
                end
            end
        end
        local ordered = entries
        if stacked then
            ordered = {}
            for _, entry in ipairs(entries) do
                if not entry.Cancel then
                    table.insert(ordered, entry)
                end
            end
            for _, entry in ipairs(entries) do
                if entry.Cancel then
                    table.insert(ordered, entry)
                end
            end
        end

        local row = ai("Frame", {
            Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0),
            AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            Parent = footer,
        })
        ai("UIListLayout", {
            FillDirection = stacked and Enum.FillDirection.Vertical or Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal,
            HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Right,
            VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center,
            SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
            Padding = UDim.new(0, 8),
            Parent = row,
        })

        local function fire(entry, viaKey)
            if closed then
                return
            end
            if entry.Button and not viaKey then
                pcall(aE, entry.Button, entry.Ripple)
            end
            if entry.Spec.Close ~= false then
                handle.Close()
            end
            aJ(entry.Spec.Callback)
        end

        for position, entry in ipairs(ordered) do
            local variant = entry.Variant
            local primary = variant == "Primary"
            local danger = variant == "Danger"
            local ghost = variant == "Ghost"
            local solid = primary or danger
            local fill = z.Surface2
            local textColor = z.Text
            if primary then
                fill = z.Accent
                textColor = z.AccentDark
            elseif danger then
                fill = z.Error
                textColor = readable(z.Error)
            elseif ghost then
                fill = z.Surface3
                textColor = z.Muted
            end
            entry.Ripple = solid and textColor or z.Text
            local width = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, BTN_H)
            if fillWidth and not stacked and #ordered > 1 then
                width = UDim2.new(1 / #ordered, -8 * (#ordered - 1) / #ordered, 0, BTN_H)
            end
            local button = ai("TextButton", {
                LayoutOrder = position,
                Size = fillWidth and width or UDim2.fromOffset(0, BTN_H),
                AutomaticSize = fillWidth and Enum.AutomaticSize.None or Enum.AutomaticSize.X,
                BackgroundColor3 = fill,
                BackgroundTransparency = ghost and 1 or 0,
                BorderSizePixel = 0,
                Text = entry.Title,
                TextSize = 13,
                FontFace = solid and D.Bold or D.Medium,
                TextColor3 = textColor,
                TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
                AutoButtonColor = false,
                ClipsDescendants = true,
                Parent = row,
            })
            entry.Button = button
            aj(button, UDim.new(0, 8))
            al(button, 18, 18)
            if not fillWidth then
                ai("UISizeConstraint", { MinSize = Vector2.new(88, BTN_H), Parent = button })
            end
            local stroke = ak(button, z.Stroke, (solid or ghost) and 1 or 0, 1)
            local press = ai("UIScale", { Parent = button })
            button.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
                if closed then
                    return
                end
                if solid then
                    ah(button, { BackgroundTransparency = 0.12 }, 0.12)
                elseif ghost then
                    ah(button, { BackgroundTransparency = 0.5 }, 0.12)
                    ah(button, { TextColor3 = z.Text }, 0.12)
                else
                    ah(button, { BackgroundColor3 = z.Surface3 }, 0.12)
                    ah(stroke, { Color = z.StrokeHover }, 0.12)
                end
            end)
            button.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
                if closed then
                    return
                end
                ah(press, { Scale = 1 }, 0.15, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint)
                if solid then
                    ah(button, { BackgroundTransparency = 0 }, 0.2)
                elseif ghost then
                    ah(button, { BackgroundTransparency = 1 }, 0.2)
                    ah(button, { TextColor3 = z.Muted }, 0.2)
                else
                    ah(button, { BackgroundColor3 = z.Surface2 }, 0.2)
                    ah(stroke, { Color = z.Stroke }, 0.2)
                end
            end)
            button.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function()
                if not closed then
                    ah(press, { Scale = 0.97 }, 0.08)
                end
            end)
            button.MouseButton1Up:Connect(function()
                if not closed then
                    ah(press, { Scale = 1 }, 0.15, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint)
                end
            end)
            button.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                fire(entry)
            end)
        end

        function handle.Close()
            if closed then
                return
            end
            closed = true
            if self._dialog == handle then
                self._dialog = nil
            end
            if unlisten then
                task.defer(unlisten)
            end
            ah(backdrop, { BackgroundTransparency = 1 }, 0.16)
            ah(holder, { Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 8) }, 0.18, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint)
            ah(holderScale, { Scale = 0.96 }, 0.18, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint)
            ah(card, { GroupTransparency = 1 }, 0.14)
            ah(cardStroke, { Transparency = 1 }, 0.14)
            ah(shadow, { ImageTransparency = 1 }, 0.14)
            task.delay(0.2, function()
                backdrop:Destroy()
            end)
        end
        handle.Dismiss = handle.Close
        function handle.IsOpen()
            return not closed
        end

        if dismissable then
            backdrop.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                if closed then
                    return
                end
                handle.Close()
                aJ(opts.OnCancel)
            end)
        end

        -- Esc cancels, Enter takes the primary action (ignored for the first moments so the key that opened it can't answer it)
        local function relayout()
            holder.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(math.clamp(bodySize().X - 32, 220, WIDTH), 0)
            fitContent()
        end
        relayout()
        local sizeConn = body:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(relayout)
        local keyUnlisten = self:_listen("Began", function(input)
            if closed or not armed then
                return
            end
            if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Escape then
                if dismissable and opts.CloseOnEscape ~= false then
                    handle.Close()
                    aJ(opts.OnCancel)
                end
            elseif input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Return or input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.KeypadEnter then
                if defaultEntry and not b:GetFocusedTextBox() then
                    fire(defaultEntry, true)
                end
            end
        end)
        unlisten = function()
            sizeConn:Disconnect()
            keyUnlisten()
        end
        task.delay(0.15, function()
            armed = true
        end)

        self._dialog = handle
        ah(backdrop, { BackgroundTransparency = 0.42 }, 0.25)
        ah(holder, { Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5) }, 0.34, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint)
        ah(holderScale, { Scale = 1 }, 0.4, Enum.EasingStyle.Back)
        ah(card, { GroupTransparency = 0 }, 0.22)
        ah(cardStroke, { Transparency = 0 }, 0.22)
        ah(shadow, { ImageTransparency = 0.45 }, 0.3)
        if badgeScale then
            task.delay(0.08, function()
                if not closed then
                    ah(badgeScale, { Scale = 1 }, 0.45, Enum.EasingStyle.Back)
                end
            end)
        end
        return handle
    end
    function a2:Confirm(opts)
        opts = l(opts, { Name = "Title", Text = "Content", Message = "Content", Description = "Content", Image = "Icon", OnConfirm = "Callback", OnAccept = "Callback" })
        local confirmText = tostring(opts.ConfirmText or "Confirm")
        local destructive = opts.Danger
        if destructive == nil then
            destructive = opts.Destructive
        end
        if destructive == nil then
            local firstWord = confirmText:lower():match("^%a+")
            local DANGER_WORDS = {
                delete = true,
                remove = true,
                reset = true,
                erase = true,
                clear = true,
                wipe = true,
                discard = true,
                destroy = true,
                uninstall = true,
                revoke = true,
                ban = true,
                kick = true,
            }
            destructive = firstWord ~= nil and DANGER_WORDS[firstWord] == true
        end
        local icon = opts.Icon
        if icon == nil and destructive then
            icon = "triangle-alert"
        end
        return self:Dialog({
            Title = opts.Title ~= nil and opts.Title or "Are you sure?",
            Subtitle = opts.Subtitle,
            Content = opts.Content,
            Icon = icon,
            Type = opts.Type or opts.Kind or (destructive and "Error" or nil),
            Color = opts.Color,
            Width = opts.Width,
            RichText = opts.RichText,
            CloseOnBackdrop = opts.CloseOnBackdrop,
            CloseOnEscape = opts.CloseOnEscape,
            OnCancel = opts.OnCancel,
            Buttons = {
                { Title = opts.CancelText or "Cancel", Cancel = true, Callback = opts.OnCancel },
                { Title = confirmText, Variant = destructive and "Danger" or "Primary", Callback = opts.Callback },
            },
        })
    end
    function a2:_listen(bZ, b_, b0)
        local b1 = self._inputListeners[bZ]
        table.insert(b1, b_)
        local function b2()
            for b3, b5 in ipairs(b1) do
                if b5 == b_ then
                    table.remove(b1, b3)
                    break
                end
            end
        end
        if b0 then
            b0._listeners = b0._listeners or {}
            table.insert(b0._listeners, b2)
        end
        return b2
    end
    function a2:_indicatorY(bZ)
        local b_ = self._tabStack
        return (bZ._button.AbsolutePosition.Y - b_.AbsolutePosition.Y) / self.Scale.Scale + b_.Position.Y.Offset
    end
    -- keeps the sidebar indicator glued to the active tab while the layout moves (section fold / unfold, tab hidden)
    function a2:_followIndicator(duration)
        if not self._introDone or self._destroyed then
            return
        end
        self._followToken = (self._followToken or 0) + 1
        local token = self._followToken
        local started = os.clock()
        local indicator = self.Indicator
        local connection
        local function step(final)
            local tab = self.CurrentTab
            if not tab or not tab._button or not tab._button.Parent then
                return
            end
            if tab._hidden or tab._collapsedHidden then
                if final then
                    indicator.Visible = false
                end
                return
            end
            local button = tab._button
            local scale = math.max(self.Scale.Scale, 0.05)
            local height = final and H or math.clamp(button.AbsoluteSize.Y / scale, 0, H)
            indicator.Visible = button.Visible and height > 0.5
            indicator.Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 0, height)
            indicator.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(8, self:_indicatorY(tab))
        end
        connection = d.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
            if token ~= self._followToken or self._destroyed then
                connection:Disconnect()
                return
            end
            if os.clock() - started >= duration then
                connection:Disconnect()
                step(true)
                return
            end
            step(false)
        end)
    end
    function a2:_placeIndicator(bZ)
        local b_ = self.Indicator
        local b0 = self:_indicatorY(bZ)
        self._followToken = (self._followToken or 0) + 1
        if not b_.Visible then
            b_.Visible = true
            b_.Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 0, H)
            b_.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(8, b0)
            b_.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            ah(b_, { BackgroundTransparency = 0.35 }, 0.3)
            if self._indicatorStroke then
                self._indicatorStroke.Transparency = 1
                ah(self._indicatorStroke, { Transparency = 0.84 }, 0.3)
            end
            if self._indicatorTint then
                self._indicatorTint.BackgroundTransparency = 1
                ah(self._indicatorTint, { BackgroundTransparency = 0.8 }, 0.3)
            end
            if self._indicatorGlow then
                self._indicatorGlow.ImageTransparency = 1
                ah(self._indicatorGlow, { ImageTransparency = 0.7 }, 0.3)
            end
        end
        local pill = self._indicatorPill
        if pill then
            pill.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(3, 7)
            ah(pill, { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(3, 16) }, 0.5, Enum.EasingStyle.Back)
        end
        local travel = math.abs(b0 - b_.Position.Y.Offset)
        ah(b_, { Position = UDim2.fromOffset(8, b0) }, 0.45, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint)
        -- liquid stretch: the highlight elongates while it travels, then settles back to its normal height
        self._stretchGen = (self._stretchGen or 0) + 1
        local stretchGen = self._stretchGen
        if travel > 2 then
            ah(b_, { Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 0, H + math.min(travel * 0.22, 16)) }, 0.14, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad)
            task.delay(0.14, function()
                if self._stretchGen == stretchGen and not self._destroyed then
                    ah(b_, { Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 0, H) }, 0.34, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint)
                end
            end)
        else
            b_.Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 0, H)
        end
    end

    function a2:_scrollTabIntoView(bZ)
        local b_ = self.TabList
        local b0 = self.Scale.Scale
        local b1 = (bZ._button.AbsolutePosition.Y - b_.AbsolutePosition.Y) / b0 + b_.CanvasPosition.Y

        local b3 = b_.AbsoluteWindowSize.Y / b0
        local b5 = b_.CanvasPosition.Y
        if b1 - 8 < b5 then
            b5 = b1 - 8
        elseif b2 + 8 > b5 + b3 then
            b5 = b2 + 8 - b3
        else
            return
        end
        ah(b_, { CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(0, math.max(0, b5)) }, 0.35, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint)

    function a2:_closePopups()

    function a2:_popoutLayer()
        if self._popLayer then
            return self._popLayer
        end
        local bZ = ai(
            "Frame",

        self._popLayer = bZ
        self._popPanels = {}
        self:_listen("Render", function()
            local b0 = math.max(self.Scale.Scale, 0.05)
            if math.abs(b_.Scale - b0) > 1e-4 then

            end

        end)

    end
