        self._miniUnhover = function()
            c5, c6, dd = false, false, false
            c8, da = nil, false
            dc += 1
            ce.Scale = 1
            IslandX.clear()
            task.delay(0.15, function()
                if not self.Minimized then
                    dk("Compact", true)
                end
            end)
        end
        function IslandX.badgeUpdate()
            local n = #IslandX.queue
            IslandX.badge.Visible = n > 0
            IslandX.badge.Text = "+" .. n
        end
        function IslandX.title(item)
            if item.Count > 1 then
                return string.format("%s  ×%d", item.Title, item.Count)
            end
            return item.Title
        end
        function IslandX.readTime(item)
            local d = item.Duration
            local dur
            if d and d > 0 then
                dur = math.clamp(d, 1.5, 6)
            else
                dur = math.clamp(2.2 + #item.Content / 30 + #item.Title / 60, 2.6, 6)
            end
            if #IslandX.queue > 0 then
                dur = math.max(1.8, dur * 0.65)
            end
            return math.floor(dur * 10 + 0.5) / 10
        end
        function IslandX.arm(dur, tint)
            dc += 1
            local gen = dc
            IslandX.pgFill.BackgroundColor3 = tint
            IslandX.pgFill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
            ah(IslandX.pgFill, { Size = UDim2.fromScale(0, 1) }, dur, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear)
            task.delay(dur, function()
                IslandX.finish(gen)
            end)
            return gen
        end
        function IslandX.show(item, chained)
            local tint = a1[item.Type] or z.Accent
            IslandX.current = item
            IslandX.busy = true
            cY.Text = IslandX.title(item)
            cY.TextColor3 = a1[item.Type] or z.Text
            cZ.Text = item.Content
            cZ.Visible = item.Content ~= ""
            local icon = item.Icon
            if icon == nil then
                icon = ({ Success = "circle-check", Warning = "triangle-alert", Error = "circle-x" })[item.Type] or "bell"
            end
            aq(cW, icon)
            if not cW:GetAttribute("CustomIcon") then
                cW.ImageColor3 = tint
            end
            cV.BackgroundColor3 = tint
            ah(IslandX.plateStroke, { Color = tint }, 0.25)
            ah(IslandX.actGlow, { ImageColor3 = tint }, 0.25)
            IslandX.iconScale.Scale = 0.45
            ah(IslandX.iconScale, { Scale = 1 }, 0.55, Enum.EasingStyle.Back)
            IslandX.rimTo(tint, 0.28, 0.3)
            IslandX.badgeUpdate()
            dd = true
            IslandX.arm(IslandX.readTime(item), tint)
            if chained then
                cY.TextTransparency = 1
                cZ.TextTransparency = 1
                cW.ImageTransparency = 1
                ah(cY, { TextTransparency = 0 }, 0.22, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad)
                ah(cZ, { TextTransparency = 0 }, 0.22, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad)
                ah(cW, { ImageTransparency = 0 }, 0.22, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad)
            end
            task.defer(function()
                if IslandX.current ~= item or c5 or da then
                    return
                end
                local fresh = c1 ~= "Activity"
                dk("Activity")
                if fresh then
                    ce.Scale = 0.96
                    ah(ce, { Scale = 1 }, 0.4, Enum.EasingStyle.Back)
                end
            end)
        end
        function IslandX.pump(chained)
            if IslandX.busy or not IslandX.ready or c5 or da then
                return
            end
            if not self.Minimized or self._destroyed or not cc.Visible then
                return
            end
            local item = table.remove(IslandX.queue, 1)
            if item then
                IslandX.show(item, chained)
            end
        end
        function IslandX.finish(gen)
            if gen and dc ~= gen then
                return
            end
            IslandX.busy = false
            IslandX.current = nil
            dd = false
            if not self.Minimized or self._destroyed then
                return
            end
            if #IslandX.queue > 0 and IslandX.ready and not c5 and not da then
                IslandX.pump(true)
            else
                IslandX.rimReset(0.4)
                if not c5 then
                    dl()
                end
            end
        end
        function IslandX.reset()
            IslandX.busy = false
            IslandX.current = nil
            IslandX.ready = false
            IslandX.readyGen += 1
            local g = IslandX.readyGen
            IslandX.rimReset(0)
            task.delay(0.55, function()
                if IslandX.readyGen == g and self.Minimized and not self._destroyed then
                    IslandX.ready = true
                    IslandX.pump()
                end
            end)
        end
        function IslandX.clear()
            IslandX.queue = {}
            IslandX.busy = false
            IslandX.current = nil
            IslandX.ready = false
            IslandX.readyGen += 1
            IslandX.badgeUpdate()
            IslandX.rimReset(0)
        end
        self._islandClear = function()
            IslandX.queue = {}
            IslandX.badgeUpdate()
        end
        self._islandActivity = function(n)
            if not self.Minimized or not cc.Visible then
                return
            end
            local item = {
                Type = n.Type,
                Title = tostring(n.Title or "Notification"),
                Content = tostring(n.Content or ""),
                Icon = n.Icon,
                Duration = tonumber(n.Duration),
                Count = 1,
            }
            local function same(o)
                return o ~= nil and o.Type == item.Type and o.Title == item.Title and o.Content == item.Content
            end
            local cur = IslandX.current
            if IslandX.busy and same(cur) then
                cur.Count += 1
                cY.Text = IslandX.title(cur)
                IslandX.arm(IslandX.readTime(cur), a1[cur.Type] or z.Accent)
                if c1 == "Activity" and not c5 and not da then
                    ce.Scale = 1.04
                    ah(ce, { Scale = 1 }, 0.35, Enum.EasingStyle.Back)
                end
                return
            end
            local last = IslandX.queue[#IslandX.queue]
            if same(last) then
                last.Count += 1
                return
            end
            table.insert(IslandX.queue, item)
            while #IslandX.queue > 5 do
                table.remove(IslandX.queue, 1)
            end
            IslandX.badgeUpdate()
            IslandX.pump()
        end
        local dm = 0
        self:_listen("Render", function()
            if cc.Visible and c1 == "Compact" then
                cq.BackgroundTransparency = 0.14 + 0.14 * math.sin(os.clock() * 2.6)
            end
            if cc.Visible and dm > 0 and c1 == "Compact" then
                local dn = os.clock()
                for dp, dq in ipairs(co) do
                    local dr = 0.5 + 0.5 * math.sin(dn * (6 + dp * 1.4) + dp * 1.9)
                    dq.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(3, math.floor(4 + dr * 11 + 0.5))
                end
            end
        end)
        self:_listen("Render", function()
            local gt = cc.GroupTransparency
            local shown = cc.Visible and gt < 0.98
            local host = IslandX.shadowHost
            if host.Visible ~= shown then
                host.Visible = shown
            end
            if not shown then
                return
            end
            host.Position = cc.Position
            host.Size = cc.Size
            IslandX.shadowScale.Scale = ce.Scale
            IslandX.shadow.ImageTransparency = 1 - 0.55 * (1 - gt)
            IslandX.halo.ImageTransparency = 1 - IslandX.haloLevel.Value * (1 - gt)
            local now = os.clock()
            IslandX.rimGrad.Rotation = (now * 75) % 360
            if c1 == "Compact" and cq.Visible then
                local phase = (now * 0.85) % 1
                local ringSize = 5 + math.floor(phase * 11 + 0.5)
                IslandX.ripple.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(ringSize, ringSize)
                IslandX.rippleStroke.Color = cq.BackgroundColor3
                IslandX.rippleStroke.Transparency = 0.3 + 0.7 * phase
            end
        end)
        local dn = am({
            AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
            Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5),
            Size = UDim2.new(1, -28, 0, 16),
            TextSize = 12,
            FontFace = D.Bold,
            TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center,
            RichText = true,
            TextTransparency = 1,
            Parent = ci,
        })
        local dp = ai(
            "TextButton",
            {
                Name = "IslandBubble",
                AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
                Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0),
                BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0),
                BorderSizePixel = 0,
                Text = "",
                AutoButtonColor = false,
                Visible = false,
                ZIndex = 30,
                Parent = cb,
            }
        )
        aj(dp, UDim.new(1, 0))
        local dq = ai("NumberValue", { Value = 0 })
        local dr = false
        local ds = nil
        local function dt(du)
            if du == dr then
                return
            end
            dr = du
            cn.Parent = du and dp or cm
            cn.AnchorPoint = du and Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5) or Vector2.new(0, 0)
            cn.Position = du and UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5) or UDim2.new()
            cm.Visible = not du
            ah(dn, { TextTransparency = du and 0 or 1 }, 0.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad)
            ah(
                dq,
                { Value = du and 1 or 0 },
                du and 0.55 or 0.3,
                du and Enum.EasingStyle.Back or Enum.EasingStyle.Quint
            )
            if du then
                ce.Scale = 0.96
                ah(ce, { Scale = 1 }, 0.45, Enum.EasingStyle.Back)
            end
        end
        self:_listen("Render", function()
            local du = dq.Value * cf.Value
            local dv = cc.Visible and du > 0.02 and cc.GroupTransparency < 0.5
            dp.Visible = dv
            if not dv then
                return
            end
            local dw = cb.AbsolutePosition
            local dx, dy = cc.AbsolutePosition - dw, cc.AbsoluteSize
            local dz = math.min(dy.Y, b7.Height)
            local dA = 6
            local dB = dx.X + dy.X + dA + dz <= cb.AbsoluteSize.X
            local dC = dB and dx.X + dy.X or dx.X
            local dD = dB and 1 or -1
            local dE = dC - dD * dz * 0.6
            local dF = dC + dD * (dA + dz / 2)
            local dG = dE + (dF - dE) * du
            local dH = math.clamp(0.35 + 0.65 * du, 0, 1.2)
            local dI = math.sin(math.clamp(du, 0, 1) * math.pi)
            dp.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(dG, dx.Y + dz / 2)
            dp.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(dz * dH * (1 + 0.4 * dI), dz * dH * (1 - 0.18 * dI))
            dp.BackgroundTransparency = cc.GroupTransparency
        end)
        dp.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            if self.Minimized then
                self:Restore()
            end
        end)
        local du = {}
        function self:_refreshMini()
            local dv = 0
            for dw, dx in pairs(k.Flags) do
                if dx._type == "Toggle" and dx.Value == true then
                    dv += 1
                end
            end
            if dv ~= dm then
                local dw = dv > dm
                dm = dv
                cp.Text = tostring(dv)
                for dx, dy in ipairs(co) do
                    ah(dy, { BackgroundColor3 = dv > 0 and z.Accent or z.Muted }, 0.25)
                    if dv == 0 then
                        ah(dy, { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(3, 3) }, 0.25)
                    end
                end
                if dw and c1 == "Compact" and cc.Visible then
                    ce.Scale = 1.06
                    ah(ce, { Scale = 1 }, 0.4, Enum.EasingStyle.Back)
                end
            end
            cJ.Text = tostring(dv)
            local dw = {}
            for dx, dy in pairs(k.Flags) do
                if dy._type == "Toggle" and dy.Value == true and dy._searchName ~= "" then
                    table.insert(dw, dy._searchName)
                end
            end
            table.sort(dw)
            local dx = {}
            for dy = 1, math.min(#dw, 3) do
                dx[dy] = k._rich(dw[dy])
            end
            local dy = #dw - #dx
            cM.Text = '<font color="#8A8A93">Running </font>'
                .. table.concat(dx, '<font color="#8A8A93"> \u{b7} </font>')
                .. (dy > 0 and string.format('<font color="#8A8A93">  +%d</font>', dy) or "")
            cM.Visible = #dw > 0
            ds = nil
            for dz, dA in ipairs(self._pinned) do
                if not dA._isShown or dA:_isShown() then
                    ds = dA
                    break
                end
            end
            if ds then
                local dz = tostring(ds:Text() or "")
                if dz:gsub("<[^>]*>", ""):match("%S") then
                    dn.Text = dz
                    local dA = ds._shownColor and ds._shownColor() or z.Text
                    local dB, dC, dD = dA:ToHSV()
                    dn.TextColor3 = dD < 0.35 and z.Text or dA
                else
                    ds = nil
                end
            end
            dt(dm > 0 and ds ~= nil)
            local dz = dm > 0 and not dr
            cq.Visible = not dz
            cr.Visible = not dz
            cp.Visible = dz
            cn.Visible = dm > 0
            cm.Visible = not dr
            cl.Visible = not dr
            IslandX.logoPlate.Visible = not dr and IslandX.logo.Image ~= ""
            local dA = typeof(self.Keybind) == "EnumItem" and aI(self.Keybind)
            cN.Text = E and "Tap to open" or (dA and ("Click or press " .. dA .. " to open") or "Click to open")
            local dC = {}
            for dD, dE in ipairs(self._pinned) do
                if (not dE._isShown or dE:_isShown()) and #dC < b7.Pinned then
                    table.insert(dC, dE)
                end
            end
            cL.Visible = false
            for dD = 1, math.max(#dC, #du) do
                local dE = dC[dD]
                local dF = du[dD]
                if dE then
                    if not dF then
                        local dG = ai(
                            "Frame",
                            { Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 18), BackgroundTransparency = 1, LayoutOrder = dD, Parent = cL }
                        )
                        dF = {
                            Frame = dG,
                            Key = am({
                                Size = UDim2.new(0.5, -4, 1, 0),
                                TextSize = 12,
                                FontFace = D.Regular,
                                TextColor3 = z.Muted,
                                RichText = true,
                                Parent = dG,
                            }),
                            Value = am({
                                AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0),
                                Position = UDim2.fromScale(1, 0),
                                Size = UDim2.new(0.5, -4, 1, 0),
                                TextSize = 12,
                                TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right,
                                RichText = true,
                                Parent = dG,
                            }),
                        }
                        du[dD] = dF
                    end
                    dF.Frame.Visible = true
                    dF.Key.Text = k._rich(dE.Name)
                    dF.Value.Text = dE:Text()
                    local dG = dE._shownColor and dE._shownColor() or z.Text
                    if dF.Value.TextColor3 ~= dG then
                        ah(dF.Value, { TextColor3 = dG }, 0.2)
                    end
                elseif dF then
                    dF.Frame.Visible = false
                end
            end
            if c1 == "Expanded" and (c5 or self.IslandStyle == "Always Show") then
                task.defer(function()
                    if c1 == "Expanded" and (c5 or self.IslandStyle == "Always Show") and self.Minimized then
                        local dD = de("Expanded")
                        if math.abs(dD.Y - cc.Size.Y.Offset) > 1 then
                            dk("Expanded")
                        end
                    end
                end)
            end
        end
        self.MiniBar = cc
        self.Island = cc
        return cc
    end
    function a2:Minimize()
        if self.Minimized or not self._introDone or not self.Open or self._destroyed then
            return
        end
        self.Minimized = true
        self._minimizeGeneration = (self._minimizeGeneration or 0) + 1
        local cb = self._minimizeGeneration
        self:_closePopups()
        self:_refreshToggleButton()
        self:_refreshBackdrop()
        local cc = self:_buildMiniBar()
        self:_refreshMini()
        local cd = self.Gui
        local ce = self.Root.AbsolutePosition - cd.AbsolutePosition
        local cf = self.Root.AbsoluteSize
        local cg = 1
        if self._ghost then
            ce = self._ghost.AbsolutePosition - cd.AbsolutePosition
            cf = self._ghost.AbsoluteSize
            cg = self._ghost.BackgroundTransparency
        end
        local ch, ci, cj = b8(self, ce, cf, k._radius(10))
        ch.BackgroundTransparency = cg
        ci.Transparency = cg
        ah(ch, { BackgroundTransparency = 0 }, 0.11, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad)
        ah(ci, { Transparency = 0 }, 0.11, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad)
        ah(self.Scale, { Scale = (self._fitScale or 1) * 0.985 }, 0.11, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad)
        ah(self.Shadow, { ImageTransparency = 1 }, 0.2)
        cc.Visible = true
        cc.GroupTransparency = 1
        task.delay(0.11, function()
            if self._minimizeGeneration ~= cb or self._destroyed then
                return
            end
            self.Root.Visible = false
            self.Scale.Scale = self._fitScale or 1
            local ck, cl = self:_miniLand(ce + cf / 2)
            b9(ch, cj, ck, cl, math.floor(cl.Y / 2), 0.36)
            task.delay(0.3, function()
                if self._minimizeGeneration ~= cb or self._destroyed then
                    return
                end
                self._miniScale.Scale = 0.9
                ah(self._miniScale, { Scale = 1 }, 0.3, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint)
                ah(cc, { GroupTransparency = 0 }, 0.18, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad)
                ca(self, ch, ci, 0.2)
                if self.IslandStyle == "Always Show" then
                    task.delay(0.22, function()
                        if self._minimizeGeneration == cb and self._islandSettle then
                            self._islandSettle()
                        end
                    end)
                end
            end)
        end)
        task.spawn(function()
            while self.Minimized and self._minimizeGeneration == cb and not self._destroyed do
                self:_refreshMini()
                task.wait(0.5)
            end
        end)
    end
    function a2:Restore()
        if not self.Minimized or self._destroyed then
            return
        end
        self.Minimized = false
        self._minimizeGeneration = (self._minimizeGeneration or 0) + 1
        local cb = self._minimizeGeneration
        self:_refreshToggleButton()
        self:_refreshBackdrop(true)
        local cc = self.Gui
        local cd = self.MiniBar
        local ce = self._fitScale or 1
        local cf = Vector2.new(self.Root.Size.X.Offset, self.Root.Size.Y.Offset) * ce
        local cg = self.Root.AbsolutePosition + self.Root.AbsoluteSize / 2 - cc.AbsolutePosition
        local ch = cg - cf / 2
        local ci, cj = ch, cf
        local ck = 1
        if self._ghost then
            ci = self._ghost.AbsolutePosition - cc.AbsolutePosition
            cj = self._ghost.AbsoluteSize
            ck = self._ghost.BackgroundTransparency
        elseif cd and cd.Visible then
            ci = self._miniOrb.AbsolutePosition - cc.AbsolutePosition
            cj = self._miniOrb.AbsoluteSize
        end
        if cd and cd.Visible then
            if self._miniUnhover then
                self._miniUnhover()
            end
            ah(cd, { GroupTransparency = 1 }, 0.12, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad)
            task.delay(0.12, function()
                if self._minimizeGeneration == cb then
                    cd.Visible = false
                end
            end)
        end
        local cl, cm, cn = b8(self, ci, cj, math.floor(math.min(cj.X, cj.Y) / 2))
        cl.BackgroundTransparency = ck
        cm.Transparency = ck
        ah(cl, { BackgroundTransparency = 0 }, 0.1, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad)
        ah(cm, { Transparency = 0 }, 0.1, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad)
        b9(cl, cn, ch, cf, k._radius(10), 0.4)
        ah(self.Shadow, { ImageTransparency = self._shadowRest }, 0.45)
        task.delay(0.3, function()
            if self._minimizeGeneration ~= cb or self._destroyed then
                return
            end
            self.Scale.Scale = ce
            self.BodyStroke.Transparency = 0
            self.Root.Visible = true
        end)
        task.delay(0.4, function()
            if self._ghost == cl and self._minimizeGeneration == cb then
                ca(self, cl, cm, 0.22)
            end
        end)
    end
    function a2:ClearIslandQueue()
        if self._islandClear then
            self._islandClear()
        end
    end
    function a2:SetIslandDraggable(cb)
        self._islandLocked = cb == false
    end
    function a2:ResetIslandPosition()
        self._islandAnchor = nil
        if self._islandReset then
            self._islandReset()
        end
        self:_writeConfigSettings({ IslandPosition = false })
    end
    function a2:SetMinimized(cb)
        if cb then
            self:Minimize()
        else
            self:Restore()
        end
    end
    function a2:Toggle(cb)
        if not self._introDone then
            return
        end
        if self.Minimized then
            if cb ~= false then
                self:Restore()
            end
            return
        end
        if cb == nil then
            cb = not self.Open
        end
        if cb == self.Open then
            return
        end
        self.Open = cb
        self:_refreshToggleButton()
        self:_refreshBackdrop(cb)
        self._minimizeGeneration = (self._minimizeGeneration or 0) + 1
        local cc = self._minimizeGeneration
        local cd = self.Gui
        local ce = self._fitScale or 1
        local cf = Vector2.new(self.Root.Size.X.Offset, self.Root.Size.Y.Offset) * ce
        local cg = self.Root.AbsolutePosition + self.Root.AbsoluteSize / 2 - cd.AbsolutePosition
        local ch = cf * 0.94
        local ci, cj, ck
        if self._ghost then
            ci = self._ghost.AbsolutePosition - cd.AbsolutePosition
            cj = self._ghost.AbsoluteSize
            ck = self._ghost.BackgroundTransparency
        end
        if cb then
            local cl, cm, cn = b8(self, ci or cg - ch / 2, cj or ch, k._radius(10))
            cl.BackgroundTransparency = ck or 1
            cm.Transparency = ck or 1
            ah(cl, { BackgroundTransparency = 0 }, 0.12, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad)
            ah(cm, { Transparency = 0 }, 0.12, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad)
            b9(cl, cn, cg - cf / 2, cf, k._radius(10), 0.3)
            ah(self.Shadow, { ImageTransparency = self._shadowRest }, 0.3)
            task.delay(0.2, function()
                if self._minimizeGeneration ~= cc or self._destroyed then
                    return
                end
                self.Scale.Scale = ce
                self.BodyStroke.Transparency = 0
                self.Root.Visible = true
            end)
            task.delay(0.3, function()
                if self._ghost == cl and self._minimizeGeneration == cc then
                    ca(self, cl, cm, 0.18)
                end
            end)
        else
            self:_closePopups()
            local cl = ci or self.Root.AbsolutePosition - cd.AbsolutePosition
            local cm = cj or self.Root.AbsoluteSize
            local cn, co, cp = b8(self, cl, cm, k._radius(10))
            cn.BackgroundTransparency = ck or 1
            co.Transparency = ck or 1
            ah(cn, { BackgroundTransparency = 0 }, 0.08, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad)
            ah(co, { Transparency = 0 }, 0.08, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad)
            ah(self.Shadow, { ImageTransparency = 1 }, 0.16)
            task.delay(0.08, function()
                if self._minimizeGeneration ~= cc or self._destroyed then
                    return
                end
                self.Root.Visible = false
                b9(cn, cp, cg - ch / 2, ch, k._radius(10), 0.2)
                ca(self, cn, co, 0.16)
            end)
        end
    end
    function a2:SetKeepOnScreen(cb)
        self.KeepOnScreen = cb ~= false
        if self.KeepOnScreen then
            self:_clampToScreen()
        end
    end
    function a2:SetKeybind(cb)
        self.Keybind = cb
        if self._keyChipLabel then
            self._keyChipLabel.Text = aI(cb)
        end
    end
    function a2:Notify(opts)
        opts = l(opts, { Text = "Content", Message = "Content", Image = "Icon", Name = "Title" })
        if self.Minimized and self._islandActivity then
            self._islandActivity(opts)
        end
        local holder = self.NotifyHolder
        if self._destroyed or not holder or not holder.Parent then
            local noop = function() end
            return {
                Dismiss = noop,
                Close = noop,
                Update = noop,
                Restart = noop,
                IsAlive = function()
                    return false
                end,
            }
        end

        local GAP = 8
        local slideOff = E and UDim2.fromOffset(0, -36) or UDim2.fromOffset(340, 0)
        local KIND_ICONS = { Success = "circle-check", Warning = "triangle-alert", Error = "circle-x", Info = "info" }
        local KIND_GLYPHS = { Success = "\u{2713}", Warning = "!", Error = "\u{d7}", Info = "i" }

        local function kindName(value)
            if type(value) ~= "string" then
                return nil
            end
            local v = value:lower()
            if v == "success" then
                return "Success"
            elseif v == "warning" or v == "warn" then
                return "Warning"
            elseif v == "error" or v == "danger" then
                return "Error"
            elseif v == "info" then
                return "Info"
            end
            return nil
        end

        local kind = kindName(opts.Type)
        local customColor = typeof(opts.Color) == "Color3" and opts.Color or nil
        local function tintColor()
            if customColor then
                return customColor
            end
            if kind == "Success" then
                return z.Success
            elseif kind == "Warning" then
                return z.Warning
            elseif kind == "Error" then
                return z.Error
            end
            return z.Accent
        end

        local titleText = tostring(opts.Title or "Notification")
        local contentText = opts.Content ~= nil and tostring(opts.Content) or nil
        if contentText == "" then
            contentText = nil
        end
        local explicitIcon = opts.Icon ~= nil
        local iconName = opts.Icon
        if iconName == nil then
            iconName = KIND_ICONS[kind] or "bell"
        end

        -- no Duration given: scale the time on screen with how much there is to read
        local duration = tonumber(opts.Duration)
        if duration == nil then
            duration = math.clamp(2.6 + (#titleText + #(contentText or "")) / 26, 4, 9)
        end
        local persist = duration <= 0

        local buttons = {}
        for _, spec in ipairs(type(opts.Buttons) == "table" and opts.Buttons or {}) do
            if type(spec) == "table" and #buttons < 3 then
                table.insert(buttons, spec)
            end
        end
        local clickFn = opts.OnClick or opts.Callback

        local function makeKey()
            return (kind or "") .. "\n" .. titleText .. "\n" .. (contentText or "")
        end

        -- the same message again: count it on the existing toast instead of stacking a copy
        if opts.Stack ~= false and #buttons == 0 and type(clickFn) ~= "function" then
            local key = makeKey()
            for _, existing in ipairs(self._toasts) do
                if existing._key == key and existing._alive() then
                    existing._bump(duration)
                    return existing
                end
            end
        end

        ---------------------------------------------------------------- build
        self._notifyOrder = self._notifyOrder + 1
        local slot = ai("Frame", {
            Name = "Toast",
            Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            LayoutOrder = self._notifyOrder,
            Parent = holder,
        })
        local lane = ai("Frame", {
            Position = slideOff,
            Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0),
            AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            Parent = slot,
        })
        local shadow = ai("ImageLabel", {
            Position = UDim2.fromOffset(-22, -18),
            Size = UDim2.new(1, 44, 1, 44),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            Image = A.Shadow,
            ImageColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0),
            ImageTransparency = 1,
            ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Slice,
            SliceCenter = Rect.new(49, 49, 450, 450),
            ZIndex = 0,
            Parent = lane,
        })
        local card = ai("CanvasGroup", {
            Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0),
            AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
            BackgroundColor3 = z.Background,
            BorderSizePixel = 0,
            GroupTransparency = 1,
            Active = true,
            Parent = lane,
        })
        aj(card, UDim.new(0, 12))
        local stroke = ak(card, z.Stroke)

        local sheen = ao(card)
        sheen.BackgroundTransparency = 0.86
        ai("UIGradient", {
            Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
                NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1),
                NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, 0),
                NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1),
            }),
            Parent = sheen,
        })

        -- soft colour wash fading out from the left edge + a short accent rail
        local wash = ai("Frame", {
            Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
            BackgroundColor3 = tintColor(),
            BackgroundTransparency = 0.86,
            BorderSizePixel = 0,
            Parent = card,
        })
        ai("UIGradient", {
            Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
                NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0),
                NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.6, 0.78),
                NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1),
            }),
            Parent = wash,
        })
        local rail = ai("Frame", {
            AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5),
            Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 0.5),
            Size = UDim2.new(0, 3, 1, -28),
            BackgroundColor3 = tintColor(),
            BorderSizePixel = 0,
            Parent = card,
        })
        aj(rail, UDim.new(0, 2))

        local body = ai("Frame", {
            Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0),
            AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            Parent = card,
        })
        al(body, 16, 14, 13, 17)

        local badge = ai("Frame", {
            AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
            Position = UDim2.fromOffset(15, 15),
            Size = UDim2.fromOffset(30, 30),
            BackgroundColor3 = z.Surface3,
            BorderSizePixel = 0,
            Parent = body,
        })
        aj(badge, UDim.new(0, 9))
        local badgeStroke = ak(badge, z.Stroke, 0.4)
        local badgeScale = ai("UIScale", { Scale = 0.6, Parent = badge })
        local icon = ai("ImageLabel", {
            AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
            Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5),
            Size = UDim2.fromOffset(16, 16),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            ImageColor3 = z.Text,
            ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit,
            Parent = badge,
        })
        local glyph = am({
            Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
            Text = "",
            TextSize = 16,
            FontFace = D.Bold,
            TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center,
            TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.None,
            Visible = false,
            Parent = badge,
        })

        local column = ai("Frame", {
            Position = UDim2.fromOffset(40, 0),
            Size = UDim2.new(1, -40, 0, 0),
            AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            Parent = body,
        })
        ai("UIListLayout", { SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder, Padding = UDim.new(0, 3), Parent = column })
        local columnPad = al(column, 0, 0, 0, 0)

        local closable = opts.Closable ~= false
        local titleRow = ai("Frame", {
            Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 18),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            LayoutOrder = 1,
            Parent = column,
        })
        local titleLabel = am({
            Size = UDim2.new(1, closable and -26 or 0, 1, 0),
            Text = titleText,
            TextSize = 14,
            FontFace = D.Bold,
            TextColor3 = z.Text,
            Parent = titleRow,
        })
        local chip = am({
            AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5),
            Position = UDim2.new(1, closable and -26 or 0, 0.5, 0),
            Size = UDim2.fromOffset(30, 16),
            BackgroundColor3 = z.Surface3,
            BackgroundTransparency = 0,
            Text = "",
            TextSize = 11,
            FontFace = D.Bold,
            TextColor3 = z.Text,
            TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center,
            TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.None,
            Visible = false,
            Parent = titleRow,
        })
        aj(chip, UDim.new(0, 8))

        local contentLabel = am({
            Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0),
            AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
            Text = contentText or "",
            TextSize = 13,
            FontFace = D.Regular,
            TextColor3 = z.Muted,
            TextWrapped = true,
            TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.None,
            TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top,
            RichText = opts.RichText == true,
            Visible = contentText ~= nil,
            LayoutOrder = 2,
            Parent = column,
        })

        local actions = nil
        if #buttons > 0 then
            actions = ai("Frame", {
                Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0),
                AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
                BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                LayoutOrder = 3,
                Parent = column,
            })
            ai("UIListLayout", {
                FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal,
                SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
                Padding = UDim.new(0, 6),
                Parent = actions,
            })
            al(actions, 0, 0, 7, 0)
        end

        local closeBtn = ai("TextButton", {
            AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0),
            Position = UDim2.new(1, 4, 0, -3),
            Size = E and UDim2.fromOffset(28, 28) or UDim2.fromOffset(22, 22),
            BackgroundColor3 = z.Surface3,
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            BorderSizePixel = 0,
            Text = "",
            AutoButtonColor = false,
            Visible = closable,
            ZIndex = 3,
            Parent = body,
        })
        aj(closeBtn, UDim.new(0, 6))
        local closeIcon = ai("ImageLabel", {
            AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
            Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5),
            Size = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 12),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            ImageColor3 = z.Muted,
            ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit,
            ZIndex = 4,
            Parent = closeBtn,
        })
        local closeText = nil
        aq(closeIcon, "x")
        if closeIcon.Image == "" then
            closeIcon:Destroy()
            closeIcon = nil
            closeText = am({
                Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
                Text = "\u{d7}",
                TextSize = 18,
                FontFace = D.Bold,
                TextColor3 = z.Muted,
                TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center,
                TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.None,
                ZIndex = 4,
                Parent = closeBtn,
            })
        end

        local track = ai("Frame", {
            AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 1),
            Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 1),
            Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 3),
            BackgroundColor3 = z.Surface3,
            BackgroundTransparency = 0.4,
            BorderSizePixel = 0,
            Visible = not persist,
            ZIndex = 2,
            Parent = card,
        })
        local fill = ai("Frame", {
            Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
            BackgroundColor3 = tintColor(),
            BorderSizePixel = 0,
            Parent = track,
        })

        ---------------------------------------------------------------- appearance helpers
        local function setIcon(name)
            icon.Image = ""
            icon.ImageRectOffset = Vector2.zero
            icon.ImageRectSize = Vector2.zero
            if name then
                aq(icon, name)
            end
            local ok = icon.Image ~= ""
            icon.Visible = ok
            glyph.Visible = not ok
            glyph.Text = KIND_GLYPHS[kind] or "\u{2022}"
        end

        local function tint()
            local color = tintColor()
            ah(wash, { BackgroundColor3 = color }, 0)
            ah(rail, { BackgroundColor3 = color }, 0)
            ah(fill, { BackgroundColor3 = color }, 0)
            ah(badge, { BackgroundColor3 = z.Surface3:Lerp(color, 0.16) }, 0)
            ah(badgeStroke, { Color = color, Transparency = 0.72 }, 0)
            ah(glyph, { TextColor3 = color }, 0)
            ar(icon, color, true, 0)
        end

        local function layoutText()
            columnPad.PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, (contentText ~= nil or actions ~= nil) and 0 or 6)
        end

        local count = 1
        local function setCount()
            local reserve = closable and 26 or 0
            if count > 1 then
                chip.Text = "\u{d7}" .. math.min(count, 99)
                chip.Visible = true
                titleLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, -(reserve + 36), 1, 0)
            else
                chip.Visible = false
                titleLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, -reserve, 1, 0)
            end
        end

        setIcon(iconName)
        layoutText()
        ag(card, tint)

        ---------------------------------------------------------------- lifecycle
        local handle
        local kill
        local dead = false
        local hovering, dragging, moved = false, false, false
        local startX, dx = 0, 0
        local progTween, enterTween
        local moveConn, endConn, sizeConn

        local function sync(instant)
            if dead then
                return
            end
            local height = card.AbsoluteSize.Y
            if height <= 0 then
                return
            end
            local goal = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, height + GAP)
            if instant then
                slot.Size = goal
            else
                ah(slot, { Size = goal }, 0.3, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint)
            end
        end

        local function setPaused(paused)
            if not progTween or dead then
                return
            end
            if paused then
                if progTween.PlaybackState == Enum.PlaybackState.Playing then
                    progTween:Pause()
                end
            elseif progTween.PlaybackState == Enum.PlaybackState.Paused then
                progTween:Play()
            end
        end

        local function startProgress(seconds)
            if progTween then
                progTween:Cancel()
                progTween = nil
            end
            if persist or dead then
                return
            end
            fill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
            local mine = ah(fill, { Size = UDim2.fromScale(0, 1) }, seconds, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear)
            progTween = mine
            if mine then
                mine.Completed:Connect(function(state)
                    if state == Enum.PlaybackState.Completed and progTween == mine then
                        kill()
                    end
                end)
                if hovering or dragging then
                    mine:Pause()
                end
            end
        end

        function kill(swiped)
            if dead then
                return
            end
            dead = true
            for index, toast in ipairs(self._toasts) do
                if toast == handle then
                    table.remove(self._toasts, index)
                    break
                end
            end
            if moveConn then
                moveConn:Disconnect()
            end
            if endConn then
                endConn:Disconnect()
            end
            if sizeConn then
                sizeConn:Disconnect()
            end
            if progTween then
                progTween:Cancel()
            end
            if enterTween then
                enterTween:Cancel()
            end
            if swiped ~= true then
                ah(lane, { Position = slideOff }, 0.3, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint)
            end
            ah(card, { GroupTransparency = 1 }, 0.2)
            ah(stroke, { Transparency = 1 }, 0.15)
            ah(shadow, { ImageTransparency = 1 }, 0.2)
            task.delay(0.22, function()
                if not slot.Parent then
                    return
                end
                slot.ClipsDescendants = true
                ah(slot, { Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0) }, 0.24, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint)
                task.delay(0.26, function()
                    slot:Destroy()
                end)
            end)
            aJ(opts.OnDismiss)
        end

        local function bump(seconds)
            if dead then
                return
            end
            count += 1
            setCount()
            startProgress(seconds or duration)
            badgeScale.Scale = 1.22
            ah(badgeScale, { Scale = 1 }, 0.45, Enum.EasingStyle.Back)
            ah(stroke, { Color = tintColor() }, 0.08)
            task.delay(0.16, function()
                if not dead then
                    ah(stroke, { Color = z.Stroke }, 0.35)
                end
            end)
            if not dragging then
                lane.Position = E and UDim2.fromOffset(0, 5) or UDim2.fromOffset(-9, 0)
                ah(lane, { Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0) }, 0.4, Enum.EasingStyle.Back)
            end
        end

        ---------------------------------------------------------------- handle
        handle = {}
        local function argOf(a, b)
            if a == handle then
                return b
            end
            return a
        end
        handle.Dismiss = function()
            kill()
        end
        handle.Close = handle.Dismiss
        handle.IsAlive = function()
            return not dead
        end
        handle.Restart = function(a, b)
            local seconds = tonumber(argOf(a, b))
            startProgress(seconds and seconds > 0 and seconds or duration)
        end
        handle.Update = function(a, b)
            local new = argOf(a, b)
            if dead or type(new) ~= "table" then
                return
            end
            new = l(new, { Text = "Content", Message = "Content", Image = "Icon", Name = "Title" })
            if new.Title ~= nil then
                titleText = tostring(new.Title)
                titleLabel.Text = titleText
            end
            if new.Content ~= nil then
                contentText = tostring(new.Content)
                if contentText == "" then
                    contentText = nil
                end
                contentLabel.Text = contentText or ""
                contentLabel.Visible = contentText ~= nil
                layoutText()
            end
            if new.Type ~= nil then
                kind = kindName(new.Type)
            end
            if new.Color ~= nil then
                customColor = typeof(new.Color) == "Color3" and new.Color or nil
            end
            if new.Icon ~= nil then
                explicitIcon = true
                iconName = new.Icon
            elseif new.Type ~= nil and not explicitIcon then
                iconName = KIND_ICONS[kind] or "bell"
            end
            if new.Type ~= nil or new.Color ~= nil or new.Icon ~= nil then
                setIcon(iconName)
                tint()
            end
            handle._key = makeKey()
        end
        handle._key = makeKey()
        handle._alive = function()
            return not dead
        end
        handle._bump = bump

        ---------------------------------------------------------------- interaction
        local function paintClose(on)
            ah(closeBtn, { BackgroundTransparency = on and 0.4 or 1 }, 0.15)
            if closeIcon then
                ar(closeIcon, on and z.Text or z.Muted, true, 0.15)
            else
                ah(closeText, { TextColor3 = on and z.Text or z.Muted }, 0.15)
            end
        end
        closeBtn.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
            if not ax() then
                paintClose(true)
            end
        end)
        closeBtn.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
            paintClose(false)
        end)
        closeBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            kill()
        end)

        local interactive = { closeBtn }
        for index, spec in ipairs(buttons) do
            local primary = spec.Variant == "Primary" or spec.Style == "Primary" or spec.Primary == true
            local btn = ai("TextButton", {
                Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, E and 32 or 26),
                AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X,
                BackgroundColor3 = primary and z.Accent or z.Surface3,
                BackgroundTransparency = primary and 0.12 or 0.35,
                BorderSizePixel = 0,
                Text = "",
                AutoButtonColor = false,
                ClipsDescendants = true,
                LayoutOrder = index,
                Parent = actions,
            })
            aj(btn, UDim.new(0, 7))
            local btnStroke = ak(btn, primary and z.Accent or z.Stroke, primary and 0.4 or 0)
            al(btn, 11, 11, 0, 0)
            am({
                Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0),
                AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X,
                Text = tostring(spec.Title or spec.Name or spec.Text or "OK"),
                TextSize = 12,
                TextColor3 = primary and z.AccentDark or z.Text,
                TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center,
                TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.None,
                Parent = btn,
            })
            btn.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
                if ax() then
                    return
                end
                if primary then
                    ah(btn, { BackgroundTransparency = 0 }, 0.12)
                    ah(btnStroke, { Transparency = 0 }, 0.12)
                else
                    ah(btn, { BackgroundTransparency = 0.1 }, 0.12)
                    ah(btnStroke, { Color = z.StrokeHover }, 0.12)
                end
            end)
            btn.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
                if primary then
                    ah(btn, { BackgroundTransparency = 0.12 }, 0.2)
                    ah(btnStroke, { Transparency = 0.4 }, 0.2)
                else
                    ah(btn, { BackgroundTransparency = 0.35 }, 0.2)
                    ah(btnStroke, { Color = z.Stroke }, 0.2)
                end
            end)
            btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                if dead then
                    return
                end
                aE(btn, primary and z.AccentDark or z.Text)
                if spec.Keep ~= true then
                    kill()
                end
                aJ(spec.Callback, handle)
            end)
            table.insert(interactive, btn)
        end

        card.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
            hovering = true
            setPaused(true)
        end)
        card.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
            hovering = false
            if not dragging then
                setPaused(false)
            end
        end)
        card.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
            if dead or not aw(input) then
                return
            end
            local pointer = av()
            for _, item in ipairs(interactive) do
                if item.Visible and az(pointer, item) then
                    return
                end
            end
            dragging, moved, startX, dx = true, false, input.Position.X, 0
            if enterTween then
                enterTween:Cancel()
            end
            setPaused(true)
        end)
        moveConn = b.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
            if not dragging or dead or not aA(input) then
                return
            end
            dx = input.Position.X - startX
            if math.abs(dx) > 4 then
                moved = true
            end
            local shift = E and dx or math.max(dx, 0)
            lane.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(shift, 0)
            card.GroupTransparency = math.clamp(math.abs(shift) / 260, 0, 0.7)
        end)
        endConn = b.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
            if not dragging or not aw(input) then
                return
            end
            dragging = false
            if dead then
                return
            end
            if math.abs(dx) > 70 and (E or dx > 0) then
                ah(lane, { Position = UDim2.fromOffset(dx > 0 and 340 or -340, 0) }, 0.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint)
                kill(true)
                return
            end
            ah(lane, { Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0) }, 0.25, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint)
            ah(card, { GroupTransparency = 0 }, 0.2)
            if not moved and type(clickFn) == "function" then
                aJ(clickFn, handle)
                if opts.DismissOnClick ~= false then
                    kill()
                end
            elseif not hovering then
                setPaused(false)
            end
        end)
        sizeConn = card:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(function()
            sync()
        end)
        slot.Destroying:Connect(function()
            if moveConn then
                moveConn:Disconnect()
            end
            if endConn then
                endConn:Disconnect()
            end
            if sizeConn then
                sizeConn:Disconnect()
            end
        end)

        ---------------------------------------------------------------- show
        setCount()
        task.defer(function()
            sync()
        end)
        enterTween = ah(lane, { Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0) }, 0.5, Enum.EasingStyle.Back)
        ah(card, { GroupTransparency = 0 }, 0.3)
        ah(shadow, { ImageTransparency = 0.55 }, 0.4)
        ah(badgeScale, { Scale = 1 }, 0.5, Enum.EasingStyle.Back)
        startProgress(duration)

        table.insert(self._toasts, handle)
        while #self._toasts > (self.MaxNotifications or 4) do
            local oldest = table.remove(self._toasts, 1)
            if oldest and oldest.Dismiss then
                oldest.Dismiss()
            end
        end
        return handle
    end
    function a2:Destroy()
        if self._destroyed then
            return
        end
        self._destroyed = true
        pcall(k._host.Forget, self)
        if self._autoSave then
            pcall(self._autoSaveTick, self)
        end
        for cb, cc in ipairs(k.Windows) do
            if cc == self then
                table.remove(k.Windows, cb)
                break
            end
        end
        for cb, cc in ipairs(self._connections) do
            pcall(function()
                cc:Disconnect()
            end)
        end
        self._connections = {}
        self._inputListeners = { Began = {}, Changed = {}, Ended = {}, Render = {} }
        self._frameSteps = {}
        local cb = self.Gui
        local cc = false
        local function cd()
            if cc then
                return
            end
            cc = true
            if not pcall(cb.Destroy, cb) then
                pcall(function()
                    cb.Enabled = false
                end)
            end
        end
        local ce, cf = pcall(function()
            if self._dialog then
                self._dialog.Close()
            end
            self:_closePopups()
            local ce = self._fitScale or 1
            ah(self.Scale, { Scale = ce * 0.92 }, 0.22, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint)
            self:_fade(1, 0.2)
            ah(self.BodyStroke, { Transparency = 1 }, 0.12)
            ah(self.Shadow, { ImageTransparency = 1 }, 0.2)
            if self.MiniBar and self.MiniBar.Visible then
                ah(self.MiniBar, { GroupTransparency = 1 }, 0.18)
            end
            if self._backdrop then
                self._weatherField.Visible = false
                ah(self._backdropTintFrame, { BackgroundTransparency = 1 }, 0.2)
                ah(self._backdropHeat, { BackgroundTransparency = 1 }, 0.2)
            end
            for cf, cg in ipairs({ self.ToggleButton, self.OpenButton }) do
                if typeof(cg) == "Instance" and cg:IsA("GuiObject") then
                    ah(cg, { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0) }, 0.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint)
                end
            end
        end)
        if not ce then
            warn([[[AirFlow] unload animation failed, removing the window directly: ]] .. tostring(cf))
            cd()
            return
        end
        task.delay(0.24, cd)
    end
    a2.Unload = a2.Destroy
    function k:Destroy()
        for cb = #k.Windows, 1, -1 do
            local cc = k.Windows[cb]
            if cc then
                cc:Destroy()
            end
        end
    end
    k.Unload = k.Destroy
    local cb = getthreadidentity or getidentity or get_thread_identity or (syn and syn.get_thread_identity)
    local cc = setthreadidentity or setidentity or set_thread_identity or (syn and syn.set_thread_identity)
    local cd = nil
    if cb then
        local ce, cf = pcall(cb)
        if ce and type(cf) == "number" then
            cd = cf
        end
    end
    local function ce()
        local cf = k.Windows[#k.Windows]
        local cg = cf and cf.Gui
        if typeof(cg) ~= "Instance" then
            return false
        end
        return not pcall(function()
            return cg.Name
        end)
    end
    local cf = {}
    d.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        if #cf == 0 then
            return
        end
        local cg = cf
        cf = {}
        for ch, ci in ipairs(cg) do
            ci()
        end
    end)
    local function cg(ch, ...)
        local ci = table.pack(...)
        local cj = nil
        table.insert(cf, function()
            cj = table.pack(pcall(ch, table.unpack(ci, 1, ci.n)))
        end)
        while cj == nil do
            task.wait()
        end
        if not cj[1] then
            error(cj[2], 0)
        end
        return table.unpack(cj, 2, cj.n)
    end
    local ch = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
    local ci
    local function cj(ck)
        return function(...)
            if ce() then
                if cc then
                    pcall(cc, cd or 8)
                end
                if ce() then
                    return ci(cg(ck, ...))
                end
            end
            return ci(ck(...))
        end
    end
    function ci(...)
        for ck = 1, select("#", ...) do
            local cl = select(ck, ...)
            if type(cl) == "table" and not ch[cl] then
                local cm = getmetatable(cl)
                if cm ~= a2 and cm ~= aS then
                    ch[cl] = true
                    for cn, co in pairs(cl) do
                        if type(cn) == "string" and type(co) == "function" and cn:sub(1, 1) ~= "_" then
                            cl[cn] = cj(co)
                        elseif type(cn) == "number" and type(co) == "table" then
                            ci(co)
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        return ...
    end
    for ck, cl in ipairs({ k, a2, aS }) do
        for cm, cn in pairs(cl) do
            if type(cm) == "string" and type(cn) == "function" and cm:sub(1, 1) ~= "_" then
                cl[cm] = cj(cn)
            end
        end
    end
    return k
end)()
return a
